jobs.title: Temporary Researcher, Top Hospitals list
jobs.jd: Forbes is an iconic global media brand that has symbolized success for over a century. Fueled by journalism that informs and inspires, Forbes spotlights the doers and doings shaping industries, achieving success and making an impact on the world. Forbes connects and convenes the most influential communities ranging from billionaires, business leaders and rising entrepreneurs to creators and innovators. The Forbes brand reaches more than 140 million people monthly worldwide through its trusted journalism, signature ForbesLive events and 49 licensed local editions in 81 countries. Forbes is seeking a detail-oriented and efficient researcher who is skilled in Excel and has experience working with large datasets to contribute to the production of Forbes Top Hospitals 2027 list and rating system. This second-annual national hospital list will be published in early 2027 to serve as a credible resource for patients/consumers and the medical community. Responsibilities Fact-check each hospital name in our database (thousands of hospitals) to confirm or identify the most up-to-date and official hospital name. Confirm that each hospital profile page on Forbes.com corresponds to the accurate hospital name and Forbes ID. Ensure that each hospital’s information (i.e. address) is correct, and potentially fact-check which hospitals are tied to a given CMS facility ID (as determined by CMS, aka the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services). This will involve online research and calls to the hospitals for fact-checking. Assist with each hospital’s profile display / fact-check the ratings on the profiles. Assist with research and data entry details as needed. There is the possibility to contribute to the editorial package for this list, which could involve reporting and writing short articles on hospitals and healthcare topics. The ideal candidate Excellent research and reporting skills Meticulous fact-checker Highly skilled in keeping precise and detailed records Effective communicator Industrious problem-solver Capable of managing multiple tasks simultaneously Comfortable covering hospitals and healthcare Some experience with health/science reporting or a science/healthcare background a + Capable of researching scientific studies a + Some experience with content management systems a + The hourly rate for this role is $25.00 - $35.00 Forbes has estimated the compensation range set forth above in good faith. The compensation range is what we believe we will offer, and ultimately pay, a successful candidate. In determining this range, we consider the experience, level of education (if applicable to the role), knowledge, skills, and abilities required to be had by a successful candidate as well as the budget and the company’s pay rates, generally. This said, we may have to make changes to our compensation estimates and job descriptions from time to time and we expressly reserve the right to do so. Should we make any such changes, this advertisement will be revised to reflect such revisions. We encourage you to occasionally re-visit this advertisement to ensure that you are abreast of any changes. Thank you for your interest in joining Forbes! #LI-PM1 #LI-Remote This role may evolve over time. While this job description outlines the primary responsibilities, additional duties may be assigned as business needs change. Forbes aims to offer employees the flexibility they need in order to be successful. Some positions may require candidates to be based in a specific location for consideration while some roles may be fully remote (within the U.S.) if it aligns with the needs of the position. This position is only open to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, & Washington. Due to business operations and compliance requirements, we are unable to consider applicants based outside these states at this time. Forbes is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: DFIR Consultant - Remote (Anywhere in the U.S.)
jobs.jd: GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk. General Description The DFIR Consultant is a core technical contributor within GuidePoint Security’s Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) Practice. Working under the guidance of Senior and Principal Consultants, the DFIR Consultant performs investigations across a range of engagement types, produces clear and accurate analysis, and communicates findings effectively to clients while continuing to build depth across core DFIR disciplines. The DFIR Practice performs reactive incident response investigations, forensic investigations, proactive threat discovery and threat hunting, and Purple Team exercises (as Blue Team in collaboration with the GuidePoint Red Team). In this role you will apply your technical skills, creativity, and adaptability to deliver results to clients across a variety of sectors. About the DFIR & Threat Intelligence Practice The DFIR & Threat Intelligence Practice helps organizations prepare for, respond to, and recover from cyber incidents, turning front-line experience into intelligence that keeps clients ahead of the threat. Six specialized teams work as one across the full arc of an incident, from readiness planning through response, recovery, and threat research. We partner with client security and legal teams, cyber insurance carriers, breach counsel, and GuidePoint’s regional and sales organizations to cut dwell time and limit business impact. The six teams: DFIR (Digital Forensics & Incident Response) — Breach investigation, forensics, containment, and eradication when an incident is confirmed or suspected. IRA (Incident Response Advisory) — Readiness before an incident: IR planning, tabletop exercises, Blue Team enablement, and program maturity assessments. GRIT (GuidePoint Research and Intelligence Team) — Original threat research and intelligence that drives our investigations, Threat Actor communications, TI advisory, and as-a-Service capabilities. SD (Strategic Delivery) — Delivery management that keeps engagements staffed, on track, and consistent. R&R (Recovery & Restoration) — Post-incident rebuild that returns clients to safe, operational environments. Insurance & Counsel — The bridge to carriers and breach counsel through the claims and legal side of an incident. What sets us apart: one integrated practice carries a client through the whole lifecycle with no hand-off gaps, including the demanding parts of an engagement that most providers cannot cover in-house, from GRIT’s Threat Actor communications and negotiation support to R&R’s full environment restoration and coordination with insurers and counsel. GRIT’s research feeds live investigations so our response reflects how adversaries operate now, and established carrier and counsel relationships make GuidePoint a trusted partner across the incident response community. Roles and Responsibilities: Technical Execution & Engagement Delivery Investigation Execution: Perform DFIR investigations as a contributing technical resource, including host forensics, network traffic analysis, malware handling/triage, log review, and BEC analysis, under the direction of engagement leads. Engagement Communication: Support effective engagement communication, time management, and coordination throughout the investigative lifecycle. Deliverables: Produce clear, accurate engagement deliverables that detail technical findings, recommendations, business impact, and realistic remediation strategies for both technical and managerial audiences. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement Peer Collaboration: Collaborate with peers and engagement leads across concurrent engagements, sharing findings and coordinating to deliver consistent, high-quality results. Automation & Efficiency: Use scripting and automation to reduce manual processes and improve the efficiency of DFIR tasks. Skills Development: Continually strengthen relevant skills, knowledge, and abilities to grow across core DFIR disciplines and stay current with the information security industry. Client & Practice Contribution Client Support: Support client relationships by providing information and guidance during engagements and serving as a reliable technical contributor. Practice Contribution: Contribute to a perpetually evolving service portfolio driven by emerging threats and diverse client needs. Growth Mindset: Maintain a strong desire to learn, adapt, and improve alongside a rapidly growing company; perform other duties as assigned. Engagement & Availability Expectations The DFIR Consultant is held to a high standard for availability, initiative, and ownership. This includes: Maintaining availability outside standard business hours during high-severity incident surges. Participating in on-call rotation as appropriate for the role. Proactively surfacing gaps in engagement delivery, processes, or client communication to engagement leads. Setting an example of professionalism, urgency, and ownership on every engagement. Required Experience and Education: High School diploma and 5 years of experience, OR Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of experience, OR Master’s degree. Hands-on experience across core DFIR disciplines: host forensics, network traffic analysis, malware handling/triage, log review, and BEC analysis. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and managerial audiences. Creativity and adaptability to solve challenging problems in a rapidly changing environment. Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes. Preferred Experience and Education Prior experience in a consulting or professional services role. Experience with established DFIR methodology and process. Experience with a variety of industry-related solutions including EDR, NDR, XDR, SIEM, FW, NGAV, Velociraptor, and others. Proficiency with common programming and scripting languages including PowerShell, Python, Bash, Go, or similar. Experience with enterprise cloud technologies such as Amazon Web Services, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and Azure. Awareness of attacker techniques, advanced threat groups, and integration of threat intelligence into an investigation. Relevant industry certifications such as, but not limited to, GCFA, GCFE, GCIH, GCIA, GDAT, GREM, or CISSP. Travel Requirements: Up to 20% travel Physical Requirements: Sedentary work Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application. Why GuidePoint? GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers. Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance

jobs.title: Cloud Operations Support Specialist (Tier 2)
jobs.jd: Dark Wolf is seeking a Cloud Operations Support Specialist (Tier 2) to join our team and serve as an essential frontline escalation point for maintaining, monitoring, and operating our AWS cloud environments. In this role, you will handle Tier 1 escalations, monitor system health, manage incident response, oversee backups and capacity, and execute standard operational changes. Our support specialists solve real-time operational challenges for unique mission customers and play a vital role in ensuring the high availability, reliability, and security of critical cloud systems. Key Responsibilities: Serving as the primary Tier 2 escalation point for Tier 1 service desk tickets, diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues across AWS cloud environments before escalating to Tier 3 engineering. Proactively monitoring cloud infrastructure, service metrics, and system performance using AWS monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, CloudTrail) to detect and resolve alerts before impact occurs. Conducting routine checks of automated backup schedules, snapshot integrity, and storage/compute capacity; take corrective action or implement routine adjustments when thresholds are exceeded. Triaging, investigating, and resolving operational incidents in accordance with established SLAs; perform initial root cause analysis and document problem trends to prevent recurring outages. Executing approved standard changes, routine maintenance tasks, service restarts, access requests, and basic configuration updates following strict change-management procedures. Coordinating closely with Tier 1 support staff, Tier 3 Cloud Systems Engineers, and security personnel to provide seamless handoffs, operational feedback, and continuous documentation updates. Authoring and maintaining comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting runbooks, and Knowledge Base (KB) articles to empower Tier 1 resolution, streamline escalation paths, and capture lessons learned from incident triage. Required Qualifications: 2+ years of experience in IT help desk, technical support, systems operations, or a Tier 2 support role. Hands-on operational experience supporting services and basic infrastructure within Amazon Web Services (AWS) (e.g., EC2, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, VPC). Demonstrated experience handling incident, problem, and service request ticketing workflows within GitLab Proven track record monitoring system performance, resource utilization, and backup integrity in a cloud or hybrid environment. Solid baseline troubleshooting skills across Linux and/or Windows operating systems and basic cloud networking (DNS, routing, security groups). Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills, with experience creating standard operating procedures (SOPs) and knowledge base articles. US Citizen with an active Top Secret security clearance (or Secret with ability to obtain/maintain Top Secret, as required by customer contract). Desired Qualifications: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, or AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate. Relevant DoD 8570/8140 baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+, Network+, or CySA+). Familiarity with basic scripting (e.g., Bash, PowerShell, Python) for routine administrative queries or log parsing. Familiarity with Department of War (DoW) security controls, ticketing processes, or Air Force base operations. The estimated salary range for this position is $60,000.00 - $110,000.00, commensurate on experience and technical skillset. We are strictly looking for direct, full-time W2 employees. We do not engage with third-party staffing agencies, C2C, or 1099 independent contractors for this role. We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled and other protected categories. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity, confirm US Citizenship, and complete the required employment eligibility verification upon hire.

Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations. Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more. Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward! We are seeking a Marketing Operations Specialist to support product and delivery teams within a marketing and communications team . This role combines two disciplines. You will keep the marketing technology, data, and processes behind our campaigns running well, and you will drive agile delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams. The ideal candidate is an organized, hands-on operator who is comfortable working in marketing platforms and data, and who can also facilitate team ceremonies, manage competing priorities, and help teams deliver against evolving business goals. You will work independently and build strong relationships across product, marketing, creative, content, operations, and client stakeholder groups. jobs.title: Research Associate
jobs.jd: In Some Jobs You Take Orders. In This One, You Write History. Join the healthcare information technology team that’s turning drug and medical device data into knowledge used by thousands of hospitals, the majority of U.S. health plans, retail pharmacies and pharmacy benefit managers, and millions of health care decision-makers throughout the world. Partnering with our information system developer and healthcare institution customers, you’ll help evolve leading-edge thinking into reality and make a measurable difference in improving human health. We’re looking for people who are intelligent, productive, committed, willing and able to go above and beyond, passionate about making a difference, innovative and energized. You’ll play an essential role in a successful company’s continued growth. Are you ready for this exciting challenge? First Databank (FDB) is currently seeking a Research Associate to join the Editorial Content team . The Research Associate plays a critical role in accurately processing and maintaining pharmaceutical product data to support the integrity of the company’s healthcare knowledge base. The role requires someone who can work independently and collaboratively within a team environment, review manufacturer submissions, verify and enter product information, identify and resolve data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with established editorial standards and procedures. The role demands communication with manufacturers, customers, and internal stakeholders, and the ability to analyze, quality check, and maintain high-quality data. Success in this role depends on a commitment to accuracy, continuous process improvement, and adherence to evolving policies, work instructions, and quality standards. This position is based in our Carmel, IN office and follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation to work on-site at least three days per week. Responsibilities Review and process manufacturer submissions and other source information for inclusion in knowledge base content. Perform accurate data entry of coded and uncoded information into editorial systems. Analyze and resolve discrepancies identified in audits and reports, escalating when necessary. Conduct basic research, interpret findings, and apply editorial policies appropriately. Support team goals by collaborating, cross-training, and serving as a backup as needed. Take ownership of assigned work, ensuring accountability and accuracy. Required Skills Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey findings and issues. Solid IT literacy, including proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook). Demonstrated interest in working with systems, workflows, and process improvements to enhance operational efficiency. Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new systems, software applications, and evolving technologies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and data accuracy. Effective organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities. Attention to detail with consistent accuracy in data entry and review. Adaptability to hybrid work requirements and commitment to clear communication in both remote and in-office settings. Initiative, self-direction, and ability to use emerging tools, including artificial intelligence, to enhance workflow. Required Experience Strong aptitude for learning and working within editorial, database, and workflow management systems. Ability to follow work procedures, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy and productivity standards. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor of Science (BS) or Associate in Science (AS) in health or biological sciences. Certified Pharmacy Technician (PTCB certified) with at least 2 years of healthcare pharmacy technician experience. Experience or familiarity with automation tools, artificial intelligence (AI), or emerging technologies to support editorial workflows. Accommodations We are committed to an accessible application process. If you need an accommodation to apply, please contact accommodations@fdbhealth.com . This email address is for accommodation requests only. Benefits This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; a flexible spending account; paid holidays; paid time off; an employee assistance program; and other company benefits. Base Salary Range: $42,000 — $51,000 USD

jobs.jd:
Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. 

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.



Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it  —  someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years. 

 

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Data Science team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

 - Growth Marketing 

 - Product Development

 - AI & Automation

 - Strategic Partnerships 

 

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.



Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

 - No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc. 

 - No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals. 

 - Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end. 



What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

 - Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

 - Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

 - Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

 

Who You Are

 - First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?" 

 - Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

 - Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

 

What You'll Bring

 - 2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

 - Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

 - Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

 - Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

 

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

 
 

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Credit (Retros)
jobs.jd:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.


ABOUT THE TEAM

We’re part of Plaid’s Data organization, building models and insights that help millions of people better understand and grow their financial lives. We use Plaid’s unique financial data to help lenders make more informed decisions and build better credit experiences.

We partner across data science, engineering, product, and Go-to-Market to turn complex data into practical customer recommendations and scalable solutions. We value technical rigor, creativity, user empathy, and teamwork.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Data Scientist on the Credit team, you’ll apply quantitative analysis and deep credit expertise to help lenders make better use of cash flow insights. You’ll work across customer problems, credit policy, and data products—translating Plaid’s data into recommendations and insights that drive business impact and inform product direction.

Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:

 - Deep-dive into model performance for clients, triage issues, and identify opportunities to improve outcomes.

 - Analyze Plaid’s unique data to identify emerging credit risk signals and build and evaluate credit retrospectives.

 - Create tailored recommendations for clients based on their data and Plaid’s insights.

 - Build and maintain data pipelines, including ETL processes using tools such as dbt.

 - Develop metrics, alerts, and dashboards to monitor production machine learning model performance.

In this role, you will:

 - Own the process of developing hands-on recommendations for incorporating cash flow insights into lending decisions, using best practices for account-level decisioning.

 - Improve customer adoption of Plaid Insights through custom analysis tailored to each customer’s needs.

 - Serve as a subject matter expert on credit insights and credit policy implementation, supporting Data Science, Engineering, and Go-to-Market partners.

 - Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and data visualization to develop models and actionable insights.

 - Identify useful signals that can inform machine learning models.

 - Inform and influence Product and Engineering teams through clear analysis and presentations.



WHAT EXCITES YOU

 - Applying data science and credit expertise to real-world lending decisions.

 - Working with Plaid’s unique financial data to uncover emerging credit risk signals and create useful customer insights.

 - Helping lenders make more informed decisions with cash flow data and account-level recommendations.

 - Partnering across Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Go-to-Market to turn analysis into customer and product impact.

 - Working on high-impact problems that can improve financial access and outcomes.



WHAT EXCITES US

 - 2–5 years of industry experience in a financial services Data Science role.

 - Deep familiarity with SQL and Python.

 - Deep understanding of credit risk and the development of underwriting models.

 - Hands-on credit expertise building and maintaining credit policies for lenders.

 - Knowledge of the lending lifecycle and how to optimize each step, including marketing, acquisition, customer management, and collections or recoveries.

 - Demonstrated ability to make data-driven decisions.

 - Nice to have: Experience building data pipelines and automating ETL processes with dbt or similar tools.

jobs.jd:
ABOUT SOLACE

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-02-10/vcs-give-solace-health-1-billion-valuation-for-patient-advocacy-tech?accessToken=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzb3VyY2UiOiJTdWJzY3JpYmVyR2lmdGVkQXJ0aWNsZSIsImlhdCI6MTc3MDczMDg4MywiZXhwIjoxNzcxMzM1NjgzLCJhcnRpY2xlSWQiOiJUQThVUzhLR0NURzEwMCIsImJjb25uZWN0SWQiOiJBRDYxODI0MTc0ODM0MTk0QTRENUZFNzkwMzNGMDJGNSJ9.TE2pFUAOQAPMUXFlzoQ7zeJvctq7cSibbZqtIwhW-2U&leadSource=uverify+wall.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Solace, data isn't just about understanding the past; it's about predicting the future. We are a rapidly scaling startup where we work hard, move fast, and wear many hats.

The Solace Data Team is looking for a Data Scientist who excels at forecasting, prediction, and machine learning to help us anticipate patient needs and optimize our operations. Reporting directly to the VP of Data, you will have the opportunity to lead high-impact projects that directly influence our strategic decision-making.

In this role, you will go beyond descriptive analytics to build the predictive engines that drive our business. Whether you are forecasting operational volume, modeling patient risk, or designing rigorous A/B tests, you will bridge the gap between advanced statistics and practical business application, ensuring our models are robust, interpretable, and impactful.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build Predictive Models: Develop and refine machine learning models to solve critical business problems, such as predicting patient churn, estimating operational volume, or scoring advocate quality.

 - Drive Forecasting Rigor: Own the development of time-series forecasts that guide our capacity planning and resource allocation. You will help us anticipate "what comes next" with higher accuracy.

 - Design & Analyze Experiments: Lead the design and analysis of A/B tests and causal inference studies. You will ensure we measure the true impact of our product and operational changes.

 - Uncover Deep Insights: Apply advanced statistical methods to complex datasets to find patterns that simple reporting might miss. You will answer the "why" and "how" behind our most difficult questions.

 - Productionize Solutions: Work closely with Data Engineers to take your models from a local notebook to a production environment, ensuring they run reliably within our data infrastructure.

 - Communicate Complexity: Translate complex statistical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders. You will be the voice of statistical reason in strategic discussions.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Statistical Expertise: You have a strong background in statistics, probability, and mathematics (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time-series forecasting).

 - Python & ML Proficiency: You are fluent in Python and its data science ecosystem (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, NumPy). You write clean, reproducible code.

 - Forecasting Experience: You have hands-on experience with time-series analysis and forecasting techniques (e.g., ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing).

 - Advanced SQL: You can write complex queries to wrangle your own data from Snowflake without relying solely on others to prepare it for you.

 - Preferred Masters Degree or PHD: Data Science, Applied Science, or related fields.

 - Data Privacy Awareness: You understand the importance of protecting patient data. You are familiar with best practices for handling PHI and PII and ensuring privacy in your analysis.

 - Startup DNA: You are a self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity. You take ownership of problems and are willing to wear many hats to get the job done.


BONUS POINTS

 - Deployment Experience: Experience using tools like Docker, Airflow, or MLflow to deploy and monitor models in production.

 - Healthcare Experience: Experience working with healthcare or insurance claims data is a plus.

 - NLP & Unstructured Data: Experience applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to extract insights from unstructured text data.

 - Marketplace Matching: Experience designing matching algorithms or ranking systems for two-sided marketplaces.

 - dbt & Engineering Skills: Comfort reading or writing dbt models to understand the lineage of your data.

Applicants must be based in the United States.



Up for the Challenge? 

We look forward to meeting you.

jobs.title: Quant Risk Analyst - Derivatives & Clearing
jobs.jd:
ABOUT POLYMARKET

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform, where people trade on the outcomes of real-world events. As our markets, volumes, and derivative product suite grow, so does the sophistication of the risk infrastructure behind them. Our clearing and risk systems must operate with the rigor of a traditional clearinghouse while moving at the speed of a crypto-native trading platform.


THE ROLE

We're hiring a mid-level quantitative risk analyst to design and implement enterprise-scale risk models at the heart of our clearing operation. You'll own models for market risk, volatility and correlation of derivatives, stress testing, and automated liquidation — the systems that keep the platform solvent and users protected in fast-moving markets.

This is a hands-on role: you'll be building models in production code, not just specifying them. We expect you to work fluently with AI tools for development and research — and to be the skeptic in the room, pressure-testing AI-generated models and code against well-established risk frameworks before anything ships.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-scale risk models covering market risk, margin, and counterparty exposure for a clearing organization.

 - Build volatility and correlation models for derivatives, including calibration, backtesting, and ongoing model validation.

 - Develop and run stress-testing frameworks: historical scenarios, hypothetical shocks, and reverse stress tests.

 - Design and tune auto-liquidation logic — trigger thresholds, liquidation waterfalls, and safeguards against cascading liquidations.

 - Use AI tools extensively to accelerate model development, coding, and research — and rigorously validate AI outputs against established risk models (VaR/ES, SPAN-style margining, GARCH-family volatility models, standard correlation frameworks) before deployment.

 - Monitor model performance in production, investigate breaks, and iterate quickly.

 - Partner with engineering, trading, and product teams to embed risk controls into platform architecture.

 - Document model assumptions, limitations, and validation results to an audit-ready standard.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5–7 years of quantitative risk experience at a clearinghouse, exchange, prime broker, trading firm, or similar.

 - Proven expertise designing and implementing risk models at enterprise scale — production systems, not just research prototypes.

 - Deep experience modeling volatility, correlation, option skews, option pricing and implementing at scale for trad-fi derivatives, perpetuals, and fully collateralized event contracts.

 - Hands-on experience with market risk modeling, stress testing, and auto-liquidation mechanics in a clearing context.

 - Strong fluency with AI-assisted development and coding, paired with the judgment to pressure-test AI outputs against well-established risk models and catch what looks plausible but is wrong.

 - Expert-level Python (numerical stack: NumPy, pandas, SciPy; solid software engineering practices).

 - Advanced degree in a quantitative field (math, statistics, physics, financial engineering, CS) or equivalent experience.

 - Strong mathematical foundation in stochastic calculus and linear algebra.


NICE TO HAVE

 - C# and/or C++ for performance-critical or production systems.

 - Familiarity with crypto market structure, perpetuals, or prediction markets.

 - Experience with CCP risk frameworks (CPMI-IOSCO PFMI, default management, margin methodology).

 - Experience building real-time risk systems.


PAY TRANSPARENCY

Base salary range: $400,000 to $450,000, plus equity and benefits.

This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.


LOCATION & WORK SETUP

This role is based in our New York City office, in person. You'll be working directly alongside the trading, engineering, and risk teams.

jobs.title: Workplace Operations - New York
jobs.jd:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

This is an exciting opportunity to anchor ElevenLabs' New York office -our second-largest hub. As Workplace Operations lead for our SoHo space, you'll be the go-to person for our rapidly growing US team and a central hub for the New York AI community.

You'll own the day-to-day workplace experience: keeping operations running smoothly, maintaining white-glove standards, and driving initiatives that elevate employee experience, optimize costs, and scale our infrastructure as we grow. You'll ensure our office is a place where people love to work. This fully in-office role is based in SoHo with on-site presence.

Perfect for a proactive, high-energy individual who thrives at the center of the action and wants to grow their career in a fast-paced AI company.

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Be the Hub & Culture Driver: Serve as the main point of contact for the office, welcoming guests, leading onboarding, and boosting team culture through curated food/beverage programs, social rituals, and office perks.

 - Run Daily Operations & Vendors: Manage all day-to-day workplace logistics—including cleaning, maintenance, security, and shipping—while owning vendor relationships from contract negotiations to performance management.

 - Optimize Space & Landlord Relations: Partner with building management to maintain facilities, establish white-glove service standards, and manage ongoing space planning, floor plans, and seating charts to support a growing team.

 - Support Events & VIP Visitors: Coordinate logistics for internal and external events—such as AI hackathons, team offsites, and all-hands meetings—while ensuring a high-touch, premium experience for visiting executives and clients.

 - Own Onboarding & Internal Comms: Partner with People Ops to continuously improve the local onboarding experience (tours, swag), manage all office-related communications, and maintain clear SOPs and workplace documentation to ensure a seamless experience as the team grows.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - Based in New York, able to be in the office 5 days a week.

 - Strong operational expertise in managing the day-to-day running of a high visibility office. Thrives in high pressure environments requiring solid judgement and quick decision making.

 - Experience acting as the primary point of contact for building management, coordinating with vendors, and overseeing office maintenance and supplies.

 - Ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from senior executives and legal partners to vendors and office guests, ensuring a professional and welcoming environment.

 - A proactive and forward-thinking approach, with a proven ability to anticipate needs, identify inefficiencies, and implement new processes to improve workflow in a fast-paced environment.

 - Experience in fostering a positive and productive office environment, including planning and executing office-wide events and negotiating with vendors to ensure high-quality service and cost-effectiveness.
   
   


WHY THIS ROLE?

This is an exciting opportunity to lead operations at one of the world’s top AI companies. You’ll have the autonomy to shape our local culture, scale a critical hub, and directly impact how our team and the broader AI community experience ElevenLabs every day.



We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Sales Finance Operations Analyst
jobs.jd:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
The Finance Team supports and empowers Palantirians through day-to-day operations and creative problem-solving. The International Tax Manager is responsible for supporting the company’s direct and indirect tax compliance and reporting across multiple jurisdictions worldwide. This role requires a strong analytical mindset and technical background with the ability to navigate complex and evolving tax matters with a practical business-oriented approach. The ideal candidate is detail oriented, solutions driven and comfortable working cross functionally to support accurate compliance, effective risk management and scalable tax processes.
 Own process and workflow optimization — proactively identify inefficiencies and gaps in forecasting, reporting, and deal tracking processes. Develop and implement improvements that enhance speed, accuracy, and cross-team collaboration. Drive automation and tool development — lead initiatives to automate manual workflows, build dashboards and reporting tools, and reduce ad hoc analysis burden. Leverage AI and automation tools to drive efficiency across Sales Finance processes. Partner with Finance Systems and Engineering teams as needed. Turn ad hoc Revenue strategy and performance requests from leadership into scalable workflows — provide the immediate analytical support, identify recurring questions or patterns, and build repeatable processes or tools to address them and reduce future one-off requests. Support the Deal Desk team during peak activity periods, particularly quarter-end close. Streamline and improve closeout workflows and ensure timeliness and accuracy. Collaborate with forecasting team — work closely with the forecasting analyst to ensure that process improvements integrate seamlessly with weekly execution. Bachelor’s in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related discipline. 3+ years in finance operations, process improvement, systems implementation, or sales operations. Comfortable operating in both strategic and tactical modes—designing improvements and executing operationally. High ownership and execution bias — sees problems and takes personal accountability for solutions from conception through implementation. Salary
 
The salary range for this position is estimated to be $95,000 - $160,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual's relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.
 


Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies.
 
Benefits
 
•  Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance
•  Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance
•  Commuter benefits
•  Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based
•  2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs)
•  10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year
•  Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events
•  Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents
•  Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation
•  Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child
•  Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan
 
Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. Palantir is committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

If you would like to understand more about how your personal data will be processed by Palantir, please see our Privacy Policy.

CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. Computer Forensic Analysis : hands-on experience using forensic analysis tools in incident response investigations to determine the extent and scope of compromise. Systems Administration : hands-on experience administering networks and resolving connectivity, authentication, and configuration issues across small to large enterprise environments. Network Analysis Fundamentals : strong working knowledge of network protocols and analysis tools, with experience analyzing network traffic to support incident investigations. Identity Platform Awareness : experience working with identity and access management platforms such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and similar enterprise technologies. Email Security Awareness : experience investigating Microsoft 365 security incidents, including business email compromise (BEC) and adversary-in-the-middle (AITM) attacks. Third-Party Log Analysis : working knowledge of log sources across cloud platforms, network devices, identity providers, email platforms, and other enterprise technologies, with experience conducting investigation and triage within a SIEM platform. Incident Remediation : basic understanding of surgical remediation actions needed to contain threats across compromised hosts, including third-party platform containment measures. Network Operations and Architecture/Engineering : working knowledge of secure network architecture and hands-on experience troubleshooting and navigating network environments. Programming/Scripting : experience with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash to support investigation workflows or automate repetitive tasks. AI Fundamentals : experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. Bonus Points: Capable of completing technical tasks without supervision. Desire to grow and expand both technical and soft skills. Ability to foster a positive work environment and attitude. Requirements Must be willing to work 4x10 schedule, including a day on the weekend. Education: BA or BS / MA or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Math, Information Security, Information Assurance, Information Security Management, Intelligence Studies, Cybersecurity, Cybersecurity Policy, or a related field. Applicants without a degree but with relevant work experience and/or training will be considered. #LI-RC2 #LI-Remote Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike: Market leader in compensation and equity awards Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge Paid parental and adoption leaves Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections Vibrant office culture with world class amenities Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.jd: Career Area: Sales Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. The Site Analytics team within Mining Solutions’ Cat Solutions & Services (CS&S) organization develops end-to-end productivity solutions for quarry and mining customers, transforming operational data into actionable insights that improve site performance, cost per ton, efficiency, and sustainability. As a Product Consultant - Site Performance & Productivity Optimization , you will connect customer data, equipment, technology, and site operations to business results. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers and internal teams, you will apply data analysis, modeling, simulation, and product application expertise to identify performance opportunities and recommend practical solutions. You will also support go-to-market and sales execution while contributing technical expertise to the continued development of the Site Analytics offering. What Makes This Role Exciting This role combines mining operations, technology, and analytics to deliver meaningful customer impact, while giving you the opportunity to influence both site performance and the future of a growing service. Deliver measurable customer impact. Help customers improve production, operating efficiency, and cost per ton by turning complex operational data into actionable recommendations. Work at the leading edge of mining productivity. Apply data, modeling, simulation, and technology to solve real-world challenges across mining and quarry operations. Build global partnerships. Work directly with customers, dealers, technology partners, and Caterpillar teams to solve complex operational challenges. Shape what comes next. Contribute your expertise to new performance models, visualizations, technology integrations, and approaches that expand the value of Site Analytics. Turn analysis into measurable customer value: Conduct product performance studies and assess jobsite efficiency; identify, evaluate, and track the financial impact of performance improvements; and present actionable recommendations to customer leadership. Value Selling: You qualify opportunities based on real customer needs, show clear value beyond the product itself, and coach others to do the same. Products and Services: You know how our offerings connect across Caterpillar and can explain features, delivery options, and updates clearly. Critical Thinking: You gather and organize the right data, weigh risks and alternatives, and help the team reach sound decisions. Communication: You turn complex analysis into clear presentations and reports, skip the jargon when it isn't needed, and give and take feedback constructively. Relationship Management: You build strong working relationships with customers, technology partners, and peers. You respond quickly, monitor satisfaction, raise issues early, and work through critical problems together. Top Candidates Will Also Have: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics, or a related discipline, or substantial progressively responsible experience in a closely related field. Demonstrated experience with data analysis, modeling, and simulation, particularly in quarry, aggregates, mining, heavy equipment, or comparable industrial environments. jobs.jd: Job Summary The Red Hat Consulting team is looking for an Architect focused on Red Hat Cloud Products to join us in Raanana. In this role, you will specialize in the design and development of cloud-ready Infrastructure and application architectures, including automated container platforms, deployment pipelines. You'll lead the on-site implementation of Red Hat's technologies like Red Hat OpenShift, Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation, Red Hat Smart Management and Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform. You'll play a key role in the enterprise development of our customers, helping make our solutions both practical and workable for their businesses. You'll work to gain an understanding of customer infrastructure and business needs, make recommendations that resolve their issues, and help them make strategic decisions. As a Cloud Architect, you will help customers build enterprise applications and capabilities around cloud technologies to streamline development and allow for continuous feature release of Infrastructure and applications. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. jobs.jd: Job Description & Summary PwC, cabinet pluridisciplinaire, rassemble 7 000 collaborateurs en France et au Maghreb, au sein d’un réseau mondial de plus de 364 000 personnes dans 136 pays. jobs.jd: Job Description: Zur Unterstützung des IT Operation- und Kubernetes Teams sucht Airbus Defence and Space einen IT Operations & Cloud Platform Specialist (d/m/w) Als IT Operations & Cloud Platform Specialist (d/m/w) übernehmen Sie die Schlüsselrolle an der Nahtstelle zweier Technologie-Generationen: In einem 50/50-Hybridmodell steuern Sie sowohl moderne Cloud-Native-Plattformen als auch hochverfügbare Enterprise-Datacenter-Lösungen. Sie arbeiten in einem spezialisierten Team, tragen echte End-to-End-Verantwortung und schaffen die Plattformbasis für hunderte geschäftskritische Anwendungen. Dein Standort Unser Standort ist nur einen Katzensprung von München, der schönen Landeshauptstadt von Bayern, entfernt. Du magst Sport und andere Outdoor-Aktivitäten? Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien. Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical) Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 1. Cloud Platforms & Container Operations (50%) Plattformbetrieb & GitOps: Sie betreiben, warten und skalieren unsere Managed-Container-Services auf Basis von Red Hat OpenShift und Kubernetes – sowohl in Standardumgebungen als auch in isolierten, hochsicheren Zonen ( air-gapped / restricted ). Site Reliability Engineering (SRE): Sie überwachen Kernmetriken (Latenzen, Uptime, Fehlerraten via Prometheus & Grafana), halten SLOs verlässlich ein und reduzieren operativen Routineaufwand ( Toil ) durch konsequente Automatisierung. DevSecOps & Entwicklungsschnittstelle: Sie etablieren Best Practices für Container-Sicherheit, steuern das Schwachstellenmanagement ( Vulnerability Management ) und unterstützen Entwicklerteams bei der nahtlosen Integration moderner CI/CD-Pipelines. Entry into Service: Als technischer Sparringspartner begleiten Sie die Inbetriebnahme neuer Container-Applikationen von der Konzeption bis zur Produktion. 2. Infrastructure & Compute Operations (50%) Enterprise Hardware Lifecycle: Sie übernehmen die ganzheitliche Betreuung, Wartung und Entstörung unserer physischen Serverlandschaft (HPE ProLiant, Synergy Frames, OneView), inklusive Firmware-Updates und Hardware-Komponententausch. Virtualisierung & Datacenter: Sie verantworten Administration, Patching, Skalierung und tiefes Troubleshooting für hochverfügbare Umgebungen auf Basis von VMware vSphere (ESXi, vCenter) sowie Nutanix. ITIL-Prozesse in der Praxis: Sie steuern die täglichen operativen IT-Prozesse souverän – von der schnellen Störungsbeseitigung (Incident Management) über fundierte Ursachenanalysen (Problem Management) bis hin zu Changes mit minimaler Ausfallzeit. Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery: Sie überwachen Backup- und Replikationsprozesse und leiten Disaster-Recovery-Tests, um im Ernstfall schnellste Wiederherstellungszeiten zu garantieren. Gewünschte Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen Fundierte Basis: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Systemtechnik oder eine vergleichbare IT-Ausbildung (z. B. Fachinformatiker/in für Systemintegration) mit mehrjähriger Praxis im Enterprise-IT-Betrieb. Die perfekte Kombination: Mehrjährige operative Erfahrung im Betrieb von produktiven Kubernetes- / OpenShift-Clustern. Zeitgleich tiefgehendes Praxiswissen in der Administration von VMware vSphere und Nutanix. Hardware-Kompetenz: Praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit physischer Rechenzentrums-Hardware (idealerweise HPE Compute / Synergy / ProLiant) inklusive Wartung und Firmware-Management. Prozess-Sicherheit: Sicheres Verständnis und gelebte Praxis von ITIL-Serviceprozessen bei Ausfällen und Eskalationen in kritischen Umgebungen. Sprachkenntnisse: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für die Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Schnittstellen Teams. Kein 100%iges Match? Kein Grund zur Sorge! jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.jd: Starting from £45,500, salary depending on skills and experience 37 hours a week, Permanent Lincoln or Huntingdon office / Hybrid working Love Every Drop. At Anglian Water, we're transforming the way we deliver services for our customers, communities and the environment. To support this, we're looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our Performance team. We’re looking for a structured, detail-oriented Business Analyst with proven experience delivering business analysis within Waterfall project environments , who can bring clarity, challenge and insight to complex pieces of work. You’ll be confident engaging with stakeholders, understanding business problems, analysing processes, shaping requirements, and supporting delivery teams to design and validate solutions that meet real business needs. What you'll be doing As a Business Analyst, you'll support the successful delivery of projects through the capture, analysis and management of business and technical requirements. Acting as the bridge between stakeholders and delivery teams, you'll ensure solutions are aligned to business needs and provide clear direction throughout delivery. Your responsibilities will include: Leading requirements elicitation and analysis activities, workshops and stakeholder engagement sessions. Producing high-quality business analysis artefacts and detailed upfront requirements documentation. Creating and maintaining requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle. Identifying opportunities to improve processes and deliver better business outcomes. Developing AS-IS and TO-BE process maps using BPMN 2.0 standards. Defining and validating both functional and non-functional requirements, including security, performance, usability and reporting requirements. Supporting solution design reviews to ensure requirements are fully understood and met. Supporting testing, business validation and user acceptance testing activities. Managing requirements throughout the project lifecycle in a controlled and structured manner. Working collaboratively with stakeholders, architects, project managers, technical teams and business subject matter experts. Essential experience Proven Business Analyst experience within Waterfall project environments, including producing detailed upfront requirements documentation and maintaining requirements traceability. Agile experience is welcome, but candidates must also have demonstrable Waterfall delivery experience. Significant experience eliciting, analysing, validating, and documenting detailed upfront requirements, supported by high-quality business analysis artefacts. Experience managing requirements throughout the full project lifecycle, including maintaining traceability and supporting controlled change. Experience validating solution designs against agreed business and functional requirements. Ability to work independently, manage their own workload, and bring structure and clarity to ambiguous or complex pieces of work. Strong process mapping experience, specifically using BPMN 2.0. Experience facilitating requirements workshops and stakeholder engagement sessions. Confidence working with business stakeholders and technical/delivery teams to ensure requirements are understood, agreed, and delivered. Experience defining and validating non-functional requirements, such as security, performance, usability, and reporting. Experience supporting testing and business validation activities to ensure solutions meet agreed requirements. Desirable BCS Business Analysis qualification. Experience working within a regulated environment where governance, assurance and documentation standards are critical. Experience supporting large-scale business transformation initiatives. Experience working within utility, infrastructure or similarly regulated sectors. What's in it for you? At Anglian Water, you'll be part of a purpose-driven organisation that's committed to innovation, sustainability and delivering exceptional service to our customers. We offer: 26 days annual leave plus bank holidays (increasing with length of service) Flexible working options Private healthcare Competitive pension scheme. Anglian Water double-matches contributions up to 7% Life assurance at eight times your salary Annual bonus scheme Personal accident cover Virtual GP service Selection Process As part of the recruitment process, shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a practical business analysis assessment designed to showcase their approach to requirements gathering, analysis and problem-solving. When applying, please give clear examples of your experience producing detailed requirements and maintaining traceability within Waterfall or similarly structured project delivery environments Why apply? jobs.jd: We are seeking a highly skilled Payroll Analyst to support complex U.S. payroll operations with sound judgment, technical payroll expertise, and a continuous improvement mindset. This role is responsible for delivering accurate, compliant payroll while reducing risk, strengthening controls, improving processes, and enhancing the employee experience. The successful candidate will be curious, analytical, and comfortable partnering across Payroll, HR, Finance, Benefits, Tax, Technology, vendors, and business stakeholders to solve problems, support payroll-related projects and implementations, influence change, and drive meaningful business impact The best Payroll Analysts do more than process payroll. They improve it by preventing errors, solving root causes, improving controls, reducing manual work, and delivering measurable results. Position Responsibilities: Payroll Operations, Compliance & Analysis Independently process, audit, and validate high-volume payroll accurately and on time across multiple jurisdictions, legal entities, pay groups, and payroll cycles. Handle escalated payroll support cases, including complex employee, manager, HR, and vendor inquiries requiring research, judgment, and timely resolution. Lead complex payroll activities, including equity compensation, executive payroll, deferred compensation, board payments, mobile employee payroll, relocation, annual compensation, bonus cycles, taxable benefits, and special tax treatment items. Lead quarterly and year-end activities, including reconciliations, audits, amended filings, adjustments, taxable benefit reporting, and employee reporting requirements. Research and resolve complex payroll, tax, and benefits issues while applying federal, state, local, and other regulatory requirements. Investigate payroll discrepancies, determine root causes, and recommend sustainable solutions. Testing, Controls & Continuous Improvement Support payroll system, configuration, integration, and process changes through structured end-to-end testing and validation. Develop test scripts, scenarios, and validation plans, including regression, integration, parallel, negative, and exception testing. Anticipate edge cases and confirm that results align with business requirements. Document testing outcomes, defects, risks, and recommendations. Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, standardize, and strengthen payroll processes and controls. Create and maintain process documentation, job aids, and operating procedures while contributing to projects that reduce risk and support scalable payroll operations. Technology & AI Enablement Use Workday, ADP GlobalView, SAP-based payroll tools, and related technologies to support payroll delivery, integrations, and issue resolution. Support and troubleshoot inbound and outbound payroll integrations, including retirement plans, deferred compensation, benefits, withholding, garnishments, tax filings, and workers' compensation reporting. Use approved AI, automation, reporting, and productivity tools to improve research, reconciliations, documentation, testing, analysis, process mapping, and communications. Identify practical technology and workflow improvements while protecting confidential data, validating outputs, maintaining human review, and ensuring payroll compliance. Partnership & Team Impact Build strong partnerships with Benefits, Pension, Compensation, Finance, Tax, Technology, and external vendors. Communicate complex payroll concepts in clear, business-friendly language. Share knowledge, support teammates, and contribute to a culture of learning and continuous improvement. Influence positive change through expertise, credibility, and collaboration. Experience with ADP GlobalView, SAP, or similar enterprise payroll systems. Advanced Excel and data analysis skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently with minimal direction, and collaborate effectively within a team environment. Preferred Qualifications: CPP, FPC, or similar payroll certification. Experience supporting international payroll operations, including expatriate payroll, mobile employees, cross-border taxation, and related compliance requirements across jurisdictions such as Canada, the United Kingdom, and Hong Kong. Assist the team with the maintenance of the control environment, to ensure it is fit for purpose and meets regulatory requirements. Work collaboratively with colleagues and take personal accountability to maintain and enhance controls. jobs.jd: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This role ensures that RDT invests in projects, products, and initiatives that drive the highest business value, accelerating the speed of getting medicines to patients through enterprise thinking and cross-portfolio awareness. Guide Strategic Alignment: Work with function leaders to translate business priorities to function or enterprise initiatives based on established guardrails. Business Domain Expertise: Use strategic agility to help teams focus on business value while aligning with the strategic initiatives of both business and RDT leadership. Drive Common Value Framework: Partner with RDT functions and business stakeholders to define strategic priorities and ensure the Value Framework is used consistently to prioritize work. Governance & Investment Management Drive Strategic Portfolio Management: Lead the governance body for your specific function, aligning senior business and RDT leaders on how to allocate the functional budget across business or enterprise portfolios. Drive Functional Portfolio Management: Oversee governance at the sub-function level, ensuring that critical business cases are realized and that intended benefits are tracked. The "Strategic Equalizer": facilitate balancing investments across products and services within your function, ensuring the portfolio remains resilient and focused on outcomes. Portfolio Execution and Transparency Manage Portfolio Risks: Proactively identify, highlight, and enable risk management across the portfolio to minimize project failures related to delays or budget overruns.
