jobs.title: Analyst, KYC
jobs.jd: Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count? Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world. With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career. Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded. About the role: In your role as Analyst, your purpose and objective of your role in the GCIB KYC team is conducting customer identifications and due-diligences prior to on-board new customer, as well as ongoing monitoring of our customer’s money laundering risk profiles in accordance with internal and regulatory requirements. The GCIB KYC team will work closely with the GCIB coverage team and MUFG’s Financial Crime divisions and follow appropriate channels to ensure each customer is on-boarded in accordance with our requirements, with any issues identified and dealt with appropriately. Responsible for completing the identification process, including sanction screening, negative press assessment and corruption allegations for all authorised individuals as required in accordance with relevant AML / CTF laws. For existing customers, the team will monitor our customer’s money laundering risk regularly as well as conducting periodic KYC reviews within the allocated time schedule. What you’ll be doing: New Customer On-boarding – When on-boarding any new customers, prior to providing designated banking services, the Analyst will perform customer identification and due-diligence processes to assess their money laundering risk profile to on-board any new customers prior to provide designated banking services. Post On-boarding Process - After on-boarding is complete, the Analyst will continue to monitor our customer’s money laundering risk under the framework stipulated in our internal policies and procedures. Any detection of customer’s profile changes potentially impacting their money laundering risk, the Analyst is required to process customer due-diligence and identification as an extra-ordinary review. Apart from an extra-ordinary review, the Analyst will conduct a regular periodical KYC review in accordance with schedule set out in our internal policies. Quality Control – As part of ‘in progress’ review, designated team members conduct cross check KYC due diligence reports prepared by other team members prior to submission for approval. What we are looking for: 1 + years experience in the compliance, banking, accounting, legal, consultancy, regulatory or any equivalent sectors Experience in AML / KYC fields is considered favourably Economics / Finance / Business and Commerce / Accounting / Law Degree from a leading university is essential ACAMS / CPA / CA or a relevant Masters qualification will be considered favourably Possess a general understanding of financial business, economy and markets Proficiency in Microsoft Office in particular, MS Word, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint Be able to engage in independent research and analysis of customers, regulations and banking products The ability to communicate clearly both in writing and verballyYou will have strong interpersonal and presentations skills Will be a team player Will be a self-starter with drive, initiative and enthusiasm Our culture: MUFG fosters a highly professional, supportive work environment that enables our employees to help maximize our customers' prosperity. We focus on building long-term customer relationships and giving back to our communities in order to develop shared and sustainable growth for a better world. Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.

jobs.title: Research Associate I
jobs.jd: Category: Science Lab/Area: Bruneau Lab Description: Who we are: At Gladstone Institutes, every role contributes to discoveries that have the potential to transform lives. Gladstone is a world-renowned independent, nonprofit biomedical research organization dedicated to solving some of the most challenging diseases affecting humanity. Our scientists are leaders in neuroscience, cardiovascular disease, immunology, stem cell biology, and emerging areas of biomedical innovation. Located in San Francisco's vibrant Mission Bay research hub, Gladstone brings together exceptional researchers, clinicians, and professionals who share a common goal: improving human health through science. With approximately 600 employees, we offer the agility of an independent institute combined with the impact of a globally recognized research organization. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where employees are encouraged to grow professionally while contributing to work that truly matters. About the Role: The laboratory of Benoit Bruneau at the Gladstone Institutes ( http://bruneaulab.gladstone.org ) is searching for a Research Associate (RA) to help us study the regulation of genes during heart development, using mouse models in vivo and stem cells in vitro. There is a potential for one or two publications within a two-year time period. Candidates with plans for graduate school, medical school or dental school are encouraged to apply. What You Will Do: We are looking for a research associate whose primary role will focus on culturing induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) and performing molecular biology techniques to understand gene expression regulation during in vitro cardiac differentiation. iPSC culture: maintain and expand iPSC lines, including routine passaging, freezing, and thawing of cells Differentiation protocols: use differentiation protocols to generate cardiomyocytes, ensuring consistency and reproducibility, and checking differentiation efficiency by flow cytometry Molecular biology techniques: perform molecular biology techniques such as PCR, RT-qPCR, and western blotting to analyze gene expression and protein levels Use sequencing techniques such as RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, and ATAC-seq to investigate gene regulation and epigenetic changes in iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes Analyze experimental and sequencing data, and interpret results Updates records and log books and assists in maintaining lab records and inventory Assist in lab management functions including ordering reagents, organizing laboratory inventory What You Will Need: Associate's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong work ethic Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to multitask Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team setting. What Is Preferred: BA/BS in Biological sciences and at least 6 months practical experience in a research laboratory (preferred) iPSC or cell culture Flow cytometry Molecular biology skills such as PCR, western blotting, RT-qPCR Lab management (ordering, restocking, database maintenance) Additional Skills R or python programming (or equivalent) Experience with next-generation sequencing, e.g., RNA-seq, ChIP-seq CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing Proficiency in Excel, Word, ImageJ Fiji, Photoshop and Illustrator Salary Range: $28.91/hr. ($60,147) - $33.32/hr. ($69,307) Gladstone Perks & Benefits People –work with talented, committed, and supportive teammates within an organization that values each member of its community. A meaningful place to grow and learn –whether it’s your professional skills or scientific knowledge, we have the resources and environment to advance either so you can better support Gladstone’s mission to drive a new era of discovery in disease-oriented science and to mentor tomorrow’s leaders in an inspiring and excellent environment. Healthy work/life balance –you are highly engaged and productive at work because you can have time to recharge and enjoy a vibrant life outside of work. Compensation –competitive salary. Title and salary will be commensurate with education and experience. Excellent benefits –generous medical, dental, vision, retirement plan, paid vacation, commuter benefits, access to free shuttle transportation. ​ Gladstone is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, sex, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, medical condition, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other non-job related characteristic. jobs.title: Logistics Planning
jobs.jd: About AbbVie AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook , Instagram , X and YouTube. The Customer Logistics Planner is the execution and control hub for outbound shipments in the Gaucho third-party manufacturing model. The role coordinates end-to-end order and shipment execution from second-leg stock transport order creation through shipment departure, documentation archiving, exception resolution and stakeholder communication. The planner helps protect supply continuity and customer service by maintaining accurate system transactions, compliant shipping documentation, timely visibility and early escalation of risks. The Customer Logistics Planner owns shipment execution and visibility within the Shipment CoE, while Transportation retains ownership of carrier strategy, transportation procurement and carrier management. Key responsibilities Order and delivery execution: Create and manage second-leg STOs and outbound deliveries in SAP; update weights and measurements using the Nota Fiscal; create packing lists; post goods issue for departed shipments; and provide accurate shipment data to support commercial invoicing. Shipping and export documentation: Prepare pro forma invoices and other shipment documentation for customs and payment purposes; check completeness and compliance; and archive final shipping documentation in the designated repository. Shipment control and visibility: Maintain shipping forecasts and master arrival schedules, monitor open orders and deliveries, review allocation issues and blocks, and escalate overdue or at-risk shipments. Exception management: Coordinate resolution of shipment delays, booking constraints, documentation gaps, complaints, discrepancies, complex lane requirements and urgent business requests, working with Transportation and other relevant functions as needed. Stakeholder coordination: Coordinate daily with the third-party manufacturer, Global Supply Planning, Transportation, affiliates, Global Trade Compliance, Finance, Quality, Planning and other supply chain partners. Engage with carriers as required in line with the agreed Transportation interface and operating model. Affiliate and customer service: Provide timely updates and pre-alert information, align around holiday schedules and market-specific requirements, and support affiliates with complex export and transportation needs. Performance and governance: Support operational and carrier performance reviews by providing shipment data, issue trends and execution insights, together with KPI reporting, month-end activities, audit readiness, process controls and the Calendar of Discipline. Continuous improvement: Identify process gaps, improve standard work, strengthen controls and visibility, and contribute to scalable solutions as shipment volumes and regional complexity increase. Support stabilization and continuous improvement of new operating models as processes and interfaces mature. Key interfaces Internal: Shipment CoE, Transportation, Global Supply Planning, Finance, Global Trade Compliance, Quality Assurance, Planning, manufacturing and distribution teams, and commercial affiliates. External: Third-party manufacturer, freight forwarders, service providers, destination-market partners and carriers, with carrier engagement coordinated through Transportation where applicable. Bachelor's or master's degree, preferably in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Management, or a related discipline. Minimum three years of relevant experience in logistics, customer logistics, order management, supply chain execution, or a comparable environment. Hands-on ERP experience, preferably SAP, including order, delivery, shipment, or inventory transactions. Experience with international shipping documentation, export processes, customs-related requirements, and cross-functional stakeholder coordination. Fluent written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage for international market support. jobs.title: Revenue Accountant
jobs.jd:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenLabs operates a complex and fast-evolving revenue model – enterprise contracts, self-serve API subscriptions, usage-based billing, and expanding international markets. As a Revenue Accountant, you will play a key role in ElevenLabs’ revenue accounting function. 

You will own significant portions of the monthly revenue close, support the application of ASC 606 to customer arrangements, and help build scalable processes and controls as ElevenLabs grows toward IPO readiness.

You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, Billing Operations, Engineering, and FP&A to support contract review, usage and billing completeness, new product launches, and accurate and timely revenue recognition. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a lean Finance team – the right person will independently run recurring workstreams, identify issues early, and help scale the revenue accounting operating model as the business grows.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Execute significant portions of the monthly revenue close, including journal entries, deferred and unbilled revenue schedules, reconciliations, and flux analysis

 - Perform recurring usage / consumption completeness and billing-to-GL reconciliations; investigate exceptions and drive resolution with cross-functional partners

 - Review customer contracts and apply established ASC 606 guidance to standard arrangements; escalate novel, high-judgment, or precedent-setting matters

 - Support accounting for credits, refunds, contract modifications, cutoff, and variable consideration, with clear and audit-ready documentation

 - Prepare revenue workpapers, audit support, and control evidence; support external audit, walkthroughs, and SOX readiness activities

 - Support accounting readiness and UAT for new products, pricing structures, billing models, and partner / channel launches

 - Improve and automate recurring revenue processes, reconciliations, documentation, and exception reporting as the business scales




REQUIREMENTS

 - Deep expertise in ASC 606, including multi-element arrangements, SSP evaluation, variable consideration, contract modifications, and principal vs. agent analysis

 - Experience leading the revenue close: deferred revenue management, unbilled receivables, journal entry review, and month-end flux analysis

 - Track record of partnering with Sales and Legal on contract review and revenue impact assessments

 - Experience operating in a pre-IPO or public company environment, with direct exposure to external audit, controls build-out, and revenue accounting documentation

 - CPA, ACA, or ACCA qualification (active); Big 4 or public accounting background a strong plus

 - Strong systems proficiency; Stripe, Metronome, HubiFi or a comparable revenue recognition tool preferred




BONUS:

 - Experience with consumption/usage-based and subscription billing models

 - Familiarity with ASC 326 (CECL) and AR accounting in a high-volume SaaS context

 - Multi-entity or international revenue accounting background




LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Central Europe or Eastern US timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York and Warsaw.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.jd: Position Summary The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is responsible for overseeing all financial functions of Noregon , including financial planning and analysis, accounting, budgeting, forecasting, treasury, risk management, and compliance. This role ensures the company's financial health and long-term sustainability by providing strategic financial leadership, accurate reporting, and sound financial governance. The CFO serves as a key member of the executive leadership team, partnering closely with the C-Suite executives, Founder, board members, and senior leaders to support business strategy, operational decision-making, and growth initiatives. This position requires strong financial acumen, strategic vision, and the ability to lead and influence across the organization. Key Responsibilities Provide strategic financial leadership and guidance to the CEO and executive team to support short- and long-term business objectives. Oversee all financial operations, including accounting, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, treasury, tax, audit, and compliance activities. Develop and maintain financial models, forecasts, and analyses to support business planning, investment decisions, and performance management. Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of financial statements and management reporting. Establish, monitor, and enforce financial policies, procedures, internal controls, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Partner with business leaders to evaluate financial implications of strategic initiatives, operational changes, and growth opportunities. Communicate financial performance, risks, and opportunities clearly to executive leadership, the Board, and other key stakeholders. Lead annual budgeting and long-range planning processes, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Manage cash flow, working capital, capital expenditures, and banking relationships to ensure financial stability. Oversee audits, tax filings, insurance programs, and risk management activities. Develop and monitor key financial metrics and KPIs, providing regular reporting and insights to management. Drive continuous improvement of financial systems, processes, and reporting capabilities. Collaborate cross-functionally with departments including Sales, Operations, Product, Human Resources, and IT to support organizational effectiveness. Perform all other duties as assigned. Supervisory Responsibilities Provide leadership, direction, and development for the Finance and Accounting teams. Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field required. Master's degree (MBA) and/or CPA, CMA, or similar professional certification preferred. Demonstrated experience in a senior financial leadership role with responsibility for enterprise-wide financial management. Additional Qualifications Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting standards, budgeting, forecasting, and internal controls. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex financial information into actionable insights. Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. High level of integrity, sound judgment, and discretion when handling confidential information. Process-oriented mindset with a focus on operational efficiency and continuous improvement. Ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously in a dynamic environment. Work Environment This is an in-person role at Noregon's headquarters in Greensboro, North Carolina. This job operates in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment. Physical Requirements Primarily a sedentary role requiring extended periods of sitting. Extensive computer usage requiring basic motor skills and manual dexterity. Occasional standing, walking, reaching, kneeling, and crouching. Travel Requirements Less than 10% travel. This position description outlines the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. jobs.title: Supervisor, Spaceport Operations (Transportation)
jobs.jd: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. SUPERVISOR, SPACEPORT OPERATIONS (TRANSPORTATION) The Spaceport Operations Supervisor will develop, manage, market, provide strategic direction, and oversight of transportation programs (employee commute shuttles, on-site shuttles, airport shuttles, Tesla rental program, bike share, hovercraft commuter operations, and related amenities) while supporting broader Spaceport Village operations including site amenities and customer service. You will optimize routes, operational practices, and parking systems for the most efficient, safest, and highest-participation transportation program possible. You will train and implement effective customer service strategies, coordinate operations, analyze data, monitor and motivate staff, ensure excellent customer service, engage customers, hire and develop talent, maintain mandatory training, handle scheduling and payroll, and drive process improvements. This role supports the SpaceX mission by delivering efficient transportation logistics, outstanding customer service, vehicle/amenity maintenance, and quality-of-life support that boosts morale and productivity. RESPONSIBILITIES: Oversee the full portfolio of transportation programs: off-site shuttles (vans and charter buses), on-site shuttle service, Tesla rental program, hovercraft commuter operations, bike share, parking lots/structures/facilities, and related team-building or employee engagement events Innovate approaches to increase participation in employee commuter and parking programs through communications, messaging, incentive systems, and creative campaigns Act as primary point of contact for parking and transportation facilities; perform strategic analysis to improve and optimize overall system efficiency, routes, and operational practices Recommend and support development of internal transportation and parking policies, procedures, and programs Lead internal customer relations for commute/transportation questions and feedback; oversee customer service, issue resolution, root-cause analysis, and corrective action plans Oversee communication of systems/service changes to stakeholders (email, newsletter, intranet/app, signage, basic graphics) Interface with internal stakeholders (including Spaceport Development, Facilities, Culinary, and Hospitality teams) to understand, develop, and align goals Monitor quality, consistency, and financial activities of Spaceport transportation and related operations; set/enforce standards, inspect and routinely walk areas of responsibility; strategically drive revenue and improve operating costs Train staff on customer service, anticipating guest/employee needs, problem resolution, and safety practices; create and maintain in-person and online training materials; ensure the team is current with all mandatory company training Enforce proper safety practices and support high-volume, complex multidisciplinary operations BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: High school diploma or equivalency certificate 3+ years of leadership experience in transportation program management, hospitality, or other corporate employee services programs PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Bachelor’s degree in hospitality or related field Experience opening new operations and/or creating operational procedures from the ground up; 1+ years in SpaceX Spaceport Operations a plus Advanced knowledge of customer service and problem resolution; excellent written and verbal communication skills Experience in a corporate environment; proficient knowledge of human resources management and Microsoft Office/Outlook Ability to organize work for large groups in various service formats; strong time management skills Experience with high-volume, complex multidisciplinary operations and leading teams of 10+ staff members Eye for aesthetic industrial design; ability to read and understand basic floor plans; familiarity with space planning, facilities in an aerospace industry, and ERP software for RFPOs/work orders Ability to work effectively in a team environment; make independent judgments with limited information; logical and strategic approach to solving problems Communication skills for relaying data (verbally and in writing) between employees, vendors, and customers Comfortable working in a high-stress environment balancing several projects, with flexibility to adjust for abrupt changes in strategic direction ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Must be willing to travel to other SpaceX locations for significant/extended periods of time as needed (up to 85% of the time) Must be available to work extended hours and weekends Must be able to relocate to Starbase, Texas Ability to provide 24/7 on-call support for emergencies and critical operations Valid state issued driver's license ITAR REQUIREMENTS: To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: IT Support Analyst
jobs.jd:
Canvas Worldwide dares to be the challenger the ad industry needs. Do you "Challenge the Comfortable?" Then you'll fit right in here at Canvas. 
 
Recognized as one of Ad Age's "Best Places to Work" for three consecutive years, Canvas Worldwide is an independent media agency committed to providing creative solutions for brands that challenge the status quo. Our clients include Hyundai, Kia, Genesis, MGM, Zillow and McDonald’s (to name a few…). 
 
Our agency cultivates an environment where all are welcome to push outside their comfort zones to solve problems in new ways. We encourage the team to be its best by creating the most positive workplace experience for all. For instance, we outpace the industry on diversity and inclusion AND offer continuous training and workshops for career development. So, if you dare to challenge the comfortable… then keep reading.


The Role 
Canvas Worldwide is currently seeking a Helpdesk Support Analyst to join our Technology & Agency Services team (CTAS). We're looking for people who have a passion for technology and bring a progressive view to core services. The role is for first-level support of our endpoints (Windows, MacOS, iOS, Android, etc.) as well as Azure/M365 cloud services and maintenance. Additionally, you will assist in maintaining our technical knowledge base and inventory. 
 
Key Duties & Responsibilities: 
•    Monitor and respond to associate technical requests via Zendesk ticket queue as well as Teams support channel 
•    Endpoint device creation, testing and deployment (Windows  
•    Work to ensure proper SLA response times and security standards, escalating as needed. 
•    Create and maintain knowledgebase articles on solutions, processes, and workflow 
•    Assist in preparing and enforcing logging and reporting procedures for end-user computing operations 
•    Assist with inventory and provide oversight to management 
•    Onboarding and Offboarding for accounts and equipment, giving assistance and walkthrough for new associates 
•    Help identify any systemic, ongoing issues and work with desktop support and vendors to isolate and remedy issues 
•    Be able to lift and transport computers and devices for setup and shipping 
•    Off-hours and emergency support as required 
 
 
Qualifications: 
•    At least two years of experience in a comparable position

jobs.title: Product Growth
jobs.jd:
About the Team

The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments worldwide. We work across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention and monetization, through product experiments, in-product improvements, performance marketing, creative development, and AI-powered workflows.



The International Growth team works with regional leaders in priority markets to identify the user needs and product gaps that matter most for adoption, usage, and monetization. We turn country priorities into product roadmaps and growth plans, then partner with engineering, research, design, data science, marketing, finance, policy, and partnerships to test and ship improvements.



We combine product strategy, product experimentation, with hands-on growth operations. We account for local behavior, competition, and product experience while building shared capabilities such as segmentation, lifecycle journeys, and experimentation systems. We measure what ships, adapt it to the market, and scale approaches that work across markets.



About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Product Growth generalist with an international focus to help people get lasting value from ChatGPT across markets, use cases and product experiences. You’ll partner with international and central teams to understand user needs, identify growth opportunities and turn them into measurable improvements across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention and monetization.



You’ll combine strong analytics and experimentation with product intuition, design judgment and a deep understanding of users and local markets. You’ll use AI-native automation and agentic tools to accelerate research, analysis, prototyping and execution. This role requires systems thinking and the ability to move across diverse experiences, improving both individual funnels and end-to-end workflows as products, user behavior and market needs evolve.



You’ll be responsible for:

 - Partner with product, eng, and design to turn insights into intuitive experiences and prototypes, improving how users discover value, complete tasks and return.

 - Diagnose and optimize funnel performance using user research, event-level behavior, cohort analysis, and competitive insight. Identify drop-offs and high-value segments, distinguish local needs from shared product friction, and prioritize interventions.

 - Build and use agentic workflows to automate research, analysis, prototyping and experiment operations, with clear quality checks and human judgment where needed.

 - Connect acquisition and marketing insights to product journeys; partner with regional marketers and channel specialists on tests that improve qualified acquisition and activation.

 - Own a rigorous experimentation program across onboarding, activation, repeat usage, re-engagement, paid conversion, and expansion. Partner with Engineering and Data Science on hypotheses, instrumentation, A/B tests and holdouts, readouts, and staged rollouts, with clear success metrics and guardrails.

 - Build and execute a focused international growth roadmap, including in-product upsell, cross-sell, targeting, onboarding, activation/adoption, expansion, and monetization related experiences. Identify the use cases, onboarding barriers, product entry points, and upgrade moments that can improve adoption and sustained customer value.

 - Partner with Data Science and Engineering to develop, deploy, and improve classifiers and propensity models for segmentation, targeting, and personalized in-product journeys. Evaluate predictive quality and use controlled experiments to establish incremental activation, conversion, or expansion impact.

 - Own measurement across activation, retention, paid conversion, upsell, cross-sell, and revenue. Separate incremental impact from market mix, seasonality, or cannibalization, and use the results to decide what to scale, adapt, or stop.

 - Run a clear operating cadence with regional and central partners, surfacing international experimentation results, trade-offs, dependencies, and decisions without requiring formal ownership of every team involved.

 - Build repeatable growth primitives, such as segmentation, lifecycle journeys, referral and expansion triggers, and experimentation tooling, that can be reused across segments and markets. Use AI-native workflows to accelerate research, prototyping, and iteration.



We’re looking for someone with:

 - Experience across product growth, growth strategy and operations, data science, experimentation, and growth design systems, with hands-on ownership of product experiments and measurable outcomes in a fast-moving technology company.

 - A user-first track record of translating research and behavior into product priorities, then working with technical teams to ship improvements.

 - Deep expertise in funnel optimization and experimentation, including instrumentation, A/B testing, statistical power, holdouts, segmentation, cohort analysis, and interpreting incremental impact. A track record of turning experiment results into sustained product improvements.

 - The ability to work across product and marketing levers, connecting audience and acquisition insights to activation, retention, and monetization.

 - Analytical fluency in funnel modeling and growth economics, including incrementality, LTV, CAC, and payback; the ability to move between strategic prioritization and hands-on execution.

 - Practical experience applying classifiers and propensity models to growth problems with Data Science and Engineering, including choosing useful signals, evaluating model quality, and testing the impact of targeted interventions.

 - Ideally, experience scaling and continuously optimizing growth initiatives within Engineering and Data Science pods, from shared prioritization and implementation through experimentation and rollout.

 - Experience adapting products or growth programs across markets, with sound judgment about language, local behavior, business needs, and what should remain consistent globally.

 - Experience optimizing self-serve funnels and in-product upsell, cross-sell, or expansion journeys, or strong evidence of applying comparable growth expertise to a new customer segment/goal

 - The ability to influence central and regional teams, work independently through ambiguity, and carry an initiative from diagnosis through execution and evaluation.



Workplace & Location

 - San Francisco or New York City based.

 - Travel as needed for key cross-functional sprints and regional collaboration.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: AI Scientist - Domain Expert Crashworthiness
jobs.jd:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




ABOUT THE JOB

Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in crashworthiness simulations to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering.

You will work at the intersection of industrial simulation, physics modeling, machine learning, and engineering workflows. Your role is to bring deep solid-mechanics expertise into the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of AI Physics Models for real engineering use cases.

This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who understands industrial structural simulation not only conceptually, but through direct experience with simulation models, solver workflows, data generation, validation, and engineering decision-making.

You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics.

Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Work with our research team to define, generate, and iteratively improve simulation datasets for training and evaluating crashworthiness foundation models, balancing coverage of relevant physical scenarios, simulation fidelity, and computational cost.

 - Design and run high-fidelity simulation campaigns using structural mechanics solvers such as Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Ansys Mechanical, Radioss or equivalent tools.

 - Define the relevant variation space for training data: geometry, mesh resolution, material behavior, boundary conditions, loading, contact, joints, failure modes, and engineering KPIs.

 - Build or guide automated pipelines for simulation setup, execution, post-processing, dataset creation, and model evaluation.

 - Work with research teams to train and evaluate AI models on simulation data, and diagnose failure modes caused by data gaps, poor coverage, numerical artifacts, or model limitations.

 - Evaluate model outputs against industrial engineering needs, including field-level accuracy, scalar KPIs, deformation modes, load paths, energy absorption, stress/strain fields, failure indicators, uncertainty, and out-of-domain behavior.

 - Work with industrial customers to understand their simulation workflows and engineering priorities, define use cases and success criteria, and incorporate their feedback into model development and validation.
   
   


ABOUT YOU

 - You have deep expertise in crashworthiness, solid mechanics, and structural mechanics, with substantial experience in industrial simulation workflows.

 - You have a Master’s degree or equivalent technical depth in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, civil/structural engineering, computational mechanics, applied physics, or a related field.

 - You have 4+ years of relevant industrial experience (or PhD +1 years) in domains such as automotive, aerospace, and consumer electronics.

 - You have hands-on experience with explicit dynamics for crash or impact simulation and understand nonlinear FEM and related topics such as contact, plasticity, structural dynamics, buckling, material modeling, fracture/damage, fatigue, crashworthiness, or durability.

 - You have direct experience with simulation validation, correlation, model quality, numerical sensitivity, and engineering KPI definition.

 - You are a strong Python developer who can build and maintain reliable tools for simulation automation, data processing, and model evaluation. You apply sound software engineering practices, including version control with Git, automated testing, code review, and clear documentation.

 - You have hands-on experience working in Linux and HPC environments, including submitting and monitoring batch jobs, selecting appropriate compute resources, and troubleshooting simulation workflows. You can run simulation campaigns efficiently across a compute cluster.

 - You are comfortable operating in ambiguous technical environments and turning poorly defined industrial problems into scoped datasets, experiments, metrics, and execution plans.

 - You communicate clearly with both deep technical experts and non-specialist stakeholders.




IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU

 - Have experience applying machine learning, surrogate modeling, reduced-order modeling, optimization, or data-driven methods to simulation problems.

 - Have contributed to reusable internal tools, open-source code, simulation automation frameworks, or production-quality engineering workflows.

 - Have experience working directly with industrial customers, product teams, or engineering decision-makers.

 - Have publications, patents, internal technical leadership, or recognized contributions in engineering, simulation, computational mechanics, or ML-for-physics communities.




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Global Supply Analyst
jobs.jd:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base is hiring a Global Supply Analyst to help source and manage the suppliers behind our home battery systems. You'll support sourcing from RFQ to award, build cost models, and help keep suppliers on track as we scale production. You'll work closely with senior supply managers, engineering, manufacturing, and logistics, and take on more ownership quickly.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Support RFQs end to end: gather requirements, send RFQs, compare bids, and recommend suppliers.

 - Build and maintain should-cost models and pricing benchmarks to find cost-downs and prepare for negotiations.

 - Help negotiate piece price, tooling, and payment terms, and keep contracts and agreements organized.

 - Track supplier performance on cost, quality, and delivery, and flag problems early.

 - Manage lead times, capacity, and open orders with suppliers as we ramp production.

 - Research new suppliers and market trends in your assigned categories.

 - Present clear findings and recommendations to the supply chain team and engineering partners.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - A degree in engineering, supply chain, business, or a related field.

 - 0–2 years of experience in sourcing, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or a related internship.

 - Strong Excel and data analysis skills.

 - Clear, direct written and verbal communication.

 - Strong organization, with the ability to keep many things moving at once.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities.

 - Willingness to travel domestically and internationally, about 25% of the time.




PREFERRED SKILLS

 - Internship or work experience in sourcing, procurement, or manufacturing at a hardware company.

 - Familiarity with manufacturing processes such as injection molding, sheet metal, or electronics assembly.

 - Experience with MRP or ERP systems.

 - A technical or analytical background that helps you understand how parts are made and what drives their cost.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Our supply chain team sources components, runs manufacturing operations, and builds the supplier partnerships we need to make the lowest-cost, highest-quality home batteries at scale. Homeowners across the country rely on Base for whole-home backup and lower electricity bills. Our network of home batteries also helps keep the grid stable as demand climbs from AI, electrification, and extreme weather. We build in-house and expand at a speed and cost incumbents can't match, and this team makes that possible.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.jd: Application close date: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed. At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs. Blue National Security builds and operates space systems for the Intelligence Community and Department of Defense. Someone has to be watching those systems continuously — and that's this role. We're looking for a Cyber Defense Analyst to monitor, investigate, and respond across BNS classified enclaves, mission ground systems, and labs. You'll work real events on real national security systems, and you'll do it alongside senior engineers who will teach you the environment rather than hand you a queue and walk away. This is a hands-on-keyboard role. You'll spend your days in consoles, terminals, and logging data. You'll also get your hands on the tooling itself, helping deploy sensors, onboard log sources, and tune detections under the direction of our senior engineers. That's how you'll learn this environment, and it's the fastest path to becoming the engineer who designs the next one. If you're coming off a military cyber protection team, a government SOC, or a service watch floor and you want to keep growing technically rather than get slotted into a ticket queue, this is a strong landing spot. What You'll Do Monitor and triage. Work security events and alerts across SIEM, EDR, network sensors, and audit logs. Determine what's noise, what's misconfiguration, and what warrants escalation. Investigate. Pull the threads — pivot across host, network, and identity data to build a picture of what actually happened, and document it clearly. Respond. Serve as first responder during incidents. Execute containment steps per playbook, preserve evidence, build timelines, and support senior engineers leading the response. Hunt. Participate in structured hunts, initially alongside senior team members and increasingly on your own hypotheses as you learn what "normal" looks like here. Support audit and insider threat review. Perform privileged user activity monitoring and audit log review in partnership with Security and Counterintelligence. Stand watch during mission events. Provide heightened monitoring coverage during launches, mission operations, and other critical windows. Get hands on the tooling. Assist with sensor deployment, log source onboarding, and agent rollout across enclaves under engineering direction. Tune and improve detections. Reduce false positives, validate rule coverage, and propose new detections based on what you find in the data. Improve the playbooks. Execute response procedures and flag every gap you hit — you'll be the first to find them, and your input drives the rewrites. Automate what you repeat. Script recurring triage, enrichment, and reporting tasks. We'll help you build this skill if you don't have it yet. Required Qualifications 2+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, IT operations, or system administration or equivalent military/government cyber experience Working knowledge of network protocols and Windows and Linux fundamentals Familiarity with SIEM and EDR concepts and the ability to investigate events using them Understanding of common attack techniques and exposure to the MITRE ATT&CK framework Clear, concise written communication — your investigation notes will be read by senior staff and government customers Genuine curiosity and the instinct to keep pulling on a thread when something doesn't add up Active U.S. Government Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility and eligibility for SAP access determination; U.S. citizenship DoD 8140 CSSP Analyst or IAT Level II certification (Security+ CE or equivalent) at hire or within [6] months A degree is not required. Equivalent military, government, or hands-on technical experience is fully accepted. You close tickets, escalate anything interesting, and learn very little about the systems you're supposedly defending. This team is small enough that you can't be siloed. You'll sit next to the engineers building the enclaves, help deploy the sensors you'll be watching, and see your tuning recommendations go live. jobs.jd: TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice Personal Information We Collect Your Privacy Choices Team Overview The Financial Services Analytics team partners with banks, lenders, insurers, and other financial institutions to solve complex business challenges using advanced analytics and TransUnion data assets. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd: Data Scientist Build AI That Accelerates Scientific Discovery Do you want your work to help researchers solve humanity’s biggest challenges? At Elsevier, data science is not about building models for the sake of building models. It is about advancing scientific discovery, improving healthcare outcomes, and helping researchers, clinicians, educators, and institutions unlock knowledge that can improve lives around the world. Every day, millions of scientists rely on our products to discover evidence, connect ideas, validate findings, and advance research. As a Data Scientist, your work will directly contribute to the tools and technologies that help accelerate human progress. About the Team As part of a growing team of Data Scientists, you will take on some of the hardest problems in science. This team is building intelligent systems that can reason across scientific publications, research data, knowledge graphs, ontologies, metadata, taxonomies, citations, and content spanning every scientific discipline. About the Role As a Data Scientist at Elsevier, you will design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions that power knowledge discovery across the global research ecosystem. You will work with one of the world's richest collections of scientific information, including publications, citations, research datasets, metadata, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and multidisciplinary content spanning every scientific field. This role combines cutting-edge AI with meaningful impact. You will help build intelligent systems that make scientific knowledge more discoverable, trustworthy, connected, and actionable. What You'll Do Design and deploy machine learning, NLP, and generative AI solutions that help researchers discover, understand, and apply scientific knowledge. Build intelligent retrieval, search, recommendation, ranking, and question-answering systems that improve research outcomes. Develop AI systems that connect information across publications, datasets, citations, knowledge graphs, and scientific ontologies. Fine-tune, evaluate, and integrate large language models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems into production environments. Create robust evaluation frameworks that measure quality, reliability, relevance, trustworthiness, and user impact. Build scalable data pipelines and machine learning workflows that support experimentation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Apply the appropriate combination of classical machine learning, deep learning, retrieval, and generative AI techniques to solve complex scientific problems. Collaborate with engineering, product, UX, analytics, and domain experts to transform ambiguous challenges into practical solutions. Contribute clean, maintainable, production-quality Python code and reusable AI components. Continuously improve the capabilities, performance, and real-world value of AI systems that support scientific discovery. What We're Looking For Degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline. Extensive Python programming skills and experience building production-quality data science solutions. Experience with machine learning fundamentals, including model development, evaluation, feature engineering, and performance optimization. Experience working with large-scale structured, semi-structured, or unstructured datasets. Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, including large language models, embeddings, retrieval systems, and generative AI. Familiarity with frameworks such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent tools. Experience evaluating AI outputs and improving model quality, reliability, and business impact. Ability to translate complex problems into measurable, data-driven solutions. A genuine passion for advancing science, improving access to knowledge, and using AI to create meaningful real-world impact. Why Join Elsevier Because your work will matter. You will help build AI systems that support researchers, healthcare professionals, educators, and institutions around the world. Your contributions will help people discover critical evidence, uncover new insights, accelerate innovation, and advance scientific progress. This is an opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and meaningful AI problems anywhere—combining world-class data, cutting-edge technology, and a mission dedicated to improving lives through science and knowledge. jobs.title: Global Head, Autonomous Platform Strategy & Portfolio
jobs.jd: The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Advances in AI, data, robotics, and laboratory automation are transforming drug discovery and development. The Roche Autonomous Lab Accelerator brings together gRED, pRED, PT, and the Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) to build closed-loop Lab-in-the-Loop capabilities that connect scientific intent, digital design, experimental execution, and high-quality data generation. The Opportunity The Global Head, Autonomous Platform Strategy & Portfolio will turn the autonomous-lab vision into a prioritized portfolio of capabilities and scientific use cases. Bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and R&D experimental labs by turning the autonomous-lab vision into a rigorously prioritized portfolio of capabilities and scientific use cases. Serving as the empowered portfolio strategy leader/ executive, you will ensure that capital investments and technological advancements translate directly into accelerated scientific impact for the organization. In this role, you will: Core Strategic Responsibilities Roadmap & Vision: Define, maintain, and champion the multi-year strategic platform roadmap, ensuring alignment with overarching corporate scientific goals and drug discovery pipelines. Investment & Business Case Development: Formulate robust business cases to justify capital allocation, prioritizing technology investments based on projected ROI, scientific impact, and time-to-value. Build vs. Buy Strategy: Systematically evaluate and identify which scientific & technology workflows, hardware, and software capabilities should be externally sourced versus internally developed to optimize for speed, cost, and competitive advantage. Set the decision framework for what Roche builds, co-develops, permits/licenses or acquires. Identify what to externally source versus internally develop/ customize workflows. Track capability maturity across chemistry, biology, DMPK, protein sciences, etc. Strategic Benchmarking: Continuously benchmark external autonomous-science developments, keeping the organization ahead of industry trends in AI, robotics, and next-generation lab automation. Vendor & Partner Ecosystem: Define the partner and vendor strategy, identifying key external players for strategic collaborations and negotiating high-level co-development initiatives. External communications and presence: Represent the Roche autonomous lab as a senior leader in the scientific and technology community with credibility and presence. Leadership & Portfolio Management Cross-Domain Maturity Tracking: Monitor and drive the capability maturity of automated workflows across diverse scientific disciplines, including chemistry, biology, DMPK, protein sciences, etc. Team Leadership: Direct, mentor, and align a high-performing team of Product Managers and Technical Program Managers, ensuring seamless execution across the entire autonomous platform portfolio. Annual Strategic Planning: Lead the annual strategic planning process for the autonomous platform, coordinating closely with executive leadership to secure and allocate capital budgets. Co-Development Oversight: Manage external strategic collaborations, ensuring that co-development partnerships consistently deliver on integrated scientific and technical milestones. Scientific Change Management: Autonomous lab platforms fundamentally shift how bench scientists work. Explicitly requiring experience in driving behavioral adoption, user experience (UX), and overcoming cultural resistance in scientific organizations is critical. Who you are: Experience: 10+ years of progressive leadership at the intersection of life sciences, technology, and portfolio strategy in a Pharma/Biotech environment. Domain Expertise: Deep technical familiarity with lab automation, AI/ML applications in R&D, automation technology and core drug discovery workflows. Leadership Track Record: Proven experience directing Product and Program Managers and negotiating high-value external strategic partnerships. Business Acumen: Demonstrated success building capital allocation business cases and translating complex technical investments into clear executive ROI. jobs.jd: Are you a dedicated Business Intelligent Analyst (Snowflake, Databricks, SSRS ) looking to build complex reports for our core Healthcare Education Team? About the role: As a BI Analyst you will be entrusted to support Trade and Commercial Reporting within Elsevier Healthcare Education’s (EHE) Business Intelligence Team. This role will partner with commercial, analytics, technology, and senior stakeholders to modernize reporting workflows, improve reporting quality, and deliver scalable BI solutions that support business decision-making. About the team- Elsevier’s Healthcare Education team develops digital learning, assessment, and simulation products—including Sherpath AI, ClinicalKey Student, Shadow Health, HESI, Complete Anatomy, and Osmosis—to support medical and nursing students, educators, and future healthcare professionals worldwide. From an AI Software Engineering perspective, the team’s work spans generative AI, RAG, intelligent search, personalized learning, data analytics, cloud-based applications, and virtual patient simulations to improve educational experiences and learning outcomes. Key Responsibilities Owning the development and enhancement of Trade and Commercial Reporting solutions across Snowflake, Tableau, and related BI environments. Applying AI tools, where appropriate, to improve analysis, documentation, workflow efficiency, and reporting development. Converting legacy manual reporting workflows, including Excel-based processes, into scalable dashboards, automated reporting, and repeatable analytical solutions. Supporting reporting migrations by translating legacy queries, business rules, and reporting logic into new data warehouse environments. Validating reporting outputs across legacy and new environments to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with business definitions. Partnering with commercial stakeholders, including senior and VP-level audiences, to gather requirements, clarify business questions, and deliver actionable reporting outputs. Investigating data discrepancies, perform quality checks, document issues, and coordinating resolution with business and technical partners. Maintaining documentation for reporting processes, data definitions, query logic, migration mappings, and technical workflows. Managing multiple reporting priorities and stakeholder requests with strong attention to detail and limited oversight. Required Qualifications 3+ years of hands-on SQL experience using Snowflake, Databricks, SSRS , or similar data platforms. 3+ years of experience developing dashboards and reports in BI visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms. Demonstrated experience converting manual or legacy reporting workflows into automated BI, dashboard, or reporting solutions. Demonstrated experience translating reporting logic, SQL queries, or business rules across systems, data warehouses, or reporting platforms. Experience gathering requirements from business stakeholders and converting them into technical specifications, reporting logic, or dashboard solutions. Proven ability to validate data, investigate discrepancies, and ensure reporting accuracy. Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and their applications. Elsevier employs 10,000 people worldwide, including over 2,500 technologists. We have supported the work of our research and health partners for more than 140 years. Growing from our roots in publishing, we offer knowledge and valuable analytics that help our users make breakthroughs and drive societal progress. U.S. National Base Pay Range: $71,600 - $119,400. jobs.title: Data & Digital Marketing Analyst
jobs.jd: Unilever is looking for a Data Analyst Benelux Function : Customer Development Reports to : Business Intelligence Lead Scope : Belgium and Netherlands Location : Brussels, Belgium or Rotterdam, Netherlands, with ability to travel to the other country once per week according to business needs. Terms & Conditions : Full-Time. Local employment conditions apply. Salary range: €56,000–€77,000 gross per year, including holiday allowance, depending on experience and internal positioning. About Unilever Food Solutions Unilever Food Solutions is the 2nd largest Business Unit of Unilever, is one of the 3 Power brands of the Foods Business Group, and a global market leader in Food Service. We are an independent Global Business Unit that operates in over 76 countries, and employs ~4000 employees. We have a unique B2B business model focused on serving chefs and our purpose is to free them to love what they do. We at UFS have a clear strategy in place for 2030 with a bold ambition for turnover and profitability, by being the best solution provider to our growing operator base. We plan to do this via a product first focus on superiority, by becoming the leader in AI-powered customer experience and by nurturing a winning culture. We have had a history of delivering with excellence and resilient performance in the past few years. We also strive to stay 3 steps ahead in the industry. For example, our Future Menus Report identifies emerging culinary trends, making us a trendsetter for inspiring innovative solutions for chefs worldwide. We have a culture of caring deeply not just for our business but also for our people. We foster an entrepreneurial culture built on speed, simplicity, trust, and a deep hunger to grow. Our people thrive on their roles being empowered and end to end - across all functions. We also invest heavily in building future skills and leaders. Our People agenda of Accelerate-Grow-Thrive consistently helps us lead in employee engagement, with scores exceeding Unilever scores across all dimensions and being one of the most engaged teams at Unilever. Here, you will continuously learn, unlearn, and relearn, challenging yourself to accelerate your development in an end-to-end business and in end-to-end roles. If you're dreaming of contributing to Unilever’s 2nd largest business unit, a fast-growing business, where you're empowered so you can play to win and thrive as part of One Team with One Goal, then come and join us! Job purpose UFS is accelerating its digital transformation to fuel growth through data driven and technology enabled go-to-market capabilities. The focus of UFS marketing and sales is to engage with chefs and customers through an integrated communication system via visits by sales representatives and digital touchpoints like the UFS.com website / webshop, segmented and personalized campaigns and emerging digital channels (Whatsapp, AI). The new roles of marketing and customer development teams are more integrated in the digital ecosystem and are vital for a great operator and customer experience. The Data & Digital Marketing Analyst acts as the bridge between Data and Marketing & Customer Development teams. The role is responsible for digital performance measurement, reporting, customer data quality and marketing technology enablement across the UFS digital ecosystem. Beyond analytics, the role partners with marketing and customer development teams to translate data into actionable business recommendations, support customer journey design and optimization, and drive adoption of data-driven decision making. The role ensures digital platforms, reporting and Martech solutions effectively support customer engagement and business growth. Key responsibilities Own the data-related aspects and backend processes of digital initiatives and platforms , such as e-commerce, WhatsApp Business, Showpad, Marketo and future digital capabilities, ensuring proper data collection, integration, governance, cleansing and optimizing. Monitor data flows and integrations across platforms and ensure correct synchronization between systems (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo and UDL), identifying and resolving data quality and process issues. Act as the primary point of contact for data-related and backend process topics within the digital landscape, including data quality, enrichment, collection, governance and cleansing. Build and maintain dashboards, data models and reporting frameworks across commercial, marketing and digital channels, platforms and campaigns , enabling effective performance tracking and data-driven decision-making. Support the setup, measurement and optimization of customer journeys and campaigns across CRM, loyalty and customer engagement platforms (e.g., Marketo and WhatsApp Business), translating performance data into actionable recommendations to improve customer engagement and campaign effectiveness. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Digital and Data stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable data and analytical solutions, while driving continuous improvement in reporting and data management processes. Collaborate closely with global Data & Digital teams to build, maintain and continuously improve reporting solutions, ensuring the accuracy, consistency and validation of business KPIs and performance metrics. Required qualifications BSc in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or Statistics Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights. Experience with reporting, dashboards and data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, DAX and data modelling). Familiarity with Azure and Databricks. Understanding of data governance, data quality and data lifecycle processes. Understanding of digital marketing, customer journeys and campaign measurement. Understanding of MarTech ecosystems and customer data flows (e.g. Salesforce, Marketo, Adobe Analytics, Showpad). Ability to troubleshoot backend platform and integration issues. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Proactive, collaborative and continuous improvement mindset. Fluent in English; Dutch and/or French is a plus. Preferred qualifications Experience with Adobe Analytics, Salesforce, Marketo and Showpad. Knowledge of Python, Pandas, R and/or SQL. Experience in CRM, customer journey or digital performance analytics. Work location and conditions The role can be based in Brussels (CityDox office) or Rotterdam (Hofplein office) and operates in a hybrid working model. You are focused on continuous improvement and play a key role in implementing better ways of working, including your ability to synthesize solutions/ automations leveraging use of AI.
