jobs.title: Weather Forecaster II
jobs.jd: The Weather Forecaster II provides aviation, ship and site weather forecasting services, maintaining responsibility for developing forecasts and preparing weather briefings for pilots and interested parties such as outlying camps, field parties, and stations, as well as any ocean vessels operating in the area of responsibility. This position requires selected individuals to be knowledgeable in all aspects of weather forecasting, including creating weather charts and preparing briefing materials, and perform in a supervisor capacity; demonstrating good problem-solving skills while overseeing daily operations, preparing all required reports, and monitoring the weather office for areas as outlined in the task. In addition, this position observes and records weather conditions used for forecasting and archival purposes. This position has the potential to deploy to McMurdo Station, Antarctica to conduct work locally. The United States Antarctica Program requires all personnel deploying to Antarctica to pass a physical qualification. Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc. serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Technology, Infrastructure & Engineering, Health, Manufacturing, Public Safety, Consulting, and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical - Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays. As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act. ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS A valid USA passport is required and is reimbursable. Must be able to obtain a T1 Clearance through the government customer. Must pass internal background checks. Knowledgeable in all aspects of weather forecasting. Must be able to perform job duties in extreme, cold, dark, work environments. Must pass medical and dental examination prior to deployment; expenses are reimbursable. Ability to follow directions and work independently or with a team. Ability to be reliable in attendance/punctuality. Ability to practice and promote required safety standards. Skilled proficiency conducting audits and utilizing quality management systems. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. Ability to cooperate and negotiate with teammates and customers to find mutually acceptable solutions. Ability to organize work, set priorities, and determine resource requirements. Organization, problem-solving, resolution and critical thinking skills. Customer service and relationship-building skills. Excellent verbal and written communications skills. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned. Provides aviation, ship and site weather forecasting services, maintaining responsibility for developing forecasts and preparing weather briefings for pilots and interested parties such as outlying camps, field parties, and stations, as well as ocean vessels operating in the area. Creates weather charts, prepares briefing materials, and performs in a supervisor capacity. Takes, records and disseminates surface weather observations, and completes necessary forms in accordance with Federal, Department of Defense (DOD), and World Meteorological Organization (WMO) guidelines. Records, transmits, and archives METAR/SPECI and synoptic observations in accordance with established procedures and in support of the Global Climate Observing System. Prepares balloon, radiosonde, and ground tracking equipment for use in the upper-air program. Performs the launch and tracking of the rawinsonde package. Evaluates and transmit atmospheric pressure, temperature, relative humidity, and wind direction and speed encoded from the radiosonde flight data. Monitors and reports expendable inventory levels regularly. Develops and publishes timely shift schedules for observing personnel. Trains and recommends personnel for certification as weather observers for McMurdo Station and supported airfields as required. Recommends personnel for decertification when performance dictates. Provides training to personnel that will provide weather observations for the airfields at McMurdo. Provides training to personnel who will provide basic weather information from camps or locations where qualified observers are not posted. Provide quality checks and data validation of observational data. Coordinate with other functions and organizations. Provide input as the observer SME for planning and preparation of operational activities EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE Graduate of a DoD meteorology technician course or equivalent civilian course of study leading to a weather observing/forecasting certification and ten (10) years of experience in weather forecasting and operational meteorology including at least three (3) year of experience in airport/airfield weather forecasting in support of an operational weather office. AND High school diploma or general education degree (GED) and a minimum of two (2) years of experience as a qualified weather observer for surface observations at an aviation weather facility. Preferred Ten (10) years of experience in weather forecasting and operational meteorology including at least one (1) year of experience in airport/airfield weather forecasting in support of an operational weather office. Forecasting experience in high latitudes or polar regions. Analytical case study development and publication experience. High school diploma or general education degree (GED) and two (3) years of experience as a qualified weather observer for surface observations at an aviation weather facility. PHYSICAL DEMANDS The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform successfully the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job. Work is primarily performed in an office environment. Regularly required to sit. Regularly required use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms to handle objects and operate tools, computer, and/or controls. Required to speak and hear. Occasionally required to stand, walk and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. May occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Exposed to general office noise with computers printers and light traffic. This position requires a physical qualification for potential deployment to Antarctica. EOE including Disability/Vet CNI offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes: Medical Dental Vision 401(k) Family Planning/Fertility Assistance STD/LTD/Basic Life/AD&D Legal-Aid Program Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Paid Time Off (PTO) – (11) Federal Holidays Training and Development Opportunities Your application submission will be considered for all potential employment opportunities with Chickasaw Nation Industries (CNI).

jobs.jd: Procore AI is hiring an AI Sales Executive to join the AI sales team. This is a quota carrying role focused on commercial and enterprise AI deals in the construction industry. The role combines a unique set of skills in technical discovery, solution scoping, and product demonstration with ownership of the full sales cycle. The role works directly with customers to scope, build, and demonstrate AI agent solutions, and to close and then continue to expand those deals through mastery of the technical capabilities of the deliverable to associate with value, ROI, and cost. This position will report to the Senior Director, AI Sales and can be based remotely in the US (with possibility for hybrid if located in San Francisco, CA or Austin, TX). We are looking for someone to join our team immediately. What You Will Do Identify general contractors, specialty contractors, and asset owners ready to adopt agentic workflows, in partnership with other sales and solutions team members and leadership. Run technical discovery with customer executives, operators, and engineering teams, including review of document libraries, integrations, and operational processes such as submittals, RFIs, estimating, logs, contracts, financial, and change orders among many actions. Qualify opportunities based on named workflow owners, measurable ROI (hours saved, rework avoided, capacity increased, etc), and data accessibility within or outside of Procore. Demonstrate LLM based agents, MCP integrations, and API workflows using the customer's own drawings, specifications, and project documents alongside AI within the Procore environments. Stand up proofs of concept and pilots in customer environments or embedded within the Procore tools demonstrating what a scaled opportunity would look like. Configure, tune, and troubleshoot standard and domain tailored AI agents independently or using broader resources within Procore. Define clear boundaries between out of the box configurations and custom builds. Scope custom work only where it can be executed by the team. Own the sales process and opportunities from qualification through pricing, contract, and signature. Translate technical feasibility into commercial proposals, including adoption path (a crawl, walk, run approach), credit and consumption sizing, and pricing. Partner with Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, Deployment Specialists, Customer Success, and Professional Services through go live, renewal, and expansion when opportunities require more resources pre and post sale. Identify expansion opportunities across existing customers. Document recurring technical integration patterns and share reusable components with Product and Engineering. Keep Salesforce, forecasts, and deal records current. Manage your time, engagement, workflows, and business with operational excellence. What We’re Looking For Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, applied mathematics, physics, or machine learning, or equivalent hands on experience is a plus. 3 or more years in forward deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or AI engineering, with experience shipping LLM agents, retrieval pipelines (RAG), or enterprise data integrations to paying customers is preferred or with similar parallel experience. Strong coding skills in Python or TypeScript, with comfort reading API specifications, relational databases, Procore SDKs, and unstructured enterprise documents is a plus. Working knowledge of ML fundamentals, including evaluation, training, and problem decomposition. Experience selling, consulting, or solution engineering on technical products. Quota carrying experience is a plus. Ability to explain technical solutions to executives and end users, including leading whiteboarding sessions, presentations, and business consultations with senior leaders. Ability to be clear, concise, factual, and transparent about current product boundaries and drive adoption through standard platform capabilities. Willingness or experience carrying quota, managing pipeline, and going through a closing process for contracts. Ability to work across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Field Sales without formal authority. Willingness to travel frequently to customer locations and the Procore office regularly. Preferred: experience in commercial construction, engineering consulting, or heavy industry workflows such as bidding, cost management, or project field logs. Additional Information Base Pay Range: 140,300.00 - 192,912.50 USD Annual On Target Earning Range: 280,600.00 - 385,825.00 USD Annual This role may also be eligible for Equity Compensation and/or Bonus Incentive Compensation. Procore is committed to offering competitive, fair, and commensurate compensation. Actual compensation will be based on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, education or training, and location. For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates: Procore will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the requirements of applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. jobs.title: Graduate Analyst
jobs.jd: Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. Min fees. Max ease. Full speed. Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere. More about our mission and what we offer . As a Graduate Product Analyst, you’ll join our North America Regional Analytics team in September 2027. This full-time role is a chance to make a real impact early and kickstart your career. You’ll be onboarded with the global Graduate cohort in one of our offices and learn the basics of being a Wiser. The Role: We’re hiring three graduates to work as analysts inside our North America product teams, which build Wise for personal and business customers in the US and Canada. Our analysts don’t sit in a central reporting team: each one works day to day with product managers & engineers and helps them decide what to build next and whether it worked. You’ll join one of four teams: Onboarding, Send, Account or Growth. Each owns a different stage of the customer’s journey with Wise, and each is described below. You won’t be on your own. A senior analyst will mentor you, review your work and help you grow, and you’ll be part of a team of analysts covering the whole North America product. What you’ll be doing: Shape Strategy & Prioritization: You’ll help your team understand where customers struggle and what is worth fixing first. That means digging into funnels and customer behavior, reading customer feedback and survey responses, and sizing opportunities so the team can prioritize the work with the biggest impact. As you grow, you’ll lead your own discoveries and present recommendations to your product manager. Learn Launch Rigor & Experimentation: You’ll help design and analyze A/B tests and pre/post comparisons for new features, and learn to turn the results into a clear call: roll out, iterate or roll back. You’ll keep an eye on your team’s core metrics and flag when something looks wrong. Build on the Semantic Layer: We believe analysts add the most value when they focus on product discovery, not ad-hoc requests. You’ll learn to build and maintain the data models and dashboards that let your team answer their own questions, using Snowflake, dbt, Git, Airflow, Python and Lightdash, and help improve the AI skills that run our routine reporting. Share What You Learn: You’ll explain your findings to your team and the wider NorthAm squad, in writing, in charts and in person, so that your work leads to a decision. How we work with AI: We lean hard into AI: AI skills produce our routine work and deep dives, so our analysts can focus on discovery. You’ll use AI tools every day, and you’ll own the answer, not the tool: checking the data, the logic and the conclusion before anyone acts on it. Where you could join: Onboarding Onboarding owns the first steps of a customer’s journey: creating a profile, getting verified (Know Your Customer / Know Your Business checks) and taking a first action with Wise. It also keeps financial crime out at the front door. The core challenge is letting genuine customers through quickly while stopping bad actors. You might work on questions like: Where do new customers drop out between signing up and their first transfer, and what would bring them back? Which verification steps slow genuine customers down without catching more fraud or financial crime? Send Send covers what happens when a customer sends money, and is made up of three teams: Pay-in: how customers pay money into Wise, for example by bank transfer (ACH) or card. Which payment methods help customers complete their transfer, and what does each one cost us? Payout: how money reaches recipients’ bank accounts in the US and Canada, balancing three levers: cost, speed and conversion. What would make these payouts faster or cheaper, and how much more volume would that bring? You’ll also help track the health of our banking partners. Payment Risk: transfer suspensions and ACH and card chargebacks. How do we cut losses from chargebacks and fraud without blocking good customers? Account Account owns how customers use Wise as an account, not only for one-off transfers: getting paid into Wise with USD and CAD local account details, spending with the Wise debit card, and earning a return on money held with Wise. You might work on questions like: What makes a customer start getting paid into their Wise account, and what makes them keep doing it? Who uses the Wise card, for what, and what stops others from using it? Does holding money with Wise change how customers send money abroad? Growth Growth owns the top of the funnel: how people find Wise and decide to try it. That covers landing pages, the promotion engine, corridor strategy (which country-to-country routes we focus on) and pricing, where you’ll work with our Pricing Data Science team to understand how price affects demand. You might work on questions like: Did a promotion bring in customers who stay, or customers who leave once it ends? Which corridors should we focus on next, and why? Your first six months: By three months: you own part of your team’s regular metrics and have delivered your first analysis. By six months: you’ve led a discovery or an experiment readout from question to recommendation and presented it to your team. Qualifications What you’ll bring: Education: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitative field such as economics, statistics, mathematics, computer science or engineering, completed by your start date, or equivalent practical experience. Technical Foundations: You’ve used SQL, Python or R to answer a real question with data, in a course, a project, an internship or on your own. You understand the basics of statistics, such as distributions, hypothesis tests and confidence intervals, and can tell when a difference is real rather than noise. Curiosity & Product Sense: You want to know why customers behave the way they do, and you ask “so what should we do?” about every result. Clear Communication: You can explain a finding to someone who isn’t technical, in writing and in conversation, and you’re comfortable saying “I don’t know yet”. Ownership: You finish what you start, ask for help early and act on feedback. AI with Judgment: You use AI tools to work faster, and you check their output before you trust it. Right to Work: You must be authorized to work in the US. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Nice to have but not essential: Hands-on experience with any of Snowflake, dbt, Git, Airflow or Lightdash. Exposure to A/B testing or causal inference, in a course or in practice. An internship or project in analytics, data science, product or finance. An interest in payments, fintech, or how people move and manage money across borders. For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive. We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences. Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers. If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs . Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram .

jobs.title: Warranty Analyst
jobs.jd: MSX has been a trusted partner to leading vehicle manufacturers, their retailers, and mobility organizations globally for more than 30 years. Our unwavering commitment is to help our clients transform their businesses and effectively manage operations in the areas of: Sales Performance; Repair Optimization and Compliance; Parts and Accessories Sales Performance; and Consumer Engagement. With our global teams, industry expertise, and the power of technology, we design and deliver tailored, sustainable, and innovative solutions and services that help our clients optimize their operations and captivate their customers. MSX International’s warranty support program provides analytical and technical support to Hyundai Motor America (HMA) to help monitor warranty performance, identify emerging vehicle concerns, and support informed decisions on repair quality and warranty costs. Based on-site at HMA headquarters in Fountain Valley, California, the program brings together warranty analysis, vehicle repair information, and cross-functional collaboration to support product quality and customer satisfaction. The Warranty Analyst contributes by investigating warranty and goodwill claims, analyzing expense and repair trends, and reviewing vehicle buyback cases to identify and document the defective causal parts or conditions associated with repurchase. Position Summary Do you enjoy connecting the dots between vehicle repair records, warranty data, and the technical issues behind them? Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and motivated to turn complex information into actionable findings? At MSX International, we’re looking for a Warranty Analyst to support HMA’s warranty group through data analysis, technical case review, and accurate documentation. You’ll evaluate warranty and goodwill performance, investigate unusual claim patterns, and collaborate with Quality Engineers and internal stakeholders to identify areas requiring further review. You’ll also support vehicle buyback analysis by reviewing repair histories and related records to identify and document the initial and final defective causal parts and/or conditions that led to vehicle repurchase under applicable lemon laws. This on-site, hourly role offers direct collaboration with warranty, quality, and engineering teams at HMA headquarters, providing exposure to automotive operations and opportunities for professional development. As a member of the warranty support team, you’ll: Analyze warranty expenses and prepare monthly comparisons against forecasts, prior-month results, and prior-year performance. Evaluate warranty performance by model and model year, including total costs, units in operation, failure rates, and cost per claim. Review powertrain warranty expenses, including coverage under HMA’s 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty. Analyze quarterly cost-per-unit trends by month in service, including failure rates, claim costs, and labor operation codes across warranty, goodwill, and campaign repairs. Identify significant cost variances, emerging concerns, and unusual claim patterns; communicate findings and recommend further investigation. Monitor goodwill expenses, support forecasting, and identify campaign-related costs and dealers with high expenses and low customer satisfaction results. Analyze warranty repair data alongside technician training records to identify potential relationships between training gaps and repeat repairs. Review dealer use of labor operation codes and warranty repairs, coordinating with Regional Warranty Managers when excessive or unusual activity requires investigation. Conduct repair-sequence and repair-narrative analyses to assess dealer repair efficiency and potential effects on vehicle quality. Review vehicle buyback repair records, service orders, and customer communications to identify the initial and final defective causal parts and/or conditions associated with repurchase. Collaborate with Quality Engineers and internal departments to clarify technical findings and accurately document buyback conclusions. Enter and maintain warranty, claim, and buyback findings in designated internal systems. Prepare reports, presentations, and ad hoc analyses for management. Participate in training and product-information exchanges; travel, including overnight stays, may be required for up to four weeks annually. Support occasional vehicle testing, service coordination, and other related assignments as directed. Technical Expertise Strong understanding of automotive repair procedures, diagnostic methods, and vehicle systems. Ability to interpret repair orders, warranty claims, service histories, and technical documentation. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Word. Ability to analyze warranty costs, failure rates, claim trends, and forecast variances. Strong data-entry accuracy and documentation practices. Desired Skills Strong analytical, mathematical, and root-cause investigation skills. Exceptional attention to detail when reviewing technical records and documenting findings. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to explain analytical findings clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Strong organization, prioritization, multitasking, and follow-up skills. Ability to collaborate with client personnel, dealership staff, engineers, and warranty teams. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency is a plus. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent. Experience in automotive repair and product quality. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data and develop clear findings and recommendations. Strong computer proficiency, including database querying and Microsoft Office applications. Ability to manage multiple assignments while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines. Preferred Qualifications Four-year degree in engineering. Dealership fixed operations and warranty experience. At MSX International, you’ll apply your automotive knowledge and analytical skills to meaningful warranty and product quality challenges. Working on-site at HMA headquarters provides opportunities to collaborate with warranty, quality, and engineering professionals while broadening your understanding of manufacturer operations. If you’re ready to turn technical records and warranty data into actionable insights, we want to hear from you. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate may not have been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At MSXI, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. jobs.title: Managing Consultant - Digital Trust and Cyber Security
jobs.jd: About us We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. As strategies, technologies and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity. Our teams combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results. Our Digital Trust & Cyber Security team helps clients strengthen trust in technology, build resilience and respond to emerging cyber risks. In the US, we are growing our work with clients operating critical infrastructure, drawing on PA’s consulting, cyber and technology capabilities and our collaboration with Jacobs. The opportunity We are looking for a Managing Consultant to help grow and deliver our Digital Trust & Cyber Security work in the United States. You will bring strong and relevant market experience from either Utilities or Transport. Experience across both sectors is not required. What matters is your ability to apply credible sector insight to the challenges facing organisations responsible for complex, interconnected and operationally critical services. You will work with senior clients to understand their priorities, shape opportunities and translate emerging cyber and technology risks into practical action. A particular area of focus will be post-quantum cryptography, where clients need to understand their exposure, assess critical systems and trust dependencies, establish priorities and plan a managed transition. This is a senior role combining market development, senior client engagement, commercial contribution, consulting delivery and team leadership. You will work with colleagues across PA, relevant US go-to-market teams and Jacobs to convert market opportunity into high-quality client work and repeatable capability. The role is expected to be aligned to PA’s Digital & Data stream and supported across the wider DTCS and Jacobs growth agenda. What you’ll be doing Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders in US Utilities and/or Transport organisations. Bring practical sector insight to conversations about cyber security, resilience, critical infrastructure and emerging technology risk. Identify and shape client opportunities, helping move them from initial conversations through qualification, proposal and delivery. Contribute to the growth of our US Digital Trust & Cyber Security business, including opportunities arising through PA’s collaboration with Jacobs. Help clients understand the relevance of post-quantum cryptography to their organisation, critical services, technology estate and supply chain. Shape and lead PQC-readiness work, including executive briefings, readiness assessments, prioritisation, roadmaps and related follow-on activity. Apply security-architecture thinking to cryptographic assets, trust relationships, technology and supplier dependencies, and the sequencing of migration. Connect sector, business and operational context with specialist cryptography, security architecture, OT, resilience and transformation expertise from across PA and Jacobs. Provide senior oversight as opportunities convert into delivery, ensuring teams remain focused on client outcomes, quality and practical recommendations. Lead consulting teams and create clear roles for specialist, delivery and junior colleagues. Contribute to propositions, market perspectives and reusable approaches where these support real client engagement and commercial opportunity. Support account and pursuit teams with sector insight, qualification, solution shaping, proposals and senior client discussions. Develop colleagues and help build a sustainable US capability around critical-infrastructure cyber security and PQC. What we’re looking for Significant professional experience in either Energy, Utilities or Transport, gained in consulting, industry or a combination of the two, with a familiarity of the relevant industry frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK TTPs, NIST CSF, and CIS Control etc). jobs.title: Safety Specialist, Environmental, Health & Safety Operations (Gloucester City, NJ)
jobs.jd: Wonderful Citrus is North America’s leading integrated grower, shipper and packer of fresh citrus, including clementines/mandarins, navel and Valencia oranges, lemons, limes, grapefruits, and other citrus varieties. Wonderful Citrus farms more than 74,000 acres of fresh citrus and has supplier relationships around the world to ensure a year-round supply. Our citrus can be found in all channels of distribution, with our consumer brands most visible in the produce department of grocery stores across the globe under our flagship consumer brands, Wonderful Halos Mandarins, Wonderful Seedless Lemons, and Wonderful Sweet Scarletts Texas Red Grapefruit. SUMMARY: THIS POSITION IS LOCATED 100% ONSITE IN GLOUCESTER CITY, NEW JERSEY AND WORKS THE SECOND SHIFT. To serve as the area specialist in safety and security by developing and carrying out procedures in collaboration with the local facility operations that will effectively control incident rates and health exposures in the company and minimize overall work related and site incidents. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Responsibilities include but are not limited to: Responds to and investigates work related injuries. Notifies management of pertinent details. Guides and assists plant personnel with all levels of safety and health opportunities. Reviews facility incident trends and makes recommendations for implementation of corrections. Supports internal forklift and aerial lift certification processes. Interact with 3rd party organizations to fulfill project completion goals safely and effectively. The candidate will work closely with the broader Finance team and Commission Managers/Directors/Cost Center Leaders with respect to overall commercial finance and operations. *On-site office presence is required 3 days out of the work week. Specifically, the Business Finance and Operations Manager will be responsible for the following: Financial Management & Analysis: Collaborate with Commission Managers/Directors/Cost Center Leads to forecast, invoice, and monitor project budgets, identify potential issues, and analyze financial performance. Work closely with the finance team to ensure accurate revenue and cost allocation, improve billing processes, and drive process efficiencies. Analyze utilization data, including timesheet compliance and accuracy, and support Cost Center Leaders with utilization reporting. Operational Support: Review and analyze expense submissions, ensuring timely and accurate accounting and invoicing. Coordinate midmonth and monthly forecast meetings with leadership teams. Assist with sector reporting for the Real Estate Sector. Review trial balances and update related commercial documents. Ensure adherence to T&T standard procedures and policies across the commercial function. Support the preparation of bids by reviewing project margin templates and financials. Coordinate all external client procurement portal registrations. Provide general administrative support, including meeting preparation and coordination. Monitor mandatory training and declaration completions across the territory. Project Management & Collaboration: Learn and support the digital team with the development of cost center leader dashboards. Lead, manage, or coordinate with existing market operations leads. Assist with special projects as requested. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail and accuracy level. Strong organization skills with the ability to prioritize effectively ensuring all deadlines are met. Strong team skills, collaborating with and supporting colleagues, senior management and external clients. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and strategically. Anticipate needs and proactively resolve issues. Resilient character, comfortable with operating in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple stakeholders and tight deadlines. Ability to handle confidential information and maintain the security of records and files. Self-starter who takes initiative to improve processes. Results driven with a pro-active approach. Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree, business or related field is preferred. Five+ years of experience in a business support/operations or finance/accounting function is preferred. Experience in client billing. Experience working in a professional services or consulting environment is a plus. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 accounting software is a plus. *SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable. *On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs* Our inspired people share our vision and mission. jobs.title: Operations & Engagement Coordinator, Agency Development & Sales Strategy
jobs.jd: The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. Job Description About the Team The mission of the Agency Development & Sales Strategy team is to leverage agencies as our next big source of incremental revenue growth. Our strategy is to create the conditions for our Sales Organization to drive more revenue from agency partners. Our approach is threefold: drive demand by changing perceptions; enable commerce by reducing friction and creating incentives; and standardize ways of working in order to scale. As a small but growing team, we have outsized impact by leveraging other internal teams, including Industry Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Programmatic Ops. About the Role You will report to the Associate Director, Agency Development & Sales Strategy. This role is based in our New York office and follows a hybrid work schedule. As the Operations & Engagement Coordinator, you will support the operational core of the team. You will help execute day-to-day processes, coordinate projects, and manage logistics that enable successful, long-term partnerships with advertising agencies, with a particular focus on agency-facing activations. You will ensure that information, timelines and logistics stay aligned. You will assist in setting up and maintaining internal systems and workflows that translate strategy into successful agency partnership. This role is ideal for a highly organized professional with strong project coordination skills, attention to detail, and an interest in agency partnerships, engagements, and media. Success in this role is defined by reliable execution, clear communication, and the smooth, scalable operation of our processes. Responsibilities Change agency perceptions of The Times Agency Engagements: Support the planning and coordination of agency-specific engagements (e.g., Lunch & Learns, leadership gatherings, summits); managing logistics, invitations, venue and vendor coordination, materials preparation, and day-of execution Scheduling: Maintain an event calendar, track deadlines, manage checklists, coordinate internal stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Research, Creative), and ensure follow-up actions and reporting are completed on time Outbound Communications: Help create external-facing materials – such as competitive reports and presentation decks – to strengthen agency relationships Enable commerce by reducing friction and creating incenti ves Agency Partnerships: Support the development and execution of revenue-generating deals with agency partners (e.g., tracking deliverables, updating status docs, coordinating approvals) Strategic Implementation: Support the roadmapping, scoping and executing of strategic initiatives and work streams aligned with team goals Prioritization and Planning: Coordinate with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Programmatic teams to identify opportunities, propose priorities, and ensure alignment on agency engagement strategies Standardize ways of working in order to scale Workflows: Help design and refine workflows and processes that streamline repeated tasks and external-facing materials, using AI-driven tools and automations where possible Industry Research: Monitor industry trends and agency needs, collaborating with Sales Ops and Measurement teams to generate insights that enhance The Times' value proposition. Lifecycle Support: Support the lifecycle of projects by helping to organize information, schedule meetings, capture notes and action items, and follow up with stakeholders to keep work moving Accountability: Use and help maintain tools and processes (e.g., CRM and reporting dashboards) required to associate our engagement efforts with real traction with agencies (e.g., RFPs, IOs) Basic Qualifications: 1+ years of experience in operations or project coordination, event planning, business strategy support, business development support, or a related field. jobs.title: Threat Actor Engagement & Intelligence Consultant - Remote (Anywhere in the U.S.)
jobs.jd: GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk. General Description: We are looking for a skilled threat actor communications and engagement professional to support GuidePoint’s Digital Forensics and Incident Response practice within the GuidePoint Research and Intelligence Team (GRIT). The primary function of this role will be threat actor communications (also known as threat actor engagement, or ransomware negotiations) for GuidePoint’s clients, collecting intelligence and advising digital extortion victims of appropriate courses of action aligned to their business needs. This is a client-facing role, requiring tact, professionalism, and a robust understanding of threat actor behavior and organization. The ideal candidate will also support GRIT’s intelligence research efforts, operationalizing threat intelligence data obtained through threat actor engagement and digital forensics efforts. The Threat Actor Engagement and Intelligence Consultant will be required to demonstrate strong client-facing consulting skills, calm under pressure, communications ability, and initiative under circumstances with unclear or incomplete guidance. About the GuidePoint Research and Intelligence Team: GRIT provides managed Threat Intelligence and Exposure Management services, Deep and Dark Web investigations, threat actor engagement, threat briefings, and advisory consulting in CTI operationalization, maturity, and program development. In each of these services, our goal is to better secure and prepare our clients to build, implement, and improve their security and CTI programs through advisory, instruction, assistance, or direct support. Additionally, GRIT supports GuidePoint’s DFIR practice, providing Threat Intelligence support to active intrusion investigations and response efforts, or informing DFIR advisory efforts and tabletop exercises. GRIT performs independent threat research into Ransomware and the cybercrime threat landscape, contributing to quarterly and annual reports, as well as Requests For Information (RFIs) and media inquiries. GuidePoint Security’s GRIT service offerings evolve in response to emerging threats and diverse client needs, and your creativity and expertise will assist the GRIT Practice with adapting to this rapidly changing environment. Roles and Responsibilities: Lead and conduct Threat Actor Communications engagements, advising clients, legal counsel, and insurance carriers on risks, benefits, and key considerations for communication with threat actors in ransomware and data extortion cases. Operate as a technical resource within the Practice and actively participate in DFIR investigations to share and identify actionable intelligence. Effective engagement communication, time management, and collaboration with peers and clients. Foster client relationships by providing support, information, and guidance Author comprehensive engagement deliverables that are tailored to both technical and managerial audiences; fully detail the technical findings, recommendations, business impact, and realistic remediation strategies. Utilize automation, orchestration, and scripting to reduce manual processes, improving overall efficiency while also enabling new capabilities to meet the rapidly changing needs of our clients. Contribute to integration of existing and future open-source and commercial tools or automation to help improve GRIT processes and procedures. Perpetually strengthen relevant skills, knowledge, and abilities to stay at the forefront of the information security industry. Maintain a strong desire to learn, adapt, and improve along with a rapidly growing company. Willingness and ability to support a rotating on-call schedule, including possible weekend work as needed to support emergency requirements. Required Experience and Education: 2 - 4 years prior experience in communicating with threat actors, such as through virtual persona operations, ransomware negotiations, or use of “sock puppet” accounts in Deep and Dark Web collection. Two (2+) years of experience performing Threat Intelligence analysis and/or collection Prior experience in intelligence sharing relationships and partnerships within the private sector, ISACs, government, and/or private intelligence sharing groups. Prior experience in building and developing persona operations, including familiarity with dark web forums and marketplaces, adversary behavior, and trust mechanisms. Familiarity with digital forensics and incident response workflows, processes, and deliverables. Experience in client-facing, professional services, or consulting roles. Experience using emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes. Preferred Experience and Education Familiarity with cryptocurrency tracing and blockchain technology. Experience implementing or improving operational processes or procedures in the intelligence lifecycle. Proficiency hunting APT data using open source or commercial cyber threat analytic tools or data repositories such as VirusTotal, Passive Total, Threat Miner, or Maltego. Experience in scoping and conducting threat research centered on cybercrime, ransomware, and/or nation-state cyber operation. Travel Requirements: Travel not required Physical Requirements: Sedentary work. Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day. Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day. We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application. Why GuidePoint? GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers. Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity. This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation. Some added perks…. Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions) Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options) Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment Pet Benefit Option

jobs.title: Power Market Data & Modeling Analyst II – Model Ready Data Team
jobs.jd: Join the Market Leader in Electric Power Data and Analytics Solutions The electrical grid is the largest and most complicated machine ever built. Yes Energy’s industry-leading electric power trading analytics software provides real-time visibility into the massive amount of data generated by the North American electrical grid daily. Our unique and innovative view of the data informs real-time trading decisions and mid-to-long-term investment decisions that keep utility prices low, support the energy transition, and keep the grid running. It’s both challenging work and work with a purpose. Be a part of our successful, growing business during international transformation. Position Summary The Model Ready Data Team builds the modeling data service behind EnCompass, Yes Energy’s power system simulation engine. We produce and maintain the model-ready datasets for North American power systems (generators, load, fuels, transmission, emissions, reserves, and more) that form the baseline for customers’ modeling ecosystems, along with the assumptions documentation that explains every input. We bridge Yes Energy’s Data Platform and Modeling disciplines by translating power system data and historical reports into modeling inputs and supporting the development of proprietary nodal LMP forecasts. As a Power Market Data & Modeling Analyst you will build, validate, and automate those datasets while developing expertise in one or more power markets. Position Details Salary Range: $105,000-$115,000 Location: Hybrid – Boulder, CO; Seattle, WA; or Boston (Newton), MA Full-time Reporting to: Director, Model Ready Data Travel requirements: Occasional travel as needed for client or team collaboration Primary Responsibilities Data Model Development: Build, test, and analyze data models for North American power systems, delivered as model-ready datasets for EnCompass Model Updates: Run regular model-update cycles: refresh generation fleets, load forecasts, fuel prices, interchanges, emissions, reserves, and transmission constraints from internal, public, and commercial sources Technical Optimization: Develop and maintain Python-based automation that ensures data quality from source to product Validation & Benchmarking: Validate models by running simulations, benchmarking results against historical market outcomes, and diagnosing discrepancies Automation : Automate recurring analytics & modeling workflows to increase operational efficiency across departments Documentation: Maintain customer-facing assumptions documentation for each market/region we model Market & Client Expertise: Become an expert in one or more power markets; support clients with case diagnosis and expert advice on power market modeling Continuous Improvement: Identify and research new data sources, tools, and modeling structures to improve model quality and sophistication Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a similar quantitative field Understanding of North American power market fundamentals and energy economics Strong technical execution and proven experience using Python (or similar) for data manipulation and automation Comfort working with large, messy tabular data (CSV, Excel, SQL) and checking it against its source A knack for good software and the habits that produce it: version control, code review, testing, and readable code Excellent analytical skills in response to open-ended questions Ability to work efficiently on multiple, non-overlapping tasks with minimal supervision Confidence in presenting technical content to both colleagues and clients Passion for the energy transition Preferred Qualifications Advanced Degree: M.S. or Ph.D. in engineering or computer science with a focus on power systems Simulation Experience: Experience with power system models such as Enelytix, EnCompass, PLEXOS, AURORA, or PROMOD; optimization, production cost modeling, or capacity expansion modeling experience Software Engineering: Practical experience contributing to large code bases Data Platforms: Experience with workflow orchestration (Dagster, Airflow, or similar) and cloud data platforms (Snowflake, AWS) Renewables Modeling: Experience with geospatial or weather data, or wind/solar generation modeling Systems Thinking: Ability to view the grid holistically, understanding dependencies between technology, data, and market processes. ABOUT YES ENERGY Overview Yes Energy delivers real-time market data and electric power trading decision solutions. Over 1,000 market participants use Yes Energy solutions daily. The business is a leader in all aspects of information content collection and management, developing and delivering data and market analytics solutions. Since its inception in 2008, Yes Energy has become a trusted and respected supplier of innovative and reliable solutions focused on the needs of power market analysts, traders, and trade managers. Yes Energy has a team of 400 amazing professionals in Boulder, CO (HQ); Boston, MA; Chicago, IL; Glendora, CA; Richmond, VA; London, United Kingdom; Auckland, New Zealand; and Bucharest, Romania. Culture Yes Energy has been named one of the Best Places to Work in Colorado, and we have the culture to prove it. At Yes Energy, we care about saying “Yes” to customers. We like to listen, learn, and develop our solutions in line with their needs. We think about customers as business partners, and when we help them be more successful … we are more successful, too. Around the office, our culture is driven by some pretty fundamental values that we’re proud of: We love innovation and solving tough challenges; We are “high standards people” who combine passion and pride with hard work and rewards of all kinds-- in an ethic that is consistent across the company. We’re team-focused with a flat hierarchy-- we work in small teams on well-defined projects that directly impact the success of the business; We play to the strengths and experience of each person while each of us also works along a continuum of roles adjacent to our focus area. This presents the challenge of maintaining a broad set of skills as well as an opportunity to learn and contribute in many ways. We are constantly growing. Professional development happens every day and every year. Compensation and Benefits We offer highly competitive salaries and real bonuses that are achievable and that you can impact. Our benefits package is also very competitive, including medical insurance, a 401 (k) Plan with matching, flexible vacation, and flexible work schedules. Yes Energy encourages and funds investment in both formal and informal professional development. At Yes Energy, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. In accordance with Colorado law, the range provided is Yes Energy’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may be higher or lower based on non-discriminatory factors such as location, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. Yes Energy provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Yes Energy complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location where the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: AML/Compliance Analyst
jobs.jd: Who We Are: Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more. Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it. Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator. Our Team Members: We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. Your Role: As the AML/Compliance Analyst, you’ll partner with the Chief Compliance Officer of Alpaca Crypto LLC to support and execute the anti-money laundering (AML) and compliance operations for our digital asset platform. This role is critical to mitigating risk, conducting transaction monitoring, and ensuring that Alpaca's crypto offerings operate securely and in full accordance with regulatory standards. The Compliance Department team is 100% distributed and remote. This role will report directly to the Chief Compliance Officer, Alpaca Crypto LLC. Key Responsibilities: Transaction Monitoring: Perform daily review and disposition of transaction monitoring alerts (fiat and crypto) to identify unusual or suspicious activity. Investigate & Report: Conduct deep-dive investigations into complex user accounts and blockchain transactions. Draft high-quality narratives and prepare/file Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) with appropriate regulatory bodies (e.g., FinCEN). Blockchain Forensics: Utilize on-chain analytics tools (e.g., Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic) to trace cryptocurrency flows, identify high-risk wallet interactions, and assess illicit finance risks. KYC / EDD: Assist with escalated Know Your Customer (KYC) / Know Your Business (KYB) reviews, Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), and OFAC sanctions screening. Rule Tuning & Optimization: Collaborate with the CCO and compliance engineering to refine and tune transaction monitoring rules, ensuring false positives are minimized while capturing actual risks. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with customer support, engineering, and product teams to integrate compliance controls seamlessly into the Alpaca API ecosystem. What You Need (Qualifications): Experience: 2–5 years of experience in AML, transaction monitoring, or financial crimes compliance within a cryptocurrency exchange, fintech, or traditional financial institution. Crypto Knowledge: Strong understanding of blockchain technology, digital assets, and the specific AML risks associated with the crypto ecosystem. Regulatory Grasp: Solid understanding of BSA/AML regulations, OFAC sanctions, and FinCEN guidance regarding virtual currency. Analytical Skills: Proven ability to analyze complex financial data, connect the dots across different platforms, and write clear, concise investigative narratives. Tools: Hands-on experience with blockchain analytics tools and traditional fiat transaction monitoring vendors. Autonomy: High level of self-motivation and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, 100% remote startup environment. Bonus: Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CAMS, CGSS, or crypto-specific certifications like CCAS/Chainalysis Reactor Certification) are a strong plus How We Take Care of You: Competitive Salary & Stock Options Health Benefits New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500 Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. jobs.title: Data Analyst, Autograph Operations & Governance
jobs.jd: About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. About the Company Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators. Role Summary The Data Analyst, Autograph Operations & Governance will support the accuracy, governance and flow of Autograph and Athlete Deal data across Athlete Partnerships, Product Development and Autograph Operations. Based in Sunnyvale and working closely with Autograph Operations, this role will help improve data quality, standardize processes and ensure reliable information across the end-to-end autograph lifecycle. The position will report into the centralized data governance team and serve as a key cross-functional partner to teams that create, manage and rely on autograph data. What you’ll be doing: Support the management, maintenance and improvement of systems used to track Athlete Deal and Autograph data. Monitor data quality and identify, investigate and resolve discrepancies across systems and workflows. Partner with Athlete Partnerships, Product Development and Autograph Operations to establish and maintain consistent data standards and processes. Support ongoing data cleanup, reconciliation and governance initiatives. Help document data sources, workflows, ownership and dependencies across the autograph lifecycle. Assist with Airtable architecture, access controls and data-management best practices. Review and reconcile Product Development and Autograph Operations data to ensure accuracy across systems. Support operational reporting, including Cards-In reporting and other recurring business needs. Help improve processes related to autograph orders, carryover cards, damages and other operational workflows. Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, duplicate data and disconnected processes. Create reporting and analysis for business leaders and cross-functional stakeholders as needed. jobs.jd: Who is Trace3 ? Trace3 is a leading Transformative IT Authority, providing unique technology solutions and consulting services to our clients. Equipped with elite engineering and dynamic innovation, we empower IT executives and their organizations to achieve competitive advantage through a process of Integrate, Automate, Innovate. Our culture at Trace3 embodies the spirit of a startup with the advantage of a scalable business. Employees can grow their career and have fun while doing it! Trace3 is headquartered in Irvine, California. We employ more than 1,200 people all over the United States. Our major field office locations include Denver, Indianapolis, Grand Rapids, Lexington, Los Angeles, Louisville, Texas, San Francisco. Ready to discover the possibilities that live in technology? Come Join Us! Street-Smart - Thriving in Dynamic Times We are flexible and resilient in a fast-changing environment. We continuously innovate and drive constructive change while keeping a focus on the “big picture.” We exercise sound business judgment in making high-quality decisions in a timely and cost-effective manner. We are highly creative and can dig deep within ourselves to find positive solutions to different problems. Juice - The “Stuff” it takes to be a Needle Mover We get things done and drive results. We lead without a title, empowering others through a can-do attitude. We look forward to the goal, mentally mapping out every checkpoint on the pathway to success, and visualizing what the final destination looks and feels like. Teamwork - Humble, Hungry and Smart We are humble individuals who understand how our job impacts the company's mission. We treat others with respect, admit mistakes, give credit where it’s due and demonstrate transparency. We “bring the weather” by exhibiting positive leadership and solution-focused thinking. We hug people in their trials, struggles, and failures – not just their success. We appreciate the individuality of the people around us. JOB SUMMARY: As part of the Finance team and under the general direction of the Senior Payroll Manager, the Payroll Analyst position provides operational support for payroll processing, reporting, compliance, employee services, and commissions administration across Trace3 and affiliated entities. The role supports POH, Finance, and all employees while helping the payroll department scale with continued growth and acquisition activity. This role is expected to strengthen business continuity, reduce key-person dependency, and provide additional capacity as Trace3 continues to grow through organic expansion and acquisitions. In addition to supporting day-to-day payroll operations, the position will serve as the designated backup for commissions administration, ensuring continuity for a critical compensation process. The role will support payroll processing, reporting, employee inquiries, compliance activities, audits, reconciliations, and post-payroll reporting while helping maintain accurate, timely, and scalable payroll operations. By assuming key operational responsibilities, this position allows senior payroll resources to focus on strategic initiatives, process improvements, system optimization, governance, and organizational growth. SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS: Process full-cycle payroll for exempt employees, corrections, commissions, bonuses, and final paychecks. Reconcile payroll records for each pay period and resolve discrepancies as needed. Respond to employee and management inquiries regarding payroll, deductions, taxes, and employment verifications. Maintain accurate payroll records and audit employee data to ensure compliance with wage laws and tax regulations. Ensure accurate processing of payments and deductions, including garnishments, levies, and benefits. Prepare and distribute payroll reports on a weekly, monthly, and year-to-date basis. Support internal and external audits by providing payroll documentation and analysis. Document workflows and standard procedures; identify and implement process improvements. Assist with the team on payroll-related projects such as implementations, system upgrades and automation initiatives. Collaborate with HR, Finance, IT, and other departments to ensure data accuracy and alignment with organizational goals. May perform other duties as assigned by supervisor. REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: High School Diploma required (college degree preferred). 3-5 years of related work experience. Understanding of Payroll business processes, and commissions. Experience with UKG (UltiPro) payroll software required. Solid understanding of payroll, final pay and multi jurisdiction taxation laws. Able to work well in a team environment. Advanced Excel (pivot tables, macros, Power Query, xlookup, sumifs). Experience with payroll integrations, data mapping, and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau). Ability to troubleshoot complex payroll system issues and recommend solutions. Must be detail-oriented and have strong analytical and organizational skills. Ability to multi-task, meet deadlines, and manage changing priorities. Excellent customer service skills. PHYSICAL DEMANDS: While performing the standard duties of this job, the employee can expect light physical exertion with long periods of sitting, occasional standing and walking; limited bending, crouching, stooping, stretching, reaching, or similar activities; occasional lifting/moving of items up to 25 pounds. Hearing and speech communication in person and over the telephone is essential to fulfilling the duties of this position. Specific vision abilities required to read printed materials and a computer screen; including close vision and the ability to adjust focus. WORK ENVIRONMENT: While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be remote or in person. Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, skill set, performance, licensure and certification, and business needs. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ. Our patented and best-selling products are designed to simplify and improve everyday life with leading-edge innovation, incomparable quality, and aspirational style. A career at Trove Brands is not about punching the clock. It’s about embracing exciting and fast-paced opportunities that sharpen your skills, drive innovation, and play an integral role in growing our global reach. Your work will not only impact the company, it will impact the lives of millions of people around the world. When you step up to a career at Trove, you step up to cutting-edge excellence. You sign up for bold action and invigorating synergy. You agree to face—and break through—new challenges every single day. Join the Digital Marketing team and help shape creative decisions across Trove Brands. As a Digital Creative Performance Analyst, you'll analyze paid advertising and email marketing performance to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and provide insights that inform future creative. Working closely with Digital and Creative teams, you'll support creative testing and contribute recommendations that strengthen campaign performance across our brands. Key Responsibilities: Analyze paid advertising and email marketing creative across product launches, seasonal campaigns, and evergreen initiatives. Evaluate key performance metrics, including click-through rates, conversion rates, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend. Identify trends in messaging, visuals, formats, and calls to action to understand what resonates with consumers and inform future creative. Translate performance data into actionable recommendations for new creative concepts and improvements. Support the planning and evaluation of A/B tests to identify opportunities for creative optimization. Track testing results and creative recommendations to measure impact and inform future decisions. Prepare monthly creative performance reports highlighting key trends, findings, and opportunities. Maintain organized records of creative testing results, insights, and best practices. Help develop consistent reporting templates and documentation to support ongoing creative analysis. Partner with Digital, Creative, and Brand teams to share insights and provide data-backed creative feedback. Participate in campaign planning to help apply previous learnings to upcoming initiatives. Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, data organization, and reporting. Foundational understanding of digital marketing metrics and A/B testing. Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with excellent attention to detail. A curious, collaborative mindset with an interest in creative strategy and a willingness to learn. Experience with pivot tables, dashboards, or other reporting tools. Exposure to creative testing, paid media, email marketing, or campaign optimization.
