jobs.title: People Operations Generalist
jobs.jd:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The first-day setup that goes smoothly. The benefits question answered with care. The employee change that reaches Payroll right on time. These moments shape how it feels to work at Notion, and People Operations helps make them happen.

As a People Operations Generalist, you’ll provide thoughtful operational support across People programs and processes, owning the critical touchpoints that make our team members feel supported throughout their journey. From the moment someone accepts their offer through their growth and transitions at Notion, you'll ensure every process runs smoothly. You may contribute to employee lifecycle, benefits, global mobility, HR systems, and other areas. You’ll manage work from intake through completion, keep records and handoffs accurate, and help employees and partners navigate processes with clear updates and follow-through.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can independently manage routine workflows, recognize when a case needs specialist or approval support, and adapt as responsibilities shift. The mix of work may evolve over time, creating opportunities to support different teams and build breadth across People Operations.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Make the everyday feel effortless. Process assigned HRIS and employee-lifecycle transactions; maintain clean People data in our HRIS through audits, validation checks, and partner handoffs that prevent downstream reporting issues

 - Be a helpful first stop. Act as the Tier 1 Support for employees. Triage and resolve questions or requests submitted to our ticketing system

 - Keep benefits running smoothly. Coordinate routine benefits transactions and employee update; support compliance workflows, respond to employee questions and requests; partner with benefits providers, HRIS, and Payroll to resolve eligibility or data discrepancies

 - Help people navigate global moves. Initiate and track immigration and relocation cases, milestones, and provide stakeholder follow-ups. Partner with employees, candidates, People Partners, Recruiting, hiring managers, and immigration counsel to keep cases moving.

 - Bring care and judgment to each case. Resolve routine cases using documented guidance and route exceptions, policy decisions, or sensitive matters to the appropriate specialist or approver.

 - Keep teams connected and work moving. Be a reliable partner to cross-functional teams, including Global Mobility, Recruiting, Legal, Finance, People Partners, and IT on all things People Operations

 - Build trust through accuracy. Manage compliance - SOC2, maintain employee files, support regular audits, etc.

 - Leave processes better than you found them. Support ad-hoc projects that improve our processes and operations. Support an employee experience that is thoughtful and consistent

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 2+ years in People Operations, benefits administration, global mobility coordination, or a related service-operations role.

 - Workday proficiency required, with hands-on experience managing employee data, processing employee lifecycle changes, and generating reports to support team

 - Experience managing and resolving employee inquiries through a case-tracking system or ticketing queue using platforms such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, or other systems

 - Experience creating or improving SOPs through documentation and operational reports

 - Confidence managing repeatable workflows independently, prioritizing competing requests, following through on details, and learning new workstreams as priorities change.

 - Strong service orientation and clear, empathetic written communication, with strong triage and prioritization skills

 - Comfort working with data: maintaining data accuracy, building simple metrics, and communicating findings clearly

 - Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle sensitive employee data with discretion

 - Ability to coordinate across employees, vendors, counsel, and internal partners

 - A process-improvement mindset: you notice patterns and look for ways to make support more accurate and easier to navigate




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $53.36 - $59.61 hourly, annualized to a base salary range of $111,000 - $124,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. jobs.title: Trusted Access Specialist, Critical Harm Operations
jobs.jd:
About the team

Trusted Access helps eligible customers access and use advanced AI capabilities with appropriate safeguards. Within User Safety & Risk Operations, we connect customer onboarding, eligibility review, access provisioning, and support into a service customers can navigate with confidence.

We work with Product, Engineering, technical support, regional operations, and customer-facing teams to resolve difficult access problems and improve the systems behind them. Our work combines sound judgment on individual cases with better products, clearer guidance, and automation that reduces unnecessary friction.

About the role

We’re looking for a senior operator to own and improve the customer access workflow for an assigned Trusted Access program. You will connect application and eligibility review, approvals, appeals, provisioning coordination, and support so customers can reach a clear, reliable outcome.

Your primary focus will be improving how the program works. You’ll use complex customer cases to uncover recurring problems, then deliver product, automation, self-service, and support-process improvements. You’ll also own difficult eligibility and access escalations, helping customers and account teams understand what is blocking progress and driving the right partners toward resolution.

This role combines independent workflow ownership with hands-on operational judgment. Success means customers reach usable access with fewer avoidable delays, decisions remain accurate, and the workflow runs reliably through the people and systems you enable.

In this role, you will:

 - Own the operational workflow for an assigned Trusted Access program, from application through confirmed access and subsequent changes. Identify where customers get stuck and prioritize improvements by customer impact, risk, and effort.

 - Investigate complex eligibility, onboarding, and access cases. Reconcile approval, verification, account, workspace, and provisioning records; apply approved requirements within your authority and bring exceptions to the appropriate decision-maker.

 - Drive customer and account-team escalations through resolution. Establish the blocker, maintain clear ownership across handoffs, communicate realistic next steps, and confirm that the customer can use the intended capability.

 - Turn recurring case patterns into product and process changes with Product, Engineering, and customer-facing partners. Define the problem and requirements, help validate the fix, and measure whether it reduced repeat contacts or manual work.

 - Build guidance that makes reliable resolution repeatable: support playbooks, help-center content, training, and quality checks. Enable frontline and outsourced support teams to handle more cases accurately and independently.

 - Use data to distinguish fast ticket closure from better access outcomes. Diagnose delays, rework, and decision errors, and use the findings to refine your workflow and priorities.

 - Develop and validate AI-assisted workflows and automation with technical partners. Establish checks, human review, and fallback paths appropriate to the decisions involved.

 - Maintain clear documentation and qualified backup across programs. Share what you learn so improvements continue working when another specialist takes ownership.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have independently owned and improved customer support, onboarding, access, risk, or product-operations workflows in a complex service environment.

 - Can show durable improvements you delivered through product changes, self-service, automation, or partner enablement, with evidence of adoption and better customer outcomes.

 - Exercise sound judgment when records conflict, requirements are unclear, or customers need urgent help. You can separate what the evidence supports from what still needs an authorized decision.

jobs.title: Founding Data Scientist, Capacity & Pricing Optimization
jobs.jd:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.


THE ROLE:

GPUs are the most expensive and supply-constrained input in AI. Our ability to effectively deploy them towards our customer demand is one of the critical inputs to our growth. We're hiring our first Data Scientist to build and own the quantitative models that drive pricing, packaging, and capacity allocation in order to optimize capacity and balance supply with demand.

The ideal candidate brings expertise at the intersection of operations research and economics with the ability to both model our market, build dynamic pricing models, and design experiments and causal studies. This is a hands-on role: you'll write production-quality code, ship models that drive real decisions, and bring an true ownership mentality to help set priorities in addition to executing on them.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON:




SUPPLY/DEMAND MODELING

 - Build fill-rate models for serverless inference, balancing utilization against performance and latency targets.

 - Model how traffic is shared and multiplexed across models and customers to set safe capacity buffers.


PRICING OPTIMIZATION

 - Design pricing for low-utilization capacity, including spot and preemptible offerings, off-peak and overnight windows, and sub-scale capacity pools.

 - Develop pricing policies to optimize our capacity utilization and price-yield.

 - Design execute experiments and causal studies to estimate elasticity across customer segments, models, and products.


GPU MIX OPTIMIZATION

 - Optimize the model-hardware matching across GPU generations, vendors, clouds, and regions, accounting for workload fit, substitution, and lead times.

 - Optimize our capacity across commitment types and terms, quantifying the tradeoff between cost, flexibility, and utilization risk to guide how we source capacity.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.title: Growth
jobs.jd:
GROWTH

About the role

Pure is looking for one of our first dedicated growth hires to own how we acquire users. You’ll decide where our dollars go across paid social, creators, influencers, and community, and run fast, disciplined tests to find what actually moves, installs and retains users. Creative is the core of that work: you’ll build an in-house, ideally automated ad engine that produces hundreds of variants for Meta and TikTok, giving the team a fast read on what works.

You’ll be our first dedicated growth hire, working with the founders. This is a builder role: you’ll run the experiments yourself and own the results.

Location: In-person only (New York office)
Type: Full-time
Reports to: GTM

What you’ll do

 - Own the acquisition testing roadmap across paid social, UGC and creator content, influencer partnerships, outbound, and community. Decide what to test, what to scale, and what to cut.

 - Treat creative as the primary growth lever. Produce and edit hundreds of ad variants for Meta and TikTok, using AI video generation and traditional editing together.

 - Build the creative engine behind a multi million dollar monthly marketing budget, AI generation, and batch editing and export workflows, so one concept becomes dozens of variants without adding headcount.

 - Run tight feedback loops. Launch, read the data, kill losers, and turn the next batch around in hours, not days.

 - Mine the Meta Ad Library and study how category leaders run their creative. Adapt the formats that work, including celebrity-style and UGC-style ads.

 - Work with the UGC and content lead and the GTM lead (influencers, outbound, partnerships) so paid and creator channels reinforce each other. Use ad learnings to brief creators, and use creator wins as ad material.

 - Build the measurement picture, tracking cost per install, cost per retained user, and creative-level performance so spend decisions rest on data.

 - Stay deep in the app so every ad and experiment reflects how people actually use and talk about it.

What we’re looking for

 - A track record of getting users or customers through paid social, short-form video, or creator-led channels, whether at a company or on your own.

 - A portfolio of ads or social videos you made yourself, showing range, speed, and, ideally, results.

 - A test-and-learn mindset. You’re comfortable forming a hypothesis, running a small test, and making a call with imperfect data.

 - Strong editing skills in tools such as CapCut, Premiere, After Effects, or similar.

 - Hands-on experience with AI video generation tools.

 - High social media fluency. You know what looks native on Meta and TikTok.

 - Obsessed with the app and its users.

 - Scrappy and fast, comfortable shipping a lot of work in a fast-paced environment.

 - Able to work in person at our NYC office.

Nice to have

 - Experience bootstrapping a business or running your own paid social.

 - Experience writing scripts or working with UGC creators.

 - Community or social account management experience.

Perks & benefits

 - Medical, dental and vision insurance, with 100% of premiums covered by Pure, starting on your first day.

 - Free Equinox membership.

 - Dinner provided in the office every night.

 - Up to $75/day for other meals when in the office.

 - Weekly dry cleaning and laundry service.

Pure is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: BOM Analyst (1st shift)
jobs.jd: Hyve Company Overview Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure. Position Overview The BOM Analyst is responsible for creating, maintaining, and auditing Bills of Materials (BOMs) to ensure accurate configuration of Hyve’s server, rack, and PCBA products. This role supports Engineering and Operations by ensuring part numbers, revisions, alternates, and quantities are correct in the ERP system, enabling smooth production and minimizing rework or scrap. Key Responsibilities Create, update, and maintain BOMs within the ERP system (SAP/Oracle or equivalent). Validate part numbers, revisions, quantities, alternates, and item attributes for accuracy. Process and implement Engineering Change Orders (ECO/ECN) with attention to detail and minimal production disruption. Partner with Engineering, NPI, Supply Chain, and Production to resolve BOM discrepancies and support new product builds. Audit BOMs regularly to ensure alignment with engineering documentation and actual production usage. Support item master data maintenance, including UOM, lead time, revision control, and part classification. Identify and correct data issues that impact material planning, production, or configuration accuracy. Assist with documentation updates, configuration tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives. Required Qualifications 1–5 years of experience in BOM management, configuration control, or manufacturing data analysis. Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or proprietary). Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, part specifications, and change documentation. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Effective communication skills and ability to work cross‑functionally in a fast‑paced environment. Basic understanding of electronics components, assemblies, or high‑mix manufacturing preferred. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Technology, or related field; or equivalent experience. Experience supporting server, rack, PCBA, or electronics manufacturing. Familiarity with ECO/ECR processes and change control systems (Agile, Arena, Windchill, etc.). Knowledge of configuration management principles. Experience with NPI builds or engineering support roles. jobs.jd: Cardinal Health Canada, with over 1300 employees is an essential link in the Canadian healthcare supply chain, providing over 70,000 products to healthcare facilities and medical professionals across the country. The Pricing Analyst will be accountable for the setup, maintenance and regular updates to all pricing agreements, vendor contracts and customer contracts for assigned accounts. This is a full-time, 12-month contract role working in a hybrid work model which requires on-site presence twice a week at the Vaughan/Dorval Office. This role needs someone who has a keen attention to detail, a passion for data and a customer centric approach. jobs.title: Commodity Risk & Financial Analyst
jobs.jd: Job Description: Key Responsibilities Commodity Risk Management, Valuation & Reporting Execute daily commodity risk management processes, including trade validation, trade reconciliation, exposure monitoring, and risk reporting across multiple commodities and regions. Generate and maintain commodity exposure, hedge coverage, net open position, and market risk reports for business and leadership stakeholders. Maintain and validate commodity forecast, pricing, position, and market data to ensure integrity and consistency across systems and reports. Partner with Commodity Price Risk Managers to evaluate hedge structures, coverage strategies, and potential financial impacts of commodity market movements. Support liquidity forecasting and reporting related to commodity hedging activities, including cash settlement requirements, margin obligations, and derivative-related cash flows. Financial Analysis, P&L Attribution & Business Insights Develop and maintain financial models, dashboards, and reporting tools to quantify commodity exposures, hedging performance, market risks, and business impacts across the global Mars Snacking portfolio. Deliver P&L attribution and cause-of-change analysis, identifying key drivers of financial performance including commodity price movements, basis changes, hedge impacts, timing effects, and market structure shifts. Conduct scenario analysis, sensitivity modeling, and risk and opportunity assessments to evaluate financial impacts and support strategic decision-making. Support budgeting, forecasting, and business performance reviews by translating commodity market dynamics and hedging activities into clear financial outcomes. Prepare executive-ready reporting and insights that communicate commodity exposures, financial impacts, risks, opportunities, and mitigation strategies. Hedge Accounting, Financial Controls & Governance Support hedge accounting programs through documentation, monitoring, and testing of designated hedging relationships in partnership with Treasury and Technical Accounting teams. Perform prospective and retrospective hedge effectiveness testing to ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and maximize hedge accounting effectiveness. Maintain a strong control environment around commodity transactions, trade validation, market data governance, curve management, and financial reporting processes. Support internal and external audits by providing valuation support, reconciliation documentation, control evidence, and commodity risk reporting. Ensure compliance with commodity risk management policies, financial controls, and governance requirements. Systems, Data Management & Process Improvement Serve as a key user and business owner for commodity risk management and CTRM systems, supporting system integrity, process controls, master data governance, and end-user adoption. Reconcile data across CTRM platforms, broker statements, ERP systems, market data providers, and financial reporting systems. Develop and enhance reporting and analytical solutions using Excel, VBA, SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, and other technology platforms. Identify automation opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, reporting accuracy, transparency, and controls. Support implementation, testing, and ongoing enhancement of commodity risk management systems and technology platforms. Planning & Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Treasury, Technical Accounting, Finance, Procurement, S&OP, Commercial Finance, and Commodity Price Risk Managers to support commodity risk management objectives. Support demand forecast validation and volume planning processes that underpin commodity exposure and hedge management activities. Support budgeting, forecast updates, cause-of-change reporting, and business performance reviews in collaboration with Finance Business Partners. Provide analytical support for business planning, sourcing decisions, commodity strategy development, and financial performance management. Build strong relationships across Treasury, Procurement, Planning, Manufacturing, Commercial, and Finance teams, providing insights and executive-ready reporting to support business decisions. Required Experience & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Financial Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related analytical field. Strong understanding of global commodity markets, trading, hedging, valuation methodologies, and risk management principles. Experience supporting commodity risk management, treasury, commodity trading, market risk, financial planning, product control, or commodity finance organizations. Experience developing financial models that combine commodity pricing, sourcing assumptions, exposure forecasts, hedge results, and business drivers to assess P&L impacts. Experience with commodity exposure reporting, Mark-to-Market valuation, trade reconciliation, hedge effectiveness testing, financial controls, and P&L attribution analysis. Advanced analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and deliver actionable insights. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with SQL, Python, VBA, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical and reporting tools. Experience with CTRM systems, ERP platforms, financial reporting systems, and market data providers preferred. Demonstrated ability to perform data validation, reconciliation, valuation, financial analysis, and reporting in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Excellent critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities. Proactive mindset with a willingness to challenge discrepancies, improve processes, and recommend solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional teams. Demonstrated success operating within complex matrix organizations and collaborating with diverse internal and external stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting commodity trading, procurement, treasury, risk management, hedge accounting, or commodity finance organizations. Knowledge of futures, options, swaps, OTC instruments, and hedge accounting methodologies. Experience with independent price verification (IPV), P&L attribution, hedge effectiveness testing, and financial controls. Experience working with CTRM systems, data warehouses, ERP systems, and business intelligence platforms. Exposure to agricultural, dairy, energy, packaging, or other globally traded commodity markets. Professional certifications such as CFA, FRM, CPA, or equivalent are considered a plus. What can you expect from Mars? Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles. Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today. A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University. An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus. #LI-JH1 #LI-Onsite The base pay range for this position at commencement of employment is between the range listed below, however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position will include variable pay, medical and dental benefits, participation in 401k plan, and paid time off benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an applicant receives an offer of employment. jobs.jd: YOUR OPPORTUNITY A truly unique role offering the opportunity to influence GTR Europe performance with the chance to help dynamically manage P&L and gain front line commercial finance experience. On the other, you will be getting into the details on Europe sales performance, working with the commercial teams to identify opportunities & drive delivery, managing costs & tracking KPIs in Europe P&L. Develop detailed monthly regional performance reports (market, brand, customer level) covering NSV, GP, GM%, DBC and variance analysis vs. budget. Align landing positions (Vol, NSV, GP, A&P) with Commercial and Marketing leads before submitting updates to the Regional Director, Finance Manager, and Central Finance. Maintain accurate Volume, NSV, and GP forecasts through continuous review and improvement of forecasting tool. Collaborate with Commercial team to prepare annual commercial plans (IAP/Budget) for review and approval by the Regional Director and Finance Manager. Support the Regional Finance Manager in quarterly customer credit assessments and reviews. Ensure accurate month-end accrual postings through timely and correct MJEs. Review accrual adequacy by comparing accruals vs. actual invoices and customers’ stock-in-hand. Conduct quarterly accrual adequacy checks with the Commercial team and obtain sign-off from the Regional Director. MARKETING DECISION SUPPORT: Review monthly A&P Planner vs. Budget/LE and prepare landing positions for month, quarter, and FY; challenge Commercial and CMM teams to optimize ROI on incremental A&P spend. Embed culture of cost control within regional commercial teams. Share variance analysis of Travel & Entertainment actual spends vs Budget and update Forecast on monthly basis. Able to prioritize effectively and manage workload against tight deadlines Fundamental understanding of internal controls, standards, and processes to ensure accuracy and consistency in data used for decision-making, internal/external reporting and communications Strong communication, influencing, presentation & collaboration skills required in order to achieve results across the organization High comfort in modelling & understanding large & complex data sets into useful information & insights Education: Accounting qualifications (CA or equivalent). Degree level with strong results. LEADERSHIP AGILITY At Bacardi we care deeply about finding brilliant talent who can bring the following personal attributes to help elevate our 3Fs: Fearless, Family, Founder culture to the next level. Belonging: You have a strong capacity to create a culture of ‘Belonging’, where people feel appreciated for who they are, what they do, and who they can become Self-Awareness: You have high levels of self-awareness, are reflective and know yourself well, understanding both your own strengths and weaknesses and your impact on others People Agility: You bring a deep ability to understand and relate to people and navigate through tough situations to harness and multiply collective performance Results Agility : You demonstrate consistent delivery of results in first-time situations by inspiring teams, exhibiting a presence that builds confidence in yourself and others. Mental Agility : You can think critically to penetrate complex problems and expand the possibilities by making fresh connections. You think strategically whilst being execution focused and bring creativity to the challenges you’re presented with Change Agility: You have a deep natural curiosity, desire to experiment and ability to effectively deal with the heat of change. You have a growth and learning mindset: ready to test, stumble, learn and apply from experience Disclaimer: Bacardi seeks talent from all backgrounds to bring diversity of thought, agility and capability to our organization across the globe. The consultant partners closely with executive sponsors, business leaders, project teams, communications, training, and functional stakeholders to identify change impacts, assess organizational readiness, mitigate adoption risks, and measure realization of expected business outcomes. jobs.title: Center for Global Security Research (CGSR) Undergraduate Research Associate - Summer 2027
jobs.jd: Join us and make YOUR mark on the World! Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability. Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact. The Center for Global Security Research (CGSR) was established at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) in 1996 to bring together experts from the science, technology, and policy communities to address pressing national security challenges. For over 20 years, CGSR has engaged diverse perspectives on topics important to national security, deterrence, diplomacy, dual-use technology, arms control, nonproliferation, space, cyber, biosecurity, and energy security. We have openings in Summer 2027 for undergraduate students to engage in practical research on global security topics. Students will work with CGSR over the duration of three to four months as a research associate (RA). RAs will engage in practical research to further their educational and career goals, while also supporting the development of strategies for national security and LLNL’s mission focus areas. Examples of relevant fields of research include nuclear deterrence, arms control, nonproliferation, emerging technologies, cybersecurity, space, biological & chemical security, and energy security. This position offers a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You will have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week. CGSR’s objectives are as follows: To explore the dynamics of potential 21st century strategic conflicts (i.e., those with a potential nuclear aspect) and to formulate ideas about how to achieve U.S. deterrence and other objectives in such conflicts. To explore the sources and characteristics of strategic competition in the emerging security environment and to formulate organizing concepts to enhance the competitive position of the United States and its allies and partners over the long term. To identify whether and how technically based approaches can address new challenges to national and international security. To catalyze broader national and international thinking about the requirements of effective deterrence, assurance, and strategic stability in a changed and changing security environment. To assist in the development of new generations of experts motivated by a clear view of the changed and changing security environment. More information on CGSR, its research focus areas, and its publications can be found at https://cgsr.llnl.gov/ . This job will be closed to applicants on February 1, 2027. You will Conduct an independent research project on an agreed upon topic aligned with CGSR/LLNL research priorities under the supervision of CGSR staff. Support CGSR/LLNL through contributions to ongoing research activities. Tasks may include contributing to literature reviews, annotated bibliographies, and workshop summary reports. Attend relevant research seminars, speakers’ series, and workshops. Present research to LLNL staff at end of the assignment. Prepare end-of-assignment technical report or publication. Perform all assignments in accordance with ES&H, security, and business practice requirements and policies. Perform other duties as assigned. Must be eligible to access the Laboratory in compliance with Section 3112 of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA). See Additional Information section below for details. Must be currently enrolled in an accredited university or have completed AA/AS degree in a field of research aligned with CGSR analytic priorities. Areas of study include international relations and/or security, political science, economics, public policy, emerging technologies, nonproliferation, energy, biosecurity, foreign language studies, or related fields. Demonstrated academic and/or professional achievement in a relevant field of research aligned with CGSR analytic priorities. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact. You will manage facility documents and records in accordance with all LLNL, DOE and ES&H requirements. You may also serve as additional support in the areas of document control or information management application development. These positions will be in the Administration Division within the Operations and Business Directorate and is matrixed to the Strategic Deterrence (SD) Directorate. jobs.jd: By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive. Why join Harvard Business School? Harvard Business School, located on a 40-acre campus in Boston, was founded in 1908 as part of Harvard University. It is among the world's most trusted sources of management education and thought leadership. For more than a century, the School's faculty has combined a passion for teaching with rigorous research conducted alongside practitioners at world-leading organizations to educate leaders who make a difference in the world. Through a dynamic ecosystem of research, learning, and entrepreneurship that includes MBA, Doctoral, Executive Education, and Online programs, as well as numerous initiatives, centers, institutes, and labs, Harvard Business School fosters bold new ideas and collaborative learning networks that shape the future of business. Harvard Business School (HBS) is seeking multiple Predoctoral Research Associates starting in Summer 2027 to support an assigned faculty member in one of the following academic units. Accounting & Management Business, Government and the International Economy Entrepreneurial Management Finance General Management Marketing Negotiation Organizations & Markets Organizational Behavior Strategy Technology and Operations Management Research subjects can include but are not limited to: labor economics, marketing economics, private equity / venture capital disclosures and taxation, decision making and gender stereotypes in shaping beliefs, industrial organization and the market design of digital platforms, media economics and economics of digital platforms, emerging financial technologies and alternative data, political economy and empirical corporate finance, R&D strategy and the economics of innovation, entrepreneurial management, corporate social responsibilities focused on climate change and gender diversity, asset pricing shaping politics and markets, specialized knowledge commercialization and micro-geographic environments shaping innovation, behavioral economics, intergroup inequity, and tech strategy. Please note the faculty currently hiring include: Ray Kluender : Professor Kluender researches analyzes the determinants of financial well-being and the nature of financial distress, traces the frontier of how entrepreneurship and technology can solve social problems, and identifies market failures and the implications for appropriate corrective policies. Current projects involve partnerships with large-scale financial technology companies and employ a wide range of empirical approaches. His predoc researcher will get hands-on experience with every stage of the research project from conception through publication and will develop a wide range of empirical skills to prepare them for PhD programs. A two-year commitment is expected. Professor Kluender's three prior predocs are currently pursuing PhDs at Princeton, Berkeley, and Harvard. Maren Hoff : Professor Maren Hoff at Harvard Business School is seeking a part-time Research Assistant/Predoc to assist with projects in consumer behavior. Tasks will include literature reviews, experimental designs, and analysis in R. This position is well-suited for pre-docs or master’s students interested in pursuing a PhD in behavioral science, marketing, psychology, or related fields. Candidates interested in a January start encouraged to apply. Christopher Stanton : Conduct empirical and theoretical research in organizational economics, focusing on how markets and workplaces shape competition, productivity, and economic opportunity. Zoe Cullen : Professor Cullen is a labor economist whose research examines how information, technology, and firm behavior shape the well-being of workers and society. Her current projects study how artificial intelligence is reshaping the value of human expertise and the distribution of wages across workers and firms, as well as contemporaneous forces determining worker bargaining power. These projects involve large-scale field experiments and partnerships with technology and payroll companies, drawing on administrative data and a wide range of empirical methods. Her predoc researcher will get hands-on experience with every stage of the research process, from designing experiments through analysis and publication, and will build the empirical and institutional skills needed for a top PhD program. Professor Cullen's prior predocs are currently pursuing PhDs at MIT, Princeton, Chicago, and Yale. Ideal candidates will be comfortable in an environment that requires a high level of independence, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to use discretionary judgment. Primary duties: Work under the general direction of HBS faculty on topics central to HBS research agenda. Provide subject-area knowledge, analysis and interpretation to faculty member. Identify and explore a wide-range of questions related to faculty’s research agenda. Write cases, case supplements, project reports, and policy memos from start to finish creating original writing based on subject-area expertise, research, and interviews, and write articles for applicable business audiences such as Harvard Business Review. Develop, design, conduct, analyze, and implement research using data science knowledge and prior knowledge of requested statistical packages. Perform statistical programming. Experience with NLP. Manage and manipulate data using requested packages, such as STATA, Python, R, or MATLAB. Ensure compliance with department, University, and federal regulations. Complete work with only general direction. Be aware of department, School, University policies and potential outside research policies. Under general direction of faculty member, must be able to take complex research ideas, concepts, and methodologies and apply them to new projects and situations. Must be able to structure assignments and keep faculty member informed as necessary, using own judgment. Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents. Responsible for other duties as assigned. Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree with a GPA above 3.5 is required. Additional Qualifications and Skills: Proven evidence of independent research in specific advanced field of study. Evidence of prior high-quality, original academic writing, and background in analysis and interpretation of relevant data, research, news, and literature is helpful. Ability to read academic, subject-specific information and write a reasoned and thoughtful analysis, as well as produce a creative interpretation, is a must. The candidate must have extremely high standards in terms of quality of work, attention to detail, strong organization skills, and absolute commitment to task completion. Must be able to balance multiple tasks and shifting priorities under tight deadlines at an accelerated pace when necessary. It is helpful if the candidate is familiar with navigating a complex organization, such as Harvard Business School. jobs.jd: About Us SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja , the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world. AI at SharkNinja At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in. Position Summary The DTC Fulfillment Analyst is responsible for monitoring and improving end-to-end Order-to-Porch performance for direct-to-consumer shipments. This role reviews daily shipment and tracking data, proactively manages delivery exceptions, and drives accountability and corrective actions with parcel carriers and DC operations partners to ensure a fast, reliable, and positive consumer delivery experience. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, data-driven, and comfortable working cross-functionally with carriers, customer service, and internal operations teams to resolve delays, prevent recurring delivery issues and striving for a superior customer experience everyday. Key Responsibilities Order-to-Porch Performance Monitor daily DTC shipment activity and tracking status to ensure on-time delivery performance. Identify at-risk, delayed, or stalled shipments and take proactive action to resolve issues. Track and report Order-to-Porch lead time performance against service level targets. Present ideas for Order-to-Porch lead time improvements for alignment and implementation. Carrier Management & Accountability Drive carrier accountability through root-cause analysis, follow-ups, and corrective action requests. Escalate recurring issues and support carrier performance reviews with data and insights. Exception Management Investigate delivery exceptions including pickup and in-transit delays, misroutes, failed delivery attempts, and lost or damaged shipments. Coordinate resolutions with carriers, fulfillment centers, and customer service teams. Ensure timely and accurate updates are communicated to internal stakeholders. Consumer Experience Support Partner with Customer Experience teams to minimize consumer impact from delivery delays. Support post-purchase experience by ensuring shipment issues are resolved quickly and accurately. Identify trends that negatively impact consumer satisfaction and recommend process improvements. Reporting & Continuous Improvement Maintain dashboards and reports related to shipment status, delivery performance, and carrier KPIs. Analyze trends to identify opportunities to improve speed, reliability, and cost. Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing delivery delays and exceptions. Qualifications Required Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience) 1-3 years of experience in logistics, transportation, fulfillment, or e-commerce operations Experience working with parcel carriers and shipment tracking systems Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large data sets High attention to detail and strong follow-through Preferred Experience supporting DTC or e-commerce fulfillment operations Familiarity with Order Management Systems (OMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), or carrier portals Experience with carrier performance metrics and service level management Key Skills & Competencies Shipment tracking and exception management Data analysis and reporting Problem solving and root-cause analysis Cross-functional communication and collaboration Customer-first mindset Success in This Role Looks Like: Reduced Order-to-Porch lead time and delivery variability Fewer repeat carrier service issues Faster identification and resolution of delivery exceptions Improved consumer delivery experience and satisfaction Other Requirements Travel Required - up to 10% Salary and Other Compensation: The annual salary range for this position is displayed below. jobs.title: Leasing & Sales Consultant-Cortland Dublin
jobs.jd: At Cortland, we operate with a forward-thinking approach that challenges conventional norms and actively seeks insights beyond traditional industry boundaries. As a recognized leader in the multifamily sector, our focus on performance, innovation, and disciplined execution continues to drive strong growth and market leadership. We are committed to building a best-in-class organization by empowering top talent with the resources, autonomy, and support needed to deliver results and advance their careers in a high-performance environment. Role Overview As a Leasing & Sales Consultant, you’ll be the driving force behind occupancy and revenue at your community. This role goes beyond leasing apartments; it’s about selling a lifestyle and creating an experience that makes people proud to call Cortland “home.” You’ll combine proactive sales strategies with exceptional engagement to turn prospects into residents and keep your community thriving. Sales & Revenue Generation: Drive occupancy and revenue by achieving and exceeding leasing goals, conversion targets, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Actively manage your sales pipeline—follow up promptly, nurture potential residents, and close leases with confidence. Use consultative selling techniques to uncover needs, present solutions, and create value that resonates with each potential resident. Keep CRM records accurate and up to date for all potential resident interactions. Monitor and report on lead activity, conversion metrics, and pipeline health. Stay organized and disciplined to ensure timely follow-up and consistent engagement. Community Advocacy & Resident Experience: Guide potential residents through the leasing process with confidence and care, making it simple, stress-free, and enjoyable journey that reinforces our brand promise of better living. Deliver a concierge-level experience by anticipating needs, offering personalized solutions, and creating memorable interactions. Build lasting relationships that inspire loyalty and referrals through exceptional service. Represent the community as an ambassador, showcasing not just homes but a lifestyle of comfort, convenience, and premium living. Handle objections gracefully, turning challenges into opportunities. Establish, manage, and maintain marketing programs and social media presence to attract and retain residents. Plan and execute resident events and engagement programs that strengthen community ties. Adaptability & Continuous Improvement: Respond to coaching and feedback with agility; implement best practices promptly. Adjust sales approach based on market conditions, prospect needs, and leadership guidance. Professionalism & Brand Alignment: Maintain integrity, accountability, and reliability in all aspects of performance. Maintain a polished, approachable presence that reflects our premium brand standards in every interaction. Qualifications 6+ months of sales, customer-facing, or performance-driven experience preferred. Strong desire to succeed in a goal-oriented, fast-paced sales environment. Confident, persuasive, and people-focused with a natural ability to build rapport. Coachable and resilient, with a positive attitude and willingness to learn. Motivated by targets, results, and earning potential; comfortable being held to goals. Organized and disciplined with follow-up, time management, and attention to detail. Comfortable learning and using CRM systems to track leads and customer interactions. Professional, polished, and approachable with a strong sense of personal presentation. Aligns with company values and takes pride in representing a premium brand experience. Join us as we reimagine apartment living and drive outsized returns through purpose, performance, and people. jobs.title: Technical Business Requirements Analyst
jobs.jd: Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space. Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart. You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality. If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager. The Technical Business Requirements Analyst serves as the business-facing liaison between manufacturing operations and Information Technology. This role translates manufacturing needs into clear, actionable, and testable requirements for the digital tools that support production, inventory, supply chain, quality, engineering, configuration management, and shipping. The analyst also helps teams explore solutions early through wireframing, lightweight user-experience design, and AI-assisted prototyping. By making workflows and concepts visible before development, the role helps manufacturing users, IT, and engineering align on the right problem, the right interaction model, and the right technical path. Core Responsibilities Requirements analysis and business liaison Partner with manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, inventory, and operations stakeholders to understand business needs and operational challenges. Elicit, document, analyze, prioritize, and validate business, functional, technical, data, reporting, and integration requirements. Translate operational needs into user stories, use cases, workflow diagrams, functional requirements, nonfunctional requirements, and acceptance criteria. Document current-state and future-state processes and maintain traceability from the original business need through design, development, testing, release, and implementation. Represent manufacturing priorities during project planning, backlog refinement, solution design, implementation, and release planning. Wireframing and user experience definition Create low- and medium-fidelity wireframes, screen flows, navigation concepts, and workflow prototypes for manufacturing tools. Use wireframes to clarify roles, data entry, scan flows, approvals, exceptions, alerts, dashboards, and handoffs before development begins. Collaborate with operators, supervisors, engineers, quality personnel, and IT to validate usability, terminology, information hierarchy, and shop-floor practicality. Document interaction requirements, field behavior, validation rules, permissions, accessibility considerations, and responsive or device-specific needs. Use prototypes to expose ambiguity, reduce rework, and support structured design reviews and stakeholder decisions. AI-assisted prototyping and responsible experimentation Use approved AI tools to rapidly generate, refine, and compare prototype concepts, sample workflows, interface copy, test scenarios, and synthetic examples. Turn business requirements into AI-assisted clickable or interactive prototypes that help stakeholders experience proposed solutions before implementation. Evaluate AI-generated concepts for accuracy, usability, security, privacy, export-control implications, bias, traceability, and alignment with approved requirements. Ensure that AI-generated outputs are treated as drafts requiring human review and are not used with controlled, sensitive, proprietary, or regulated data unless explicitly authorized. Partner with IT, cybersecurity, data governance, and business owners to establish practical guardrails for AI-supported analysis and prototyping. Manufacturing systems and process improvement Build working knowledge of planning and scheduling, MRP, inventory, kitting, receiving, production execution, quality, configuration management, shipping, reporting, ERP, MES, QMS, PLM, and WMS tools. Lead or support process mapping, workflow analysis, root-cause analysis, and continuous-improvement activities. Evaluate solutions for usability, scalability, maintainability, security, data integrity, operational risk, and cross-functional impact. Define business rules, roles, permissions, approvals, alerts, validations, and exception-handling requirements. Testing and implementation Develop test scenarios, test cases, test data, acceptance criteria, and prototype-based usability test scripts. Coordinate functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing. Validate delivered functionality against approved requirements and prototypes; support defect triage and resolution. Participate in implementation planning, cutover readiness, training, communications, go-live support, and early-production monitoring. Communication and collaboration Facilitate interviews, workshops, prototype reviews, demonstrations, design reviews, and decision meetings. Explain technical concepts in clear business language and business needs in clear technical language. Build productive relationships across manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, IT, program management, and leadership. Promote a culture of integrity, respect, cooperation, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in information systems, business, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, operations, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered. Three or more years of experience in business analysis, systems analysis, manufacturing operations, IT delivery, product ownership, UX, or a related role. Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and validating business and technical requirements. Experience creating process maps, workflow diagrams, wireframes, user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, and business documentation. Strong written, verbal, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting ERP, MES, MRP, QMS, PLM, WMS, inventory, warehouse, or manufacturing execution systems. Experience in aerospace, space systems, defense, advanced manufacturing, electronics, or another regulated industry. Experience with Figma, FigJam, Miro, Balsamiq, Axure, or comparable wireframing and prototyping tools. Experience with AI-assisted product discovery, interface prototyping, requirements analysis, or test generation. Knowledge of configuration management, product lifecycle management, quality systems, nonconformance, corrective action, and production documentation. Experience with SQL, data analysis, dashboards, APIs, master data, data governance, role-based access, and audit trails. Experience with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies. Success Measures Manufacturing users have a trusted path for communicating system needs. Requirements, wireframes, and prototypes are clear, complete, traceable, testable, and aligned to business outcomes. Teams identify usability and workflow issues before development, reducing rework and implementation surprises. Manufacturing tools improve productivity, quality, visibility, data integrity, and operational control. AI-assisted work is useful, transparent, human-reviewed, and consistent with security, privacy, export-control, and data-governance requirements. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers with thousands of vehicles nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events. Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale. Why Join Us Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change. Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization. Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX. Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability. (Hybrid: Monday, Wednesday, Friday in-office) About the Role CharterUP is seeking an early career Data Analyst to join our Finance BI team, someone eager to tackle data challenges and assist in meeting the reporting and analytics needs of teams throughout the organization. This role’s deliverables will have a high impact, with visibility to leadership. What You’ll Do Collect, clean, and organize large datasets from multiple sources (e.g., databases, APIs, spreadsheets) for both one-off data requests and recurring reports. Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights that will guide business strategy and decision-making. Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to track key business metrics. Present findings, recommendations, and insights in a clear and concise manner to non-technical stakeholders. What You’ll Bring Bachelor’s and Master's degrees. jobs.jd: Who We Are Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it. You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. About The Role This is an exciting opportunity to join a lean but growing Strategic Finance & Business Operations team at a high-growth pre-IPO startup. You will play a critical role as an analytical thought partner to various leaders and teams across Verkada to drive business insights, decision-making rigor, and operational excellence, helping us reach the next level of scale and operating sophistication in the process.
