jobs.title: Anthropic Research Resident
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.jd: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role The Anthropic Residency is our paid, fixed-term research program, with placements lasting between six weeks and six months. We are looking for people who have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields and want to transition to full-time work focused on making sure AI systems are safe and beneficial for all of humanity. If you are a professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer and want to transition to work on transformative AI, we want to hear from you. Background in machine learning is not required. What to expect A concrete, scoped project matched to your background, with direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers Access to Claude models and GPU compute Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community Interview process The interview process will include an initial application, recruiter screen, technical assessment, research discussion and a reference check. Applications for this round close on November 22, 2026 (11:59 PM PT). We expect to make offers in January 2027. You may be a good fit if you Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole Are excited to transition into working on empirical AI research full-time Have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields (professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer) Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly Strong candidates may also Have experience authoring research papers in machine learning, NLP, or AI safety Have experience with LLMs, reinforcement learning or Kubernetes clusters and complex shared codebases Mentors and research areas Potential Anthropic mentors include: Sara Price : leads the Alignment Training team; background in data science Ethan Perez : leads the Alignment Science team; background in machine learning Evan Hubinger : leads the Alignment Stress-Testing team; formerly at The Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI) Samuel Marks : leads the Scalable Oversight team; background in mathematics Elana Simon : researches the interpretability of language models and biological models; background in biomedical informatics Belinda Li : researches how language models represent the world, users, and themselves; background in natural language processing (PhD, MIT) Jack Lindsey : leads the Model Psychology team; background in theoretical neuroscience Nicholas Carlini : researches adversarial machine learning and AI security; previously at DeepMind and Google Brain Jascha Sohl-Dickstein : works at the intersection of safety and pretraining; background in physics and neuroscience, formerly Principal Scientist at Google Brain Residents will work on empirical research questions in collaboration with Anthropic's research teams. Areas we are particularly interested in include: AI safety & alignment Scalable Oversight: Developing techniques to keep highly capable models helpful and honest, even as they surpass human-level intelligence in various domains. Adversarial Robustness and AI Control: Creating methods to ensure advanced AI systems remain safe and harmless in unfamiliar or adversarial scenarios. Model Organisms: Creating model organisms of misalignment to improve our empirical understanding of how alignment failures might arise. Model Internals and Interpretability: Advancing our understanding of the internal workings of large language models to enable more targeted interventions and safety measures. Safeguards Research: Developing robust defenses against adversarial attacks, comprehensive evaluation frameworks for model safety, and automated systems to detect and mitigate potential risks before deployment. AI Welfare: Improving our understanding of potential AI welfare and developing related evaluations and mitigations. AI security & frontier red-teaming Stress-testing frontier models to understand the full extent of their current capabilities in fields such as cybersecurity, robotics or cryptography. ML systems & reinforcement learning Improving how frontier models are trained and building the infrastructure behind that research, from model architecture, optimizers and training data to accelerator simulators, hardware backends and RL environment pipelines. For a fuller picture of the questions we care about, see our Recommendations for Technical AI Safety Research Directions and recent publications from our Alignment , Interpretability and Frontier Red teams. Logistics Duration: Placements are six weeks, three months or six months, depending on team fit and candidate preferences. Other lengths between three and six months are possible by exception. Location: We prefer that Residents work from our San Francisco office, where most of our research staff is based, but remote participation is possible, especially for shorter placements. Most full-time research roles at Anthropic require relocation to San Francisco. Remote participants need to be based in a country where Anthropic can hire. Commitment: Full-time role for the duration of the residency. Compensation: $350,000 to $500,000/year pro-rated for the duration of the residency + benefits Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas for placements of three months or longer. For six-week placements we encourage remote participation from a country where Anthropic can hire. Applicants may also be considered for the Anthropic Fellows Program . The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $350,000 — $500,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking in

jobs.title: Data Sourcing & Strategy Associate
jobs.jd: About Bridgewater Bridgewater Associates is a premier asset management firm, focused on delivering unique insight and partnership for the most sophisticated global institutional investors. Our investment process is driven by a tireless pursuit to understand how the world’s markets and economies work — using cutting-edge technology to validate and execute on timeless and universal investment principles. Founded in 1975, we are a community of independent thinkers who share a commitment to excellence. By fostering a culture of openness, transparency, and inclusion, we strive to unlock the most complex questions in investment strategy, management, and corporate culture. Explore more information about Bridgewater on our website here . Our Culture Our culture is anchored in excellence, meaning constant improvement, and it is deeply tied to our mission. Because markets are objective, competitive, and getting smarter everyday, we need to keep rapidly improving to have any chance of beating them. Truth is our most essential tool for engaging with the markets and constantly improving because once you know what's true about your problems and opportunities, you can determine how to get better. Valuing truth means being transparent about your decision-making and mistakes, giving and receiving feedback with humility, and fighting for the best answers over hierarchy, ego, or self-interest. Operating this way is hard – it's only possible because we build meaning in our work and relationships. This meaning comes from the audacity of the mission, and the joy of working alongside people who make you a better version of yourself. The culture, like Bridgewater itself, is always evolving. In 1997 our founder Ray Dalio wrote down his lessons, starting with a Philosophy Statement which remains our foundation. This later evolved into a set of 300+ Principles. In 2022, when Ray transitioned the company, we re-underwrote several of those principles and evolved others, with a specific focus on Meritocracy. Today the culture sits, alongside our people, as our most important edge. When we get it right, it’s the engine that powers everything else. About Your Role In this role, you will be an integral part of the Research, Data Strategy and Acquisition function at Bridgewater. Operating at the front edge of our Investment Data practice, you will be part of the execution and evolution of our Relationship Management, Supplier Knowledge Management, and Internal Stakeholder Management disciplines. You will engage with investors, associates, engineers, and external vendors and sources to improve our understanding of external offerings and vendors’ understanding of our needs, quality management, and business alignment. You will be immersed in our workflows, investment questions, supplier challenges, market making and matching, internal marketing/advocacy, and vendor engagement strategy. You will regularly communicate your understanding and assessments to a diverse group of stakeholders, including investment professionals, vendors and service providers, Management, Compliance, Legal, and Finance. You will partner across the firm and with vendors (existing and prospective), collaborating with hundreds of individuals over the course of a year. You will drive the following responsibilities: Executing across the systems, sourcing, supply chains, and internal demand we use to acquire, provide and maintain the inbound fuel for the Investment requests that arrive unspecified or overly prescribed, helping the investor clarify what they need. Dynamically understanding the world of offerings, known and unknown to Bridgewater, creating potential market matches, indications of interest, discerning and selecting structure from the external world. Owning the Investment Asks that land unspecified or over-specified, where the investor or colleague cannot say what they need. Understanding and effectively communicating the state of specific components of the sourcing portfolio, and our knowledge bases of passes, no bids, and deferred opportunities. Building, maintaining, and rapidly sorting inbound possibilities, candidate sources and existing data sources and services in the sourcing portfolio. Improving and executing on the ML/AI layer we are rapidly introducing into our external discovery and matching process, designed from first principles. Creating and documenting initiatives to raise the quality, reliability, and efficiency of the practice’s systems. Continuously evaluating and enhancing processes for sourcing, vetting, and delivering content processes at scale. Advocating with existing and potential vendors to improve the quality of their pitches. You will be a fit for the role if you: Are curious, practical, analytical, capable, and willing to fail and learn from failing, in broad engagement with a diverse international set of people and processes both inside and outside of Bridgewater. Are able to manage a high volume of work across diverse functions and competing priorities, while effectively communicating, executing and marking to market. Think in terms of systems and naturally look for ways to solve problems through the evolution of those systems. Hold a high degree of personal responsibility and ownership in everything you do. Are willing to operate across all levels of work, starting from basic task execution and evolving into complex, multi-month and multi-modal efforts. In this role, you will grow with us by: Undergoing an on-the-job training program that includes structured engagement with the external world, live apprenticeship, and working with highly experienced colleagues. Actively engaging and grappling with the growth and evolution of the practice. Having your voice and perspective heard, and over time representing the firm in important vendor, counterparty, and provider management discussions. Minimum Qualifications 4-year degree from an accredited undergraduate institution 3-7 years of relevant work experience at an investment bank, vendor/service provider or asset management firm Experience in at least two of the following: Relationship Management, Supplier Knowledge Management (understanding what suppliers and sources can offer, beyond their past performance), or Internal Stakeholder Management Experience with Capital Markets market or research data is a strong plus Physical Requirements The anticipated onsite requirement for this role is three days per week at our Westport, CT campus and one day per week at our NYC campus. Compensation Band The wage range for this role is $170,000-$225,000 inclusive of base salary and discretionary target bonus. The expected base salary for this role is between 70%-80% of this wage range. Why Choose Bridgewater? It takes all types to make Bridgewater great. We seek a diverse group of innovative thinkers and push them to engage in rigorous and thoughtful inquiry. We develop people through an honest examination of their abilities and performance, enabling personal growth and professional development. We strive to provide you with opportunities that will challenge you and unlock your potential. One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits. Explore more information about Bridgewater’s benefits on our website here . Bridgewater reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations. This job description is not a contract and confers no contractual rights, privileges, or benefits on any applicant or potential applicant. Bridgewater has the right to change any and all terms of this job description, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, qualifications and benefits. jobs.jd:
Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications.
In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar.
Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression.
Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.
 Conduct research and develop solutions involving camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images. Contribute to open source software such as TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. Collaborate with other researchers to develop ideas and peer-review work. Prepare and present research findings to customers and collaborators. Receive support and encouragement to participate in national and international conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, WACV, and 3DV. Seek funding to grow and develop your own research areas, if desired. A PhD in Computer Science or a related field. Experience using multiview geometry to develop algorithms for building 3D point clouds, meshes, Gaussian Splats, or NeRFs from imagery or video. Experience with AI/ML methods for 3D reconstruction or camera calibration. Experience with good software development practices and proficiency in C++ and/or Python. A strong publication record in top-tier research publications and conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV. A highly innovative approach and a demonstrated record of solving difficult technical challenges using imagery. Experience collaborating successfully with others and thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment. Due to contractual restrictions, only US Citizens will be considered for this position. If not already cleared TS/SCI, willingness and ability to apply for and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance. Candidates should include a detailed list of publications as part of their resume or CV. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Cloud Distribution & Growth
jobs.jd:
About the Team

Cloud service providers give developers a way to use OpenAI models in the environments where they already build and run software. Our team works with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, and Finance to understand which customers we can reach through these providers and what helps them grow from a first API call to a production workload.

About the Role

In your first few months, you’ll identify a customer segment or workload where OpenAI can grow, recommend an investment to GTM, Product, and Engineering, and define how we’ll know whether it brought new usage to OpenAI. Your first priority will be to explain what drives usage and revenue across providers. You’ll use that understanding to help GTM decide which customers and workloads to invest in and to build forecasts the team can plan against.

A customer might sign a substantial cloud commitment and send very little traffic. You can sit down with the account team, trace the customer’s first requests, and work out whether they need help launching, access to a different model, or more capacity. When you see the same opportunity across customers, your work can change where OpenAI invests.

In This Role, You Will:

 - Build a reliable view of the business from provider usage reports, billing records, and API logs. Show how new workloads, expansion, changes in price, and shifts in model mix contribute to growth.

 - Estimate how much demand cloud distribution adds to OpenAI. Trace customer activity across channels to distinguish new use cases from traffic that moved from the direct API.

 - Identify where customers are ready to scale. Combine what account teams hear with evidence on request failures, latency, and model availability. Work with Product and Engineering on a change and measure what happens to usage.

 - Shape growth plans with GTM and Finance. Estimate what existing workloads and upcoming launches can contribute by year end, test the assumptions that matter most, and recommend where to focus with each provider.

 - Own the consumption forecast. Compare forecasts with actual usage over the same period, explain the biggest misses, and use what you learn to improve the next forecast.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.jd:
About RunSybil

Founded in 2023 by Ari Herbert-Voss and Vlad Ionescu, RunSybil is on a mission to automate hacker intuition. We are building Sybil, an AI-driven pentester that discovers vulnerabilities before they are exploited. As adversaries adopt AI to expand their attack surface, we are putting cutting-edge offensive security into the hands of defenders. Backed by strong investor support and early customer traction, our team includes experts from OpenAI, Meta, Mandiant, Palantir, Cruise, Trail of Bits, and Aptiv.

About the Role

We are looking for a Security Analyst to join our security research team. You will work hands-on with web application vulnerabilities every day, assessing findings, confirming exploitability, rating severity, and delivering clear, accurate reports that customers rely on to understand and remediate their risk.

This role does not require software engineering experience. It requires deep familiarity with web vulnerabilities, sharp analytical judgment, and the ability to communicate findings precisely. If you have spent time in bug bounty, application security, or pentesting and have a strong eye for what is real and what is noise, we want to hear from you.


What You Will Do

 

 - Assess and validate web application vulnerabilities across a range of targets and confirm exploitability and scope

 - Reproduce findings hands-on using tools like Burp Suite

 - Rate severity accurately using established frameworks such as CVSS and OWASP

 - Write clear, accurate, customer-facing finding descriptions and remediation guidance that security practitioners trust and developers can act on

 - Maintain consistent standards across a high volume of findings

 - Surface patterns, edge cases, and unusual behaviors to the broader team

 - Identify patterns across findings and share feedback on where and how Sybil can improve

 

We Are Looking for Someone Who Brings

 

 - 2 or more years of hands-on experience with web application vulnerabilities through bug bounty, penetration testing, application security, or a similar role

 - Solid, practical understanding of OWASP Top 10 and common web vulnerability classes: you have actually found and confirmed these, not just read about them

 - Experience reproducing and validating findings manually, including in ambiguous or noisy environments

 - Comfort with tools like Burp Suite, browser developer tools, or similar for hands-on verification

 - Strong written communication: you can describe a vulnerability, its impact, and how to fix it in plain language

 - Attention to detail and consistency: you apply the same standard to the hundredth finding that you applied to the first

 - Self-direction: you manage your own work without needing someone to structure your day

 

Location: Remote (US)


Compensation: The base salary for this full-time position ranges from $130,000-$160,000. In addition to base salary, we offer meaningful equity. We want everyone here to have ownership in what we're building.

Diverse teams build better products. RunSybil is committed to hiring people who bring different perspectives, lived experiences, and backgrounds to our work. We encourage candidates of all races, ethnicities, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability or medical conditions, ages, religions, and socioeconomic backgrounds to apply. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we still want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Security Analyst

Partner with Trading, Prime Brokerage, Operations, Technology, Compliance, Risk Management, Agent Banks, Custodians, and Depositories to facilitate successful settlement outcomes. jobs.title: Data Scientist II - Customer Analytics
jobs.jd: About the Role The Data Science team at Gap Inc. transforms customer, product, digital, and market data into insights that drive measurable business impact. The successful candidate will lead high-impact analyses across customer acquisition and retention, product and basket performance, digital engagement, and omnichannel behavior. This role requires analytical rigor, business acumen, data storytelling, and strong stakeholder management. The ideal candidate can structure ambiguous business questions, connect insights across internal and external data sources, and clearly articulate what is happening, why it matters, and what actions to take. What You'll Do The ideal candidate is an applied, business-facing data scientist who pairs strong technical capabilities with a passion for working directly with business partners, using analytics and modeling to drive decisions rather than focusing primarily on behind-the-scenes model development. Lead end-to-end analytical projects, from framing complex business questions and developing the analytical approach to delivering actionable recommendations and measuring impact. Analyze large customer, transaction, product, marketing, and digital datasets to identify growth opportunities and business performance drivers. Translate complex findings into concise, executive-ready narratives that clearly communicate the “so what,” recommended actions, trade-offs, and expected impact. Develop customer and product analytics—including lifecycle, segmentation, basket, cross-shopping, cohort, funnel, and behavioral analyses—to inform business strategy. Integrate internal data with external sources, such as consumer trends, search behavior, competitive intelligence, and market research, to build a holistic view of the customer and business. Apply statistical, predictive, causal, and machine learning techniques when appropriate to improve business decision-making. Develop scalable analytical frameworks, reusable datasets, and automated processes that enable consistent measurement and reduce manual work. Partner with business leaders, product managers, data scientists, engineers, and technology teams to translate business priorities into analytical roadmaps and deliverables. Build trusted stakeholder relationships, proactively identify emerging needs, constructively challenge assumptions, and influence decisions through clear, data-backed recommendations. Who You Are Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of relevant experience, or master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant experience, in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or another quantitative field. Proven ability to lead complex analytical projects from problem definition through recommendation and business activation. Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience working with large datasets in distributed or cloud environments. Proficiency in Python, R, Spark, or other modern analytics and data science tools. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders. Self-starter with the ability to work independently, proactively drive work forward, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively across functions. Preferred Qualifications Experience in DTC retail, apparel, e-commerce, consumer products, or another customer-focused industry. Experience analyzing customer lifecycle, acquisition, retention, loyalty, product performance, or omnichannel behavior. Experience with basket analysis, product affinity, cross-shopping, or customer-product relationships. Experience integrating external data—such as search trends, consumer research, competitive intelligence, social listening, or market data—with internal performance data. Experience with digital analytics, including website or app engagement, customer journeys, conversion funnels, and marketing channel performance.

jobs.title: AVP of Claims, Fraud & Financial Crimes – Life, Health & Annuities
jobs.jd: Why USAA? At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families. Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful. We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs. The Opportunity USAA Life Insurance Company is seeking an accomplished and transformational insurance leader to serve as its next AVP of Claims, Fraud & Financial Crimes , a newly elevated leadership role responsible for shaping the future of claims administration and financial crime prevention across the Life, Health, and Annuity businesses. Reporting directly to the Vice President of LifeCo Operations, this executive will lead the teams responsible for Claims and the Special Investigations Unit (SIU), with end-to-end accountability for claims administration, complex claim adjudication, fraud prevention and investigation, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), financial crimes, and the operational controls that protect USAA Life Company and its members. Claims represents one of the most important moments in the relationship between an insurer and its policyholders. This leader will be responsible for ensuring that claims are handled with speed, accuracy, empathy, and integrity, delivering on USAA's promise to members while maintaining the rigorous controls required to protect the financial strength and reputation of the organization. The mandate spans routine claims through highly complex and contestable matters requiring deeper investigation, medical record review, fraud assessment, legal interpretation, and regulatory expertise. The opportunity extends well beyond administering claims. This executive will lead the continued evolution of USAA Life's fraud detection, investigation, AML, and financial crimes capabilities, bringing greater sophistication to how emerging risks are identified, assessed, investigated, and mitigated. The leader will strengthen the connection between Claims and SIU while leveraging data, analytics, technology, and process improvement to identify suspicious activity earlier, improve investigative effectiveness, and make sound, consistent decisions. Equally important, the executive in this role will establish the operating strategies, governance, performance disciplines, and controls required to deliver exceptional outcomes across Life Insurance, Health Insurance, and Annuities. Partnering closely with Operations, Legal, Compliance, Enterprise Risk, Product Management, and Technology, this leader will continuously strengthen claims processes while balancing member experience, regulatory obligations, fraud prevention, operational efficiency, and financial stewardship. For an accomplished insurance executive, this is a unique opportunity to lead at the intersection of claims, customer experience, risk, and financial crime prevention. The successful leader will inherit experienced teams while having the mandate to elevate their capabilities, modernize how claims and investigations are managed, and ensure USAA continues to deliver for members when they need the organization most. Additional Overview The AVP, Claims, Fraud & Financial Crimes is responsible for leading the execution, oversight, and continuous improvement of USAA Life Company's claims administration, fraud prevention, anti-money laundering (AML), and financial crimes programs across Life Insurance, Health Insurance, and Annuity products. This leader oversees claim operations, complex claim adjudication, fraud risk management activities, regulatory compliance, and operational controls to ensure claims are processed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements. The role partners closely with Operations, Legal, Compliance, Enterprise Risk, Product Management, and Technology teams to deliver exceptional member experiences while protecting the financial integrity and reputation of USAA Life Company. The AVP champions operational excellence, risk management, process improvement, and data-driven decision-making while leading teams responsible for claims governance, fraud detection and investigation, financial crime prevention, and member-centric claims resolution practices. Location USAA offers a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week. This position can be based in one of the following locations: San Antonio, TX; Charlotte, NC; Phoenix, AZ. Relocation assistance is available for this position. What You'll Do Claims Operations & Governance Lead the execution and continual enhancement of claims programs, policies, procedures, and operational practices across Life Insurance, Health Insurance, and Annuity products. Ensure claims processes balance member advocacy, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and financial stewardship. Oversee the investigation, evaluation, adjudication, and resolution of complex, contestable, and sensitive claims. Maintain governance frameworks, operational controls, and quality standards to ensure consistency and accuracy of claims decisions. Identify opportunities to improve claims processes, service delivery, and member outcomes through process optimization and technology enablement. Complex Claims Oversight Provide leadership and decision authority for the most complex, high-risk, contestable, and high-value claims, including settlements exceeding established authority limits. jobs.jd: Job Description General Motors is seeking a Senior Workday Functional Analyst with strong expertise in Workday Core HCM, Personal Information, EIB processing, reference letters, and HR data migration to support and enhance our Workday environment. This role will focus heavily on employee data management, mass data transactions, document generation, data conversion, and maintaining accurate and scalable Workday configurations. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing Personal Information and Contact Information processes, developing and processing EIBs, configuring reference letters and related documents, and supporting large-scale data migration and data validation activities. This role will partner closely with HR, Payroll, Recruiting, Compensation, and IT teams to deliver projects, enhancements, production support, and data initiatives. Key Responsibilities Configure, maintain, and enhance Workday Core HCM, with a strong focus on Personal Information, Contact Information, Staffing, Jobs & Positions, and employee data management. Configure and support Personal Information Business Processes, including routing, approvals, validations, condition rules, notifications, security, and related employee self-service functionality. Create, test, process, and troubleshoot Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) files for high-volume and mass business transactions. Manage inbound EIB processing, including data preparation, transformation, validation, error resolution, reconciliation, and post-load verification. Support HR data migration and conversion activities, including data extraction, cleansing, mapping, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and validation between legacy systems and Workday. Partner with business and technical teams to define data mapping and conversion requirements and ensure migrated data meets Workday configuration and business requirements. Configure and maintain reference letters, employment letters, document templates, and other employee-related Workday documents, including dynamic fields, calculated fields, conditional content, and business process integration. Perform mass updates and data corrections using appropriate Workday tools while maintaining strong data quality, integrity, and audit controls. Analyze and resolve EIB errors, data discrepancies, validation failures, and other complex Workday data issues. Configure and maintain Workday Business Processes, including BP routing, approvals, condition rules, notifications, validations, questionnaires, documents, and Business Process Security Policies. Support Workday production issues and serve as a Tier escalation contact for complex Core HCM, Personal Information, EIB, document, and data-related issues. Develop and utilize Workday reports and calculated fields to support data validation, reconciliation, migration, troubleshooting, and business requirements. Support testing activities, including unit testing, regression testing, data validation, and end-to-end testing for Workday enhancements and data loads. Review automatically available functionality delivered through Workday R1/R2 releases, assess business impact, and support regression testing. Review and disposition setup-required functionality delivered through Workday releases and coordinate appropriate configuration changes. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements, document solutions, and implement scalable system and data improvements. Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, IT professionals, functional teams, and end users. Qualifications 4+ years of Workday functional experience, preferably supporting Workday Core HCM in a large enterprise environment. Strong hands-on experience with Workday Personal Information and Contact Information configuration and Business Processes. Strong experience with HR data migration, data conversion, data mapping, cleansing, transformation, reconciliation, and validation. Strong knowledge of Workday Core HCM and the Workday Business Process Framework. Experience with Workday reporting, calculated fields, security, and Business Process Security Policies. jobs.title: Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst
jobs.jd: Location: Halifax - Wilkinson, Canada In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible. Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid) Position Summary Thales has a vacancy for a Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems. Regulatory Compliance Requirements This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access. Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level Key Areas of Responsibility Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems. Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests. Data Integrity & System Administration: Reconcile data between Maximo and DRMIS to ensure consistency; execute high-accuracy data entry and maintenance within Maximo to support maintenance and supply activities; and maintain accurate supply support records derived from LSA data. Cataloguing & Government System Liaison: Interface with the Canadian Government Cataloguing System (CGCM/CGCS) to resolve cataloguing discrepancies and facilitate new NSN assignments. Data Analysis, Reporting & Database Management: Utilize Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) to conduct mass data cleanses and identify trends; develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into part changes and obsolescence risks; and leverage Microsoft Access to manage complex datasets requiring structured, searchable records. Obsolescence & Supply Support Planning: Proactively identify parts approaching end-of-life, collaborate with the Obsolescence department to identify and catalogue suitable alternatives, and translate LSA data into actionable supply support records to prepare the supply chain for future maintenance requirements. Chorus Role Prepare and Deliver Customer Service Minimum Qualifications Technical System Expertise: Proven experience using both Maximo and DRMIS (or CGCS/CGCM) is mandatory. Software Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills are essential (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, and complex data reconciliation). Change Management: Demonstrated experience managing workflows and tasks within JIRA. Experience: 5 years in ILS, Supply Support, or Technical Data Management within a defence or aerospace environment. Critical Thinking: The candidate must be a self-motivated problem solver capable of investigating complex data discrepancies independently. If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community! Preferred Qualifications Data Analytics & Database Tools: Proficiency in Power BI and Microsoft Access is considered a strong asset. Defense & In-Service Support Experience: Experience with DND In-Service Support (ISS) contracts and experience supporting an operational military asset. Logistics Support Analysis Expertise: Familiarity with Logistics Support Analysis (LSA) and exposure to Logistics Support Analysis application software such as OmegaPS. Technical Publications & Documentation Standards: Knowledge of Canadian Forces Technical Orders (CFTOs) and government-adopted technical publications. Digital Technical Data Standards: Knowledge of the S1000D specification and Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) format. Language Requirements: Bilingualism (English/French). Special Position Requirements Schedule : Core business hours Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week. Physical Environment : Hybrid position – which is a mix of working from home and onsite (in office, at customer site or on-board ships alongside in harbour. Physical Demands : Predominantly office work but may be required to work in dockyards and onboard Naval ships. Travel : Occasional domestic travel maybe required in support of the ships. What We Offer The reference Total Target Compensation (TTC) market range for this position, inclusive of annual base salary and the variable compensation target, is between Total Target Cash (TTC) $74,146.88– $126,733.63 CAD Annual. This reflects how companies in a similar industry and geographic region generally pay for similar jobs. This range helps the Company make pay decisions as one data point among many. Where a position falls within this range is also dependent on other factors including – but not limited to – the employee’s career path history, competencies, skills and performance, as well as the company’s annual salary budget, the customer’s program requirements, and the company’s internal equity. Thales may offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s status protected by local, state, or federal law. All hiring decisions, including candidate evaluation, selection, and disposition, are made by human recruiters. Artificial intelligence does not make hiring decisions on our behalf. Why Join Us? jobs.title: Consultant, Economic Financial Advisory Services
jobs.jd: Who We Are FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations. At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you. Are you ready to make your impact? About The Role Our Economic and Financial Consulting (EFC) team in India supports clients through legal, regulatory and international arbitration matters by providing clear, evidence-based analysis of complex economic and financial issues.We apply the theory and principles of microeconomics and finance provide advice to clients. We approach problems in a highly structured but practical way, and present complex concepts and data in an understandable manner. We have extensive modelling experience, building robust and relevant econometric and financial models for a variety of uses. International Arbitration We provide end-to-end valuation and litigation support, including: determining if a claim is worth pursuing; identifying the correct approaches or methodologies for quantifying damages; evaluating claims in the context of past and future economic damages incurred; and pinpointing the exact type of expertise, evidence and documentation required. Antitrust & Competition Economics Using rigorous, state-of-the-art analytical methods applied to complex data, we evaluate the likely effects of proposed mergers and acquisitions on prices, costs and competition. Our experts regularly assist both defendants and plaintiffs in antitrust litigation, including cases involving price fixing, predatory pricing, bundling and various forms of allegedly exclusionary conduct. An integral part of our role in many of these cases involves the estimation of lost profits or damages from elevated prices and output restrictions. Accountancy and financial reporting We advise on accountancy and financial reporting issues and provide opinions on liability and remedy issues in cases involving fraud and false accounting, breach of contract or warranty disputes. We assess the relevance and reliability of information obtained from financial records and reports. What You’ll Do We are looking for a talented, ambitious individual to join our Economic and Financial Consulting (EFC) team in New Delhi or Mumbai which primarily focus on providing services for international arbitration and competition economics. Suitable candidates will be problem-solvers who enjoy developing and applying bespoke approaches to solve complex, unstructured problems in a logical manner. Candidates will have strong understanding of financial valuation, economic theory and accounting fundamentals. Candidates will have strong analytical skills; be able to explain their work and communicate their conclusions and findings clearly, both orally and in writing; and be able to draw upon considerable experience of applying principles to solve problems in practice. The ideal candidate will have both an eye for the big picture, and for detail. How You’ll Grow In this dynamic role, you’ll collaborate with our global network of member firms and work alongside diverse teams across Asia and beyond. You’ll gain hands-on experience across a range of projects, helping clients navigate complex challenges and implement effective solutions. We’re committed to continuous learning and professional growth through on-the-job training and selfpaced development programs. Our milestones framework and internal courses are designed to equip and empower you for future roles. You’ll also have the opportunity to work closely with senior leadership to support business expansion initiatives. What You Will Need to Succeed Basic Qualifications At least 2 years’ work related experience with a focus on disputes advisory, general financial valuation, economics, accounting, statistics, or econometrics. Masters Degree from a university with a reputation for excellence in the subject in question and/or completed the CA, CFA or other relevant professional qualification; and Ability to research, analyse and summarise market data; manage data sets, analyse economic and financial data, draft memos, expert reports and presentation material. Preferred Qualifications A solid understanding of the concepts in one or more of the following disciplines: valuation, accountancy, economics and finance; Strong skills in applying those concepts in one or more specific areas; The capacity to critically evaluate and compare different sources of information and assumptions to assess reliability; Good project management skills and experience in managing people and individual work streams; Proficiency in MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Knowledge of other relevant analytical software such as Microsoft VBA or Access is also desirable; Proficiency in or knowledge of data resource software including Capital IQ, Thomson Reuters, Bloomberg, FactSet and Merger Market; Ability to efficiently organise and conduct research; and Ability to communicate effectively and authoritatively verbally and in writing. FTI Consulting is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.

jobs.title: Center for Global Security Research (CGSR) Graduate Research Associate - Summer 2027
jobs.jd: Join us and make YOUR mark on the World! Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability. Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact. The Center for Global Security Research (CGSR) was established at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) in 1996 to bring together experts from the science, technology, and policy communities to address pressing national security challenges. For over 20 years, CGSR has engaged diverse perspectives on topics important to national security, deterrence, diplomacy, dual-use technology, arms control, nonproliferation, space, cyber, biosecurity, and energy security. We have openings in Summer 2027 for graduate level students or students who have received their bachelors, master’s, or are working on their PhD to engage in practical research on global security topics. Students will work with CGSR over the duration of three to four months as a research associate (RA). RAs will engage in practical research to further their educational and career goals, while also supporting the development of strategies for national security and LLNL’s mission focus areas. Examples of relevant fields of research include nuclear deterrence, arms control, nonproliferation, emerging technologies, cybersecurity, space, biological & chemical security, and energy security. This position offers a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You will have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week. CGSR’s objectives are as follows: To explore the dynamics of potential 21st century strategic conflicts (i.e., those with a potential nuclear aspect) and to formulate ideas about how to achieve U.S. deterrence and other objectives in such conflicts. To explore the sources and characteristics of strategic competition in the emerging security environment and to formulate organizing concepts to enhance the competitive position of the United States and its allies and partners over the long term. To identify whether and how technically based approaches can address new challenges to national and international security. To catalyze broader national and international thinking about the requirements of effective deterrence, assurance, and strategic stability in a changed and changing security environment. To assist in the development of new generations of experts motivated by a clear view of the changed and changing security environment. More information on CGSR, its research focus areas, and its publications can be found at https://cgsr.llnl.gov/ . This job will be closed to applicants on February 1, 2027. You will Conduct an independent research project on an agreed upon topic aligned with CGSR/LLNL research priorities. Support CGSR/LLNL through contributions to ongoing research activities. Tasks may include contributing to literature reviews, annotated bibliographies, and workshop summary reports. Provide analysis to ongoing work, involving a moderate to high degree of technical and analytic complexity. Assist in the planning and execution of workshops to support CGSR research efforts. Gather and analyze data and information in support of broader CGSR research efforts. Participate in research planning and evaluation discussions with other members of the CGSR staff. Attend relevant research seminars, speakers’ series, and workshops. Present research to LLNL staff at end of the assignment. Prepare end-of-assignment technical report or publication. Perform all assignments in accordance with ES&H, security, and business practice requirements and policies. Perform other duties as assigned. Must be eligible to access the Laboratory in compliance with Section 3112 of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA). See Additional Information section below for details. Must be currently enrolled in an accredited university and actively pursuing a graduate degree, or have recently completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a field of research aligned with CGSR analytic priorities. Areas of study include international relations and/or security, political science, economics, public policy, emerging technologies, nonproliferation, energy, biosecurity, foreign language studies, or related fields. Demonstrated academic and/or professional achievement in a relevant field of research aligned with CGSR analytic priorities. Strong record of independent research and publication, or a strong proposal of research to be done while at CGSR and in future academic and professional settings. Effective interpersonal skills with the ability to work in a team environment. Pay Range $6,752 - $8,201 Monthly This position is under a step structure. Please note that the step placement is determined by your most recent completed academic year. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory? Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor! Holiday Pay Sick leave accrual Individual 401(k) contributions Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values Security Clearance None required. However, if your assignment is longer than 179 days cumulatively within a calendar year, you must go through the Personal Identity Verification process. This process includes completing an online background investigation form and receiving approval of the background check. National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) The 2025 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), Section 3112, generally prohibits citizens of China, Russia, Iran and North Korea without dual US citizenship or legal permanent residence from accessing specific non-public areas of national security or nuclear weapons facilities. The restrictions of NDAA Section 3112 apply to this position. To be qualified for this position, Candidates must be eligible to access the Laboratory in compliance with Section 3112. Pre-Employment Drug Test External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices. jobs.title: Mendocino Region, California, US - Strong Communicators Needed for Airbnb Luxe Home Consultant Project
jobs.jd: Join our program supporting Airbnb’s Luxe program as a Home Consultant and help us uphold the exceptional quality and hospitality standards expected from the luxury homes in Airbnb’s Luxe offering. As part of our Managed Services program, you will conduct in-person home assessments, document property conditions, capture photos, and provide detailed evaluation reports to support our luxury quality review process. Candidates should propose their rate for reviewing and submitting a report for a 1-bedroom home. Average base rates within this region generally fall between $75-$90 for a 1-bedroom property. An additional $5 USD will be added for each additional bedroom, up to 8 bedrooms total. Base Compensation Example: • 1 bedroom = your proposed base rate • 2 bedrooms = base rate + $5 • 3 bedrooms = base rate + $10 • Etc. up to 8 bedrooms (all house sizes above 8 bedrooms will receive the 8 bedroom rate) Travel Compensation In addition to the consultation fee, consultants will also receive compensation for travel for each day they conduct an assessment at a rate based on the consultant's distance to the assessment location. Additional information about the travel compensation and related requirements and procedures will be shared with candidates before offers are extended.

jobs.title: AI Enabled Device Modeling
jobs.jd: About GlobalFoundries GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com. New College Graduates Overview GlobalFoundries offers full-time career opportunities for recent graduates in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. New graduates gain practical experience through technical assignments, collaboration, mentorship, and exposure to advanced semiconductor technology development. Summary of Role GlobalFoundries is seeking a new graduate with strong artificial intelligence and machine-learning skills to develop AI-enabled methods for semiconductor device modeling. The engineer will combine device physics, measured silicon data, simulation data, and modern AI/ML techniques to accelerate model extraction, improve predictive accuracy, and create scalable modeling workflows for CMOS, cryogenic, photonic, superconducting, and other emerging devices. Essential Responsibilities Develop and evaluate machine-learning methods for semiconductor device modeling, including parameter extraction, surrogate modeling, model calibration, and prediction of device characteristics. Build reproducible data pipelines that combine measured device data, compact-model simulations, TCAD results, and relevant process or test metadata. Train, validate, and compare AI/ML models using appropriate baselines, holdout datasets, error metrics, uncertainty analysis, and physics-based constraints. Apply methods such as neural networks, Gaussian processes, optimization, sensitivity analysis, and physics-informed machine learning to device-modeling problems. Automate model fitting, feature extraction, hyperparameter optimization, regression testing, visualization, and reporting using Python-based workflows. Work with device, characterization, compact-modeling, PDK, EDA, and circuit-design teams to translate technical requirements into usable AI-enabled modeling solutions. Document datasets, assumptions, model architecture, training methods, validation results, limitations, and recommended usage to support traceability and knowledge transfer. Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations and transition successful methods into maintainable device-modeling and design-enablement workflows. Other Responsibilities Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. Work and collaborate on other projects and/or assignments as needed. Required Qualifications Education - Bachelor's or Master's degree completed or expected in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Physics, Physics, or a related field from an accredited degree program. Academic or project experience in machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, optimization, or scientific data analysis. Strong Python programming skills and experience with common scientific and machine-learning libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX. Understanding of supervised learning, regression, neural networks, model validation, overfitting, uncertainty, and quantitative performance evaluation. Foundational understanding of semiconductor device physics and transistor electrical behavior, with interest in applying AI methods to device modeling. Experience working with structured scientific or engineering datasets, including data preparation, visualization, feature engineering, and reproducible analysis. Ability to communicate technical results clearly and collaborate across AI, device, modeling, characterization, and design teams. Travel - Up to 10%. Fluency in English - written and verbal. Preferred Qualifications Graduate coursework, thesis research, internship, co-op, or substantial project work in AI/ML for semiconductor devices, electronic design automation, scientific machine learning, or computational physics. Experience with physics-informed neural networks, differentiable programming, Bayesian optimization, Gaussian processes, active learning, or uncertainty quantification. Exposure to compact transistor models, SPICE simulation, parameter extraction, TCAD, cryogenic device behavior, photonic devices, superconducting devices, or quantum hardware. Experience using experiment tracking, version control, testing, or reproducibility tools such as Git, MLflow, Weights & Biases, containers, or automated workflows. Experience with Linux environments, high-performance computing, GPU acceleration, cloud computing, or large-scale simulation and training datasets. Ability to balance predictive performance with physical consistency, interpretability, robustness, and computational efficiency. Demonstrated technical initiative through publications, conference presentations, open-source contributions, competitions, or interdisciplinary research projects. Project management skills, including the ability to innovate, execute solutions that matter, and navigate ambiguity. Strong written and verbal communication skills and strong planning and organizational skills. Expected Salary Range $58,400.00 - $100,800.00 The exact Salary will be determined based on qualifications, experience and location. jobs.title: Revenue Operations Partner II
jobs.jd: Territory Planning Analyst II About the Role The Territory Planning Analyst II owns the design, execution, and ongoing integrity of AvidXchange’s GTM territory structures. You’re the person who ensures every account has a clear owner, every rep has a well-defined book of business, and every territory reflects the current state of the market — across direct sales, channel, and strategic partnerships. You sit within the GTM Planning function under Revenue Operations, working alongside the Sales Compensation Analyst and Senior GTM Strategy Analyst. The territory potential data and coverage analysis you produce are direct inputs to quota planning, and the account data you monitor is the foundation everything else is built on. When the data is clean, the whole GTM motion runs better. What You’ll Do Territory Design & Optimization Own the annual territory planning and carving process, building balanced territories that optimize for coverage, revenue potential, and equitable distribution across segments. Maintain territory rules engines defining assignment logic — named accounts, geography, verticals, partner affiliations, revenue tiers — and ensure consistent application. Manage execution of territory realignment and account reassignments. Build scenario models that let leadership evaluate the impact of proposed territory changes on coverage, quota distribution, pipeline disruption, and customer experience. Conduct post-realignment analyses to measure whether changes delivered expected improvements and surface recommendations for future planning cycles. Define requirements for territory and account scoring models built by the Revenue Insights team, providing business-side QA on model outputs and feedback on scoring methodology. Partner & Channel Territory Management Manage territory and account assignment complexity across 20+ ERP partner relationships and banking partnerships, maintaining clear rules of engagement and attribution boundaries. Maintain partner-specific territory maps and account overlays defining sourced, influenced, and co-sold accounts versus direct motions. Build and maintain attribution data models linking partner-sourced opportunities to the correct territory, rep, and compensation plan. Produce partner territory coverage reports identifying white space, overlap, and conflict, and coordinate with Channel and Strategic Partnerships teams to keep definitions aligned with current agreements. Account Data Monitoring & Integrity Own ongoing monitoring of account and territory data health in Salesforce — identifying and resolving misalignments before they affect territory accuracy, quota inputs, or GTM reporting. Monitor duplicate records and enforce deduplication standards; partner with Systems & Process to build automated rules, you own the ongoing review and resolution. Review and resolve territory misalignments surfaced by logic errors. Monitor account-to-territory alignment and manage the account handoff process from new business to existing sales, ensuring clean transitions and accurate ownership records. Manage account and contact status progression to ensure lifecycle stages reflect current reality across the CRM. Own firmographic data integrity, enforcing standards and resolving tagging errors that affect segmentation and territory logic. Run regular enrichment cadences, validating enrichment accuracy and coordinating with third-party providers on data quality. Systems Requirements & Execution Define requirements for Salesforce territory configuration — hierarchies, assignment rules, sharing rules, visibility — and submit to the Systems & Process team for implementation. Validate post-deployment. Define specifications for bulk account reassignments and segmentation updates with clear change management documentation, acceptance criteria, and rollback procedures. Maintain a territory change log and audit trail documenting all structural changes, rationale, effective dates, and downstream impacts. What We’re Looking For Required 3–5+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or CRM/Data Management in a B2B SaaS, payments, or fintech environment. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce territory management, assignment rules, data management, and reporting. Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications for a Systems team. Experience with data enrichment tools (ZoomInfo, Dun & Bradstreet, Clay) and a track record of maintaining data quality standards at scale. Strong SQL or equivalent data querying skills for analysis, auditing, and quality monitoring. Experience managing territory structures in organizations with channel or partner complexity. Highly organized with strong attention to detail — territory and data errors have downstream consequences across quota, compensation, and reporting. Preferred Experience with territory planning tools such as Anaplan, Fullcast, Varicent Territory, or similar. Salesforce Admin certification or equivalent hands-on configuration experience. Background in payments, ERP ecosystems, or B2B platforms serving the middle market. Experience managing territory structures through an acquisition integration or business model consolidation. What Sets You Apart You treat data integrity as a competitive advantage, not a cleanup task — you’re monitoring and resolving issues before they surface in a report or a dispute. You can hold the big picture (territory strategy) and the fine detail (field-level data accuracy) at the same time without losing quality in either. You work well at the seam between business logic and system configuration — you know what you need, you can spec it clearly, and you know how to QA the output. You’re the person who catches problems early and documents the fix so they don’t happen twice. About AvidXchange AvidXchange is a leading provider of accounts payable (“AP”) automation software and payment solutions for middle-market businesses and their suppliers. By trade, we are a technology company, but if you ask anyone who works here, they’ll tell you our people are at the core of who we are. At AvidXchange, mindset is everything . We are Connected as People , Growth Minded , and Customer Obsessed . These three mindsets represent our culture – who we are, who we’ve always been, and they guide us to improve every day. Since our founding in 2000 in Charlotte, NC, we’ve created a company of over 1,300 teammates working across the U.S., or remotely. AvidXchange is proud to be Certified™ as a Great Place to Work ®. The prestigious recognition is based on anonymous data from our teammates and makes official what our teammates have known for years – that AvidXchange is a Great Place to Work®. Who you are: A go-getter with an entrepreneurial mindset – that means you are not afraid of taking risks, winning big or facing the unknown. Someone who understands that business is people centric. Connecting with others as humans first allows you to develop mutually beneficial working relationships. Focused on making a difference for our customers. AvidXchange exists to help solve complex problems for our customers so we can all realize our potential. What you’ll get: AvidXchange teammates (we call them AvidXers) get the perks and prestige of a growing tech company paired with the flexibility of a founder-led startup. We help our AvidXers develop as professionals and as human beings, providing work/life balance, development programs, and competitive benefits. At AvidXchange, we are building more than a tech company – we are building an experience. We remain committed to a culture where you can fully be 'you’ – connected with others, chasing big goals, and making a meaningful impact. If you want to help us grow while realizing your potential and creating stories you’ll tell for years, you’ve come to the right place. jobs.title: Operations + Maintenance Specialist
jobs.jd: McAdams is a full-service land planning, landscape architecture, civil engineering, transportation, and geomatics firm located in North Carolina, South Carolina, Texas, and Florida. We bring experiences to the forefront of everything we do, and to do that takes special people. Position Overview The Operations + Maintenance Specialist supports the planning, design, construction, operation, and long-term performance of athletic and recreational facilities. Leveraging firsthand experience operating and maintaining sports facilities, this role brings an owner/operator perspective that helps align design intent with long-term facility performance, maintenance needs, and operational success. Working under the guidance of the Senior Advisor and alongside design and construction professionals, this position contributes operational insight throughout project development and collaborates with project teams to evaluate facility performance, constructability, quality standards, and long-term maintenance considerations. The role also plays an important part in expanding McAdams' maintenance-focused consulting services and strengthening the firm's presence within the sports facilities market. Key Responsibilities OPERATIONS + MAINTENANCE SERVICES Serve as a resource on athletic facility operations, maintenance practices, asset management, and lifecycle planning. Develop operations and maintenance manuals, maintenance plans, inspection programs, checklists, and operational recommendations. Conduct facility assessments to evaluate existing conditions, maintenance practices, and opportunities for improvement. Stay current on industry trends, regulations, maintenance practices, and sports facility performance standards. DESIGN SUPPORT + TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENT Partner with internal design teams throughout project development to provide operational and maintenance insight that informs planning, design decisions, specifications, and facility solutions that enhance performance, maintainability, safety, and long-term owner usability. Assist with technical reviews of plans, specifications, reports, shop drawings, and submittals to evaluate design intent, constructability, quality standards, and overall facility performance. CLIENT DEVELOPMENT + PRACTICE GROWTH Support the growth of McAdams' sports facility practice by expanding client relationships, increasing market share, enhancing service offerings, and helping build a high-performing team to support future growth. Support client development efforts through existing and emerging relationships within athletics, education, recreation, and sports facility markets. Participate in industry events, networking opportunities, client meetings, and professional organizations. Assist with proposals, interviews, presentations, scope development, and marketing initiatives. Identify opportunities to enhance client value through operational insight and maintenance-focused consulting services. CONSTRUCTION OBSERVATION + FACILITY DEVELOPMENT Collaborate with project teams, contractors, and testing agencies during construction to help evaluate whether installed facilities align with design intent, performance expectations, and owner operational needs. Participate in site visits and field observations to help identify construction issues, support coordination among project stakeholders, and contribute to the successful delivery of facilities that meet design intent, performance expectations, and owner needs. Assist in evaluating installation quality, material performance, testing results, drainage systems, and overall facility performance. Support punch list reviews, warranty evaluations, corrective work inspections, and owner turnover activities. Skills + Experience Bachelor’s degree in facilities management, construction management, sports management, turfgrass management, engineering, landscape architecture, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered. 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in athletic facility operations, maintenance, asset management, or facility leadership. Experience operating, maintaining, managing, or overseeing athletic and recreational facilities. Working knowledge of synthetic turf, natural grass fields, tracks, courts, irrigation, drainage, athletic equipment, and related facility systems. Experience developing or administering maintenance programs, inspection programs, operational procedures, asset management initiatives, budgets, or capital improvement plans. Strong interpersonal, communication, presentation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
