jobs.title: Night Operations Associate - $26.71/HR (3x12)
jobs.jd: About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. A guaranteed 4-day weekend, every single week! Work Thursday, Friday, Saturday; and Sunday - Wednesday are yours. Schedule: Thursday - Saturday, 5:00 PM – 5:30 AM (PST) Pay: $24.04/hour + $2.67 shift differential = $26.71 Is This Shift Right For You? This role is built for people who already live on a different clock. It's a great fit if you're: A student with morning or daytime classes who needs evenings and nights open for work Handling childcare or family responsibilities during typical business hours A night owl who's simply sharper, calmer, and more focused after dark Into late-night drops, streams, and releases in the gaming, TCG, or collecting world — you're already up! If any of that sounds like you, you'll have three full days off every week to spend however you want — including chasing the hobby side of this job outside of work. About the Company We are Fanatics Collect , the largest trading card marketplace in the world, based in Tigard, Oregon. With nearly half a billion dollars in annual trading card sales, we’re redefining the future of collectibles—building the leading platform for storage, research, and liquidity in the trading card industry. As we continue to grow rapidly, we’re seeking passionate team members to help us deliver exceptional service and operational excellence to our clients. Role Summary The Operations Associate plays a critical role within the Operations Department, working cross-functionally to manage, track, curate, and fulfill high-value assets. Reporting to the Operations Manager, this position supports both intake operations and logistics, ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and timely processing of all items moving in and out of the vault. This is a hands-on, detail-driven role ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys teamwork, and is passionate about collectibles. Key Responsibilities Manage intake and curation of collectibles, including titling vintage, modern, and TCG cards using Fanatics Collect formatting standards. Review, organize, and archive assets for vault storage. Prepare assets for auction listings, including image/video review and replacement. Re-sticker archival keys and transfer items between locations as needed. Perform pre- and post-authentication processes (imaging, video shooting, review, and finalization). Support cross-functional operations such as Imaging, Raw Card Ingestion, and Logistics. Process inbound and outbound shipments; manage high volumes of incoming packages and auction fulfillments. Prepare, package, and label orders accurately, verifying item serial numbers against inventory. Identify and pull inventory items for client fulfillments and auction sales. Maintain accurate digital inventory records and ensure storage integrity. Collaborate across departments to resolve issues (e.g., mis-shipments, rush orders, discrepancies). Monitor and update inventory systems to reflect real-time asset status. Qualifications Experience in logistics, warehousing, or asset management (collectibles or e-commerce background is a plus). Strong organizational and multitasking abilities with acute attention to detail. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. Resilient, adaptable, and capable of thriving in a fast-paced setting with shifting priorities. High level of integrity and discretion when handling high-value assets. Proficiency in using computers and inventory management software. Ability to stand for prolonged periods, lift/move objects, and perform physical tasks (e.g., bending, reaching overhead). jobs.jd: About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility. About the Team The European Order Operations team owns the end-to-end quote-to-cash transaction process and serves as the main operational partner for Retail and Corporate Sales teams on order-related matters. The team connects Sales, Delivery, Logistics, Service, Production Control, IT, Finance, Tax, and Accounting to maintain accurate orders and enable timely deliveries. It combines hands-on daily execution with structured performance management, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. The team’s impact is visible in orderbook accuracy, delivery readiness, revenue recognition support, and a reliable experience for internal and external stakeholders. About the Role The Order Operations Specialist is an individual contributor role reporting to the Supervisor, Order Operations and supporting the execution of Lucid’s European order-to-delivery operations. This role ensure s that customers and vehicle orders move accurately and efficiently through the transaction lifecycle, while providing Sales and Delivery teams with reliable operational support. Y ou will take ownership of day-to-day order execution, proactively resolve transactional issues, maintain accurate data across systems, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure that vehicles, invoices, payments, and customer documentation are ready for delivery. Success will be demonstrated through accurate orderbook data, timely issue resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and improved operational consistency. Unlike a traditional order management position, this role provides direct exposure to the development and scaling of European automotive order operations, with opportunities to influence workflows, systems, and new purchase scenarios as the business grows. What You Own Order Execution: Own the accurate processing and maintenance of customer and vehicle orders from order placement through delivery, ensuring that required changes are completed correctly and on time. Delivery Readiness: Partner with Sales, Delivery, Logistics, Service, and other operational teams to identify and resolve order-related blockers so that vehicles and customer documentation are ready for the planned handover. Stakeholder Communication: Serve as a primary operational contact for quote- and order-related enquiries and escalations, providing clear and proactive updates on order status, fulfilment, invoicing, vehicle readiness, and delivery. Process Improvement: Identify and implement scalable processes, documentation, training materials, system enhancements, and automation opportunities that improve operational efficiency, consistency, and accuracy. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

Join Crusoe as a Data Scientist, a dedicated hire on our central Data Science and Engineering team. This full-time position offers you the opportunity to own the data and analytics function for key parts of the business, starting with the Data Center Infrastructure Group (DIG) -- the arm of Crusoe that builds and operates data centers, spanning real estate, energy, construction, and parts lifecycle management. As part of a central team, you will also have the opportunity to partner with other groups across the company as needs arise.

You will partner directly with business stakeholders, translate their needs into analytical work, and own the reporting and data quality that leadership depends on for high-stakes decisions.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Own Reporting & Dashboards: Build and maintain the weekly and monthly reports and dashboards that business leaders rely on for operational decision-making. You are the DRI for accuracy and timeliness.

 - Partner with Business Stakeholders: Work directly with leaders across construction, real estate, energy, procurement, and other functions to gather requirements and translate business questions into analytical deliverables.

 - Drive New Data Integrations: Work with data engineering to identify and onboard data from third-party enterprise systems (ERP, procurement, asset management, etc.) into the data lake, defining requirements and validating data quality as new sources come online.

 - Track Complex Projects: The infrastructure side of Crusoe runs large, multi-year construction projects with long lead times and many vendors. You will build and maintain tracking for project progress, cost burn-down, timelines, and financial performance.

 - Translate Business to Technical: Take business requirements and produce technical or techno-functional specifications that data engineers can execute on. Bridge the gap between what the business needs and how the data platform delivers it.

 - Support Master Data Management: As the company matures its MDM and ERP practices, you will help ensure master data (vendors, parts, projects, cost centers, sites) is consistent and accurate across systems.

 - Champion Data Quality: Identify gaps and inconsistencies in data, investigate root causes, and work with data engineers to implement fixes. When a number is wrong, you own the resolution.



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - Business Acumen: You understand why you are building something, not just what. You ask questions until the business context is clear and you can explain your work to non-technical stakeholders.

 - Technical Fluency: Possess strong SQL skills -- you will query BigQuery daily. Comfort working with large, complex datasets across multiple source systems.

 - Modern Data Stack Experience: Experience with a modern data stack (BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, or equivalents).

 - Reporting Expertise: Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports for operational use. Familiarity with BI tools (e.g., Sigma, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).

 - Stakeholder Management: Proven experience working directly with business partners to gather requirements and deliver data products. You are credible in a room with construction project managers and equally comfortable reviewing a data model with an engineer.

 - Ownership: Track record of being the go-to person for "is this number right?" You take accountability for data accuracy and do not wait to be told when something is off.



Bonus Points

 - Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Sage Intacct, or similar) and the data that flows from them.

 - Familiarity with master data management concepts and cross-system entity resolution.

 - Experience working in a fast-growing company where processes are still being built.

 - Python for data analysis is a plus but not required.

 - Experience with AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate analytical work.
   
   

Our Data Stack

 - Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

 - Data Lake: Google Cloud Storage (GCS)

jobs.title: Real Estate Market Intelligence Analyst
jobs.jd:
MISSION

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.




ROLE PURPOSE

Neko is opening clinics at pace: from a handful of US sites today to a 2028 cohort in the dozens and a portfolio in the hundreds by 2030. We are looking for a flexible, quantitative analyst to build the market intelligence behind that growth, using GIS, data, and analytics to decide where we open next, why, and how many clinics a market can support. The work runs from market sizing and member analytics through to site, market, and portfolio performance.

This is a build role. Neko is appointment-based, not footfall-driven, so the standard retail playbook does not transfer, and working out what predicts a successful clinic is the core problem. There is no framework to inherit: you will build the models and processes from scratch, and what you build in year one is what the whole portfolio runs on.

You will report to the Head of US Real Estate and work closely with the Transaction Managers, the Real Estate Associates, and our data analytics and engineering teams, in a small team where you help set the standard.




WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER IN THE FIRST 6-12 MONTHS

 - Market sizing: size the addressable member base by market and trade area, and translate it into how many clinics a market can support and in what order we should enter. This is the first priority of the role.

 - Site selection support: give Real Estate the analysis to justify new markets and infill locations, and to decide clinic sizing and spacing, including overlap and cannibalization as density increases.

 - Member data foundation: work with the internal data analytics and engineering teams to set up the full chain, from data collection to aggregation to analysis. Define our ideal member profile, find where those members live and work, and keep refining it as first-party data accumulates.

 - GIS platform, tool agnostic: use GrowthFactor today and own the catchment definitions, data layers, and scoring logic. Document the logic independently of the tool so it moves with us, and help evaluate and onboard the next platform when the time comes. Make the tool usable by Transaction Managers, not only by you.

 - Scoring and forecasting models: maintain a repeatable, defensible site scoring model and demand forecasts built to be re-run. A reforecast after a slipped opening or a shifted plan should be a scenario switch, not a rebuild.

 - Portfolio, market, and site performance: as clinics open, track and review performance at the portfolio, market, and site level. Compare forecast to actual, separate a bad site from a bad market from a bad launch, surface underperformers early, and document what each opening teaches us. Turn those learnings into updated site selection criteria, scoring weights, and sizing and spacing rules, so every new clinic is chosen with better information than the last.

 - Approval memos and cross-functional support: help produce LOI and Lease Approval Memos by coordinating inputs from Real Estate, Design, Construction, and Legal into a clear, one-page recommendation that leadership can decide from.

 - Process design and redesign: own the evaluation processes the team runs on, and version them. Retire what stops working, rebuild what needs it, and write it down so others can run it without you.

 - AI across the Real Estate team: use Claude and custom agents to eliminate your own manual work, then go further. Identify where AI can save broader team time (market research, data pulls, memo drafting, lease and LOI summaries, pipeline reporting), build reusable prompts, skills, and agents, train teammates to use them, and track the time saved. Be honest about where AI output needs human review.

 - Market packs and benchmarks: produce market entry recommendations, ranked pipeline views, and site-level briefs, backed by per-site cost and occupancy benchmarks by market so deal comparison sits on real data.
   
   


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3 to 6 years in real estate market analytics, site selection, location intelligence, data science, or strategy, ideally supporting multi-site physical expansion.

 - Hands-on GIS experience with GrowthFactor, Esri ArcGIS, Kalibrate, Buxton, SiteZeus, Placer, or similar. We care more that you understand catchment and scoring logic than that you know any one tool, because the tool will change.

 - Strong market sizing and quantitative skills: penetration and capture modeling, regression or other predictive approaches, and scenario and sensitivity analysis. Excel to a high standard.

 - Comfort with census, consumer spend, mobility, and first-party data, and honesty about the limits of each.

 - Financial literacy: you can build a basic site pro forma, calculate payback and break-even, and connect a demand forecast to a real estate decision.

 - Flexibility. You can tear down your own model without ego, rebuild it when the facts change, and stay organized while priorities shift.

 - Clear communication and intellectual honesty. You can defend an assumption to a skeptical executive in two minutes, name the two things most likely to be wrong, and say early when the data does not support the answer people want.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - SQL or Python, which helps you work alongside engineers.

 - Specific, demonstrable use of AI to speed up analytical work, and real interest in teaching others to do the same.

 - Exposure to healthcare or regulated markets, or to European or multi-region expansion.

That means managing AV and conferencing systems, office equipment and vendors, being the first stop for IT support, and handling daily systems access in Okta with the central Security & IT team. As the company grows, there’s room to grow with it: launching new offices, taking a bigger part in endpoint security or identity management. This role will report to Sr. IT Manager.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Manage IT operations for our SF office: AV and conferencing systems, corporate network, office equipment, supplies, and the vendors behind them.

 - Be the first stop for IT help for SF-based employees: triage hardware and software issues, manage devices from setup to retirement, and keep people productive.

 - Run onboarding and offboarding end to end. Work with People/HR on timing, set up and remove systems access, and make sure every new hire’s laptop and accounts are ready before day one.

 - Make each new hire’s first day smooth and welcoming.

jobs.title: Analyst, International Market Intelligence — X-BAT (R6169)
jobs.jd:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

The International Market Intelligence Analyst develops and maintains consistent, decision-ready budget and competitive information for international autonomous combat aircraft markets. The role supports GTM leads and Mission Success with current evidence on funding, programs, competitors, acquisition pathways, and industrial expectations. 

This is a cumulative knowledge role that brings together two related analytic disciplines. The analyst maintains structured international budget and competitive data, applies established methods to heterogeneous public and commercial sources, and produces recurring country and regional reads for priority markets. 

Regional and country GTM leads own their customers, captures, and win strategies. This role supports those leads with the budget and competitive evidence needed to shape pursuits and inform capture strategies. It does not own Price-to-Win, final pricing posture, customer engagement, or execution of customer-funded programs. 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Maintain international budget coverage. Track partner-nation defense budgets, relevant program lines, and multi-year procurement and sustainment plans for priority autonomous combat aircraft markets. 

 - Maintain international competitive coverage. Keep competitor profiles, competition and award trackers, product comparisons, and teaming and industrial-partnership maps current for assigned countries and regions. 

 - Develop integrated country and regional reads. Combine budget and competitive data into decision-ready products covering funding, timing, competitors, acquisition path, and industrial expectations for GTM and Mission Success teams. 

 - Work from primary sources. Collect and extract data from defense budgets, white papers, parliamentary and legislative records, procurement notices, and reputable open-source reporting, supplemented by commercial market data when available. 

 - Curate the knowledge base. Maintain a structured, cumulative, and queryable international budget and competitive knowledge base using AI-enabled tools for ingestion, organization, and upkeep. 

 - Publish on cadence and on demand. Deliver recurring updates and respond to scoped rapid-turn requests supporting pursuits, campaign reviews, proposal inputs, and leadership decisions. 

 - Track market developments. Monitor programs, competitions, awards, teaming, industrial partnerships, offsets, and co-production developments in assigned markets and elevate material changes. 

 - Support the international campaign system. Provide reliable inputs that help country and regional leads shape pursuits, identify intelligence gaps, and establish collection priorities. 

 - Support a culture of accountability, urgency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

Decision rights and interfaces:

 - This role is accountable for the quality, currency, and consistency of assigned international budget and competitive data; recurring country and regional products; maintenance of the international knowledge base; and timely response to scoped analytic requests. 
   
   Regional, country, and opportunity GTM leads are accountable for customer relationships, in-country strategy, partner and industrial development, win strategy, pricing posture, proposal content, and the bid/no-bid recommendation for their pursuits. 
   
   The designated Price-to-Win lead and responsible GTM and pricing leaders are accountable for PTW positions and final pricing posture. This role provides relevant international budget and competitive evidence but does not perform or own PTW. 
   
   The U.S. Market Intelligence & Price-to-Win role is accountable for the U.S. market picture and coordinates common methods and knowledge standards with this role. 
   
   Government Relations, Export, Legal, and Contracts are accountable for interagency and embassy engagement, export authorizations, disclosure determinations, legal positions, and contracting terms. 
   
   Engineering and Product are accountable for technical solution definition, configuration decisions, and performance commitments. 
   
   External customer engagement by this role is in support of, and at the invitation of, the responsible GTM lead. 

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - 3–6 years of relevant experience in international defense budget analysis, competitive intelligence, market research, business development analysis, or closely related work in defense or aerospace. 

 - Working knowledge of international defense budgets and public budget documentation, with the ability to extract useful signal from incomplete and heterogeneous sources. 

 - Experience conducting competitive or market analysis, including competitor profiles, market assessments, or product comparisons. 

 - Working familiarity with international defense acquisition and pursuit dependencies, including FMS, DCS, or hybrid pathways and associated approval, disclosure, and exportability considerations. 

 - Strong research, data-handling, analytic writing, and briefing skills, with the ability to produce clear products for senior and non-specialist audiences. 

 - Ability to manage recurring production while responding to short-notice, well-scoped internal requests. 

 - Experience using AI tools to organize and maintain structured, reusable knowledge resources. 

 - Bachelor's degree in international affairs, security studies, economics, finance, political science, business, engineering, or a related field. 

 - Demonstrated alignment with Shield AI core values: Do What Honor Dictates, Live as a Servant Leader, Pursue Excellence. 

 - Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required and to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. 

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 -  Experience supporting defense business development, capture, or strategy. 

 -  Exposure to large UAV, unmanned, or autonomous aircraft programs. 

 -  Familiarity with offset, co-production, or industrial-participation frameworks in one or more priority markets. 

 -  Regional expertise or language skills relevant to Europe, the Middle East, or Asia-Pacific. 

 -  Familiarity with foreign disclosure, security cooperation, embassy or country-team coordination, or interagency advocacy. 

Success in this role:

 - 

 - Country and regional GTM leads and Mission Success have current, reliable, and consistent budget and competitive information for priority autonomous combat aircraft markets. 

 -  Country and regional products are delivered on cadence, use traceable sources, and identify material gaps or uncertainty. 

 -  Budget and competitive context is present early enough to help shape pursuits and inform capture strategies rather than being appended after key decisions. 

 -  The international knowledge base grows in coverage and quality quarter over quarter, and recurring questions take less time to answer. 

 -  Material funding shifts, competitor moves, and industrial dynamics in assigned markets are identified and elevated in time for the campaign system to respond.

jobs.title: Procurement Analyst
jobs.jd: Who we are: As a global leader in digital infrastructure, QTS designs, builds and operates advanced data centers that support strategic AI, cloud and digital transformation initiatives. We are driven by a mission to connect the world for good and our people make it possible. Every single day, the creativity, dedication and genuine care for our communities are what push us forward and make this a truly special place to be. The Procurement Analyst supports the end-to-end intake, routing, approval, execution, processing, and recordkeeping of AIA and other Development-related agreements. Working within established procedures, the role coordinates contract packages, internal reviews, and external signatures; checks submissions for completeness; maintains accurate versions and approval evidence; and helps ensure fully executed agreements are distributed and processed in the appropriate systems. This position works closely with Development project teams, Construction Contract Management, Cost Control, Legal, Finance, Sourcing, internal approvers, and external contracting parties. Under the guidance of the appropriate process owners, the coordinator helps keep contracting activities timely, organized, and auditable. The role does not own supplier negotiations, provide legal advice or interpretation, approve exceptions, or make commercial decisions on behalf of project teams. Key Responsibilities Contract Intake and Package Administration Receive and log AIA and other Development-related agreements submitted for approval and execution. Check routing requests and contract packages for required fields, exhibits, approved templates, signer information, and supporting documentation using established checklists. Notify the submitting project team of missing, inconsistent, or outdated information and track items through correction. Apply established naming, indexing, metadata, filing, and document-control standards. Organize drafts, redlines, final forms, and superseded versions throughout the contract lifecycle. Approval Workflow Coordination Set up internal approval workflows using established Delegation of Authority requirements, policies, and approval matrices. Route packages to assigned reviewers and approvers in the required sequence. Track pending reviews, approvals, rejections, returned items, and resubmissions; send routine reminders to support target cycle times. Provide status updates and communicate required actions to requestors, approvers, Sourcing, Cost Control, and other stakeholders. Escalate overdue approvals, exceptions, conflicting instructions, and unresolved issues to the appropriate process owner. Maintain approvals, comments, exceptions, and supporting decisions. Signature and Execution Management Create DocuSign envelopes from complete and authorized routing requests using established templates and instructions. Confirm signer names, titles, email addresses, signature fields, and sequencing before release. Monitor envelope status, send reminders, address routine routing questions, and escalate nonstandard issues. Check returned agreements for signatures, dates, required exhibits, and attachments. Coordinate administrative corrections or re-execution when directed, referring substantive or legal questions to the appropriate owner. Distribute fully executed agreements and applicable exhibits to authorized recipients. Records, Systems, and Reporting Maintain complete and accurate contract files, including source documents, approvals, correspondence, signature certificates, executed agreements, exhibits, amendments, and related records. Ensure current versions are clearly identified, superseded versions are retained or archived in accordance with policy, and access is limited to authorized users. Coordinate executed agreements for Workday and eBuilder processing and confirm required handoffs are completed.Maintain contract registers, workflow logs, status trackers, and other control records. Provide timely reporting on intake volume, approval and signature status, aging, cycle time, backlog, and exceptions. Support document requests, internal reviews, and audits by locating and producing complete records.Handle contract and business information with discretion and maintain confidentiality. Process Support and Continuous Improvement Track recurring delays, incomplete submissions, and handoff issues and share observations with process owners. Maintain intake guidance, checklists, templates, standard operating procedures, and training materials as directed. Suggest practical improvements to document standards, approval steps, reporting, and system use. Assist with testing and implementation of workflow enhancements. Provide routine guidance to users on routing requirements, document standards, and system procedures. Perform related contract-operations and document-administration duties as assigned. Qualifications Required Associate degree or coursework in business administration, legal studies, construction management, supply chain, finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Entry-level experience, internship experience, or one to three years of experience in procurement or sourcing operations, contract administration, legal support, document control, project coordination, or a related administrative role. Experience working with electronic documents, business workflows, shared records, or approval tracking. Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow documented procedures, checklists, and deadlines. Ability to organize multiple assignments, maintain accurate records, and follow up professionally. Clear written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with internal and external contacts. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams. Preferred Exposure to AIA agreements or Development, real estate, engineering, or construction-related documents. Familiarity with DocuSign, Workday, eBuilder, a contract lifecycle management platform, an electronic document management system, or comparable tools. Basic familiarity with approval matrices, Delegation of Authority concepts, records retention, or audit controls. Paralegal coursework, contract-administration training, records-management training, or related professional development. Experience maintaining trackers, preparing routine reports, or updating process documentation. Core Competencies Attention to detail: Checks documents carefully and produces complete, accurate work. Organization: Keeps files, trackers, deadlines, and follow-up activities orderly. Reliability: Follows through on assigned tasks and keeps stakeholders informed. Judgment and escalation: Follows established procedures, recognizes nonstandard issues, and seeks guidance when needed. Customer service: Communicates clearly, professionally, and tactfully with internal and external contacts. Confidentiality and control: Protects sensitive information and maintains consistent records. Learning agility: Learns new systems, procedures, and contract-document requirements quickly. jobs.title: Project Analyst
jobs.jd: Who are we? Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries. People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden. Why Join Howden US? At Howden, we’re not just building a business- We’re rewriting the rules of what a global insurance broker can be. And now, it’s your turn to be part of something extraordinary. From three people and a dog to over 22,000 employees across 56 countries, we’ve grown into a $4bn revenue powerhouse with bold ambition: to become a $13bn business with 40,000 people by 2030. We’re launching our US retail platform with the same entrepreneurial spirit that’s driven our success worldwide- and we’re looking for trailblazers to help shape the future. Why Howden? You’ll Own It With 6,000 employee shareholders owning 34% of the company , our unique ownership model means you’re not just joining a team—you’re building a business you truly own. You’ll Be Empowered We’re a destination for talent where people are trusted to look after their clients and grow together. You’ll have the freedom to lead, backed by global scale and local expertise. You’ll Be Part of Something Bigger Our integrated platform spans broking, reinsurance, and MGA capabilities—giving you access to everything you need to deliver for clients and build something remarkable We have always been employee-owned and driven by entrepreneurial spirit. Right from the beginning, we've focused on employing talented individuals and empowering them to make a real difference to the company, whilst building successful and fulfilling careers at the same time. Simply put, we hire talented specialists and give them what they need to make a difference for clients. Always have, always will. What is the role? We are seeking an Operations Project Analyst to support the planning, execution, and governance of programs and projects across the US Retail business. This role sits within the PMO and works in close partnership with Program Managers to ensure initiatives are delivered with rigor, clarity, and strong business insight. The Operations Project Analyst will be responsible for supporting program delivery through analysis, problem solving, and identifying how component parts affect the delivery of the program. This is an excellent opportunity for an analytically strong professional who wants to operate at the intersection of business operations, technology, and transformation in a fast-scaling insurance brokerage. What will you be doing? Project and Delivery Support Partner with Project Managers to support the execution of assigned projects, including tracking workstream progress, dependencies, risks, and issues. Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to gather updates, resolve action items, and support meeting preparation and follow-through. Support change management activities for assigned projects, including stakeholder impact assessments, communication planning, and adoption tracking. Develop and maintain program documentation, including project plans, status reports, RAID logs, and decision logs. Support UAT planning and execution, working with business teams and technology partners to validate that solutions meet requirements. Reporting and Governance Maintain accurate and timely project documentation in PMO tools (e.g., Monday.com) in accordance with governance standards. Support portfolio-level reporting by consolidating status, risks, and milestones across assigned programs. Contribute to benefits tracking and lessons learned documentation at program completion. Assist in the development and maintenance of PMO templates, tools, and standard operating procedures. Requirements and Business Analysis Conduct current-state analysis and gap assessments to support the design of future-state solutions. Support the development of business cases and initiative intake documentation in alignment with PMO standards. Elicit, document, and validate business requirements for assigned programs and projects in partnership with Program Managers and business stakeholders. Develop clear functional specifications, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria to support technology and process delivery teams. Key Skills & Competencies Ability to synthesize complex or ambiguous information into a clear narrative and recommendation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing clear documentation for diverse audiences. Proven ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail. Collaborative and proactive, with the ability to build effective working relationships across business and technology teams. Demonstrated experience connecting analysis and project activity to business outcomes. Qualifications 3–6 years of experience in a project analyst or project delivery role—preferably within insurance brokerage or a related financial services environment. Experience developing business cases, decision materials, or executive-ready communications. Experience supporting technology implementations or business transformation programs. Familiarity with Agile, waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies. Proficiency with project management and portfolio tools (e.g., Monday.com, or similar). Ability to operate across multiple disciplines and stakeholder groups in a matrixed organization. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field. CBAP, PMI-PBA, or equivalent business analysis certification is a plus. What do we offer in return? A career that you define. Our business succeeds by allowing our people to make a mark in the areas they care about most: personal development, volunteering, and fundraising for charity, or creating new insurance products that address society’s greatest challenges. And we know that separate home and work lives don't really exist. If you're happy and healthy at home, you're more likely to be happy and fulfilled at work – and vice versa. That's why we do our best to support our people in every aspect of their lives. Compensation and Benefits The expected base salary range for this role is $75,000 - $125,000; actual base salary will be determined based on factors including candidate experience and work location. This role is classified as non-exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA). In addition to a competitive base salary, employees are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus. Howden also offers a variety of benefits and programs, subject to eligibility, including: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including healthcare savings and reimbursement accounts 401(k) retirement plan Flexible Paid Time Off and paid parental leave Life and Disability insurance Our sustainability promise We’re on a life-long journey to become an ever-more sustainable group. It's a commitment to taking care of our people and the world we live in, to doing good business, and to making a positive impact wherever we can. Our governance processes, company policies, and review systems are all geared towards our goal of making a positive impact in the world. You can read more about our sustainability work here . What do we offer in return? A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us: Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new We support each other in the small everyday moments

jobs.title: Technical Consultant (Presales), Advanced Data Solutions
jobs.jd: Technical Consultant (Presales), Advanced Data Solutions About the Team This role sits within Elsevier’s Advanced Data Solutions team, which is responsible for selling and enabling customer implementations of Elsevier’s data and software solutions. Technical Consultants (Pre-Sales) report to the global Director of Technical Consulting (Pre-Sales) while operating in regionally aligned roles, with ownership across North America, EMEA, and APAC (primarily Japan). The team partners closely with Sales, post-sales, and Professional Services teams to support enterprise customer engagements. About the Role As a Technical Consultant (Pre-Sales) , you will play a critical role in driving revenue growth by partnering with Sales to position Elsevier’s data and software solutions, and analytics capabilities as enablers of customer insight and decision-making. You will act as the technical authority throughout the sales cycle – leading discovery, shaping data-driven use cases, and demonstrating how Elsevier’s offerings can be combined to power advanced analytics, knowledge graphs, and AI-enabled workflows, including grounding LLMs, agents, and RAG applications in trusted scientific data. This role focuses mainly on pre-sales activities , with close collaboration across post-sales, professional services, and product teams to ensure proposed solutions are technically feasible, scalable, and aligned with real-world delivery and adoption. Success in this role is built on a strong technical foundation, practical AI and data expertise, curiosity about scientific domains, and exceptional customer-facing skills , enabling you to translate data and software capabilities into compelling, outcome-driven solutions. Responsibilities Pre-sales solution leadership Develop and maintain expertise in Elsevier’s solutions, including curated datasets, data APIs and integration options, MCP servers, AI agents, and SciBite semantic solutions, and how these combine to give customers' analytics and AI applications trusted access to Elsevier data and deliver insights. Lead technical discovery to understand customer objectives, analytical workflows, data landscapes, and success criteria, translating business and scientific challenges into data-driven use cases, solution architectures, and value narratives Design and deliver tailored solution demonstrations showcasing how Elsevier data and software enable insights (e.g., discovery, analytics, AI-powered workflows and agents, and knowledge graph construction). Scope and prepare solution proposals, and support proof-of-concepts (PoCs), technical evaluations, and pilots to validate solution fit and value, clearly articulating technical trade-offs, assumptions, and dependencies across data, software, and services. Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the sales cycle, supporting account strategy, solution positioning, and competitive differentiation. Stay current with developments in AI (e.g., LLMs, agentic workflows, and responsible AI) and advise customers on how to apply them with Elsevier data, while using AI tools to improve the speed and quality of pre-sales work such as demos, proposals, and PoCs. Cross-functional alignment Validate solution feasibility in collaboration with Product and Professional Services teams to ensure smooth delivery, adoption, and account growth and expansion. Capture customer feedback and market insights to inform product positioning, roadmap priorities, and go-to-market strategy in partnership with Product and Marketing teams. Requirements Have deepp understanding of data-driven analytics workflows, including data ingestion, enrichment, integration, and insight generation Have working knowledge of Generative AI and LLM-based solutions (e.g., RAG, prompt design, agentic workflows, evaluation, and responsible AI and data governance), and of how NER, ontologies, taxonomies, and knowledge graphs are applied to real-world analytical use cases Have working knowledge of cloud and technical ecosystems (e.g., AWS, REST APIs, SFTP, HTTP, OAuth, Docker, Python, etc.), with familiarity with AI platforms, tooling, and integration patterns (e.g., LLM APIs, MCP). Have a degree in a science, technology, or data field (Master’s or PhD advantageous), or equivalent practical experience. Experience working in data-intensive enterprise environments (e.g., technology, engineering, pharma, or life sciences); life sciences experience is desirable but not essential, alongside a willingness to learn scientific domains. Have an understanding of how data and software are used to support research, analytics, and decision-making is highly valued. Experience delivering technical demonstrations and presentations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder-management skills. Display confidence leading complex technical discussions and navigating challenging or ambiguous customer conversations Able to travel to customer sites and industry events as required. Work in a Way That Works for You We promote a healthy work-life balance and offer flexible working options. Our benefits include wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals—supporting both your immediate responsibilities and long-term goals. Working for You We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including: Health benefits: medical, dental, and vision coverage Retirement benefits: 401(k) with match and Employee Share Purchase Plan Wellbeing: wellness platform, Headspace subscription, and Employee Assistance Programs Insurance: short- and long-term disability, life, accidental death, critical illness, and hospital indemnity Family benefits: parental leave, adoption, and surrogacy support Savings accounts: HSA, FSA, dependent care, and commuter benefits Paid time off, plus volunteer and Employee Resource Group participation days About the Business As a global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes. By combining trusted content with advanced analytics, we support research, education, and clinical practice. jobs.title: Treasury Operations Analyst
jobs.jd: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. jobs.jd: Job Description: Sales Analyst, Family Dollar - Mars Petcare Franklin, TN This role is based in Franklin, TN with regular in-office collaboration expected. The Sales Analyst, Family Dollar/Dollar Tree position plays a critical role in enabling customer teams to drive business performance across both digital and physical retail channels. This role translates data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making across assortment, pricing, promotion, forecasting, and trade investment. It exists to ensure that customer plans are informed by strong analytical rigor and aligned with Mars Pet Nutrition's growth objectives. What are we looking for? Develop actionable insights with clear narratives – articulating the “what,” “so what,” and “now what” to guide strategic decisions. Manage tracking tools for promotional and display execution, ensuring retail partner connectivity and timely updates. Prepare data and presentations for key customer milestones such as PBRs (Period Business Reviews), QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews), JBP, and other customer needs. Build dashboards or tools that improve visibility and decision-making across internal and external stakeholders. Operations & Process Improvement Manage operations-related tasks such as Compass/Financial system upkeep, new item submissions, and price change processing. Identify and implement process improvements that drive data quality, efficiency, and actionable output. Ensure data readiness for internal systems and customer requirements. jobs.title: Pricing Strategy Analyst (Remote)
jobs.jd: We're looking for a Pricing Strategy Analyst to join Procore's Corporate Strategy team. In this role, you'll be the data and analytics engine behind our pricing, packaging, and monetization strategy, turning transaction, sales, and product data into the commercial signals that inform our decisions. You'll also lead smaller pricing initiatives across the full Procore portfolio, including our emerging AI offerings. The primary goal of this role is to make sure Procore's pricing decisions are grounded in clear, accurate, and well-sourced data. As a Pricing Strategy Analyst , you'll partner with Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing to analyze how our pricing and packaging perform in the market and to build the visibility needed to improve them. Use your structured problem-solving, data analysis, and executive communication skills to shape how Procore captures value from what we build and buy. If you want hands-on work to drive top line growth and connect everyone in construction, apply today and join our team! This position reports to the Senior Manager of Pricing & Monetization Strategy and can be based remotely in the US. We're looking for someone to join us immediately. What you'll do: Lead pricing and packaging initiatives from hypothesis through recommendation, in partnership with Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing Build and stress-test the business case behind pricing decisions, including segment-level performance, cannibalization-adjusted ARR impact, and migration and monetization sizing. Analyze transaction, bookings, discounting, and product data to identify the commercial signals that explain how our pricing and packaging perform, and diagnose the root cause when they underperform, whether it is package design, sales execution, or market fit. Design and run market, competitive, and willingness-to-pay research, including win/loss and price elasticity analysis, to pressure-test pricing hypotheses before they reach leadership. Build and maintain pricing and packaging reporting and dashboards that give Product, Sales, and Finance visibility into performance, working with data teams to keep metrics and data sources accurate and consistent. Translate analysis into a small number of clear, claim-driven recommendations, present them to executive leaders, and defend them under challenge. Partner with Pricing Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Deal Desk, and Marketing to make sure approved decisions are operationalized and communicated to the field. What we’re looking for: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in pricing, monetization, strategy, business or data analytics, financial planning and analysis, or consulting wi th 2+ y ears inside a pricing or monetization practice at a top-tier strategy firm Track record of framing ambiguous problems into clear analytical frameworks and presenting recommendations to cross-functional and senior audiences. Experience leading projects or workstreams from analysis through recommendation, with the ability to balance multiple priorities. Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, with experience building revenue impact and unit economics models. Hands-on experience querying and analyzing large datasets (e.g., SQL), building reports in a BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus Ability to synthesize qualitative inputs, such as call transcripts and field feedback, into clear themes that support pricing recommendations. Cross-functional collaboration and influence skills, with experience partnering with Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing teams. Familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics (e.g., ARR, net revenue retention, win rate, discount rate) is a plus Curiosity, high agency, and an owner’s mindset with a strong bias for action. Additional Information Base Pay Range: 81,600.00 - 112,200.00 USD Annual This role may also be eligible for Equity Compensation and/or Bonus Incentive Compensation. Procore is committed to offering competitive, fair, and commensurate compensation. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is an AI safety and research company working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our customers and society as a whole. As an Enforcement Analyst focused on Agentic Alignment, you will play a crucial role in identifying and investigating harmful and unexpected behavior by models, and make enforcement decisions accordingly. You'll work closely with a suite of cross-functional teams, within and outside of Safeguards, including: Policy, Threat Intel, Engineering, Research, and Transparency. Your work will be essential in maintaining Anthropic's commitment to safe and beneficial AI as Claude takes on more autonomous work. OpenAI’s Procurement team makes working with the world easy, fast, and safe. We connect supplier readiness, purchasing, invoicing, and payment so teams can move with confidence as OpenAI scales.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Procurement Operations Specialist to support subcontracting and intercompany purchasing and payment coordination for a growing deployment business. You will keep agreements, staffing changes and purchase order (PO) funding aligned, and own the research, supplier communication and follow-through needed to resolve issues. Accounts Payable (AP) handles invoice processing and payments; Accounting owns accounting decisions.

You will also manage subcontracting workflows in our deployment operations platform and use OpenAI technology to automate repeatable steps. This combines hands-on operations with building and testing practical AI workflows that improve speed, accuracy and service as the business grows.

Location: San Francisco, CA. This role follows a hybrid work model, with three days per week in the office (Monday–Wednesday).

In this role, you will:

 - Coordinate subcontracting and purchasing from intake through completion: prepare agreement and amendment inputs, track reviews and signatures, and execute approved PO requests and changes.

 - Translate staffing, scope, term and engagement-value changes into coordinated updates to agreements, PO funding and billing schedules. Keep the source documents and transaction records connected.

 - Lead research and supplier issue remediation across contracts, POs, invoices and payments. Identify the cause, secure corrections, keep suppliers informed and give AP complete supporting evidence. Follow each issue through resolution.

 - Serve as the primary contact for intercompany invoice and payment status. Follow up with approvers, investigate stalled handoffs, and coordinate procurement and ERP system issues with AP, Accounting and Finance Systems through resolution. Keep stakeholders informed of progress and next steps.

 - Own subcontracting workflow requirements for the deployment operations platform. Build practical AI support for intake, extracting terms, preparing drafts, comparing records and researching exceptions. Test outputs against current sources and validate calculations.

 - Partner with Procurement Enablement and Finance Systems to improve workflows and integrations. Measure cycle time, rework, issue aging and time saved, then use the results to prioritize improvements.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Bring hands-on experience in procurement, procure-to-pay, finance operations or a related field, with a record of independently following work through to completion.

 - Understand how agreements, approvals, PO funding, invoices and payments connect. You can investigate discrepancies, explain findings to suppliers and coordinate a supported resolution with AP and Accounting.

 - Bring practical AI fluency and experience improving workflows with automation. You can show what you built, how you validated results and what improved.

 - Work confidently with spreadsheets and procurement or ERP systems, investigate transaction and workflow issues, and coordinate fixes with system owners.

Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.




ROLE OVERVIEW

You will be the first point of contact for the production workers at Franklin Shipyard, the welders, fitters, machinists, electricians, and technicians who build our vessels. You will keep the People Team’s day-to-day work running for the shipyard: answering questions, handling attendance paperwork, supporting new hires through onboarding, and keeping employee records accurate. This is an on-site, entry-level role for someone who is dependable, approachable, and detail-oriented, and who wants to learn HR operations by supporting people who work with their hands. You will work under close guidance, learn our policies, systems, and compliance requirements, and know when to bring in a senior member of the team. Perfect for someone passionate about both people and process.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Be the front-line People Team contact for employees: answer day-to-day questions in person, by phone, and by email on pay, schedules, attendance, benefits, and policies, and direct employees to the right HR contact before issues go to senior team members.

 - Help employees with password resets, timekeeping and badge access issues, and basic system troubleshooting.

 - Manage medical documentation and attendance points: collect doctor’s notes from employees, maintain the attendance points report, and notify supervisors when points should be removed.

 - Support onboarding and offboarding for new hires and departing employees, including first-day logistics, paperwork follow-up, and maintaining the onboarding tracker.

 - Track and coordinate PPE and uniform needs, including vest sizes and safety boot communications, with the EHS and operations teams.

 - Pull standard daily and weekly HR reports and share them with supervisors and the People Team on schedule.

 - Maintain accurate, organized, and confidential employee records and HR documentation (physical and digital).

 - Follow established procedures, check your work before submitting it, and ask for guidance before acting on sensitive issues such as workplace injuries, complaints, or discipline.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience.

 - 2-4 years of experience in HR, People Operations, customer service, or administrative support; experience in a manufacturing, shipyard, or industrial setting is a plus.

 - Comfortable being on-site and available to support multiple shifts as needed.

 - Friendly, approachable, and patient communicator who can build trust with skilled-trades and production employees.

jobs.jd:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.




COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.




TEAM OVERVIEW

Marketing Operations keeps Deepgram's go-to-market engine measurable. As our first Marketing & GTM Data Analyst, you'll build the reporting and analytics function rather than inherit a finished one, and own the answer to what's working and where to invest next. You'll partner with the Director of Marketing Operations on the weekly GTM report leadership reads, and with our Decision Intelligence and Data Engineering teams on AI analytics agents and the GTM data foundation. Your work will power Marketing, Product, SDR, AE, Partnerships, and RevOps.




KEY GOALS

 - Automate recurring GTM analytics with Decision Intelligence, designing and improving AI agents for weekly reporting, campaign and sales play readouts, scoring-model checks, and anomaly alerts, as the GTM expert who writes evaluation cases and QAs their output.

 - Own Marketing and GTM KPI definitions, calculation logic, and the weekly report leadership reads, with a clear narrative on what changed and why.

 - Measure marketing campaigns and SDR/AE sales plays from first touch through closed-won, using pre/post and cohort analysis to say what to scale, fix, or stop.

 - Create reusable campaign and sales play reporting templates with consistent definitions, time windows, and attribution rules, structured so AI agents can generate first drafts.

 - Own Dreamdata and evolve our attribution practices (multi-touch, sourcing rules, SDR credit, partner attribution), reconcile them with Salesforce and HubSpot, and turn attribution into budget recommendations.

 - Evaluate and improve MQL, PQL, and account intent scoring models, with automated monitoring of precision, coverage, and conversion lift by score.

 - Define and report partner and business development performance, including partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, co-marketing results, and performance by tier.

 - Define GTM source-of-truth datasets with Data Engineering and Decision Intelligence, write the semantic context AI analytics agents rely on, and drive data quality fixes upstream.


MINIMUM SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & CAPABILITIES

 - Turns vague or complex requests ("did re:Invent work?", "why is pipeline soft?") into clear, answerable questions before touching data, and pushes back constructively when the question is wrong.

 - Understands the B2B funnel (MQL, SAL, SQL, Closed Won) and how marketing, product-led, partner, SDR, and AE motions interact, and explains why the numbers look the way they do.

 - Writes strong SQL directly in a warehouse and across Salesforce objects (Leads, Contacts, Campaigns, Campaign Members, Opportunities, custom objects).

 - Reconciles messy data across systems, holds a high bar for what counts as right, and fixes problems at the source rather than patching downstream.

 - Has owned or improved a multi-touch attribution setup and reconciled it with CRM data.

 - Evaluates or tunes lead, PQL, or account scoring models and measures whether they improve conversion.

 - Operates AI-native: builds AI agents or agentic workflows for analytics (e.g., Claude Code, MCP servers, n8n), automates recurring analysis, and writes the evaluation cases and context agents need to be accurate.

 - Builds dashboards and recurring reports in a BI tool that people rely on and act on, with a narrative sized for leadership.

 - Owns KPI definitions so the same number means the same thing everywhere.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE-TO-HAVE, NOT REQUIRED)

 - Typically ~3–5 years in marketing analytics, GTM or revenue analytics, or a similar analytical role at a B2B SaaS company, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

 - Hands-on with Dreamdata, HockeyStack, Bizible, or a similar attribution tool, plus HubSpot and Salesforce reporting.

 - Python, and experience with dbt, semantic layers, or metric stores.

 - Worked with intent data or partner attribution.

 - Experience at a usage-based, developer-focused, or product-led business.


OUR VALUES

jobs.title: Operations & Community Engagement Coordinator, The Project on Workforce
jobs.jd: By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive. Why join the Harvard Kennedy School? The John F. Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University is one of 12 graduate and professional schools at the university. Harvard Kennedy School’s mission is to improve public policy and leadership so people can live in societies that are more safe, free, just, and sustainably prosperous. By combining cutting-edge research, the teaching of outstanding students, and direct interaction with practitioners, we have an impact on solving public problems that no other institution can match. When you work at Harvard Kennedy School, you make a difference. The Project on Workforce seeks a highly organized, collaborative, and proactive Operations & Community Coordinator to support the Project’s day-to-day operations and foster engagement across its network of researchers, students, practitioners, alumni, and advisors. The Coordinator will manage core administrative and event logistics; coordinate selected research projects; and support student, alumni, and partner engagement. This position offers an opportunity to work closely with leaders addressing some of the nation’s most pressing education and workforce challenges. Operations, Administration & Events (50%) Support financial administration, including expense tracking, reimbursements, purchasing, and preparation of financial reports. Coordinate vendor relationships, purchasing, and contracts, in collaboration with Project leadership and Harvard administrative offices. Maintain organizational systems and processes that support the Project's research and engagement activities. Coordinate convenings, meetings, and events that bring together Project on Workforce partners and stakeholders. Support scheduling and other administrative activities for Project leadership, as needed. Project Coordination (25%) Coordinate one to two research projects, including managing timelines, scheduling meetings, coordinating research assistants, and tracking project deliverables. Student & Community Engagement (25%) Coordinate recruitment, onboarding, and engagement of research assistants and student fellows. Support the Project's Cross-Harvard Study Group and other student programming that connects students with researchers and practitioners. Support outreach to Project alumni and strengthen the network of former research assistants, fellows, and study group members. Assist with community communications, outreach, and other engagement initiatives. Based at the Mossavar-Rahmani Center for Business and Government at the Harvard Kennedy School, the Project on Workforce is an interdisciplinary initiative spanning the Harvard Kennedy School, Harvard Business School's Managing the Future of Work project, and the Harvard Graduate School of Education. The Project produces rigorous research and actionable insights at the intersection of education, labor markets, and economic mobility, with the goal of creating stronger pathways between learning and work. Through research, policy engagement, strategic partnerships, and convenings, the Project brings together leaders across and beyond Harvard to address the nation's workforce challenges and expand opportunity for workers and learners. Basic Qualifications: At least 1 year of relevant professional experience. A complete application must include a cover letter. Additional Qualifications and Skills: Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to engage with a wide range of stakeholders. jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.location: Remote (US East Coast / Eastern Time Zone Preferred)
jobs.jd: Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team. Analytics Engineer We’re hiring Analytics Engineers to join Convene Hospitality Group’s (CHG) Technology organization. We’re building out the foundational platform to democratize data at CHG so that a venue GM, a finance lead, and an AI agent are all able to ask a question and get the same trusted answer. Analytics engineers own the full path from ingestion to visualization, including governance and observability. You’ll bring data in from source systems, model it through bronze, silver, and gold, define the semantic layer, and breathe life into the visualizations, conversational analytics, and business agents that teams rely on to make decisions. You’ll join the Data Platform team, reporting to its Engineering Manager, and work closely with other analytics engineers and business partners across the company. You’ll build on Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran, using Snowflake-native capabilities like semantic views and Cortex to power ThoughtSpot and beyond. What You’ll Do: Partner with the business. Work with Finance, Sales, Operations, and venue teams to understand their needs and turn them into models and metrics they trust. Own ingestion for your domains. Set up and maintain Fivetran connectors, land data in bronze, and handle schema drift and load failures. Model the business. Build dbt models that move data through bronze, silver, and gold, and shape gold around how CHG runs so people outside the data team can understand and use it. Own the semantic layer. Set metrics, dimensions, and relationships so a number means the same thing in a dashboard, a search, or an agent’s answer. Tune synonyms and descriptions so a model picks the right measure, trace wrong answers to the root cause, and help us decide where each definition lives. Power self-service in ThoughtSpot. Build the models and Liveboards that let teams explore data on their own, and turn the questions people actually ask into new test cases. Own the quality of conversational analytics. Test answers the way you’d test code. Build and maintain a golden question set of real business questions paired with certified answers as your test cases, run them as a regression suite on every model or semantic change, and block releases that fail. Back your models with dbt tests and clear documentation. Apply governance day to day. Tag sensitive data at ingestion, apply access controls such as tag-based masking and row access policies, and follow the standards the team sets, so an agent only returns what the person asking is allowed to see. Keep it fast and fresh. Monitor freshness, data quality, and pipeline health so problems surface to you before they reach a dashboard or an agent’s answer. Tune query and model performance, from incremental dbt models to warehouse sizing, so answers come back fast and Snowflake costs stay in check. Work AI-native. Lead with specs, then hand agents end-to-end tasks, from exploring source data to building models, tests, and documentation. Let agents run loose in the wild (with some guardrails in place). You hold agent and human work to the same review bar, so code from Claude and code from a teammate get the same scrutiny. Share what you learn, and help set the playbook for agentic data work. What We Look For: You have 3+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI development, building data products people rely on. You write strong SQL and have built and maintained dbt models in production. You’ve worked in a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake. You’ve worked with ELT ingestion tools like Fivetran and can troubleshoot source-data issues such as schema changes, late-arriving data, and API limits. You understand data modeling: dimensional models, medallion layering, and clear reasoning about grain, slowly changing dimensions, and event lifecycles. You’ve built dashboards or self-service data products that people use to make decisions. You test and document your work as a habit. You’re curious about the business. You ask what decision a request supports before you start building. You use AI agents for real multi-step work, like writing SQL and dbt models, generating tests, and drafting documentation, and you verify what they produce. You explain your work clearly to technical and non-technical partners. You take ownership. You see work through, ask for help when you’re stuck, and look for ways to make things better. Bonus Points You’ve evaluated LLM or natural-language analytics output, for example with golden sets or regression testing. You’ve worked in hospitality, events, real estate, or another customer-centric, multi-location business.
