It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Job duties and responsibilities are subject to change based on changing business needs and conditions. Salary Min: $120,000 Salary Max: $160,000 This role is also eligible for Convene's annual incentive performance bonus plan. This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors. We’re Here For You: At Convene Hospitality Group, we want you to feel supported in every part of your life. Here’s what you can expect: Health & Wellness: Day-one health coverage for you and your family, 24/7 virtual care, emotional well-being support, and fertility & family planning benefits. Because your well-being matters, inside and outside of work. Time Off & Balance: Generous PTO, your birthday off (because, of course!), paid parental leave, and a year-end holiday closure to recharge. Financial Growth: 401K with company match and support for education, courses, and certifications. We invest in you so you can grow personally and professionally. Development & Recognition: Ongoing career growth opportunities plus recognition programs to celebrate milestones. Community & Impact: Volunteer and give-back opportunities, and the chance to make a real impact in the work you do. At Convene Hospitality Group, we believe great teams are built by bringing together people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Our values of GRIT (Genuine, Relentless, Integrity, and Teamwork) shape how we show up for each other every day. We want everyone here to feel welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. If you’re excited to grow, learn, and make an impact, we’d love to have you on the team. Convene Hospitality Group is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. #LI-DK1

jobs.title: Data Scientist Fellow, Bioinformatics and Image Analysis
jobs.jd: (ID: 2026-3886) Axle is a bioscience and information technology company that offers advancements in translational research, biomedical informatics, and data science applications to research centers and healthcare organizations nationally and abroad. With experts in biomedical science, software engineering, and program management, we focus on developing and applying research tools and techniques to empower decision-making and accelerate research discoveries. We work with some of the top research organizations and facilities in the country including multiple institutes at the National Institutes of Health (NIH). Benefits We Offer: 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage for Employees Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays 401K match up to 5% Educational Benefits for Career Growth Employee Referral Bonus Flexible Spending Accounts: Healthcare (FSA) Parking Reimbursement Account (PRK) Dependent Care Assistant Program (DCAP) Transportation Reimbursement Account (TRN) Position Overview The Postdoctoral Fellow will turn the data produced by the autonomous laboratory in Bethesda into results that the lab can act on. The platform runs biological experiments on the BAB400 robot, which comes with a Cytation 9 imaging system, and the main data stream is microscopy images. The Fellow will build and run the image analysis and bioinformatics pipelines that measure what happened in each experiment, combine those measurements with environmental monitoring data collected alongside the experiments, and return quantitative readouts to the autonomous loop so that it can decide what to run next. The Fellow will work side by side with the Laboratory Automation Engineer and with the biologists and data engineers of IDSS. This is a hybrid research position: the Fellow is expected to contribute new methods, publish, and present, in addition to keeping the analysis running reliably. Key Responsibilities Image analysis pipelines. Develop and maintain automated pipelines for Cytation 9 images, including quality control, illumination and background correction, segmentation, tracking, and feature extraction for cultures such as iPSC colonies and, later, organoids. Quantitative readouts for the loop. Define and validate metrics that describe culture state and growth (for example confluence, colony morphology, differentiation markers, and viability), with uncertainty estimates, so that they can be used as decision inputs by the autonomous system. Closing the loop. Work with the Laboratory Automation Engineer to deliver analysis results back to the workflow orchestration layer in a machine-readable form and on a timescale the loop can use. Define the interfaces, the failure behavior, and the checks that stop bad data from driving a bad decision. Environmental data integration. Collect, clean, and align environmental monitoring data (for example temperature, CO2, O2, humidity, and other sensor streams) with imaging results. Analyze how conditions relate to culture outcomes and flag drift, excursions, and sensor faults. Statistical and machine learning methods. Apply and develop statistical, machine learning, and deep learning methods for image and multimodal data, with attention to validation, reproducibility, and batch effects. Use the existing Cytation and instrument software where it helps, and build custom methods where it does not. Bioinformatics. Integrate downstream omics data, including single-cell data, generated from the experiments where they are available, and link them to image-derived phenotypes. Data management. Work with IDSS data engineers so that images, derived measurements, and metadata are stored, versioned, and findable in line with FAIR principles and NIH data management and sharing requirements. Research and communication. Publish methods and results, present to NIAID and collaborators, document pipelines and standard operating procedures, and train staff to use the analysis tools. Required Qualifications Education. Doctoral degree (PhD or equivalent) in bioinformatics, computational biology, biomedical engineering, computer science, physics, or a related quantitative field, normally completed within the last five years. Image analysis. Demonstrated experience analyzing microscopy or other biological image data, including segmentation and quantitative feature extraction. Programming. Strong Python, including scientific and imaging libraries (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit-image, or similar) and at least one machine learning framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar). Statistics and experimental design. Strong grounding in statistics and experimental design, and experience validating analysis methods. Reproducible practice. Experience with Git and reproducible analysis practices, and with working in a Linux or high-performance computing environment. Research record. A record of research output, such as peer-reviewed publications, preprints, or released software. Collaboration. Ability to work in a close, iterative partnership with an automation engineer and biologists, and to explain methods and results clearly to both. Clearance. Ability to obtain and maintain NIH/HHS security clearance and meet federal contractor suitability requirements. Preferred Qualifications Experience with high-content or live-cell imaging systems, especially Agilent BioTek Cytation or Gen5 software. Experience with image analysis tools such as CellProfiler, Cellpose, StarDist, napari, or ImageJ/Fiji, and with deep learning methods for segmentation and classification. Experience with stem cell, iPSC, organoid, or tissue culture systems and their imaging. Experience with time-series or multimodal analysis, including sensor and environmental monitoring data. Experience with self-driving laboratories, active learning, or Bayesian optimization. Experience with single-cell omics analysis (scRNA-seq) and with workflow tools such as Nextflow or Snakemake. Familiarity with laboratory orchestration software such as MADSci, and with Docker or Kubern etes. Experience with high-performance computing environments (for example NIH Biowulf). We are committed to building a best-in-class organization by empowering top talent with the resources, autonomy, and support needed to deliver results and advance their careers in a high-performance environment. Role Overview As a Bilingual Leasing & Sales Consultant, you’ll be the driving force behind occupancy and revenue at your community. This role goes beyond leasing apartments; it’s about selling a lifestyle and creating an experience that makes people proud to call Cortland “home.” You’ll combine proactive sales strategies with exceptional engagement to turn prospects into residents and keep your community thriving. Sales & Revenue Generation: Drive occupancy and revenue by achieving and exceeding leasing goals, conversion targets, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Actively manage your sales pipeline—follow up promptly, nurture potential residents, and close leases with confidence. Use consultative selling techniques to uncover needs, present solutions, and create value that resonates with each potential resident. Keep CRM records accurate and up to date for all potential resident interactions. Monitor and report on lead activity, conversion metrics, and pipeline health. Stay organized and disciplined to ensure timely follow-up and consistent engagement. Community Advocacy & Resident Experience: Guide potential residents through the leasing process with confidence and care, making it simple, stress-free, and enjoyable journey that reinforces our brand promise of better living. Deliver a concierge-level experience by anticipating needs, offering personalized solutions, and creating memorable interactions. Build lasting relationships that inspire loyalty and referrals through exceptional service. Represent the community as an ambassador, showcasing not just homes but a lifestyle of comfort, convenience, and premium living. Handle objections gracefully, turning challenges into opportunities. Establish, manage, and maintain marketing programs and social media presence to attract and retain residents. Plan and execute resident events and engagement programs that strengthen community ties. Adaptability & Continuous Improvement: Respond to coaching and feedback with agility; implement best practices promptly. Adjust sales approach based on market conditions, prospect needs, and leadership guidance. Professionalism & Brand Alignment: Maintain integrity, accountability, and reliability in all aspects of performance. Maintain a polished, approachable presence that reflects our premium brand standards in every interaction. Qualifications 6+ months of sales, customer-facing, or performance-driven experience preferred. Strong desire to succeed in a goal-oriented, fast-paced sales environment. Confident, persuasive, and people-focused with a natural ability to build rapport. Coachable and resilient, with a positive attitude and willingness to learn. Motivated by targets, results, and earning potential; comfortable being held to goals. Organized and disciplined with follow-up, time management, and attention to detail. jobs.title: Alliances & Partner Operations Associate, Corporate Legal Solutions
jobs.jd: Harbor is seeking an Alliances & Partner Operations Associate to support the growth and success of our strategic partnerships. Our Alliances team works with leading technology and service providers to bring innovative solutions to corporate legal departments and law firms. In this role, you will help coordinate partner activities, maintain and analyze business data, track opportunities, and support initiatives that strengthen Harbor's relationships with its partners. Working closely with colleagues across Sales, Marketing, and Delivery, you will gain valuable exposure to strategic partnerships, business operations, and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career professional who enjoys working with data, solving problems, organizing information, and collaborating with others. The ideal candidate is curious, detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to develop their skills in a fast-paced, professional services environment. This is a hybrid position working from our Chicago headquarters office with some remote flexibility. Key Responsibilities: As an Alliances & Partner Operations Associate, you will contribute to the success of our partnerships by: Supporting the day-to-day operations of Harbor's strategic partner programs, helping coordinate activities, track progress, and ensure timely follow-up on key initiatives. Maintaining accurate partner and opportunity information in Salesforce and other business systems, supporting reporting and visibility into partnership activities. Collecting, organizing, and analyzing data to help identify potential business opportunities, partner overlap, and areas for growth using tools such as Excel and Crossbeam. Assisting with business research, market analysis, and opportunity tracking to support partnership planning and decision-making. Coordinating partner meetings and business reviews, including scheduling, preparing agendas and presentation materials, documenting action items, and tracking next steps. Collaborating with Sales, Marketing, Delivery, and other internal teams to support partner-related projects and initiatives. Preparing reports, presentations, and summaries that communicate partnership activities, progress, and key insights. Supporting projects involving new technologies and AI-enabled solutions, helping track activities, milestones, and opportunities for adoption. Assisting with the coordination of interns and other team resources, as needed. Proactively identifying opportunities to improve processes, organize information, and help the team work more efficiently. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Analytics, or a related field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collect, organize, and interpret information. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including the ability to work with data and create professional presentations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines. A collaborative, team-oriented approach with the ability to work independently when needed. Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn new technologies, systems, and business processes. Permanent U.S. work authorization. Preferred Qualifications: Internship, project, or other relevant experience in business operations, consulting, sales, marketing, or a professional services environment. Familiarity with CRM systems such as Salesforce or data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Interest in strategic partnerships, business development, technology, or the legal services industry. Exposure to data analysis, business research, or project coordination through coursework, internships, or extracurricular activities. Ability to work onsite in Harbor's Chicago office is a plus. About Us: Harbor is the preeminent provider of expert services across strategy, legal technology, operations, and intelligence. Our globally integrated team of 900+ strategists, technologists, and specialists navigate alongside our clients – leading law firms, corporations, and their law departments – to provide essential resources and invaluable insights. Anchored in a rich heritage of deep knowledge, steadfast relationships, and mutual respect, our unwavering dedication lies in shaping the future of the legal industry and fostering enduring partnerships within our community and ecosystem. jobs.title: Analyst, Portfolio Management
jobs.jd: About General Atlantic General Atlantic is a leading global investor with more than four and a half decades of experience providing capital and strategic support for over 885 companies throughout its history. Established in 1980, General Atlantic continues to be a dedicated partner to visionary founders and investors seeking to build dynamic businesses and create lasting value. Guided by the conviction that entrepreneurs can be incredible agents of transformational change, the firm combines a collaborative global approach, sector specific expertise, a long-term investment horizon, and a deep understanding of growth drivers to partner with and scale innovative businesses around the world. The firm leverages its patient capital, operational expertise, and global platform to support a diversified investment platform spanning Growth Equity, Infrastructure, and Strategic Solutions. General Atlantic manages approximately $126 billion in assets under management, inclusive of all strategies, as of March 31, 2026, with more than 900 professionals in 20 countries across five regions. For more information on General Atlantic, please visit www.generalatlantic.com. Position Summary General Atlantic is looking to hire an Analyst to support the Portfolio Management team. This role is a two-year program (with the ability to extend, depending on performance and business need). The Portfolio Management team provides a senior-level analytics and risk management function at the firm, working closely with our senior leaders and investment team members, and partnering with our fundraising, finance operations, valuations, and capital markets teams. The Portfolio Management team leverages portfolio company data to identify risks and opportunities and assess the general health of our portfolio for the senior-level Portfolio Committee. The team also leverages this data for internal and external reporting, including directly with investors. This generalist role offers a broad view of GA’s 200+ portfolio companies and of the firm itself. The Analyst will partner with professionals across the firm while serving a vital role to the efficiency and effectiveness of the Portfolio Management team. Responsibilities Support the quarterly financial planning cycles across portfolio companies, consolidating information and providing analyses to leadership via Portfolio Committee meetings. Collaborate across the firm working with Investment, Capital Solutions, Marketing, Legal, Accounting, and Finance professionals. Collect, review, and analyze portfolio company-level data across GA’s 250+ portfolio companies. Analyze investment performance, returns, and key metrics to draw insights and conclusions at both the company and fund/portfolio levels. Leverage portfolio data to develop metrics, solve problems, and prepare materials for senior-level audiences influencing decision-making. Synthesize findings across the portfolio and macro data to deliver thoughtful analysis and actionable insights. Support the design and implementation of process improvement and new technology initiatives to drive scalable analysis and insight across the team and firm. Use AI tools in day-to-day work to automate analysis and reporting, and to speed up research and data synthesis. Identify and pilot new ways to apply AI to portfolio data and team workflows, and share what works with colleagues. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent work experience considered. At least 1 year of experience in the consulting, accounting, corporate finance, or banking industry. Strong understanding of financial statements – P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow (i.e., ability to interpret financial data and related management information). Ability to develop presentations leveraging creativity, thoughtful business judgment and problem solving. Experience working with multiple stakeholders, effective verbal and written communication skills, and ability to synthesize information. Excellent Microsoft Office skills, including Excel and PowerPoint. Self-motivated, with a demonstrated ability to own specific parts of projects and work independently with minimal supervision. Intellectually curious, resourceful, and team-oriented, with a collaborative approach to problem solving. Experience or exposure to planning and reporting or data visualization tools (e.g., PowerBI, iLevel) is a plus but not required. Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Glean, Copilot, or similar platforms) to improve analysis, automate work, and streamline workflows; candidates should be prepared to discuss specific examples. GA Value Competitive compensation Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans Retirement savings plan with employer matching Professional development opportunities and ongoing training Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for advancement General Atlantic offers a robust reward program to all employees that will support you and your family, maintaining fulfilling, secure and healthy lives now and into the future, which includes but is not limited to medical insurance, retirement savings contributions, mental and physical health resources and an equal pay program that allows you to earn a base salary of $100,000-$115,000 of which the exact amount offered will be driven by the degree to which you meet role requirements, additional special skills and experience. Additional reward programs, such as annual discretionary bonuses and long-term incentive programs, are available for eligible employees and are offered as recognition for performance and one’s contributions towards the organization’s success. jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst, Scientific Systems
jobs.jd: Imagine if you had the skills, knowledge, and teammates to both understand the root of the world’s most pressing problems and build the technologies and companies best positioned to solve them. RA Capital has done exactly that for more than two decades, backing bold ideas in medicines to further human health and now expanding into Planetary Health to improve how efficiently we utilize the world’s precious resources. RA Capital is among the leading providers of capital and services to the most promising innovators in the world. We invest flexibly—seed to IPO and beyond, anywhere in the world—with $10 B+ under management and a culture that prizes curiosity, rigor, and collaborative debate. We are investors who not only fund companies but get elbow deep in building them. From helping them recruit talent to helping them recruit patients for their studies to helping match them to strategic partners and even going to Washington to win reforms, RA Capital’s large team has people with nearly every relevant expertise one might need to turn an idea into a cure that actually helps people. If you live for first-principles problem-solving with great colleagues, thrive on complexity, and want to do meaningful work that ripples across industries and ecosystems, you’ll feel at home at RA Capital. Here, questions are welcomed, ideas are tested, and victories are shared. Even our lawyers are creative and engaging. And don’t get us started on our compliance team’s wicked sense of humor; nothing about what we do is boring. Are you ready to bring your creativity, discipline and collaborative spirit to help us invent the future? Join us and you’ll collaborate daily with investors, founders, physicians, biologists, engineers, economists, and reform advocates who think in systems and act with urgency. Join us to invent a happier, healthier, more productive future - and have fun doing it. Role Overview RA Capital is seeking a Business Systems Analyst, Scientific & Venture Systems to support our Raven and Venture teams. Reporting to the Technology Business Partner, Raven and Venture, you will work with scientists, company builders, and business stakeholders to translate research and operational workflows into practical technology solutions. This hands-on role combines business analysis, scientific platform administration, and software implementation. You will configure and administer scientific systems, develop programmatic integrations, and automate workflows, owning solutions from discovery through deployment and ongoing support. The ideal candidate combines scientific or clinical workflow knowledge with practical technical skills, learns quickly, and enjoys a broad mix of scientific platform work, business process improvement, and day-to-day systems support. Key Responsibilities Partner with scientists and business stakeholders to map current and future workflows, gather requirements, and translate needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, technical specifications, and system configurations. Administer business and scientific systems, including CDD Vault (LIMS/ELN), managing configurations, permissions, templates, access, and ongoing maintenance. Configure and maintain registration tables and workflows supporting compound registration, sample management, and reagent management. Develop and maintain scripts and API integrations to connect systems and automate workflows; use SQL to query and validate data. Deploy and manage Notion Teamspaces, project templates, and integrations supporting RAven projects through incorporation. Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery while independently reviewing, testing, and validating generated code and recommendations. Support vendor evaluation and implementation, coordinate technical partners, and troubleshoot issues across the systems you configure and support. Plan and conduct system and user acceptance testing, maintain documentation and user guides, and train users through rollout and adoption. Manage smaller projects and workstreams, communicating scope, milestones, dependencies, and risks while identifying opportunities for ongoing improvement. Key Requirements Bachelor’s degree in biology, chemistry, bioengineering, computer science, or a related scientific or technical field. 2–5 years of experience in solutions engineering, scientific software implementation, business systems analysis, or a related role, ideally with a life sciences software provider or within a biotech organization. Hands-on experience supporting, configuring, and administering scientific or clinical data management platforms (e.g. LIMS, Electronic Data Capture (EDC)), in life sciences, biotech, or health tech. Practical programming experience, including the ability to independently read, write, debug, test, and validate code and work with REST APIs. Foundational SQL skills, including joins, parameterized queries, and data validation. Ability to evaluate and troubleshoot AI-generated code using independent programming knowledge and judgment. Experience working directly with scientific/clinical users or customers to learn research workflows quickly and translate their needs into technical solutions. Strong requirements-gathering, process mapping, and documentation skills, with close attention to detail. Clear communication with technical and non-technical colleagues, sound judgment, and a willingness to raise questions and collaborate when requirements or solutions are uncertain. Ability to work on a hybrid schedule in our Boston office. Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future. We cannot provide visa sponsorship, visa transfers, or sponsorship for practical training programs. Preferred Qualifications Direct administration or implementation experience with CDD Vault, Benchling, Revvity Signals, or similar scientific platforms. Experience implementing software across multiple customers, research teams, or organizations. Experience configuring Notion workspaces, teamspaces, templates, integrations, and automations. Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or Codex, or integration and automation platforms. Working knowledge of data platforms or cloud environments such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS or GCP. Familiarity with collaboration and project management tools such as Confluence, Smartsheet, or Jira, and exposure to Agile ways of working. Compensation RA Capital Management is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Pay for this position will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, and current market conditions. In addition to base salary (listed below), employees may be eligible for performance-based bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, retirement contributions, and paid time off. Total Rewards We take pride in offering a comprehensive employee benefits program as a key part of overall compensation. Our Total Rewards include: Employer-paid monthly premiums for health, dental, and vision coverage Wellness benefits and programs to support physical and mental well-being Resources and perks that enhance work-life balance and financial security We’re dedicated to helping our employees thrive professionally and personally. Massachusetts base pay range $90,000 — $150,000 USD ​RA Capital is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. jobs.title: Pricing Analyst (Remote)
jobs.jd: Who is Trace3 ? Trace3 is a leading Transformative IT Authority, providing unique technology solutions and consulting services to our clients. Equipped with elite engineering and dynamic innovation, we empower IT executives and their organizations to achieve competitive advantage through a process of Integrate, Automate, Innovate. Our culture at Trace3 embodies the spirit of a startup with the advantage of a scalable business. Employees can grow their career and have fun while doing it! Trace3 is headquartered in Irvine, California. We employ more than 1,200 people all over the United States. Our major field office locations include Denver, Indianapolis, Grand Rapids, Lexington, Los Angeles, Louisville, Texas, San Francisco. Ready to discover the possibilities that live in technology? Come Join Us! Street-Smart - Thriving in Dynamic Times We are flexible and resilient in a fast-changing environment. We continuously innovate and drive constructive change while keeping a focus on the “big picture.” We exercise sound business judgment in making high-quality decisions in a timely and cost-effective manner. We are highly creative and can dig deep within ourselves to find positive solutions to different problems. Juice - The “Stuff” it takes to be a Needle Mover We get things done and drive results. We lead without a title, empowering others through a can-do attitude. We look forward to the goal, mentally mapping out every checkpoint on the pathway to success, and visualizing what the final destination looks and feels like. Teamwork - Humble, Hungry and Smart We are humble individuals who understand how our job impacts the company's mission. We treat others with respect, admit mistakes, give credit where it’s due and demonstrate transparency. We “bring the weather” by exhibiting positive leadership and solution-focused thinking. We hug people in their trials, struggles, and failures – not just their success. We appreciate the individuality of the people around us. ABOUT THE ROLE: Trace3 is building a centralized Pricing Operations function focused on improving deal-level margin performance, enabling smarter pricing decisions, and creating a better seller experience. This is a hands-on, consultative role. The Pricing Analyst will review deals, analyze pricing and profitability data, and provide recommendations that help sellers build competitive and profitable customer solutions. The role will identify opportunities for margin improvement, evaluate pricing trends, support complex sales opportunities, and help translate business insights into actionable recommendations. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills with business judgment, attention to detail, and a service-oriented mindset. The Pricing Analyst should be viewed by sellers as a trusted advisor who helps improve deal outcomes, increase profitability, and accelerate deal execution. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Pricing Guidance, Deal Support, and Profitability Analysis Provide pricing analysis, commercial recommendations, and deal guidance to improve competitiveness and profitability. Review business data, historical transactions, pricing exceptions, and deal outcomes to identify margin opportunities and performance trends. Support complex or non-standard opportunities by evaluating options and partnering with stakeholders to inform decisions. Translate analysis into actionable recommendations, leadership reporting, and business reviews. Promote adoption of pricing tools, processes, and best practices across the sales organization. Document outcomes and key learnings to improve pricing consistency and effectiveness. Continuous Improvement and Cross-Functional Partnership Partner with Sales, Finance, Operations, Procurement, Partner Management, and other stakeholders to support pricing initiatives and commercial decision-making. Identify opportunities to improve pricing processes, tools, reporting, and seller experience. Maintain documentation, standards, and best practices related to pricing operations activities. Support testing, validation, and implementation of enhancements to pricing processes and tools. Contribute to the ongoing development of a scalable Pricing Operations function. QUALIFICATIONS & INTERESTS: 3-5 years of experience in pricing, deal desk, sales operations, commercial finance, revenue operations, financial analysis, or a related analytical discipline. Demonstrated ability to analyze pricing, profitability, discounting, cost structures, margin performance, or commercial transactions. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations. Understanding of gross profit, margins, pricing strategy, discounting practices, rebates, incentives, and overall deal economics. jobs.jd:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. Our product teams work across research, engineering, product, data, and design to bring OpenAI’s technology to people and businesses around the world.

Design plays a critical role in making powerful AI intuitive, useful, and trustworthy. We hold a high bar for quality and build experiences that earn users’ confidence, while moving quickly and learning from real-world feedback. We favor early validation and continuous refinement over waiting until every detail is perfect.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Designer to shape how startups, small businesses, and growing teams discover, adopt, and unlock lasting value from ChatGPT. You’ll own growth experiences across the customer journey, turning the potential of AI into meaningful, everyday impact for people across the world.

This is a highly hands-on role for a designer who pairs exceptional craft with strong product judgment and an experimental mindset. You’ll tackle some of our most interesting growth challenges, using creativity, product intuition, and experimentation to discover new opportunities. We’re looking for someone who loves treating metrics as puzzles to solve, finding unexpected solutions, and learning quickly through iteration.

Above all, you bring exceptional design craft and believe that driving measurable impact and building beautiful, intuitive experiences should go hand in hand.

This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Own end-to-end design for growth experiences across ChatGPT

 - Design and improve experiences across user lifecycle stages like discovery, onboarding, activation, engagement, collaboration, conversion, and retention.

 - Turn ambiguous opportunities into clear hypotheses, compelling prototypes, and polished product experiences.

 - Set a high bar for interaction design, visual craft, systems thinking, content, and end-to-end coherence.

 - Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, research, and go-to-market teams to shape both strategy and execution.

 - Use quantitative data, experimentation, research, and qualitative insights to identify opportunities and evaluate outcomes.

 - Translate complex and rapidly evolving AI capabilities into approachable experiences for people with a wide range of technical expertise.

 - Move fluidly between longer-term product vision and fast, iterative execution.

 - Contribute reusable patterns and insights that strengthen growth experiences across ChatGPT.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a portfolio demonstrating exceptional product thinking, interaction design, and visual craft across complex, shipped products.

 - Have led substantial product initiatives from early exploration through launch and iteration.

 - Possess strong product judgment and can connect user needs, business goals, technical possibilities, and measurable outcomes.

 - Are comfortable working with data and experiments while balancing quantitative signals with research, intuition, and design judgment.

 - Can move quickly without compromising clarity, coherence, trust, or craft.

 - Are fluent in using AI to explore, prototype, communicate, and extend what you can build.

 - Can turn ambiguous, fast-moving problems into a clear point of view and actionable product direction.

 - Communicate through strong narratives and prototypes that align cross-functional teams.

 - Are excited to rethink established growth patterns and invent interactions that feel native to AI.

 - Care deeply about building products that are useful, trustworthy, and worthy of users’ time.

Direct experience in growth design or developer products is helpful but not required. We’re most interested in designers with strong product judgment, exceptional craft, and evidence that their work meaningfully changed user behavior or business outcomes.

jobs.jd:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


ROLE OVERVIEW:

We're growing our Canadian Public Sector Delivery team and hiring Public Sector Delivery Analysts to help run some of the most consequential AI deployments in the country. You'll work alongside our Engineering Program Managers (EPMs), Technical Leads, and senior leadership to keep large, multi-stakeholder government programs organized, documented, and moving.

This is a hands-on delivery role for individuals who want exposure to enterprise AI and high-stakes program delivery while taking pride in making complex programs run smoothly. As a member of our small, senior team, you'll deliver sovereign AI to the Government of Canada, engage directly with clients from day one on a clear path toward leading engagements, and learn how frontier AI products are deployed in real, high-security environments.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Drive things to closure. Partner with the EPM and Technical Leads to track actions, dependencies, and blockers across Cohere and client teams making sure nothing slips.

 - Show up in front of the client. Prepare and coordinate client sessions, capture outcomes, and progressively lead working-level sessions such as use-case and story refinement.

 - Run the cadence. Own the meeting and reporting rhythm including agendas, scheduling, minutes, and follow-ups so every forum lands on time with clear next steps.

 - Own the delivery artefacts. Build and maintain the plans, status reports, RAID logs, decision records, use-case registers, and traceability documentation that keep our engagements audit-ready and our clients confident.

 - Keep the record straight. Maintain a single source of truth for program documentation in our public sector document management environment.
   


QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 1–4 years of experience in technology or management consulting, professional services, or an in-house technical delivery team.

 - Delivery discipline. You've run RAID, action, and decision logs, refined user stories, maintained project plans on real projects and kept them accurate and clear.

 - Client presence. You can lead a working session in front of a client, read the room, and know what to say and what to hold.

 - Strong written communication. You think through the message before you build the slide. Advanced PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.

 - Technical fluency. You're comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, environments, testing, and releases. You can talk with engineers and report back accurately.

 - Follow-through. You close items without a second reminder and know what to escalate and when.

 - Eligibility for a Government of Canada security clearance.

 - Based in the Ottawa area.

 - University Degree in Business/Commerce, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or similar preferred.

 - Nice-to-have: High degree of French language proficiency.
   


WORKING LOCATION:

This role is hybrid with the requirement to be based out of Ottawa - note, there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement.

This role requires eligibility for a Government of Canada security clearance and a high degree of French language proficiency is a nice-to-have.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

WHAT WE OFFER

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Global Onboarding & Enablement Operations Program Manager at ElevenLabs, you’ll help keep our global GTM onboarding and enablement programmes running smoothly as we grow. You’ll lead the day-to-day delivery of onboarding, making sure every new GTM hire gets a consistent, engaging start, while building the structure and processes that help the wider Enablement team work more effectively and scale its impact.

You’ll bring structure to how we plan, deliver and measure enablement, from tracking OKRs and roadmaps to coordinating the enablement calendar, launches and certifications.  - Measure programme performance: Maintain dashboards and reporting on onboarding, certifications, ramp metrics and team OKRs. Use the data to highlight progress, identify gaps and help the team understand where to focus.

 - Own Enablement operations: Run OKR and roadmap tracking, the enablement  calendar, and the team’s operating rhythms (planning, check-ins and reviews). Track dependencies across RevOps, Product Marketing, People and Product, flag risks early, and keep clear ownership, timelines and follow-through on every workstream.

Bonus

jobs.title: Technical Research Assistant I
jobs.jd: Site: The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc. Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham. Job Summary Join the Santagata Lab at Brigham and Women’s Hospital (BWH) as a Technical Research Assistant I working on a multidisciplinary program to develop new targeted therapies for rare pediatric and adult brain tumors. We are seeking a talented and highly motivated individual to help identify and validate therapeutically actionable cell-surface proteins in rare brain cancers, with particular emphasis on targets for antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) and other emerging targeted therapies. The position is supported by a Department of Defense research program focused on overcoming the major challenges posed by rare brain tumors: limited tissue availability, biological heterogeneity, and the lack of effective targeted treatments. The successful candidate will work with advanced tissue-imaging and spatial molecular technologies to quantitatively characterize therapeutic targets in patient tumor specimens and patient-derived models. Major approaches include cyclic immunofluorescence (CyCIF), ORION whole-slide multiplexed imaging, conventional immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence, and integration with spatial transcriptomic data. The research program spans rare pediatric and adult brain tumors, including ependymoma, craniopharyngioma, atypical teratoid/rhabdoid tumor, pediatric high-grade glioma, rare meningiomas, embryonal tumors, and other molecularly defined tumors. A major goal is to determine whether drugs developed for more common cancers can be repurposed for rare brain tumors based on quantitative measurement of therapeutic target expression. You will be based in Dr. Sandro Santagata’s laboratory at BWH and work closely with investigators at Harvard Medical School’s Laboratory of Systems Pharmacology, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, Boston Children’s Hospital, and collaborating laboratories. The project brings together neuropathologists, cancer biologists, chemists, imaging scientists, computational biologists, and neuro-oncologists. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career scientist interested in translational cancer research, molecular imaging, biological chemistry, quantitative pathology, and therapeutic development. The position provides extensive hands-on experience with high-dimensional tissue imaging, antibody qualification, assay development, image analysis, and integration of molecular and morphologic data from human tumors. Qualifications PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES : Develop a spatial molecular atlas of therapeutic targets in rare pediatric and adult brain tumors by generating, organizing, and quantitatively analyzing multiplexed tissue-imaging data across tumor types, cases, and histologic regions. Perform multiplexed tissue-imaging experiments using CyCIF, ORION, immunofluorescence, and related methods to quantitatively characterize cell-surface therapeutic targets in rare pediatric and adult brain tumors. Develop and qualify antibodies against therapeutic targets, including established and emerging ADC targets. Compare antibody clones and optimize staining conditions with attention to specificity, cellular localization, signal-to-background ratio, dynamic range, and reproducibility. Design and optimize multiplex antibody panels incorporating therapeutic targets together with tumor-lineage, proliferation, immune, vascular, and cell-state markers. Prepare and analyze human FFPE tissue specimens, tissue microarrays, and patient-derived tumor models while using tissue-sparing experimental strategies appropriate for scarce clinical samples. Perform quantitative analysis of whole-slide multiplexed images, including image quality control, single-cell segmentation and quantification, evaluation of target-expression heterogeneity, and visualization of spatial patterns. Integrate protein-imaging results with complementary molecular datasets, including spatial transcriptomic data, to identify and prioritize candidate therapeutic targets. Assist with studies comparing patient tumors with patient-derived cell lines and xenograft models to identify models that preserve clinically relevant therapeutic-target expression. Support development of standardized ORION multiplexed imaging assays designed to measure multiple therapeutic targets from a single tissue section and facilitate future clinical-trial and diagnostic applications. Maintain detailed experimental records and organized research datasets, including antibody-validation results, imaging experiments, sample metadata, and quality-control information. Troubleshoot and optimize experimental protocols and contribute ideas for improving assay performance, reproducibility, throughput, and tissue utilization. Prepare figures and datasets and contribute to scientific presentations, manuscripts, and collaborative project reports. Present work at laboratory and multidisciplinary project meetings and participate actively in discussions of experimental results and next steps. Support routine laboratory activities, including reagent preparation, ordering, equipment maintenance, sample organization, and adherence to laboratory safety procedures. Work collaboratively with scientists, physicians, computational researchers, and other research staff across BWH, HMS, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, Boston Children’s Hospital, and collaborating institutions. Additional Job Details (if applicable) QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s degree in biology, biochemistry, biological chemistry, chemical biology, biomedical engineering, biophysics, computational biology, bioinformatics, or a related biomedical or quantitative field. Demonstrated interest in biomedical research, cancer biology, molecular measurement, tissue imaging, or quantitative analysis of biological data. Prior laboratory research experience, particularly involving microscopy, immunofluorescence, molecular or biochemical assays, or quantitative data analysis, is preferred. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, including the ability to work with complex sample sets and contribute to development of well-annotated research datasets. Willingness to commit to approximately two years in the position and grow within a collaborative, multidisciplinary research environment is strongly preferred. SKILLS/ ABILITIES/ COMPETENCIES REQUIRED : Ability to perform reproducible experiments and maintain well-organized experimental records. Experience with or strong interest in immunofluorescence, immunohistochemistry, microscopy, protein biochemistry, molecular biology, or related experimental methods. Understanding of basic protein biochemistry and molecular interactions, including antibody–antigen binding, is desirable. Interest in quantitative analysis of biological data and willingness to learn image-analysis and computational tools. Familiarity with ImageJ/Fiji, Python, R, MATLAB, or related quantitative tools is desirable but not required. Ability to learn and troubleshoot technically sophisticated experimental workflows. Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary research environment. Intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for connecting experimental observations with questions in cancer biology and therapeutic development. Remote Type Onsite Work Location 60 Fenwood Road Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Employee Type Regular Work Shift Day (United States of America) Pay Range $21.00 - $29.01/Hourly Grade 5 At Mass G

You’ll also partner with colleagues across Compliance, Operations, and business teams to gather information and support timely alert resolution. Research individuals, entities, vessels, geographies, and transactions to determine whether alerts are true matches, false positives, or require escalation. Escalate potential true matches, complex scenarios, and policy exceptions to senior analysts or management in line with established procedures. jobs.title: Dynamic Systems and Servo Analysis Researcher
jobs.jd: Introduction to the Job As a Dynamic Systems and Servo Analysis Researcher , you will help advance precision-motion technologies used in ASML’s lithography systems. You will model structural dynamics, servo behavior, and multidisciplinary system performance to evaluate emerging concepts and guide technology-development decisions. Working within Mechanical Development, you will connect mechanical, electrical, actuator, sensor, and control-system behavior through modeling and simulation. Your analysis will help researchers understand performance limits, manage technical risks, and identify promising technology directions. As a Dynamic Systems and Servo Analysis Researcher , you will also help strengthen modeling methods and reusable research capabilities across ASML. Role and Responsibilities You will lead focused modeling and analysis activities for advanced precision-motion and mechatronic systems. You will determine the right modeling approach for each research question and translate complex results into practical technical recommendations. Develop dynamic, finite element, reduced-order, and system-level models for precision-motion systems. Integrate structural models with actuators, sensors, drive electronics, control loops, disturbances, and representative motion profiles. Analyze structural modes, dynamic stiffness, compliance, frequency response, motion accuracy, control bandwidth, settling behavior, stability, and disturbance sensitivity. Identify dominant performance drivers, coupling mechanisms, sensitivities, technical risks, and system-level limitations. Select appropriate modeling fidelity and clearly document assumptions, boundary conditions, uncertainties, limitations, and analysis methods. Validate model predictions using engineering calculations, sensitivity studies, benchmarks, and experimental or system-level measurement data when available. Communicate findings and technically defensible recommendations to researchers, engineers, system architects, and technical leadership. Education and Experience Master’s degree or doctorate in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Applied Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical discipline. Significant professional or research experience in structural dynamics, control systems, precision mechatronics, or integrated system simulation. Experience applying modeling and simulation to complex multidisciplinary engineering systems. Experience with finite element analysis and tools such as ANSYS, Siemens NX, COMSOL Multiphysics, MSC NASTRAN, or comparable platforms. Experience with MATLAB and Simulink, Python, or comparable modeling and data-analysis environments. Experience generating or using reduced-order and state-space models is highly relevant. Experience supporting early-stage technology development, feasibility studies, or advanced engineering research is preferred. Skills Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems. To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills: Apply strong knowledge of structural dynamics, vibration analysis, feedback control, finite element methods, and numerical modeling. Analyze flexible structures interacting with closed-loop control systems. Translate physical architectures into consistent mechanical, electrical, and control-system models. Evaluate bandwidth, stability, servo error, disturbance rejection, settling performance, and actuator or sensor limitations. Correlate simulations with measurements and use data to improve model accuracy and credibility. Use MATLAB, Simulink, Python, or similar environments for modeling, automation, optimization, visualization, and data analysis. Approach open-ended research questions analytically and translate them into structured analysis plans. Collaborate effectively across mechanical, electrical, mechatronics, controls, research, and systems-engineering disciplines. Communicate assumptions, uncertainty, technical tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to diverse technical audiences. Share models, methods, and lessons learned to strengthen reusable research capabilities. Other Information Desired Technical Background · Precision motion systems, mechatronics, robotics, semiconductor equipment, aerospace systems, scientific instrumentation, or comparable high-performance equipment. · Dynamic modeling of flexible structures within closed-loop control systems. · Model-order reduction and state-space realization techniques. · Frequency-domain and time-domain simulation of servo-controlled systems. · Electromechanical plant modeling and analysis under demanding acceleration, scanning, settling, and disturbance conditions. · Experience with unconventional analysis methods, automated model generation, optimization, or AI-assisted engineering workflows is beneficial. Behavioral & Leadership Skills Drives Results: Turns research questions into clear analysis plans, decision criteria, and technical recommendations. Manages Complexity: Integrates models and information from multiple disciplines to identify the dominant system-level effects. Decision Quality: Uses physics, simulation evidence, sensitivity analysis, and uncertainty awareness to support sound technical decisions. Collaborates: Works effectively with researchers, analysts, mechanical engineers, electrical engineers, mechatronics engineers, and controls engineers. Communicates Effectively: Explains model assumptions, findings, limitations, and implications clearly to technical and multidisciplinary audiences. Cultivates Innovation: Explores unconventional analytical approaches and applies new methods where they improve research speed or decision quality. Other This position is located on-site and requires on-site presence for in-person collaboration, laboratory activities, training, and meetings. Flexible workplace arrangements may be available in accordance with applicable company policy. Domestic or international travel may be required based on business needs. The role may require access to controlled technology and compliance with applicable export-control requirements. jobs.title: Faculty Position in Youth Firearm Violence Prevention Research
jobs.jd: Position Summary: The Department of Pediatrics and the Comprehensive Injury Center at the Medical College of Wisconsin (MCW), a CDC-funded Injury Control Research Center, seeks a faculty member to join a growing, interdisciplinary team dedicated to preventing firearm violence among youth. This position will be housed in the Department of Pediatrics, Division of Emergency Medicine at the MCW and Children's Wisconsin. We welcome candidates from a broad range of disciplinary backgrounds who demonstrate strong evidence of, or clear promise toward, an independent research career in youth firearm violence prevention. Relevant areas of focus include, but are not limited to: community violence intervention, hospital-based violence intervention programs (HVIPs), program and policy evaluation, epidemiologic research, clinical outcomes research, health services research, and implementation science and can include quantitative, qualitative, or mixed methods approaches. Appointment will be made at the Assistant or Associate Professor level, commensurate with the candidate's experience and research portfolio. Candidates will be appointed to a full-time research position. Position Highlights: Develop and lead an independent, extramurally fundable program of research in youth firearm violence prevention. Contribute to the scientific mission of the Comprehensive Injury Center, including its CDC Injury Control Research Center core activities. Collaborate with Center investigators, community-based organizations, hospital violence intervention programs, and local/regional/national partners on collaborative and multi-site research. Pursue extramural funding (e.g., NIH, CDC, foundation, and other federal or private sponsors) to support research activities. Publish findings in peer-reviewed journals and disseminate results to scientific, clinical, community, and policy audiences. Mentor trainees, students, and junior investigators engaged in injury and violence prevention research. Participate in Center and Department activities, including seminars, committees, and community engagement initiatives. Within the Injury Center, participate in research leadership activities in at least one of the divisions that focuses on youth firearm injury prevention (e.g., Division of Community Safety, Division of Suicide Research & Healing, Division of Data Analytics and Informatics). Center/ Department Highlights: The Comprehensive Injury Center (CIC) at the Medical College of Wisconsin is one of a select group of Injury Control Research Centers funded by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). The Center brings together investigators from pediatrics, surgery, emergency medicine, public health, and the social sciences to conduct rigorous research and translate findings into practice and policy that reduce injury and violence, with a particular focus on firearm injury prevention among children, adolescents, and young adults. The CIC partners closely with other departments and institutes at MCW, Children's Wisconsin, Froedtert Hospital, city/county health and human services departments, government and community-based violence prevention and intervention programs, and regional and national collaborators. The Department of Pediatrics at the Medical College of Wisconsin, in partnership with Children's Wisconsin, is one of the nation's leading academic pediatric programs, offering a robust research infrastructure, a large and diverse patient population, and extensive opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration. The Division of Emergency Medicine has a strong history of faculty focused on violence and injury prevention and control. MCW is a major academic health center located in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, with a strong institutional commitment to injury and violence prevention research and community engagement. Qualifications Required: Doctoral-level degree (e.g., PhD, DrPH, MD, DO, PsyD, ScD, or equivalent) in a relevant clinical, public health, social science, or biomedical discipline. Demonstrated interest and evidence of promise or productivity in research related to youth firearm violence prevention, community violence intervention, hospital-based violence prevention, injury epidemiology, program evaluation, or a closely related area. jobs.title: LN Concerts, Social Insights Analyst
jobs.jd: Job Summary: WHO ARE WE? Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com . WHO ARE YOU? Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! THE JOB The Social Insights Analyst will play a key role in Live Nation Entertainment’s Concert division, living and breathing in social listening, reporting and analytics from start to finish, including query building, dashboard development and delivering reports. This role will uncover insights and trends for actionable storytelling opportunities, guide marketing strategy, and inform cross-functional partners on social, cultural, and influencer trends. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Analytics & Strategy, this position is ideal for someone who thrives in building scalable analytics systems while staying deeply connected to cultural and platform trends and developments. We're looking for a data-minded storyteller who lives at the intersection of social media and analytics. You'll own reporting and measurement for earned conversation tied to tours, on-sales, and artist activations. This is a great fit for someone who's equally comfortable in a spreadsheet and a comment section. WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO Own measurement and analysis of earned social conversation: mentions, share of voice, sentiment, engagement on non-owned posts, organic reach, and virality across Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, and emerging platforms. Run social listening across tour cycles (from announcements, on-sales to live moments), tracking fan sentiment, conversation volume, and flagging shifts in real time. Measure fan- and creator-generated content (UGC): what's made, how it spreads, which moments drive organic amplification, and how artists, media, and fan accounts pick it up. Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports (daily, weekly, campaign-level, ad-hoc, and post-mortem), using Boolean logic to sharpen queries and insights delivery. Run competitive and benchmark analysis to contextualize our performance. Build alert systems for emerging artist topics, trends, and brand risks, supporting Community Management, Marketing, and PR/Comms in shaping response messaging. Partner with social listening-tool vendors and cross-functional teams to improve benchmarks, KPIs, alerts, and depth of insight. Uncover fan insights through audience demographics to help guide campaign planning WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING 2–4 years in social media analytics, social listening, and/or digital insights with a focus on earned measurement (agency or in-house social team preferred). Hands-on experience with social listening and publishing tools (Meltwater, Brandwatch, Sprout, Quid, etc.) plus platform-native analytics. Comfortable with audience demographic tools such as Audiense as well as platform follower demographics through CreatorIQ. Fluency in earned-social metrics (share of voice, sentiment, mention volume) and a clear sense of which ones actually matter. Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and a solid grasp of Boolean logic for query development. Proven ability to own analytics end-to-end (query design, reporting, dashboard development and maintenance), with a track record of spotting and fixing gaps in reporting infrastructure. Deep understanding of social platforms as both a fan and an analyst: how conversation forms, why things spread, what fans respond to, plus genuine curiosity about cultural trends, emerging formats, and creator marketing. Strong communication skills: you can turn a spike in conversation into a one-slide "so what" for non-technical stakeholders. Detail-oriented, organized, and able to juggle multiple projects and deadlines under pressure. A proactive, collaborative team player who flags insights before they're asked for and adapts to evolving leadership needs. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Analytics, or a related field. NICE TO HAVE: Passion for live music, touring, and artist marketing. Experience with sentiment analysis, text/topic classification, or unstructured conversation data. Familiarity with creator/influencer earned-coverage measurement. Experience connecting earned social signals to broader marketing or fan-growth outcomes. jobs.jd: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 09 The Team: The S&P Global Energy Power and Renewables research team, part of S&P Global Energy CERA, delivers market-leading research and analysis across global power and renewable energy markets. The team provides market outlooks, quantitative analysis, power price forecasts, and insights into policy, market mechanisms, and renewable energy procurement. Responsibilities and Impacts: The Southeast Asia Power and Renewables research team helps clients navigate the region’s rapidly changing power markets. Your analysis will strengthen our market outlooks and provide clients with clear, actionable insights to support strategic and investment decisions. This role will be instrumental in advancing our Southeast Asia Power and Renewables research and analysis capabilities, providing forward-looking market analysis and delivering impactful insights to clients through comprehensive written reports, advanced analytics and direct client engagement. Analyze power demand and supply through data collection, modeling and quantitative analysis to create critical insights on market trends, policy direction and company-level strategies. Conduct in-depth market and data research on power and renewable energy project transactions and tenders. Support the development of PLEXOS-based power market models for Southeast Asia, covering long-term capacity expansion, dispatch simulation, and power price forecasting. Translate model outputs into clear quantitative analysis and market insights that support the Southeast Asia research agenda. Work with other teams to develop long-term outlooks for power demand, supply, prices, and the cost of power and renewables. Demonstrated experience in data analytics, databases, data transformation, statistical analysis, or related quantitative disciplines , with strong attention to data quality and accuracy. Hands-on experience building and running power market models using PLEXOS or comparable modelling tools is an advantage. Strong quantitative and analytical skills , with the ability to interpret model outputs and translate complex data into clear, actionable market insights. Collaborative and detail-oriented , with strong ownership of documentation and delivery timelines, and the ability to work effectively with research analysts and stakeholders across different markets and time zones. Apply statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and model building and testing to reveal meaningful patterns in cyber and network data. Use data queries, dashboards, and visualizations to support customer analytic requests and present findings in live, interactive briefings. Support cyber teams using the Threat Awareness Sharing Capability (TASC) applications and mission data platforms such as JCRS-D. Partner with customers to identify cyber-operations requirements, operational gaps, use cases, and opportunities for improved data enrichment. Assess existing and proposed cyber data feeds for relevance, usability, completeness, and quality; document findings and deliverables. Use cyber-hunt methods, detection content, and emerging threat intelligence to support threat identification and awareness. Assist customer users with threat-hunting workflows, platform demonstrations, hands-on training, and timely operational support. Help translate repeatable threat-hunting methods and analytic processes into automated mission capabilities. This position requires work at a customer site in Fort Meade, MD, five days (40 hours) per week. Travel may be required within the United States and internationally. What You Must Have U.S. citizenship and a current, active U.S. Government TS/SCI security clearance, with the ability to maintain that clearance. At least 9 years of relevant cyber-security operations experience with a bachelor's degree in information technology, cybersecurity, or a related field; 7 years with a related master's degree; or 13 years with a high-school diploma or equivalent. Experience supporting U.S. defense cyber-mission customers and presenting analysis to audiences with varied levels of technical knowledge. Proficiency with SQL and Kusto Query Language (KQL), plus experience using Python for analysis. Experience with dashboards and data visualization tools such as Power BI or Superset, and familiarity with cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Knowledge of cyber-hunt methodologies; SIEM tools such as Splunk, QRadar, or ELK; and SOAR tools such as Sentinel, Cortex, or XSOAR. Experience developing or deploying threat-detection signatures, using cyber-defense sources such as CVE and OSINT, and interpreting detection content such as SNORT, SIGMA, YARA, or YAML. Experience with network-traffic analysis tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, or Zeek; MITRE ATT&CK; incident-response methods; and IDS/IPS technologies. Strong customer communication, public-presentation, writing, documentation, and user-training skills; ability to work independently and collaboratively. Ability to meet the required five-day onsite schedule at a customer site in Fort Meade and travel up to 40% of the time, domestically and internationally. Familiarity with mission Big Data Platforms, data lakes, or related architectures. Experience using Jupyter notebooks in cyber-data analysis. THE ROLE Terrana Biosciences is building a new generation of RNA-based technologies to transform agriculture. We are seeking a Research Associate I to join our IVT Production team and support the generation of high-quality RNA materials that enable discovery, platform development, and product advancement across the company. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Execute DNA assembly and molecular cloning workflows to generate constructs supporting research and RNA production. Perform bacterial transformation, colony screening, plasmid preparation, and sequence verification to identify and confirm successful constructs. Execute in vitro transcription (IVT) workflows to produce RNA supporting research and development programs. Perform RNA synthesis, purification, quantification, and quality control using established laboratory methods. Prepare DNA templates, reagents, and materials required for IVT production workflows. Conduct routine molecular biology techniques including PCR, gel electrophoresis, and nucleic acid quantification. Maintain accurate experimental records and track samples using electronic laboratory systems. Support high-throughput RNA production operations while ensuring quality, reproducibility, and timely delivery. Contribute to workflow optimization, process improvements, and laboratory organization. Collaborate with Molecular Biology, Discovery, Sequencing, and Bioinformatics teams to support project objectives. PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS Required B.S. or M.S. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Genetics, or a related field. RA I: B.S. Degree and up to 2 years of relevant laboratory experience in academic or industry settings RA II: B.S. Degree and 2–4 years or M.S. and up to 2 years of relevant laboratory experience in academic or industry settings Experience with basic molecular biology techniques, including PCR, nucleic acid handling, and gel electrophoresis. Strong attention to detail, organization, and record-keeping skills. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. Preferred Experience with RNA handling, in vitro transcription, or nucleic acid purification workflows. Familiarity with high-throughput laboratory operations, automation platforms, or LIMS systems. Experience in synthetic biology, RNA biology, or agricultural biotechnology. Location: Cambridge, MA ABOUT FLAGSHIP PIONEERING: Flagship Pioneering invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health, sustainability and beyond. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated more than 100 companies. Many of these companies have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com . At Flagship, we accept impossible missions to enable bigger leaps. Our core values guide us through uncertainty and toward lasting impact. We are an equal opportunity employer . All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We recognize that great candidates often bring unique strengths without fulfilling every qualification . If you have some of the experience listed above but not all, please apply anyway. We are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams and look forward to learning more about your background and interest in Flagship.
