jobs.title: Amazon Operations Analyst
jobs.jd: Trove Brands is a privately-held house of brands including BlenderBottle®, Owala®, Whiskware®, and Eco-Brite®. Our patented and best-selling products are designed to simplify and improve everyday life with leading-edge innovation, incomparable quality, and aspirational style. A career at Trove Brands is not about punching the clock. It’s about embracing exciting and fast-paced opportunities that sharpen your skills, drive innovation, and play an integral role in growing our global reach. Your work will not only impact the company, it will impact the lives of millions of people around the world. When you step up to a career at Trove, you step up to cutting-edge excellence. You sign up for bold action and invigorating synergy. You agree to face—and break through—new challenges every single day. The Amazon Operations Analyst supports the growth and operational performance of Trove Brands' Amazon US 1P business through data analysis, business intelligence, inventory visibility, and operational execution. This role is responsible for analyzing sales performance, identifying lost sales opportunities, monitoring inventory trends, tracking purchase orders, and providing actionable business insights. Working closely with Amazon Sales, Sales Forecasting, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, and other cross-functional teams, this role helps improve product availability, operational efficiency, and business performance. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights that support business growth. Key Responsibilities: Analyze Amazon sales, traffic, conversion, inventory, and operational performance to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities. Identify lost sales opportunities related to out-of-stocks, inventory gaps, product availability, and purchase order execution. Monitor inventory levels, Amazon demand signals, replenishment trends, and product availability to minimize stockouts. Track Amazon purchase orders from creation through fulfillment and delivery, identifying and resolving operational issues. Monitor key operational KPIs, including PO confirmation rates, fill rates, inventory availability, and fulfillment performance. Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting to provide visibility into sales performance, inventory health, and business opportunities. Analyze ASIN performance, sell-through, and category trends to identify underperformance and competitive opportunities. Support new product launches and promotional events by monitoring inventory readiness, purchase orders, and operational risks. Collaborate with Amazon Sales, Sales Forecasting, Supply Chain, Logistics, EDI/Processing, and Finance to improve operational execution. Monitor Amazon Vendor Central operations and help ensure accurate product, order, and inventory information. Leverage AI tools, automation, and data visualization to streamline reporting, improve processes, and deliver actionable insights. Required Qualifications: 1-3 years of experience in eCommerce, retail analytics, sales operations, supply chain, marketplace operations, or a related field. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and translate findings into actionable insights. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, lookups, and data analysis. Experience working with data analysis, reporting, or visualization tools. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities. Ability to identify operational challenges, troubleshoot issues, and recommend effective solutions. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across departments. Ability to learn new systems, processes, and reporting platforms quickly. Desired Qualifications: Experience working with Amazon Vendor Central or Amazon 1P operations. Experience supporting Amazon sales, inventory management, replenishment, or purchase order processes. Experience in retail or consumer packaged goods (CPG) environments. Background in retail analytics, sales planning, or supply chain operations supporting major retailers. Familiarity with EDI processes, inventory management systems, or retail replenishment operations. Experience developing reports, dashboards, or performance tracking tools. Familiarity with SQL, Python, Power BI, Looker, AI tools, or reporting automation. Our culture is passionate, entrepreneurial, and energetic. We value innovation through collaboration. And while we work smart and hard, we also connect and celebrate with equal gusto. We host team-building activities, athletic events, and seasonal celebrations to foster community and reward accomplishments. Bottom line? You’ll love it here. Among the many benefits our team members enjoy are: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision care 401k package with employer matching Paid Time Off Maternity/Paternity leave Full indoor basketball/volleyball court Fully equipped fitness center (cardio, weights, functional fitness area, lockers and showers, etc.) Yoga studio Meditation/Nap room And much more! Trove Brands is an equal opportunity employer. Phone calls regarding this position are not accepted. This is a fully in-office position at our HQ in Lehi, Utah.

Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining requirements to non-specialists. jobs.title: Collections Analyst
jobs.jd: This is Adyen Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. About the team Credit Risk Operations owns Adyen's global arrears and collections flow for our financial products. When a merchant falls behind on repayment, we work to recover what is owed while keeping the relationship intact and staying fully compliant. We sit at the intersection of Credit Risk, Product, Finance, Legal and our second-line Risk and Compliance teams. The team is growing quickly, so the processes, tooling and playbooks you help build now will shape how Adyen collects at scale. What you'll do As a Collections Analyst in Chicago, you will own a portfolio of US merchants in arrears across Adyen's financial products: cash advances, capital loans, charge cards, overdrafts and hardware financing. You will resolve each case end to end, from first outreach to repayment plan, recovery or escalation. Alongside your caseload, you will help turn a fast-growing operation into a scalable, compliant and increasingly automated one. You will run your own portfolio independently, within agreed playbooks and approval limits. You will escalate exceptions such as settlements, write-offs and legal action to senior colleagues, and take on more complex accounts as you grow. Responsibilities Own a portfolio of merchant accounts in arrears and drive each case to resolution by email Explain contractual obligations clearly, negotiate realistic repayment plans and follow through until they are met Spot breaches of agreement, such as licensing issues or unauthorized business activity, and agree next steps with Legal and Credit Risk Escalate at the right moment and coordinate recoveries with Risk, Finance, Legal and Product so merchants get one consistent answer Monitor portfolio health, including delinquency rates, roll rates, promise-to-pay and cure rates, and flag emerging risks early Keep accurate, audit-ready records of every merchant interaction and case decision Make sure every recovery action complies with US federal and state collections, servicing and lending rules Help design and improve collections tooling, automation and workflows so the operation scales without adding headcount at the same rate Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you do, we encourage you to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements Experienced in collections, account recovery or credit operations at a lender, bank, fintech or payments company Hands-on experience managing a portfolio of overdue business or consumer credit accounts Working knowledge of US collections and servicing regulations, and how to apply them day to day Confidence in difficult conversations: you balance empathy with firmness and keep the relationship intact Clear written and spoken English, including explaining terms like breach of contract or default in plain language Strong organization: you track many accounts, deadlines and follow-ups without dropping detail Comfort with collections platforms or CRM tools, and with Excel or Google Sheets for basic reporting A low-ego, high-accountability approach to working with Risk, Legal, Finance and Product Ability to leverage AI tools and automation to increase operational efficiency Preferred qualifications Experience collecting on commercial credit products: merchant cash advances, working capital loans, charge cards, overdrafts or equipment financing Familiarity with FDCPA, UDAAP, state collection licensing rules and fair-lending expectations as they apply to business credit Experience handling legal escalations, settlements, charge-offs or third-party agency placements Comfort with data: SQL, Looker or similar tools to analyze delinquency trends and build reports A track record of improving a collections process, building a playbook or helping automate a workflow Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Adyen We actively seek different perspectives to sharpen our ideas. Our unique culture is a product of our diverse backgrounds and experiences. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome to be your true self at Adyen. If you need accommodations or support during the recruitment process to perform at your best, you’ll have the opportunity to let our team know in your application. We encourage people from all backgrounds and abilities to apply. What’s next? Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. Adyen is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please note that this role is a hybrid, 3 times per week, position in Chicago. jobs.jd: About the Team The Global Safety and Security team advances DoorDash through the protection of people, property, operations, brand, and reputation. We deliver value through agility, technology, and a people-first mindset—creating environments where employees and guests feel safe, welcome, and confident. As DoorDash continues to evolve its workplace experience globally, our Corporate Safety and Security team is reimagining how physical security integrates seamlessly into every employee and guest interaction. The Associate, GOC Analyst will play a key role in designing and delivering this next-generation security experience. About the Role We are hiring a GOC Analyst to support DoorDash’s 24/7 Global Operations Center. Reporting to the GOC Manager, this role is responsible for real-time monitoring, incident triage, and operational response to protect DoorDash’s people, assets, and operations. As a frontline operator, you will serve as the first line of defense during emerging incidents—monitoring systems, assessing risk, executing SOPs, and escalating issues quickly and accurately. In addition to core operational response, you will apply foundational analytical skills to validate information, distinguish signal from noise, provide clear operational context that supports timely escalation and informed decision-making. Support Escalation and Decision-Making: Identify when issues exceed defined thresholds and escalate to the GOC Manager or Risk Intelligence team with clear, structured, and decision-ready information, without owning strategic risk interpretation. Strong Operational Judgment: Ability to assess risk, prioritize tasks, and act decisively under pressure. Technical Fluency: Comfort working across monitoring dashboards, ticketing systems, communication platforms, and basic analytics tools. Clear Communication Skills: Ability to document incidents clearly and communicate effectively with leaders and cross-functional partners. Discipline and Reliability: Proven ability to follow process, maintain attention to detail, and perform consistently across rotating shifts. Growth Mindset: Willingness to learn new tools, analytical techniques, and operational best practices within a structured operations environment. jobs.title: GEOINT Analyst, Scams
jobs.jd:
BUILD A SAFER WORLD.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Scam Disruption team is TRM's tip of the spear against pig butchering syndicates, romance fraud networks, and investment scam operations that steal billions from victims each year. As a GEOINT Analyst, you’ll be the team's location specialist: finding where scam compounds are, who is operating them, and how they move, then turning that picture into intelligence law enforcement partners can act on.

 


THE IMPACT YOU WILL HAVE

 - Locate and map scam compounds, people, and devices

 - Fuse intelligence with on-chain attribution and OSINT to identify operators and controllers

 - Find the seams: pivot from a single address, IP, photo, or victim lead to the compound and the people running it

 - Partner with the Threat Intelligence Analyst (Scams Expert), the CTI Analyst, and the All-Source Lead to translate disruption strategy into targeting packages that influence law enforcement and government action
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Creative tactical thinking — demonstrated ability to pivot from a single point to a network view, identifying operators behind operations

 - Link and pattern analysis fluency — ability to correlate disparate data sources to generate defensible target packages

 - Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain your methods, your confidence, and your own role in plain terms, and write memos, attribution write-ups, and leads that are actionable

 - AI fluency (required) — you use AI tools in your workflow, synthesizing data, drafting outputs, and accelerating analysis, with examples of how AI has impacted your work

 - Crypto experience is a plus, not a requirement — we teach on-chain tradecraft; we cannot teach the targeter's instinct

 - Familiarity with Southeast Asia scam compounds or Chinese-run criminal networks is a plus

 - Location: remote in the UK, EMEA, or US (including Washington, DC). You must already have the right to work where you're based.


ABOUT THE TEAM

 - The Scam Disruption team operates within TRM’s Blockchain Intelligence organization, alongside threat intelligence analysts, on-chain investigators, and federal partners

 - All-Source Investigators are the operational core, converting strategy and tooling into prosecutable, actionable intelligence

 - Distributed team with an async-first approach via Slack and Notion, plus structured syncs for alignment

 - High autonomy, high standards, low bureaucracy — work directly with analysts, engineers, and customers who depend on your output

 


TEAM OPERATING RHYTHMS

 - Weekly team syncs to align targeting priorities and review disruption opportunities

 - Daily async standups via Slack on active work, returns, and target packages in flight

 - Primary time zone overlap: US Eastern / Central

 - All output documented in Notion and TRM’s investigative tools

 - Surge availability expected during time-sensitive disruption windows

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.




INTERVIEWING WITH TRM

 - Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

 - Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

 - First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

 - Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

 - References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

 - Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

 - Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.




AI FLUENCY AT TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

 - Accelerate repeatable workflows

 - Structure and solve problems

 - Improve output quality

 - Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

 - A high level of personal ownership and accountability

 - Close collaboration across teams and functions

 - Frequent, high-touch communication

 - Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

 - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

jobs.title: Data Scientist (Decision Science)
jobs.jd:
About Gen

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.  

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.  

When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.  

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.  

If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. 

 

About the Role

We are looking for a Data Scientist to develop data solutions that will enable us to assist critical day to day business decisions.

As a Data Scientist in the Decision Science role, you will have the opportunity to apply analytics, experimentation and machine learning algorithms to support and enhance MoneyLion’s products with data driven decisions.

You will be embedded within the product teams and deliver tangible business value by deploying or refining solutions ranging from fraud and credit underwriting to user experience optimisations, providing convincing evidence of their effectiveness. This entails designing, developing, validating, deploying and monitoring the outcome of experiments using (and refining) business objectives that will ultimately increase revenue and reduce business costs. You will partner with Product, Data Engineers and Machine Learning teams, exploring and utilizing the frontier of innovation, in order to augment analytics with AI, rapidly iterate with configurable experiments, monitor and evaluate key developments, and understand business needs intimately to help develop valuable AI solutions.

 

About MoneyLion

MoneyLion is a leader in financial technology powering the next generation of personalized products and content, with a top consumer finance super app, a premier embedded finance platform for enterprise businesses and a world-class media arm. MoneyLion’s mission is to give everyone the power to make their best financial decisions. We pride ourselves on serving the many, not the few; providing confidence through guidance, choice, personalization; and shortening the distance to an informed action.

In our go-to money app for consumers, we deliver curated content on finance and related topics, through a tailored feed that engages people to learn and share. People take control of their finances with our innovative financial products and marketplace - including our full-fledged suite of features to save, borrow, spend, and invest - seamlessly bringing together the best offers and content from MoneyLion and our 1,100+ Enterprise Partner network, together in one experience. MoneyLion’s enterprise technology provides the definitive search engine and marketplace for financial products, enabling any company to add embedded finance to their business, with advanced AI-backed data and tools through our platform and API. Established in 2013, MoneyLion connects millions of people with the financial products and content they need, when and where they need it.

 

Key Responsibilities

 - Perform analyses to understand how our users interact with our products and how to improve our products

 - Communicate findings to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner

 - Identify anomalies and investigate the root causes of anomalies

 - Design and build experiments to solve challenging data and business problems

 - Collaborate with product owners to discover new insights and understanding of business performance based on data

 - Identify trends and opportunities from the data and influence product roadmaps

 - Develop dashboards to track relevant metrics

 - Recommend ways to measure success

 - Must have hands on experience in machine learning, predictive analytics and statistical modeling

 - Adept at problem solving using both textbook methods and novel viewpoints

 - Proficient in programming languages such as Python and SQL

 - Knowledge of data structures, data modeling, software architecture and machine learning algorithms will be an advantage

 - Demonstrably experienced with data visualization

 - Demonstrably excellent verbal and written communication skills

jobs.title: Business Operations Generalist
jobs.jd:
COMPANY BACKGROUND

Specter's mission is to help automate the physical world.

Today, we build video sensors with state-of-the-art AI agents that answer any question, anywhere in their environments. Our systems can automatically detect and reason about any physical activity captured on camera, from security incidents (e.g. perimeter intrusion, theft, LPR), to safety monitoring (e.g. PPE detection, injured people), to operational efficiency (e.g. material tracking, congestion monitoring). We offer both long range wireless (1km range) and wired sensor variants to suit any deployment.

Our co-founders Xerxes and Philip are passionate about empowering our partners in the fast approaching world of physical AI and robotics. We are a small, fast growing team who hail from Anduril, Tesla, Uber, and the U.S. Special Forces.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Business Operations Generalist to join Specter's lean BizOps team. This person will work across deal support, pricing, market strategy, planning, finance, and company systems. Today the work leans more commercial, including working with our GTM teams on sales materials, customer value cases, and proposals. In a given week, it can mean a customer business case one day and a CRM cleanup the next. Some of it is strategic. Some of it is unglamorous. Part of the job is building the templates and systems that make that work repeatable, so the role will likely look different in 6 months, and may be less GTM oriented then. We want someone who enjoys that variety, jumps into new problems as they come up, owns the outcome, and leaves each process better than they found it. The right person is analytical, commercially sharp, highly organized, and comfortable working with leadership, sales, finance, product, and engineering in the same day.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - You will put together pricing, proposals, customer business cases, and value models for complex deals, and support contract review. Over time, you will turn this work into templates and systems the sales team can run on their own.

 - You will build business cases for new markets and new products, and keep the team current on what competitors are doing.

 - You will help leadership and the sales team see the pipeline clearly through forecasting, CRM hygiene, and dashboards.

 - You will support planning, budgeting, and board and investor reporting, and track spend across the business, including production, R&D, SaaS, and vendor spend.

 - You will build processes, documentation, and decision frameworks where today there may only be spreadsheets, Slack threads, and ad hoc decisions.

 - You will handle the day-to-day work that keeps the business running: cleaning up data, coordinating vendors, chasing down numbers, and taking problems from "someone should figure this out" to a clear owner and outcome.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3 to 5 years of experience in consulting, investment banking, or investing, or in business operations, revenue operations, or a similarly analytical role at an early-stage, high-growth startup.

 - Strong with spreadsheets and financial models, and comfortable in a CRM.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - Good judgment and the ability to prioritize when everything feels urgent.

 - A low-ego team player who takes on the detailed, behind-the-scenes work without being asked and improves it over time.

 - A builder mentality: you are excited to create the first version of a system and turn one-off work into something others can reuse.

 - A generalist who enjoys variety and is excited to take on whatever problem matters most, knowing the role will change as the company grows.

 - Comfortable working without much direction or full context. You find what you need, make a reasonable call, and flag what you assumed.

 - You use AI tools to improve systems and get more done, without handing your thinking to them.

 - Interest in physical AI, hard industries, critical infrastructure, defense, energy, or industrial technology and the ability and desire to get up to speed on technical products.

 - Based in San Francisco and excited to work in person.

 - Model capacity and hiring plans: how many reps, SEs, and implementation resources we need to hit the plan, and when.

 - Help design and administer sales comp, including SPIFs that push the behaviors we need.

Evaluate and improve individual sales performance

 - Build a performance scorecard for every seller: activity, pipeline generation, stage conversion, cycle time, win rate, and deal size.

 - Diagnose where each rep is losing deals (discovery, champion building, ROI case, procurement) using CRM data, call recordings, and deal reviews.

 - Run regular 1:1 performance reviews with reps and their managers. Agree on two or three specific things to improve and track whether they do.

 - Spot what top performers do differently and make it the playbook for everyone else.

Enable and train the team

 - Own sales enablement for Call Center Agents: onboarding for new hires and ongoing training for the existing team.

 - Run trainings whenever the product changes so every seller can demo, position, and price new capabilities the week they ship.

 - Build and maintain the core assets: pitch and demo scripts, discovery guides, objection handling, competitive battlecards, and ROI calculators.

 - Certify reps on the product and the pitch through role plays and mock calls, and retrain where the data shows gaps.

 - Be the link between Product and Sales: bring field feedback to the product team and bring product updates back to the field.

Build the systems

 - Own CRM hygiene, deal stage definitions, and KPI definitions so everyone reads the same numbers.

 - You've worked directly with sellers, not just their data. You can sit with a rep, look at their pipeline, and tell them specifically what to do differently.

 - You're comfortable in front of a room. You've built and delivered trainings, onboarding, or enablement programs that changed how a team sells.

 - Strong analytical skills: advanced Excel or Sheets, comfortable building models from scratch. SQL is a plus.

 - Hands-on with Salesforce or HubSpot, including reports and dashboards.

 - You bring structure to ambiguity with low ego. You'll build the deck, then clean up the CRM, then run the meeting.

jobs.title: Market Analyst
jobs.jd:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base’s Risk & Trading team turns a fleet of distributed batteries and the households we serve into a power business that makes money. As a Market Analyst, you’ll know how much Base is earning, where it could lose money, and how it will make money in the next market.

You’ll own P&L (profit and loss) reporting and risk tracking across our battery fleet and retail operations. You’ll build the pricing models behind what we charge members, recommend hedges, and work with Finance, Growth and Legal & Policy to figure out how Base makes money in each new market. Base already does this in ERCOT. Your first job is to do it in PJM.

This role suits someone with a few years of experience in power markets, retail energy, or a related analytical field. You’ll own real decisions early.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build a bottoms-up retail pricing model for PJM that builds upon our ERCOT model.

 - Bring PJM into our risk system and P&L reporting, so we know the margin we earn and how to buy supply.

 - Identify new market opportunities and work closely with stakeholders from Finance, Growth and Legal & Policy teams to bring them to reality.

 - Recommend changes to Base’s hedging strategy in ERCOT and PJM, and track our exposure against risk limits.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Energy markets knowledge: you understand wholesale market basics in ERCOT and PJM, including how power is bought, hedged and settled. You know how retail pricing and operations work.

 - Commercial sense: you understand how a retail offer makes or loses money. You can explain the cost to supply it, the margin on it, and the risk in between.

 - Risk and statistics: you think in distributions, not point forecasts. You know power prices are tail heavy. Basic statistics is enough.

 - Coding and SQL: you build reports and models in Python (or another language), pull your own data with SQL, and work through a problem independently.

Nice to have: experience at a retail energy provider, utility supply desk, or trading middle office.



ABOUT THE TEAM

Base’s Risk & Trading team turns the grid-service capability of our distributed battery fleet into revenue. That means building and defending the models that decide which markets and products Base participates in, from real-time arbitrage to multi-year distribution deals. The team’s calls carry real weight - a mis-modeled coincident peak or an unvetted market opinion shows up directly in Base’s book. You’ll work alongside traders, market operations engineers, and policy leads who bring the same rigor to distribution-scale energy that a trading desk brings to wholesale power.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: Technical Operations Analyst II
jobs.jd: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Technical Operations Analyst II, AI Platform Reliability & Insights About the team The AI & Automation Team onboards and manages AI tools, and partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products and services. We deliver high-quality experiences for employees worldwide with best-in-class technology to boost productivity and enable AI in the flow of work. About the role We're hiring a Technical Operations Analyst II to keep our enterprise AI platforms reliable and to turn the data they produce into decisions. Many of our apps are vendor-managed, so you'll work with vendors to get the data and fixes we need. You'll sit between the engineers who build our telemetry and integrations, the vendors who run parts of our stack, and the leaders who rely on both: investigating incidents, watching the signals, and showing how our AI tools perform, how they are adopted and what they cost. This is a technical, data-driven analyst role, not a software engineering role. In this role, you will Own observability for our AI platforms and integrations: take in OpenTelemetry and platform telemetry and turn it into clear reporting and recommendations on reliability, performance, usage and cost, including token consumption and spend. Manage vendors for our vendor-managed apps: track logged issues to resolution against agreed service levels, escalate when needed, and secure the telemetry, usage and audit data they own. Lead first response and cross-team investigation for incidents, restore service quickly, write evidence-based incident reports, and harden runbooks and preventive checks so issues don't recur. Design SLO-aligned monitors, tune alerts to cut noise, and correlate tickets, alerts, telemetry and vendor reports to surface systemic risks and prioritize fixes by impact. Build and maintain BI dashboards and reports with metric definitions consistent with enterprise standards, and model demand and capacity to recommend changes. Identify routine diagnostic and reporting work to automate, and partner with engineering owners to implement it. Design AI-ready knowledge articles, runbooks and self-service content, and measure ticket deflection and customer satisfaction. Plan and run cross-team changes, such as tool rollouts and feature adoption, and measure uptake. Mentor peers and build relationships across engineering, support, security, vendors and business teams. Minimum qualifications Bachelor's degree, Master's degree or equivalent professional experience. 2+ years of experience in technical operations, application or production support, or monitoring (or 0-2 years with a Master's degree). Hands-on incident and problem management experience, including coordinating response across teams and writing root cause and incident summaries. Experience with monitoring and observability tools (for example Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace or CloudWatch), including building dashboards and tuning alerts. Experience managing vendor or third-party support relationships, including tracking issues to resolution against service levels. Comfort analyzing data to find trends and reporting on it, using spreadsheets and a BI or dashboard tool. Working knowledge of AI assistants and LLM-based tools, including how to validate AI-generated guidance and spot hallucinations or risky outputs. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical findings to technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to quantify the impact of operational issues and propose cost-effective fixes. Preferred qualifications Experience with OpenTelemetry or similar telemetry pipelines, and with SLO and SLI reporting. Experience managing vendors of SaaS or enterprise platforms, including escalations and service-level reviews. Experience administering or supporting enterprise AI or knowledge platforms (for example Glean, Claude or similar), including usage, adoption and cost reporting. Familiarity with FinOps or cost-attribution practices for cloud or AI spend. Experience with an ITSM platform such as ServiceNow, and ITIL Foundation knowledge. Experience with Looker, Tableau or a similar dashboard tool, and with defining metrics against a shared metrics platform or data lake. Experience writing knowledge articles and runbooks designed for self-service and AI search. Experience leading change or tool adoption across teams. The total cash range for this position in Austin is $87,000.00 to $121,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $139,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future. jobs.jd: Working at Moffitt is both a career and a mission: to contribute to the prevention and cure of cancer. As the only National Cancer Institute-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center based in Florida, Moffitt employs some of the best and brightest minds from around the world. Join a dedicated team of nearly 11,000 who are shaping the future we envision. Moffitt has been recognized as a Best and Brightest Company to Work For in the Nation and is continually named one of the Tampa Bay Times’ Top Workplaces. Summary Are you passionate about advancing cancer research through innovation, collaboration, and discovery? The NCI-funded Integrated Program in Cancer and Data Science ( ICADS ) at Moffitt Cancer Center is seeking highly motivated postdoctoral fellows to join a unique interdisciplinary training program designed to develop the next generation of leaders in cancer research and data science. ICADS brings together expert mentors from across Moffitt's discovery, clinical, translational, population, and quantitative sciences to provide exceptional training, collaborative research opportunities, and career development. Fellows are immersed in team-based science, pairing cancer biology and data science expertise to address critical challenges in cancer research. 💻 Data Science Fellowship Join Moffitt's nationally recognized Department of Biostatistics & Bioinformatics and collaborate on cutting-edge cancer research involving biostatistics, statistical genomics, bioinformatics, single-cell genomics, computational immunology, clinical trials, biomarkers, precision medicine, and next-generation sequencing. Required Qualifications: PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. Strong quantitative and analytical skills. Experience with R and/or programming languages such as Python or Perl in Unix/Linux environments. Knowledge of biology or genetics is preferred but not required What You'll Do As an ICADS Postdoc Fellow, you will: Conduct innovative cancer-focused research within a multidisciplinary team. Collaborate across cancer biology, clinical research, and data science disciplines. Develop scientific writing and presentation skills through manuscripts, grant proposals, seminars, and national conference presentations. Participate in structured coursework and professional development activities designed to prepare you for a successful independent research career. Receive mentorship from nationally recognized investigators and participate in a collaborative training environment supported by NCI training grants. Why Join the ICADS Fellowship at Moffitt? Interdisciplinary Team Science - Work alongside leading cancer biologists, clinicians, biostatisticians, bioinformaticians, and computational scientists to solve complex cancer challenges. Exceptional Mentorship & Career Development - Receive personalized mentorship, structured training, and support to pursue independent funding opportunities and future faculty or industry careers. Research at a Comprehensive Cancer Center - Moffitt integrates world-class patient care with innovative basic, translational, and clinical research, creating unique opportunities to make a direct impact on cancer outcomes. In addition to world-class training and mentorship, postdoctoral fellows at Moffitt have access to internal funding and career development programs, including research awards, pilot funding opportunities, and the competitive Research Instructor program, which supports the transition to research independence through protected time, mentorship, and faculty development resources. With its flourishing economy and rich cultural diversity, the Tampa Bay region masterfully combines urban elegance with breathtaking natural beauty. jobs.title: Part-Time Data Scientist
jobs.jd: By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive. Why join Harvard Medical School? Harvard Medical School's mission is to nurture a diverse, inclusive community dedicated to alleviating suffering and improving health and well-being for all through excellence in teaching and learning, discovery and scholarship, and service and leadership. You’ll be at the heart of biomedical discovery, education, and innovation, working alongside world-renowned faculty and a community dedicated to improving human health. This is more than a job - it’s an opportunity to shape the future of medicine. This position supports the key initiatives of OCCE HMS/school-wide projects. The Data Scientist will apply current and emerging analytical and problem-solving techniques in program evaluation and tracking. The position is actively involved in planning, designing, implementing, and analyzing data-driven projects such as the Pulse Survey. Collaborate with HMS and Harvard University data working groups related to policies, practices, and programs. Job-Specific Responsibilities: Work with OCCE and other Harvard University offices in planning, designing, implementing, and analyzing data-driven projects such as the Pulse Survey. Collaborate with HMS and Harvard University data working groups related to policies, practices, and programs, with a focus on establishing monitoring and accountability measures/metrics designed to progressively chart implementation activities and results produced over time. Work internally with OCCE to create, pilot, and support metric-based data reporting templates through which the evidence and impact of its programmatic interventions can be demonstrated. Conceptually, templates will feature multiple-level system thinking. Collaborate with HMS data-related groups to resolve conceptual, technical and operational issues related to databases. Translate identified data problems into well-defined technical specifications and leverage workable elements as growth opportunities. Design and build user-friendly database solutions and instrumentation. Lead and manage the development of program-related-data capture and databases that include 1) multiple data sources, 2) mixed-methods data, and 3) data elements that represent the multidimensionality of the OCCE charge and mission. Develop and maintain comprehensive Technical Notes that document process and procedures undertaken to complete all assigned tasks. Work closely with stakeholders to understand data derived from both healthcare providers and computational methods. Conduct data analysis for ad hoc reporting requests from the Dean of OCCE, constituents, stakeholders, and other sources. Basic Qualifications: Minimum of 5 years of post secondary education or relevant work experience. Additional Qualifications and Skills: Bachelor’s degree in data science, data analytics, or a related field preferred. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to write clearly for a broad audience and explain technical analysis to a non-technical audience. Ability to visualize data and communicate complex data most effectively. Excellent interpersonal skills. Enthusiasm for collaborating closely with others. Experience working with data and metrics. Certificates and Licenses: Completion of Harvard IT Academy specified foundational courses (or external equivalent) preferred. jobs.jd: By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive. Why join Harvard Business School? Harvard Business School, located on a 40-acre campus in Boston, was founded in 1908 as part of Harvard University. It is among the world's most trusted sources of management education and thought leadership. For more than a century, the School's faculty has combined a passion for teaching with rigorous research conducted alongside practitioners at world-leading organizations to educate leaders who make a difference in the world. Through a dynamic ecosystem of research, learning, and entrepreneurship that includes MBA, Doctoral, Executive Education, and Online programs, as well as numerous initiatives, centers, institutes, and labs, Harvard Business School fosters bold new ideas and collaborative learning networks that shape the future of business. Division of Research and Faculty Development (DRFD) The mission of Harvard Business School (HBS) is to educate leaders who make a difference in the world. Within HBS, by providing unparalleled faculty support, the DRFD helps to build and develop the faculty; and facilitates the creation of enduring knowledge that shapes both business scholarship and the practice of business. As the School’s largest administrative department, the DRFD houses approximately 350 full-time and part-time staff members. As a premier service organization, and in collaboration with colleagues across the School, DRFD staff deliver high-touch, customized support to the faculty, demonstrating solid judgment and high standards of responsiveness and professionalism. Case Research and Writing Group (CRG) Within the DRFD, the CRG’s mission is to support faculty by providing high quality, high value, efficient and innovative case research, development, and writing. Case Researchers support HBS faculty members in their case writing and course development efforts and assist administrative and academic departments with research, case writing, and training services. We are a collaborative feedback-driven team. Position Summary Would you enjoy working alongside HBS faculty members as they study and teach about the defining leadership and organizational challenges of our time? Are you a strong writer who loves learning, is curious, and is excited about engaging with intellectual puzzles? If so, consider joining the CRG and becoming a Case Researcher. Case Researchers help HBS faculty members develop and write course materials, in particular case studies, that train future leaders in the HBS MBA and Executive Education programs. HBS cases are sold worldwide and impact tens of thousands of students. To do so, we interview business leaders and others (politicians, professional athletes, entertainers, philanthropists, and more) about their most pressing challenges and organizational dilemmas. Travel may be involved. In addition to interviews, we gather library research, and then we write. Case Researchers occasionally work on other course development projects (such as video supplements or teaching guides) and participate in CRG recruiting, training, and mentoring activities. We are actively hiring for two Case Researcher openings under this posting. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Reporting to either the CRG’s Director or Assistant Director, the Case Researcher: Writes case studies based on field and/or library research, supports the development of course materials, including teaching notes, technical notes, and multimedia materials; manages timelines, drafts and deliverables; and creates basic case components (e.g., tables, charts, graphs), in accordance with faculty guidance. Uses research and writing technologies and is willing to experiment with and learn from new tools, including AI, to enhance productivity, efficiency, and accuracy while maintaining high quality standards. Once experienced, Case Researchers are expected to participate in CRG-level activities such as recruiting, training, mentoring and on-boarding. Builds trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents. Responsible for other duties as assigned. Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of similar research and/or writing experience or a Master’s degree and 3 years of experience is required. Candidates with less experience may be considered as a grade 55 Associate Case Researcher. Other preferred qualifications: Ability to develop cases efficiently and to high quality standards. Strong research and interpersonal skills, interviewing skills a plus. Project management skills across multiple projects with shifting deadlines and evolving scope. Solid judgment when evaluating information, interviewing decision-makers, and synthetizing complex ideas into compelling learning materials. Interest and ability to learn and apply emerging tools and technologies, including AI tools, to the development of case studies. Interest in technology and learning modalities, such as video and multimedia platforms. Openness to giving, receiving, and incorporating feedback. Editorial mindset, fact-checking skills, and attention to detail. Independent work style while seeking guidance as needed from CRG peers and faculty clients. Knowledge of a particular industry, geography, or foreign language, and familiarity with economics, finance, AI, or other business topics. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive. Why join Harvard University Central Administration? Harvard University's Central Administration (CADM) is a 5,000+ employee organization that supports the university's overall excellence by understanding and serving the needs of its schools, students, faculty, staff, alumni, and surrounding communities. Through dynamic and collaborative partnerships, CADM provides high-quality and efficient services to the schools to help them achieve their goals. Alumni Affairs and Development is a dedicated team supporting Harvard’s advancement activity through front-line fundraising, alumni and volunteer engagement, technology, prospect management and research, business process, events, communications, and many other areas. Our goal is to create an environment of respect that leverages the many talents, perspectives, and experiences of our employees; to deliver the strongest possible results by incorporating diverse perspectives into our daily work; and to make AA&D a great place to work for everyone. We strive to live our values of respect, inclusion, trust, collaboration, continuous improvement and innovation; and open communication and effective information sharing in our daily interactions and our work. AA&D is comprised of the Faculty of Arts and Sciences (FAS) Development, Advancement Communications, Events & Donor Relations (ACEDR), University Development and Advancement Solutions (UDAS), the Harvard Alumni Association (HAA), and Office of Talent, Administration and Policy (OTAP). Reporting to a Gift Planning Officer this full-time non-exempt position on the Harvard Gift Planning (HGP) team supports the work of two Gift Planning Officers. The Development Assistant serves as principal administrative contact and liaison for external and internal constituencies including donors, alumni, faculty, senior academic leaders, and Harvard University colleagues. Job-Specific Responsibilities: Provides administrative support to gift officers throughout the entire prospect management process including (but not limited to) prospect outreach, lead tracking and entering data into the alumni/donor database, data gathering and maintenance, scheduling, meeting preparation and follow-up on action items. jobs.jd: At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us! Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA. EVERSANA® MANAGEMENT CONSULTING combines deep industry and functional area knowledge with specialized expertise in market assessment, analytics, and strategy development. Our global experts help industry executives address their most pressing business challenges. We are the strategic advisory arm of EVERSANA®, serving a broad range of large and small biopharma, med tech and digital therapeutics companies. As part of EVERSANA®, we integrate our strategic planning with launch excellence and commercial execution to provide end-to-end commercialization support to our clients. We offer strategic solutions across a range of innovative therapy areas — driven by our areas of practice in: Brand Strategy/Marketing, Launch/Complete Commercialization, Product Innovation, Corporate Strategy and Business Development, Pricing & Market Access, and Strategic Data Analytics Coordination — providing a diverse range of project experiences, led by experts in their fields. Our industry leaders bring a mix of diverse backgrounds combining science and commercial specialties from preeminent educational institutions, along with experiences gained at leading consulting firms and life sciences organizations. We are growing rapidly and seek team members who value the opportunity to accelerate their personal development while contributing to winning teams; this includes exposure to thought leaders across EVERSANA and constant interaction with clients and team members at all levels. EVERSANA® MANAGEMENT CONSULTING fosters a collaborative and supportive culture in which we strive to create an environment where people can build fulfilling and prosperous careers. Our consulting staff has a wide range of opportunities to develop their skills as life sciences professionals, from leading high-stakes strategic projects/product launches to coordinating and redesigning high-science product commercialization programs across global markets. Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by: Leading targeted secondary research (e.g., desk research, secondary data analysis) and primary research (e.g., interviews with key opinion leaders / insurance payers) with minimal oversight Synthesizing research insights to develop logical and effective client recommendations Independently running work streams, meeting deadlines, and assisting junior team members as necessary Developing high-quality client communications and deliverables (e.g., PowerPoint slides, Excel models) Communicating verbal and written information in logical, clear, and concise fashion Contributing to the development of the firm’s capabilities and infrastructure Supporting the development of a high-performance culture Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias. All other duties as assigned. If reasonable accommodation is needed to perform the essential functions of your job position, please contact Human Resources. jobs.title: AI Architect | Digital Products & AI
jobs.jd: We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity. Our diverse teams of experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results. We are over 4,000 strategists, innovators, designers, consultants, digital experts, scientists, engineers, and technologists. And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defense and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport. Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands. PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life This practice is built for the way enterprise software actually gets made now: small senior pods, AI agents doing much of the build, and outcomes in weeks where traditional delivery approaches took months. We build digital products, AI agents, intelligent workflows and modernized platforms that help organizations operate differently across healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation and consumer industries. None of it is pilots or demos. The solutions we build run in production and solve problems that matter to our clients' businesses. As an AI Architect, you'll work directly with clients to shape, design, and lead the delivery of those solutions. Working alongside Product Strategists and AI Engineers, you'll own the delivery architecture for complex engagements, translating business problems into executable solutions and ensuring what gets built remains aligned to what was designed. You'll help shape opportunities before delivery begins and stay close to them throughout implementation. On some engagements, we continue to run what we've built, giving you the opportunity to stay close to the product and see the impact of your work long after go-live. This is a hands-on architecture and engineering role. Most of the code here is written by agents. That does not make this a supervision job. It moves the engineering upstream, where strong engineering judgment becomes even more important. You'll define the architecture, controls, and acceptance criteria that determine whether a solution succeeds in production, while helping teams navigate ambiguity and move delivery forward. You'll be expected to make technical decisions that stand up not only in delivery, but also in front of client technology leaders who will ultimately be accountable for the outcome. Requirements do not always arrive fully formed, and part of the role is helping define the problem while continuing to move delivery forward. As part of the Digital Products & AI team, you can expect to: Own the delivery architecture for digital products, AI agents, intelligent workflows, and modernization initiatives, ensuring solutions remain aligned from discovery through deployment. Architect the elements that determine whether AI solutions succeed in production, including tool selection, memory and context management, guardrail design, and human-in-the-loop controls. Define, build, and guide the implementation of the technical components that power agentic systems, including retrieval pipelines, MCP services and integrations, and the systems that connect AI capabilities to enterprise data and processes at scale. Modernize platforms and applications around current business needs, rebuilding where necessary rather than simply moving legacy functionality onto newer technology. Design security and operational resilience into solutions from the start, including access controls, identity management, deployment guardrails, and oversight of automated actions. Break down complex problems into deliverable components, defining scope, sequencing, implementation approaches, and delivery plans while determining feasibility and technical risk. Create reusable patterns, approaches, and tooling that strengthen future engagements, with the strongest ideas becoming capabilities and products we take to market. You have a track record of designing, building, and delivering complex technology solutions in production environments. While our delivery model may be new to you, we'll bring you up to speed on how we plan, execute, and assure our work. To be successful, you'll have: Architecture and engineering foundations Experience leading architecture and technical delivery for complex software, cloud, or digital transformation initiatives while still building and operating production software. Strong software engineering skills, ideally including Python and TypeScript. Experience designing and delivering cloud-native systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP. AI engineering Hands-on experience building AI applications and agent-based systems in production. Experience with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar technologies, and the judgment to know when an orchestration layer earns its complexity. Experience building retrieval-enabled systems and working with technologies such as pgvector, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch, with an understanding of the trade-offs between retrieval quality, latency, and cost. Architecture and delivery leadership Experience integrating applications with enterprise systems, data platforms, APIs, identity providers, and MCP-enabled services. Experience owning solution architecture for complex technology initiatives, including decomposition, sequencing, and technical decision-making across delivery teams. Strong technical judgment, communication skills, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while working directly with clients and multidisciplinary teams, balancing delivery speed with quality, security, and long-term maintainability. Experience working directly with senior technology stakeholders and credibility discussing solution approaches with engineering leaders and client CTOs. Ideally, you'll also bring: Experience delivering solutions within consulting, professional services, or time as a technical founder. Experience in healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation, or consumer industries. Experience building reusable platforms, tooling, or AI solutions in regulated environments. Hybrid working - our approach is to be in the office or on client site a minimum of 2 days per week. jobs.title: Growth Marketing Consultant - B2B Strategy (Remote)
jobs.jd: About M3: A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry. The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn. M3 Inc. is a publicly traded company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (jp:2413, NIKKEI 225) with subsidiaries in major markets including the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, and China, and in 2020 was ranked in Forbes’ Global 2000 list. The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry. In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India. We are seeking a Growth Marketing Consultant – B2B Strategy to help our businesses develop scalable, targeted marketing strategies that drive qualified sales conversations, client acquisition, and commercial growth. The Growth Marketing Consultant will partner with marketing and business development leaders across M3's subsidiaries to identify growth opportunities, develop effective B2B outreach strategies, and implement campaigns that generate measurable business results. This position combines B2B marketing strategy, persona-drive outbound targeting, multi-channel sequencing, and some hands-on campaign execution. The ideal candidate has experience developing targeted growth programs, identifying key decision-makers within prospective client organizations, and translating market insights into actionable outbound strategies that generate qualified sales opportunities. We are looking for someone who understands how to reach the right decision-makers, develop compelling messaging, and build repeatable marketing programs that convert prospective clients into qualified commercial opportunities. Experience developing outbound marketing and growth strategies for B2B services is particularly relevant, especially healthcare services, professional services, staffing and recruitment, research, or other relationship-driven industries. This is not primarily a paid advertising or traditional digital marketing role. Success requires experience with B2B demand generation, outbound marketing, and sales-aligned growth strategies. Key Responsibilities B2B Growth Strategy & Consulting Partner with marketing and business development leaders across M3’s subsidiaries to identify growth opportunities and build a targeted outbound strategy for each business. Build and own a full digital outreach path for each subsidiary, from identifying decision makers for each product to qualified handoff to the BD team. Define handoff criteria, follow-up cadence, and target account lists with each subsidiary’s BD and marketing leads, and gather their feedback on message performance. Develop a repeatable outbound framework that can be adapted across business units, services, and buyer audiences. Audience Development Define buyer personas and target account segments for each business’s sales activity. Identify the budget owners, decision makers, and influencers at target organizations, and grow contact lists from verified sources and research. Develop personalized messaging that speaks to the priorities of each specific audience, tailored by subsidiary. Convert M3’s proprietary data assets, such as its physician network and health-system relationships, into a repeatable pipeline of qualified conversations through referrals and warm introductions. Outbound Campaign Strategy & Execution Run multi-channel outbound sequences across email, LinkedIn, and other social and digital channels, with messaging tailored to each subsidiary. Design outreach sequences, messaging frameworks, and follow-up strategies that build familiarity before asking for time and generate qualified sales conversations. Test and refine messaging to improve reply rates, positive-reply rates, and pipeline contribution. Marketing Technology & AI Operate each designated business unit’s outreach technology stack (sequencing, Sales Navigator), integrate it with their CRMs, and recommend new or more advanced tools. Use AI-assisted research and personalization to build account and contact intelligence and personalize at scale, with human review and M3 brand standards applied before anything sends. Coordinate with email deliverability specialists on authentication, IP warming, sender reputation, inbox placement testing, list hygiene, and compliance with Google, Yahoo, and Microsoft sender requirements. Performance & Business Impact Report weekly on placement, reply and positive-reply rates, and pipeline sourced by subsidiary and persona. Use the data to retire what doesn’t work and scale what does, and translate results into clear recommendations for business leaders. Identify successful outreach strategies that can be replicated across M3’s subsidiaries. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 7+ years in B2B digital outreach, demand generation, or sales development, including at least 3 years owning persona-based marketing for outbound revenue generation. Demonstrated success reaching senior decision makers at complex B2B organizations. Hands-on experience with sequencing platforms (e.g., Outreach, Apollo, HubSpot Sequences), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, contact enrichment and verification tools, and CRM integration. Experience supporting or consulting for multiple business units, clients, or brands with distinct customers. Ability to identify and verify the true buyer within a target organization (budget owner, decision maker, and influencers), distinguish them from adjacent or easier-to-reach contacts, and maintain a disciplined outreach cadence toward that person without defaulting to volume. Strong writing skills: short, specific, and adaptable by persona and subsidiary brand. Ability to use AI tools for research, personalization, and testing, with sound judgment about accuracy, brand, and disclosure. Working knowledge of CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR/UK GDPR, TCPA, and LinkedIn terms of service as they apply to outbound outreach. Ability to independently manage several concurrent programs, prioritize across businesses, and report clearly to sales and marketing leaders. Analytical fluency with campaign, deliverability, and CRM data; comfortable building simple dashboards. Preferred Qualifications Experience reaching senior decision makers in healthcare or health systems, or experience selling recruitment, staffing, or physician placement services. Understanding of how health systems, medical groups, and staffing firms recruit physicians, and who owns those decisions. Working knowledge of email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI), domain and IP warming, reputation monitoring, and inbox placement testing, and of how Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Proofpoint, Mimecast, and similar filters treat outbound mail. Hands-on experience with deliverability monitoring tools. jobs.title: Fredericksburg, Virginia, US - Strong Communicators Needed for Airbnb Luxe Home Consultant Project

jobs.jd: Location: San Jose, CA (On-site) Job Type: Full-Time Target Candiddate: Recent Graduates & Early-Career Professionals Location: 1245 S Winchester Blvd, San Jose Intended Start Date : Jan 2027 About the Opportunity: Start with families. Learn how to grow an online school. Become a future education leader. At Think Academy, we're looking for ambitious, entrepreneurial early-career talent who want to shape the future of online education. You'll start by working directly with families, understanding students' learning needs, and helping them find the right programs. As you grow, you'll take on broader responsibilities in student recruitment, enrollment growth, and online school operations, with the opportunity to eventually lead a team, academic division, or online education business. Accelerated Development: Hands-on mentorship, cross-functional experience, and performance-based advancement.
