jobs.title: Media Operations Assistant
jobs.jd: Media Operations Assistant About FS&CO FREDERIC is part of F. Schumacher & Co. (FS&CO), the 137-year-old design house behind Schumacher, Patterson Flynn, Backdrop, and Tillett. Frederic Media spans three channels — FREDERIC magazine, fredericmagazine.com, and Frederic Media Books — and is now celebrating its 5th year in print. Frederic is the most refreshing voice in design, an elixir for a more beautiful life. Unfettered by outside noise, our editors embrace the unique and unexpected. Every glossy page becomes a visual feast of the covetable in a magazine born to be collectible. The magazine covers a range of topics that comprise the well-lived life — interior and garden design, architecture, entertainment, art, travel and more. Named after the visionary Frederic Schumacher, who founded F. Schumacher & Co in 1889, Frederic is a must-read for designers and design lovers looking to stay ahead of the curve. This role sits on the Frederic Media team’s Publishing and Sales side and touches all three channels — magazine, website, and books. The day-to-day is ad sales operations, cross-team logistics, events coordination and project management. This role will work closely alongside our editors and across the Schumacher family of brands, so a genuine love of magazines, design, and the printed page matters as much as the operational skill set below. Responsibilities Sales Systems & Ad Operations Create and manage Insertion Order process (IOs), Ad film submissions, and Ad invoices in Magazine Manager and Monday.com our ad sales and CRM systems; stay current on features and updates Maintain weekly Ad Sales Estimates and Positioning trackers, including ad placement within each issue Maintain the Ad Submissions tracker: log ad materials (“film”) as they arrive for each issue and route them to the Art Director, pushing advertisers when materials are running late Assist the Sales Director with mailing printed issues to advertisers, preparing tear sheets (the printed page showing an ad as it ran, sent to advertisers as proof of publication), and prepping for sales meetings Maintain an editorial credit tracker: when a brand’s product — a chair, table, vase, watch, for ex— appears in an editorial photo shoot, that’s a “credit” for the brand. Magazine Production & Distribution Work alongside the Publishing Director and outside agency on preparing print orders (distribution plan) for each quarterly Volume of the magazine Frederic Media Books Work with the Publishing Director to submit book order forms to our book publishing partner, outlining quantity, timing, and details for each order Liaise with The Hub, our fulfillment partner, on book fulfillment and inventory for event use Events Maintain the Events tracker and events calendar, and liaise with the Events team on deliverables — our events include book signings, advertiser-sponsored happenings, and our annual IT List Gala Track book inventory for events, and submit printer order forms to arrange magazine copies needed for events Media Team Operations & Logistics Using Monday.com and Notion, our project management tools, manage calendars, projects, and team tasks across our core trackers: Publishing Strategy (cross-team project status), Production Schedule, the Magazine Timeline (the print schedule for each issue), and Frederic Marketing Weekly Order office supplies and other items as necessary Attend team meetings to collect and convey information, and prepare agendas Organize recurring and external meetings This is a role with a lot of moving pieces at once, across all three Frederic Media channels — several live trackers, a quarterly production cadence, and a web of people across the company who keep things on schedule. Nothing about it is technically complex, but it rewards someone who’s naturally organized and doesn’t let details slip. Requirements Bachelor’s degree, with some exposure to data analysis Strong Excel, Illustrator, and PowerPoint skills; comfort picking up CRM and project-management software (we use Magazine Manager, Monday.com, and Notion) A genuine love of magazines and the printed page, with real interest in design and the broader creative world If you already color-code your calendar, you’ll feel right at home in this job Flexible team player willing to do whatever is necessary to keep office operations flowing smoothly, who looks for opportunities to collaborate Ability to work independently, think creatively to solve problems, and adhere to deadlines Excellent interpersonal skills, including the tact and diplomacy to deal with a variety of colleagues, clients, and vendors Comfortable handling a high volume of assignments and working confidently within a small staff Detail-oriented, with strong organizational skills and a knack for problem-solving Proven ability to multi-task and prioritize A calm, steady presence under pressure A track record of dependability and a superior ability to take direction and execute well Represents the company positively through manners annd actions We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical and mental disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/assignment, citizenship, pregnancy or maternity, protected veteran status, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law. Salary Range $60,000 — $65,000 USD

jobs.title: Jr Oracle Cloud Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Consultant
jobs.jd: At i360technologies, we deliver business consulting and technology solutions that support the mission of federal agencies. A major federal agency is consolidating its core financial management systems into a single, multi-tenant Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP solution as part of the government-wide push to standardize federal financial management. The program will migrate multiple agency components and customer agencies onto the new platform, with a stated goal of making maximum use of automation and artificial intelligence to reduce manual workload, speed reconciliation and improve data quality. i360technologies supports this program as a subcontractor to a large federal systems integrator. We are seeking a motivated, early-career Oracle Cloud Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Analyst who uses AI to bridge knowledge gaps and learn fast. You will help configure, test, deploy, and support Oracle Fusion Cloud procurement and payables capabilities in a complex federal financial environment. If you have some hands-on Oracle P2P experience, take initiative, and want to grow into a senior consultant on a program of this size, this role is built for you. This is one of the largest federal financial modernization efforts underway, and you’ll be part of it from the start, building skills on a high-profile program most early-career consultants never get access to. Location: Washington, DC Metro, on-site at client facilities; occasional travel to other client locations. Why AI Matters Here AI is central to how this team delivers. You won’t know everything on day one, and we don’t expect you to. We want analysts who use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to bridge their own knowledge gaps: learning Oracle Fusion Cloud setups, P2P processes, and federal financial rules they haven’t worked with yet, then turning that learning into real work such as configurations, documentation, and test scripts. Be ready to show us a time you used AI to learn something new fast and how you checked that what it told you was right. You will use only client-approved AI tools and never enter client data, financial records, or other sensitive information into public AI tools. What You Will Do Help configure and support Oracle Fusion Cloud P2P functionality. Support Procurement, Purchasing, Self Service Procurement, Supplier Management, Payables, Payments, and related functionality. Participate in requirements and fit-gap workshops with financial and procurement stakeholders. Help translate business requirements into Oracle Cloud configurations and functional designs. Configure approval rules, purchasing controls, supplier setups, invoice processing, matching, and payment options with guidance from senior consultants. Support integration of P2P processes with GL, Fixed Assets, Projects, Budgetary Control, and external systems. Help draft functional specifications for integrations, conversions, reports, and extensions. Support data conversion and validation. Write and execute SIT/UAT test scripts and help resolve functional defects. Support deployment, cutover, training, and post-production stabilization. Document configurations, business processes, SOPs, and controls. Use AI tools to speed up your learning, documentation, and testing, and learn from senior consultants on the team. Required Qualifications 5 years of overall professional experience, including 2+ years of Oracle ERP Procurement or Payables 2+ years of Oracle ERP Procurement or Payables experience, as a consultant, analyst, implementation team member, or power user. Hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud Procurement and/or Payables experience (Oracle EBS experience with Fusion Cloud training or certification will be considered). Understanding of end-to-end P2P processes: requisitions, purchase orders, receiving, invoice matching, and payments. Familiarity with Oracle approval workflows/BPM. Exposure to FBDI, OTBI/BIP, interfaces, or conversions from a functional perspective. Experience writing or executing SIT/UAT test scripts. Demonstrated use of AI tools to learn unfamiliar systems, processes, or rules quickly and apply that learning to real work. A track record of taking initiative to learn on your own, such as certifications, self-study, or volunteering for new work on a project. What You'll Gain A seat on one of the largest federal financial modernization programs, from the ground floor. Mentorship from senior Oracle P2P and federal financial management specialists. A career path that grows with the program: more scope, more responsibility, more expertise each year. In-demand skills in Oracle Fusion Cloud P2P and AI-enabled delivery. What Success Looks Like Configurations and documentation you own are accurate and delivered on schedule. You capture clear requirements and process notes from fit-gap workshops. Your test scripts are thorough, and defects you find are documented and resolved quickly. You close your own knowledge gaps quickly with AI and verify what it gives you, so you need less direction each month. Security & Eligibility Requirements Ability to obtain and maintain Public Trust eligibility (background investigation required) Must be a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident with at least 3 of the last 5 years of U.S. residency. Sponsorship is not available now or in the future. Work must be performed within the United States (remote access from foreign locations is not permitted) Benefits Referral Bonus (401k) Matching Holidays – Eleven Technology Reimbursement Short-Term & Long-Term Disability Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D) Paid Time Off (0-3 years - 15 Days PTO | 3+ years 20 Days) 80% Employer Paid Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision) Equal Opportunity Employer Minority/Female/Veteran/Disability All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or status within any other protected group. Only direct applicants will be considered. Submissions from recruiting or staffing firms will not be accepted.

jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.jd: About Nuance Labs Nuance Labs is building photorealistic, real-time AI avatars with emotional intelligence: a full-duplex audiovisual system that can listen, speak, react, interrupt, and respond like a real person. We're a research company, with PhDs from MIT, UW, Oxford, CMU, and Johns Hopkins, and industry experience from Apple, Meta, Amazon AGI, and more. Backed by Accel, Lightspeed, South Park Commons, and NVIDIA, we combine frontier research with ruthless engineering needed for consumer-grade, real-time systems. The team is small, the work is real, and the problems are unsolved. How Nuance Differentiates Most conversational AI avatars today are hacks — a face slapped on a speech-to-speech pipeline, stuck in the uncanny valley: emotionless, mechanical, one-turn-at-a-time. Current systems take 2–5 seconds to respond; natural conversation requires sub-500ms. That's a 10x improvement, and it demands rethinking the entire stack. That rethinking starts with full-duplex: an AI that listens and speaks simultaneously, perceives emotion in real time, and responds with a face that actually reflects it. It's an extremely hard problem, and we're developing foundation models designed for it from the ground up. About the Role We’re looking for a Business Operations Associate to help Nuance Labs run smoothly day-to-day and build the foundation for the next stage of growth. You’ll own our day-to-day finance operations, from expense tracking and vendor payments to month-end close. Beyond finance, you’ll take on cross-functional and special projects across the company. This is a hands-on role with an emphasis on reliable finance execution and practical problem-solving wherever the business needs it most. What You’ll Own Day-to-day finance, including expense tracking, month-end close with our external accountant, and finding ways to make our spend smarter. Cross-functional projects from start to finish. Internal communication systems that keep the team aligned as we scale. New processes and systems built from scratch as the company grows. What We’re Looking For Bring 1–4 years of experience in finance, consulting, or startup operations, with a proven ability to tackle unstructured problems and deliver results. Care deeply about building teams and shaping a positive and high-performing culture. Are resourceful in navigating finance, HR, and other processes — able to build order where none exists. Can partner closely with the team to turn vague needs (and sometimes half-baked ideas) into structured processes, anticipating problems and solutions before they’re spelled out. Enjoy wearing multiple hats and thrive in a small, ambitious, high-trust team. Compensation $90,000-$135,000 base salary, plus meaningful equity. We think long-term ownership matters and structure equity accordingly. Logistics Location: In-person in Seattle, five days a week — we believe in the compounding value of working shoulder-to-shoulder. Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas (O-1, H-1B, green card, etc.) from day one. AI-native tooling: Do your best work with the best tools, including unlimited tokens. Benefits & Perks Health: We offer a variety of plans that meet your needs, including an HDHP with ~$2,000 in annual HSA contributions by the company (roughly 2x what most big tech companies put in). Wellness: $2,000/yr to spend on gym memberships, fitness equipment, training/coaching, classes, and more. Work setup: One-time $500 to spend on any tech or accessories that you might need to optimize your workflow. Time off: 15 days of PTO, 10 public holidays, and we close the office for a full week at year-end. Culture: Quarterly events, annual retreat, holiday party, etc. Food: Lunch, drinks, and snacks on us every workday. We observe boba tea Tuesdays and Thursdays. Commuter benefits: Utilize pre-tax money (up to $340/month) for parking and transportation. 401(k): 4% match (100% of 1st 3% + 50% of next 2% contributions). Nuance Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better AI.

jobs.title: Meteorologist (Launch Operations)
jobs.jd: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. METEOROLOGIST (LAUNCH OPERATIONS) RESPONSIBILITIES Serve as Launch Weather Officer (LWO) for orbital launch, return-to-launch-site, re-entry, recovery, and test operations—owning weather workflows from forecast, balloon, and sensor data through countdown, launch commit criteria, contingency response, and post-flight data review Develop new decision-support forecast tools, integrate probabilistic forecast information into operator tools, and train operators and end-users of forecasts Improve launch availability by developing new weather tools, improving launch commit criteria, and coordination with SpaceX launch operations and the external weather stakeholders that support launch and re-entry operations Lead projects on weather-sensor architecture, numerical weather prediction tools, launch commit criteria, including NASA LLCCs, and marine/recovery weather Generate rocket launch, landing, and recovery forecasts against vehicle constraints, NASA Lightning Launch Commit Criteria (NASA-STD-4010), and 14 CFR Part 450 weather requirements Conduct numerical weather prediction analysis and testing; interpret model guidance (NBM, GFS, RRFS, CMC, ECMWF, GraphCast, HAFS, and other AI and ensemble variants) against measured conditions and communicate results to launch/flight control, pad operations, recovery, and leadership Drive requirements, procurement, calibration, installation, quality control, and operational use of mesonets, electric-field mills, radar, weather balloons, and related instrumentation Integrate the weather sensor suite and gridded model data into automation, dashboards, and decision-support tools Collaborate closely with peers, operators, Range, Recovery, Flight Safety, and external stakeholders to ensure reliable launch-weather support and drive initiatives that support Starship launch-rate growth Support Dragon undock, re-entry, and splashdown weather, and marine forecasts for Atlantic, Gulf, and Pacific recovery and vessel operations Provide nowcasts and alerts for hazardous weather including severe thunderstorms, lightning, tropical cyclones, flooding, marine, and heat risks Represent SpaceX with NASA, United States Space Force range weather organizations, National Weather Service, and other core partners Interface with NASA Lightning Advisory Panel, FAA Common Standards Working Group, and other university research to operations groups to drive improvement in LLCC constraints for all launch and re-entry vehicles Travel to and operate from Cape Canaveral, Vandenberg, Starbase, Hawthorne, and other launch/test/development sites as missions and projects require BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in meteorology, atmospheric science, or other nature science discipline 3+ years of professional experience in operational forecasting, launch/range weather, numerical weather prediction, or weather decision support PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE Experience as a Launch Weather Officer, range weather officer, or equivalent for orbital launch, aviation, or marine weather operations Experience presenting impact-based decision support forecasting to executive leadership and/or key decision-makers in operations Demonstrated experience communicating high-risk weather impacts on operations to executive leadership and key decision-makers; includes hurricanes, severe weather, launch forecasting, flooding, and other Impact-based Decision Support Services (IDSS) functions Combination of training and experience that has led to qualification as a forecaster by the National Weather Service or a U.S. or NATO military authority Familiarity with NASA Lightning Launch Commit Criteria (NASA-STD-4010) and 14 CFR Part 450 weather constraints Experience with weather sensors (mesonets, electric-field mills, radar, weather balloons) from requirements through procurement, installation, calibration, and operational use Experience conducting model and forecast verification and familiarity with probabilistic modeling techniques Familiarity with Linux, Python, JavaScript, InfluxDB, Grafana, or similar tools, and the ability to integrate gridded model data into weather communication tools AI-assisted programming or scripting associated with weather-sensor integration and automation Marine forecasting experience, including routing or recovery decision support Background coordinating multi-vehicle or multi-site operations (orbital launch, RTLS, droneship or marine recovery, crew/cargo re-entry, or test flights) in a high-tempo environment Experience writing procedures, training, and briefings for operators and external stakeholders; comfort owning documentation and process reliability Experience building training or qualification programs for operations personnel Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance Strong communication, emotional intelligence, and patience when negotiating difficult outcomes with partners under schedule pressure Problem-solving and critical thinking skills with comfort changing roles rapidly in a high-paced environment Development and maintaining training, qualification, and onboarding programs for Launch Weather Officers and meteorology support, including off-nominal, severe-weather, and hurricane operations ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Vandenberg and Cape Canaveral Ability to work at elevated heights and/or in tight spaces as needed for sensor or balloon operations Must be willing to travel, including extended periods at Cape Canaveral, Vandenberg, Starbase, and other sites Must be available to work extended hours, nights, weekends, and holidays when required by mission milestones ITAR REQUIREMENTS: To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here . SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

jobs.title: Research Participants - 100% Remote
jobs.jd: Survey Participant - UK Resident (Task-Based, Remote, Flexible) Location: Remote (UK) Type of contract: Freelance Hourly Rate: £19 (pay based on actual study time) About Prolific Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills. The Role Do you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews.We’re inviting UK residents to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change.Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal. The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can. What you’ll be doing Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part What you’ll bring Residence in the UK Fluent English A device with a working microphone No specialist background or qualifications required, all backgrounds are welcomed. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population. Why join this project? This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution. Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities. Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home. We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity. Links to more information on Prolific Website Youtube Privacy Statement By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.

jobs.title: Associate, New Verticals - Fulfillment Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Washington, D.C; Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, CA;
jobs.jd: About the Team New Verticals is an exciting team at DoorDash that is building and scaling new ways to delight our customers beyond restaurant deliveries (e.g., Grocery, Convenience, Alcohol, Retail). Our Catalog, Fulfillment and Logistics team has three major mandates to effectively onboard merchants, fulfill every order with speed & accuracy and improve our logistics network. We are able to do this by identifying efficiencies, building product toolings and launching operational processes at scale. You will own metrics, pull operational & product levers and drive impactful results across our Grocery, Convenience, Alcohol and Retail businesses. About the Role We are expanding our Fulfillment team by hiring an Associate. You will test, iterate and scale product features and operational initiatives to ensure our merchants are fulfilling orders with speed and high quality. You will sit in the Fulfillment, Logistics & Catalog group within our New Verticals Strategy & Operations organization. This is an individual contributor position. You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… Analyze: You love working with data and using data to drive business decision-making. You love talking to customers, unpacking their feedback, and coming up with improvement opportunities. Strategize: You will own and deliver on improving key metrics. You will create quarterly and annual plans that push our business forward and are aligned with our product capabilities. You will help these teams identify opportunities for enhancing our existing product offering and methods to improve delivery quality. Lead : You will help lead cross-functional work streams of Engineers, Data Scientists and Designers to develop best in class product features that will enhance the quality of New Vertical deliveries Own: You love owning problems end-to-end. You display ownership for the products and business lines that you are responsible for. You never shy away from raising your hand to solve ambiguous problems and are able to motivate and empower your teammates to go above and beyond. We’re excited about you because… You’re analytical. You have a data-driven mindset, live and breathe numbers, and use them to understand problems and tell stories. You’re very comfortable using Excel and visualizing data; you ideally have SQL experience! You have 1-3+ years of experience. Ideally in consulting, strategy, operations, technology, banking, food & beverage, high-growth startups, etc. You solve problems from first principles. You’re excited to think innovatively, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking. You’re equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot. You don’t hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you’re just as comfortable thinking long-term and inspiring a team. You have a completed Bachelor’s Degree. Compensation Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location. DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others. To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here . See below for paid time off details: For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year. For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week). The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado. $74,800 — $110,000 USD About DoorDash At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.jd:
About us
At Provectus, you don’t prototype in a sandbox and hand a client a slide deck. You embed inside a bank, an insurer, or a health system, learn the work, and ship a Claude + AWS system into their real, regulated production — then you watch the business number move. We’re an Anthropic and AWS Partner with 150+ certified architects. That means the newest models, real budgets, and problems that matter — without the layers, politics, and years-to-impact of a hundred-thousand-person firm. 350+ builders, 100+ customers in production, founder-led since 2010, offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA. 
Why Provectus
Frontier access — Anthropic Preferred Partner: newest Claude models, real budgets, real problems.
Real tasks (not scope), real deployment. You go where the operating problem is and ship production code to real users, not slide decks that sit in a drive. 
Embedded, not engaged. You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process — not a vendor running a project alongside it. Embedded is not staff-augmented.
Autonomous. You own the work from framing through to production, visible to clients and founders.  You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket.
Your experience stays portable. Every engagement is a new problem, often in a new industry, so your skills compound instead of narrowing to one product. No legacy-maintenance grind, not a single stack.
Craft & growth — build beside senior FDEs on a Claude-certified team; a real platform (talks, OSS) to grow your name.
We give you a stage: Claude certification, conference talks, open-source contributions, published work under your own name.
 Spend the first weeks of each engagement in the operator’s seat, learning the constraints from the inside, then rebuild the function from first principles alongside the client and a Forward Deployed Executive — and you are the one who builds it. Be part of the customer’s team, inside their process; work on real tasks, not scoped deliverables, and own the method autonomously. You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry Blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. Deliver across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare. Help shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment; help build the tooling and frameworks of a growing AI delivery practice. Typically 7+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands-on today and intend to stay that way. Genuinely willing to spend time understanding someone else’s job before writing code; demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly. Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production — not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works. You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why. Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack. Cloud-native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus), including the operational reality of a system someone else inherits. Pre-sales experience. Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room. Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job. Hands-on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork (skills, workflows, MCP, integrations, connectors, custom harnesses). Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and CI/CD in production. IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform. Open-source contributions or public writing on applied AI. Full-time. On-site visits to client’s facilities and our office in NYC 1/week Unlimited Vacation policy. Generous health, vision, and dental insurance. 401(K) matching plan. Base salary $180k–$200k + bonuses; OTE up to $250k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data. *No Visa sponsorship A person reads your application. We filter out AI-generated and fraudulent submissions automatically. Every application that clears that filter is read by someone on our team. We may ask for a quick ID verification. Fraudulent applications are common, and this protects real candidates. You’ll meet the people you’d work with. We host AI engineering events in New York and San Francisco. We'd be happy to talk in person. Your interviews are with Pavel Borobov, Solutions Architect, and Stepan Pushkarev, Co-Founder & CEO. Recruitment interview. Tech interview with our FDE (30 min). A live engineering building session (1.5 hours). We hand you a business function and the constraints. You have to understand the job and rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. Use AI the way you normally would; we expect AI-generated code. What we look at is how you used AI, the judgment behind your choices, and what you researched beyond what any LLM already knows. Soft skills interview. Offer discussion.

jobs.title: Vice President, FP&A & Financial Transformation
jobs.jd:
THE OPPORTUNITY

insitro is looking for a senior finance leader to build and run our FP&A function, and to take what is already an AI-forward finance capability into the next generation of FP&A. We've done the work of embedding AI across finance; this role owns taking that foundation further so the business has seamless access to information and makes faster, better-informed decisions.

Your year-one priorities: move us from a bi-annual budget to a rolling quarterly forecast; make scenario planning routine enough that the Executive Team sees the budget impact of a decision in days, not weeks; extend our AI-enabled, self-serve FP&A capability; and tighten the partnership with Accounting so planning, close, and reporting run as one system.

You'll own the company-wide budget and forecast, the headcount and compensation model, and the financial materials for the Executive Team and Board, and you'll present directly to the Board. You'll partner closely with Research, Platform, Clinical Development, People, and G&A, serve as a standing partner to Accounting leadership, and work tightly with Investor Relations, Corporate Strategic Finance, and Corporate Development to keep the internal plan and the external financial narrative consistent.

Based in South San Francisco, this position reports to the CFO, leads the FP&A team (today, our Director of R&D and Clinical FP&A), and offers an in-person hybrid schedule of three days per week, on average.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

Planning, Forecasting & Scenario Analysis

 - Own the Planning Cycle: Run the planning calendar end to end, covering the annual operating plan, quarterly reforecasts, and the long-range plan.

 - Rolling Forecast: Lead the shift from a bi-annual budget to a rolling quarterly forecast.

 - Bottom-Up Budget: Build the annual budget across Research, Platform and Compute, Clinical Development, lab operations, and G&A.

 - Scenario Planning: Make scenario planning a standing capability that quantifies the budget impact of decisions before commitments are made.

Next-Generation FP&A & Finance Systems

 - Systems Roadmap: Own insitro's finance systems roadmap for planning and analysis, including how Oracle Cloud ERP is configured and used across finance alongside ongoing integration of LLM-based tools and potential onboarding of an FP&A solution.

 - Scale AI-Enabled FP&A: Use LLM-based tools directly in your own work and turn strong individual practices into durable, team-wide capability.

 - Automate & Integrate: Automate management packages, scorecards, and variance reports, and work with IT and Accounting so Oracle, the data warehouse, and AI tooling form one architecture.

 - Self-Serve Access: Give cost center managers and project leads dashboards and data access so they can make decisions without waiting on FP&A.

Business & Accounting Partnership

 - R&D, Clinical & Compute Finance: Translate Research, Platform, and clinical plans into cost, headcount, and timeline models, covering trial costs, CRO/CMO spend, cloud and GPU commitments, and build-vs-buy decisions.

 - Portfolio & Headcount Decisions: Bring program-level cost visibility into portfolio decisions, including insitro Decision Boards (iDBs), and partner with People on requisition sequencing and headcount governance.

 - Partner to Accounting: Co-own the data model, chart of accounts governance, controls alignment, and close-cycle responsibilities to support Accounting leadership as we mature toward public-company standards.

Leadership, Board & Investor Relations

 - Lead the Team: Lead and grow the FP&A team and advise the CFO on finance org design and future hiring.

 - Board & Executive Reporting: Own the Executive Team and Board financial materials, and personally present budget, forecast, and variance drivers to the Board and Audit Committee.

 - One Financial Narrative: Partner with Investor Relations, Corporate Strategic Finance, and Corporate Development to keep the operating plan, guidance, capital allocation, and deal modeling consistent.




ABOUT YOU

Experience & Qualifications

 - Proven Tenure: 12+ years of FP&A/finance experience in biotech or life sciences, including owning a full planning cycle end to end.

 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

 - FP&A Builder: Track record of building an FP&A function, including standing up a planning system, moving to a rolling forecast, and automating reporting.

 - Board & Public Company: Experience presenting at the Board and Audit Committee level, plus public-company experience with SEC reporting cycles and guidance-setting.

 - IPO Readiness: IPO preparation experience, with a working understanding of public-company planning and reporting discipline.

 - Clinical & Technical Accounting: Clinical development finance experience (trial cost modeling, CRO/vendor management, accruals) and working knowledge of the R&D accounting judgments that shape the forecast (e.g., ASC 730, ASC 808).

 - Systems & Tools: Hands-on experience with an enterprise planning platform, strong knowledge of Oracle Cloud ERP/EPM or equivalent, and strong modeling and presentation skills in Excel, think-cell, and Google Workspace.

 - AI at Team Scale: Track record of scaling AI/LLM-enabled capability across a finance team, beyond personal use.

 - People Leadership: Experience leading finance teams, including managing senior individual contributors.

Core Competencies

 - Translator: You build credibility with technical leaders who don't think in financial terms.

 - AI Enthusiast: You're energized by using LLMs and AI tools to improve the work, and you bring your team along.

 - Get Things Done: You prioritize and advance multiple projects under real constraints.

 - Engage with Respect: You understand the needs of insitro teams and leaders in every interaction.

 - Own the Outcome: You take ownership of problems and of the systems that keep them solved.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Advanced Credentials: An MBA, CFA, or CPA, or a consulting background.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS AT INSITRO

jobs.title: AI Finance Researcher (MBA Student)
jobs.jd:
AI FINANCE RESEARCHER (MBA STUDENT)




ABOUT THE ROLE

AI systems are becoming increasingly capable of building financial models, analyzing business performance, and generating investment research. Yet complex financial decisions still demand the experience, critical thinking, and professional judgment of seasoned finance experts.

At Julius Research, we're recruiting exceptional MBA students with professional experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Investment Banking (IB), Private Equity (PE), Venture Capital (VC), Hedge Funds, Corporate Finance, Asset Management, or Equity Research.

Your primary responsibility will be to create sophisticated financial challenges that test the limits of frontier AI models.

Your work will expose weaknesses in today's leading AI systems and contribute to improving their financial reasoning capabilities.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design expert-level financial research and analysis tasks inspired by real-world finance and investment workflows.

 - Create complex financial modeling challenges involving DCF valuations, LBOs, three-statement models, forecasting, budgeting, and scenario analysis.

 - Develop realistic FP&A problems involving revenue forecasting, budget variance analysis, cash flow planning, unit economics, and business performance evaluation.

 - Construct investment research scenarios involving M&A, company valuation, market analysis, investment due diligence, and capital allocation decisions.

 - Design multi-stage analytical problems that require interpreting incomplete data, reconciling conflicting information, and making defensible financial judgments.

 - Identify weaknesses in advanced AI models by evaluating their calculations, assumptions, analytical approaches, and financial conclusions.

 - Develop expert solutions, scoring criteria, and research benchmarks to measure AI performance.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Currently enrolled in a Top 25 MBA program (or recent graduate), preferably with a concentration in Finance, Investments, or Corporate Strategy.

 - 2+ years of professional experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Hedge Funds, Asset Management, Equity Research, or related finance roles.

 - Previous experience as an Investment Banking Analyst/Associate, Private Equity Associate, Venture Capital Associate, Investment Analyst, Equity Research Analyst, FP&A Analyst/Manager or Corporate Finance Analyst.

 - Strong understanding of financial statement analysis, financial modeling, forecasting, company valuation, or investment research.

 - Hands-on experience with one or more of the following:
   
   - Investment Banking & Private Equity: DCF valuation, LBO modeling, comparable company analysis, M&A, and transaction due diligence.
   
   - Venture Capital & Growth Equity: Startup valuation, financial projections, market sizing, unit economics, and investment underwriting.
   
   - Hedge Funds & Equity Research: Fundamental research, earnings analysis, financial forecasting, and investment thesis development.
   
   - Corporate Finance & FP&A: Budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial planning, management reporting, and three-statement modeling.

 - Excellent quantitative reasoning, problem-solving, written communication, and attention to detail.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience at a leading investment bank, private equity firm, venture capital fund, hedge fund, Fortune 500 finance team, or high-growth technology company.

 - Proficiency in Excel financial modeling and tools such as Capital IQ, Bloomberg, FactSet, PitchBook, or financial planning software.

 - Interest in artificial intelligence, large language models (LLMs), and AI applications in financial services.

jobs.title: Security Architect, AI Infrastructure
jobs.jd:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

 - Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

 - Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own the attack surface unique to frontier compute: model weights custody, training environment isolation, accelerator and interconnect security, and multi-tenant boundaries under real adversarial pressure.

 - Design the reference architectures and standards that security engineering builds to, keeping the seam between design and build clean enough that both sides move fast.

 - Treat the workload as part of the threat model, and architect environments that stay defensible even when the thing running inside them is the adversary.

 - Run security design review for the systems that touch training and inference environments, from bare metal and fabric to scheduler and storage.

 - Track where frontier compute is going (new accelerators, interconnect generations, confidential computing, agentic workloads) and have the architecture ready before it lands.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've secured AI, ML, or HPC infrastructure where the assets were genuinely worth stealing: lab infrastructure security, supercomputing centers, or research environments that drew nation-state attention.

 - You can architect isolation at every layer it exists: hardware, firmware, hypervisor, kernel, container, network fabric, and physical.

 - You understand AI compute infrastructure as a system (accelerators, high-speed interconnects, parallel storage, schedulers) and know where each component breaks a classical security assumption.

 - You've done original work in systems or ML security, published or shipped, and can turn research into architecture that engineers actually build.

 - You defend design decisions in review on their merits, and change them when someone closer to the metal proves you wrong.

 - Bonus: Confidential computing and attestation depth. Weights custody or cryptographic key custody at scale. A publication record in systems or ML security.

jobs.title: Business Data Analyst
jobs.jd:
WHAT THE ROLE DOES

Turn data into better product decisions.

As a Business Data Analyst, you will partner with Product Owners to design experiments, analyze customer behaviour, and turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Your work will influence product roadmaps across key customer journeys, including conversion, engagement, and renewals.

You will go beyond reporting results. You will apply statistical rigour, investigate unexpected findings, challenge assumptions constructively, and uncover opportunities that improve the customer experience and business performance. This role is for a curious, proactive analyst who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of analytical initiatives, and turns insights into meaningful action to uncover opportunities and strengthen how we measure, report, and make decisions across the business.

This is a full-time, permanent position working 37.5 hours per week, with the option to work hybrid from our Edmonton, Alberta office.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Collaborate with Product Owners to design and plan experiments, define requirements, assumptions, and limitations

 - Explore and analyze experiment data to understand customer behaviour, usage patterns, and performance drivers

 - Lead multiple analytical initiatives, using findings to recommend clear next steps and inform priorities

 - Conduct deep dive analyses to uncover customer behaviour trends, friction points, and growth opportunities

 - Use AI tools to research internal documentation and tools, support SQL and code development, and review analytical work efficiently

 - Build dashboards and automated reports to improve accessibility and insight quality

 - Translate business questions into measurable metrics

 - Deliver data based recommendations and clearly identify actionable next steps

 - Improve tracking plans, event quality, and attribution logic to ensure accurate and reliable measurement

 - Write and optimize SQL queries and notebooks to support analysis

 - Communicate data analysis results, insights, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders

 - Collaborate with fellow analysts to review results, refine methodologies, and strengthen analytical approaches


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 3+ years of experience in data analysis, product analytics, or data science

 - Strong statistical judgment, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, sample size and power considerations, and the ability to distinguish meaningful findings from noise

 - Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex analysis clearly

 - Solid understanding of statistics and experiment analysis

 - Proficiency in SQL, including writing efficient queries with joins, aggregations, and filtering logic

 - Knowledge of data mining and segmentation techniques

 - Familiarity with Python for data analysis and visualization (ex. pandas, Matplotlib)

 - Ability to manage multiple experiments and analyses simultaneously

 - Proficiency using Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Visualizations, Formulas)

jobs.title: Jr Controllership Analyst - Brazil
jobs.jd:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the backbone to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

The Role
As a Junior Controllership Analyst, you will be part of the team that ensures the quality of ARQ’s accounting and financial information across multiple geographies, with an initial focus on Brazil. With support and mentorship from the senior team and local controllers, you will take part in day-to-day accounting and the monthly close, reconciliations, and regulatory reporting, learning first-hand how a regulated fintech operates at scale and across different jurisdictions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to grow fast in a highly complex environment, with international exposure and constant learning.

What you’ll be doing

 - Journal Entries & Month-End Close: Prepare journal entries and support the monthly close of the group’s entities across more than one geography, following the calendar and routines defined by the team.

 - Reconciliations: Perform bank, general ledger, and customer balance reconciliations, identifying differences and supporting the investigation and resolution of open items.

 - Regulatory Reporting: Support the preparation and validation of documents and reports to local regulators (such as CADOCs to the Central Bank in Brazil), together with the senior team.

 - Financial Statements: Support the preparation of trial balances and financial statements for the group’s entities, including notes to the financial statements, and assist with requests from the local external audits and the consolidated audit.

 - Tax Obligations & Intercompany: Support accounting-to-tax reconciliations, tax and withholding tracking, and the recording of intercompany transactions between group entities.

 - Local Accounting Standards & Consolidation: Support the understanding of differences between each country’s accounting practices (such as Brazilian GAAP/CPC, US GAAP, and IFRS) and the preparation of information for the group consolidation.

 - Process Improvement: Help document routines and identify automation opportunities, working with Finance, Product, and Data.


What you’ll need

 - Degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field (final year or completed)

 - 1 to 2 years of experience in accounting or controllership (internships count)

 - Basic knowledge of statutory accounting and Brazilian accounting practices (CPC)

 - Intermediate Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, reconciliations)

 - Organization, attention to detail, and commitment to deadlines

 - Eagerness to learn and to work at a fast pace

 - Intermediate English


Nice-to-haves

 - Experience in a financial institution, fintech, consulting, or audit

 - Familiarity with COSIF, CADOC, and Central Bank regulation

 - Familiarity with US GAAP, IFRS, or accounting in other Latin American countries

 - Familiarity with accounting ERPs and data tools (SQL, Power BI)

 - Knowledge of payments, FX, or digital asset products

 - Postgraduate degree, MBA, or certifications in progress (CRC, IFRS)

jobs.title: Data Product Consultant
jobs.jd:
What You'll Do:

The Data Product Consultant (DPC) is the technical lead for a portfolio of Nexxen enterprise clients, from onboarding through ongoing support. The DPC gets client and partner data into the Nexxen platform, keeps integrations and data deliveries working, and resolves technical issues through to the fix. The DPC is the technical partner to Sales, Account Management and Product, and represents the client's needs to Product and Engineering.

As part of Nexxen's Technical Services organization, the DPC works the team's inbound request queue against standard SLAs. With guidance from team leadership, the DPC recommends data onboarding approaches that meet each client's business goals. The role suits someone who is curious, thinks clearly when something breaks, and can explain technical topics to both business and technical audiences. This role will be based in the Chicago/LA/NYC office. Our team follows a hybrid schedule working in-office three days a week and remotely for the rest. This is an exempt position.



Responsibilities

Data onboarding and integrations

 - With team leadership support, recommend and carry out data onboarding strategies for a portfolio of accounts: 1P/CRM audience files, CRM connectors (e.g. HubSpot), hashed email, data-collection pixels, and ID syncs.

 - Set up measurement and attribution integrations, including offline-sales and footfall beacons and endpoints, server-to-server events and MMP connections.

 - Configure and maintain log-level data exports to client destinations (S3, SFTP), including fields, schemas, cadence and test deliveries.

 - Support clients and agencies integrating with Nexxen's APIs: credentials, market access, setup questions and first-line troubleshooting.

 - Support clients adopting Nexxen's AI and MCP tools during technical setup and access.

Troubleshooting and escalation

 - Identify, reproduce and document defects and client-requested enhancements in Jira, and track them with Product and Engineering through to resolution.

 - Work inbound requests from the Technical Services queue within standard SLAs.

Analysis and documentation

 - Write SQL to validate data, investigate issues and produce client analyses (e.g. match-backs, match-rate and ID analysis).

 - Develop and maintain technical design documents, project scope documents and issues lists.

 - Apply Nexxen data-handling and privacy rules to client deliveries

Client and cross-functional partnership

 - Help clients use new and existing Nexxen data products, and support Account Management in client trainings and business reviews.

What You'll Bring:

 - Programmatic advertising experience, including how audience data, identity and measurement work in a DSP.

 - Client-facing experience, including handling sensitive client issues with care.

 - Strong problem-solving and communication skills; can explain technical topics to business and technical audiences.

 - Organized and dependable with a high volume of concurrent requests and deadlines.

 - Bachelor's degree in a technical, analytical or quantitative field.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Specialist
jobs.jd:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.




THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Specialist to join our growing US team and help make it easier for our commercial teams to do their best work. 



You'll sit close to Sales and be the person they turn to when something in the deal cycle isn't clear — from opportunities and quotes to renewals, amendments, and the more unusual scenarios that don't fit a template. You'll troubleshoot issues, catch and fix mistakes before they cause problems downstream, and jump on calls with sellers when a deal needs a second pair of eyes in real time.

You'll also help keep our commercial data clean and reliable in Salesforce — spotting and merging duplicates, keeping account hierarchies accurate, and helping shape the rules and processes that prevent these issues in the first place.

Beyond day-to-day deal support, you'll spot the patterns in what Sales is asking for and feed those back as concrete process, tooling and enablement improvements. This is a hands-on role, but one with real room to grow: as you build depth across Salesforce and our wider revenue tech stack, you'll take on more analytical and strategic work — from reporting and systems projects to cross-functional initiatives with Finance, Legal, Customer Success, and the wider Revenue Operations team.

It's a great opportunity for someone who already has a solid foundation in RevOps or Sales Operations, enjoys being close to the commercial team, and wants to develop into a well-rounded Revenue Operations professional.

This role requires 3 days in our NYC office.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Support the end-to-end sales process, including opportunities, quoting, renewals, amendments, approvals, and deal support.

 - Act as the first point of contact for Sales on operational questions, helping troubleshoot process and tooling issues and escalating where needed.

 - Review opportunities, quotes, and deal structures for accuracy and completeness.

 - Help maintain and improve data quality in Salesforce — identify and merge duplicate accounts and contacts, ensure correct account hierarchies, and contribute to validation rules, processes and enablement that prevent these issues at source.

 - Apply a strong understanding of SaaS commercial concepts and metrics, including ARR, renewals, expansions, contractions, and deal deltas.

 - Help running ad hoc reporting and analysis for the sales team

 - Support standard and non-standard commercial scenarios using established processes and approval frameworks.

 - Collaborate with Finance, Legal, Customer Success, and the wider Revenue Operations team to help deals move efficiently.

 - Identify recurring operational issues and contribute practical suggestions for process improvement.

 - Maintain clear process documentation and support sales teams in understanding and following established workflows.
   


ABOUT YOU

 - 2+ years experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar commercial operations role, ideally within a SaaS business.

 - Experience supporting sales processes such as opportunity management, quoting, renewals, amendments, and deal execution.

 - Strong familiarity with Salesforce or a similar CRM, with the confidence to navigate tools and investigate issues independently.

 - Working knowledge of Excel formulas to support ad hoc reporting and data analysis.

 - A good understanding of SaaS revenue metrics and commercial deal structures.

 - Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

 - Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with Sales and cross-functional teams.

 - Comfortable working independently within established processes and knowing when to escalate.




OUR BENEFITS

We’re a scaling start up and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people.  We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

 - Competitive Salary: $90,000-$110,000

 - 401(k) (9fin pay 3%, employee contributions are uncapped)

 - Private Health Insurance, with Dental and Vision

 - Paid sick leave

 - Disability Insurance (New York)

 - Commuter Benefit

Time off

 - 25 vacation days per year

 - Local public holiday

 - Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

 - 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

 - Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

 - Professional learning and development budget

 - AI experimentation budget of $1,000 per employee to trial AI tools

 - Bi-annual team socials

 - Summer and Winter company social events
   
   

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.



9fin is an equal opportunities employer 

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

ABOUT SUPERHUMAN

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company's products include Grammarly's writing assistance, Docs’ collaborative workspace, Mail's inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and automatically delivers help. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com http://superhuman.com and about our values here https://superhuman.com/company/values.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Want to use data science to shape how one of the most beloved productivity products in the world grows, retains, and delights its users? This Data Scientist position is embedded in the Superhuman Mail https://superhuman.com/mail business unit, working alongside Data Engineering, Finance, RevOps, and UX Market Research. Together, you act as one numbers-and-insights team, with a direct line to the leaders setting strategy and a shared mandate to move the metrics that matter.



Superhuman Mail is the fastest, most AI-native email experience ever built. It helps knowledge workers and teams fly through their inbox twice as fast, stay on top of what matters most, and collaborate without friction — saving users four hours every single week. Where email has barely changed in decades, Superhuman Mail is reimagining it from the ground up: AI that drafts replies in your voice, auto-labels and triages incoming messages, surfaces follow-ups before you drop the ball, and can even send emails on your behalf. It serves everyone, from individual professionals to Fortune 500 sales teams, and boasts a deeply loyal user base and a product people genuinely love. The data environment is rich, the growth questions are hard, and the opportunity to drive real impact — on acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion — is enormous.



Your work on Mail is part of a broader platform story. The Superhuman Platform suite includes Grammarly's writing assistance, Mail, Docs, Databases, and Go, our proactive AI assistant. As a compound startup, we're building an integrated suite rather than separate tools — so insights you surface in Mail ripple across the full product portfolio, and cross-product growth loops connect the dots between how users discover, adopt, and expand across the suite. Our products serve both consumers and enterprises, creating an unusually rich data environment. Our user base spans students and knowledge workers, individual users and Fortune 500 companies, universities and global enterprises, across a growing range of languages and markets. That breadth creates no shortage of important questions to own.



This is an opportunity for those drawn to complex, high-stakes growth problems — in a product people are passionate about — who want their work to measurably change outcomes.



What you’ll do

 - Be the embedded data science partner for the Mail core product team — shaping feature strategy, prioritization, and roadmap decisions with evidence, not just fielding ad hoc requests.

 - Define and own the metrics that matter for Mail: activation milestones, engagement depth, retention curves, and the leading indicators that tell us whether a new feature is actually changing how people work in their inbox.

 - Design and run experiments across the Mail product lifecycle — from onboarding and first-week activation to long-term habit formation — and build the measurement frameworks that separate signal from noise.

 - Shape the measurement strategy for Mail's AI features — Auto Drafts, Auto Labels, Auto Archive, Calendar, MCP, and the agentic capabilities on the roadmap — by defining quality frameworks and behavioral metrics that show whether AI is making users genuinely faster and more effective.

 - Figure out what makes Mail sticky: which features drive the deepest engagement, what the activation sequence looks like for users who become power users, and where in the funnel we're leaving value on the table.

 - Partner with product-led and sales-led growth to identify and quantify the levers that turn individual users into team expansions — and surface the product signals that predict conversion and churn.

 - Use data to craft remarkable product moments — turning behavioral insight into smarter onboarding flows, better feature discovery, and engagement nudges that feel natural rather than forced. This includes understanding how features such as Calendar scheduling and MCP-driven workflows change the way users interact with Mail on a day-to-day basis.

 - Communicate findings clearly to PMs, designers, engineers, and executives — from experiment readouts to strategic deep-dives — and help raise the bar on how the Mail team makes decisions with data.

You'll do this alongside product managers, engineers, designers, and ML engineers, and in close partnership with our Experimentation team (running on Statsig), whose platform lets us ship, test, and learn quickly. We think from first principles and stay with the hardest product problems through the messy middle. Mail is a product people are genuinely passionate about — the questions are hard, the feedback loop is fast, and the opportunity to shape how millions of people experience their inbox is real.




QUALIFICATIONS
