jobs.jd: The Red Hat Services team is looking for an AI Architect to design and deliver strategic solutions that solve our clients’ business challenges, through technical leadership, hands-on implementation, and enablement of recommended practices. In this role, you will play a key role as a promoter of the adoption of Red Hat's AI platforms and solutions by using your technical expertise and interpersonal skills. You’ll need to have a balance of solid technical experience, team leadership, awareness of open source, thorough understanding of business processes, and the ability to identify and solve issues at an enterprise level. Red Hat Consulting offers more than just technical expertise. We're strategic advisers who take a big picture view of our customers’ organizations, understand their challenges, and help to overcome them with comprehensive, cost-effective solutions. As part of our team, you'll help customers quickly and strategically achieve value while building enterprise-wide capabilities. Being open is core to our technologies and our consulting approach. We are looking for people excited about working with us and growing their careers at Red Hat. We want to be transparent about what would make you most successful in the role, and if you are excited by reading the job description and feel you are suitable for the part, we encourage you to apply. This position requires candidates to work on-site with clients, so a willingness to travel regularly to customer locations throughout North America is required. Successful applicants must reside in a state where Red Hat is registered to do business and hold an Active Top Secret Clearance ( T S/SCI CI Poly) . What you will do Our customers want to make AI their own: their model, their data, their AI. Help customers make frontier and open models their own Lead model selection, optimization and serving decisions on Red Hat AI: vLLM, llm-d, LLM Compressor, the validated model catalog, and hardware profiles across NVIDIA, AMD and other accelerators. Baseline and reduce inference cost per use case (cost per million tokens, GPU utilization) using GuideLLM benchmarks and recipe-based optimization, and decide with evidence whether to prompt, ground or tune a model for a task. Design portable inference: workloads that move between cloud APIs, on-premises clusters and sovereign environments without re-architecture. Travel weekly, Monday-Thursday, to client locations Ground and evaluate on the customer's terms, in the customer's environment Design evaluation-driven release gates in Eval Hub so a model or agent ships only when the customer's own tests say so. Architect retrieval and context patterns (RAG, knowledge ingestion, permission-aware context) that keep data where it belongs, and know when that work is repeatable and when it is bespoke. Lead sovereign and disconnected deployments of Red Hat AI on OpenShift, including model provenance, signing, AI bills of materials and compliance evidence. Run it as a service, and run operations with it Design and stand up Models-as-a-Service and GPU-as-a-Service on OpenShift AI and Red Hat AI Enterprise: multi-tenancy, the AI gateway, metering, showback and chargeback, self-service accelerator access. Build agentic systems that operate infrastructure through Ansible Automation Platform: patching, CVE remediation, upgrades, supply-chain attestation and incident remediation, with every action passing through RBAC, approval and audit. Apply agent frameworks and protocols as customers use them today (MCP, A2A, OpenAI-compatible APIs, Llama Stack, LangGraph and similar), with identity, policy and observability designed in from the start. Lead the engagement and leave it better Own the architecture and the delivery plan on engagements from two-week baselines to multi-month service builds and lighthouse programs; set the success metric with the customer's sponsor and hold the team to it. Pair with and certify customer engineers so the result keeps running after we leave. Turn each delivery into a reusable asset for the practice: runbooks, reference architectures, harnesses and recipes, and feed product gaps back to Red Hat engineering with evidence. Represent Red Hat's point of view on enterprise AI with CTOs, platform leaders and FinOps teams, and support sellers in scoping results that can be dated with confidence. Provide customer feedback to internal teams to enhance product offerings and services. Lead internal initiatives that foster innovation, efficiency, and growth within the Services business. Continuously learn, grow, and adapt to new skills and technologies Regular travel to client locations, up to weekly according to project needs What you bring 10+ years in enterprise technology, with at least 5 as a hands-on architect or senior consultant delivering in customer environments. Deep, current OpenShift expertise: cluster architecture, GitOps, multi-cluster management, security and observability, GPU-enabled nodes; Red Hat Certified Architect or equivalent demonstrated depth. Production experience with Red Hat AI or its upstreams: OpenShift AI, vLLM, model serving with KServe, model registries and pipelines, and at least one of llm-d, LLM Compressor or Eval Hub. Working knowledge of how enterprises run generative AI today: inference economics, model selection and optimization, RAG and evaluation, agent frameworks and harnesses, MCP, and the governance and cost pressures that shape production decisions. Application development fluency on Kubernetes: containers, APIs, CI/CD and the trusted software supply chain (SBOM, signing, policy gates), in at least one of Python, Go or Java. Automation with Ansible Automation Platform, including event-driven automation, or an equivalent you can map onto it quickly. A record of leading engagements to a measurable result on a date, and of leaving customer teams able to run what you built. Clear writing and speaking for technical and executive audiences; comfortable setting a success metric with a sponsor and reporting against it. Preferred Agent development in production: tool calling, agent identity and delegation, sandboxed execution, agent observability and evaluation; contributions to MCP, A2A, Llama Stack, LangGraph, Kagenti or similar. Experience designing Models-as-a-Service or GPU-as-a-Service for shared platform teams: multi-tenancy, gateways, metering, showback and chargeback, scheduling with Kueue or Run:ai. FinOps for AI: building cost baselines, unit economics per use case, and verifying savings on a customer's own hardware. Sovereign, regulated or disconnected deployments; familiarity with EU AI Act obligations and model provenance requirements. Model customization: fine-tuning and post-training, synthetic data generation, and the judgment to know when prompting or grounding is the better answer. Open source contribution and community standing in projects Red Hat leads or sponsors. Prior forward-deployed, residency or customer-engineering work at a platform or model company. jobs.title: ERP Test Planning Analyst
jobs.jd: With a workforce of over 25,000 people, and opportunities in more than 1,000 different job categories, the City of Philadelphia is the fifth largest city in the United States and one of the largest employers in Southeastern Pennsylvania. As an employer, the City of Philadelphia operates through the guiding principles of service, integrity, respect, accountability, collaboration, diversity and inclusion. Through these principles, we strive to effectively deliver services, to resolve the challenges facing our city, and to make Philadelphia a place where all our residents have the opportunity to reach their potential. The Office of Innovation & Technology (OIT) is the central IT agency for the City of Philadelphia headed by the Chief Information Officer (CIO). OIT oversees all major information and communications technology initiatives for the City of Philadelphia - increasing the effectiveness of the information technology infrastructure, where the services provided are advanced, optimized, and responsive to the needs of the City of Philadelphia’s businesses, residents, and visitors. OIT responsibilities include: identifying the most effective approach for implementing new information technology directions throughout city government; improving the value of the city’s technology assets and the return on the city’s technology investments; ensuring data security continuity; planning for continuing operations in the event of disruption of information technology or communications services; and supporting accountable, efficient and effective government across every city department, board, commission and agency. In partnership with the Office of the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) and the Office of the Director of Finance, the Office of Innovation and Technology (OIT) is undertaking a major Citywide project to modernize core financial, grants, procurement, and supply chain business processes. This project (Optimize Procurement and Accounting Logistics Enterprise Resource Planning and Data Warehouse/Business Intelligence Tool, or “OPAL ERP and DW/BI project”) will replace the existing General Ledger and Procurement systems (i.e. FAMIS, ADPICS, ACIS, PHLContracts, etc.) that support these business processes and will enable the City to realize benefits such as reducing transaction processing time and effort, providing better access to information for reporting and analysis, and making it easier to onboard new employees into these functions. The Test Analyst supports a team responsible for managing testing activities for the OPAL ERP and DW/BI project. Key focus areas include financial and grants testing, as well as procurement and supply chain testing. This permanent exempt position will transition into ongoing maintenance and support work after the project’s completion. The role involves analyzing and refining project requirements, collaborating with implementation consultants on system design, conducting initial user acceptance testing, training City personnel, supporting system integrations with other City applications, and assisting with the phased launch of the software. After deployment, the team will enter an optimization phase to assess performance and implement enhancements. Because the ERP operates as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform, the role will also require continuous support, testing, and training for new functionality released every 3 to 6 months. Essential Functions Throughout the OPAL ERP and DW/BI project, the Test Analyst will: Develop and support detailed test plans and strategies. Coordinate with development teams to ensure thorough testing of modules and applications. Work with functional and OIT counterparts to develop testing workflows, system, integration, user acceptance, and readiness deployment phases. Identify, log, and track defects. Debug and resolve software issues. Oversee quality assurance efforts. Ensure defined standards and processes for software or product testing. Provide feedback and recommendations on software usability and functionality. Participate in design reviews and provide input on requirements, product design, and potential problems. Train the team in software testing best practice. Ensure compliance with general programming best practices, accepted web standards, and those set forth by upstream sources. Provide guidance and support to team members. Completion of a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in information systems, computer engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience; Technical expertise with data reporting tools and programming languages such as SQL, R, or Python;3-5 years of experience with ERP systems, 3rd Party Applications and related integrations. Experience with implementing ERP and/or DW/BI solutions strongly preferred Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Experience supporting system, integration, user acceptance, and dress rehearsal script development. Knowledgeable about software testing tools, processes and methodologies. Able to work through the process of detecting and correcting flawed process steps. Knowledgeable about current state workflows and how these processes will work in the new environment. Knowledgeable of Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Strong problem solving and analytic skills. Some experience formulating test script scenarios: system, integration, user acceptance, and dress rehearsal scripts. Salary cannot exceed $90,000 We’re interested in hiring the best possible candidate for the role. We recognize that experience, education, and qualifications can be attained in a variety of ways and that many skillsets are transferable. If you feel you’re a good fit, please don’t hesitate to apply. Please include: Resume A cover letter Please note: Applications will not be considered without a cover letter. jobs.jd: About Mirantis Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. We are seeking a Consulting Architect with deep expertise in platform engineering, Kubernetes, and AI solutions to help customers design, implement, and optimize open source solutions to support their business objectives. This role is not just about execution—you will have a high degree of autonomy to define direction, shape strategy, and influence the future of cutting-edge technologies. As part of our next-generation innovation and strategy team, you will work on new and innovative products, helping customers adopt open source solutions for cloud infrastructure, AI, and cloud-native computing. You will engage in both pre-sales and post-sales consulting, guiding customers through complex technology decisions, presenting a compelling vision, and driving successful outcomes. We’re looking for someone who thrives in uncertainty, takes risks, and challenges conventional thinking, all while working closely with customers to implement scalable, forward-thinking solutions. What You’ll Do Strategic Customer Engagement & Pre-Sales: Lead visionary discussions with customers, helping them navigate new and evolving open source technologies. Define and shape the direction of Mirantis’ solutions, working closely with colleagues and leaders across the company to align with our strategy. Build relationships with both technical and business audiences, translating emerging technologies into actionable strategies. Solution Delivery & Innovation: Design, Implement, optimize, and troubleshoot cloud-native and AI/ML workloads in Kubernetes and public cloud environments. Help customers scale infrastructure, modernize application architectures, and adopt next-generation AI and cloud solutions. Deliver workshops, training, and enablement programs to accelerate customer adoption of new and emerging technologies. Engage with open source communities, contribute to projects, and advocate for customer needs in upstream development. Proven experience in open source ecosystems (e.g., OpenStack, CNCF, LF AI & Data, OpenInfra). Expertise in Kubernetes and AI/ML platforms (e.g., Kubeflow, Ray, MLflow). Passion for emerging technologies, next-generation cloud strategies, and AI infrastructure. Strong ability to define direction, take ownership, and drive innovation in a rapidly evolving landscape. Hands-on experience with cloud automation, DevOps, and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Helm). Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence both engineers and executives. Experience in pre-sales, solutions architecture, or professional services with a consultative approach. Preferred Qualifications Active contributions to open source projects, working groups, or governance bodies. Experience speaking at OpenStack Summit, KubeCon, AI Summit, or similar industry events. jobs.jd: Agency Dept of Health and Human Services Division Secretary's Office Job Classification Title Program Coordinator II (S) Position Number 60037796 Grade NC10 About Us The North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) is one of the largest, most complex agencies in the state, and has approximately 17,000 employees. It is responsible for ensuring the health, safety, and well-being of all North Carolinians, providing human service needs for special populations including individuals who are deaf, blind, developmentally disabled, and mentally ill, and helping poor North Carolinians achieve economic independence. Description of Work Primary Purpose of the Organizational Unit: - The Office of Government Affairs serves as the primary liaison between the NC Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) and the North Carolina General Assembly, the Governor’s Office, and other key North Carolina stakeholders. The unit manages department-wide legislative coordination processes that require collaboration with stakeholders across DHHS. - The Office of Government Affairs works to advance the Department’s mission by shaping health and human services policy, providing timely legislative analysis, and ensuring effective communication with policymakers. The Government Affairs Team is a part of the Office of the Secretary and works closely with the Policy, Communications, and Legal teams – and plays a critical role in supporting leadership priorities, fostering collaboration across divisions, and promoting policies that improve the health, safety, and well-being of all North Carolinians. Primary Purpose of the Position: - The Legislative Analyst is a key member of the Government Affairs and Policy teams, responsible for analyzing pending legislation, tracking legislative activity, and coordinating engagement with internal and external stakeholders. This position ensures timely and accurate legislative analysis that is critical to informing the department’s engagement with the legislature to advance DHHS priorities. - This position serves as the primary coordinator for the DHHS Legislative Analysis (“Bill Review”) Program, ensuring consistent processes, timely review, and cross‑division alignment across more than 15 divisions - If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, have strong organizational and communication skills, and are interested in state government, we encourage you to apply. The right candidate will uphold the highest standards of confidentiality and professionalism. Duties and Responsibilities: (1) Legislative Review and Analysis - Review and track all legislation introduced at the North Carolina General Assembly; identify bills impacting DHHS or other stakeholders; monitor committee meetings, floor sessions, and legislative calendars; listen to proceedings as needed and provide timely summaries to Government Affairs and Policy leadership. (2) Manage the DHHS Legislative Analysis (“Bill Review”) Process - Coordinate the Bill Review process across more than 15 divisions; communicate with division leadership and subject matter experts; review submitted analyses, provide feedback, and ensure all bill summaries and analysis are accurate, complete, and submitted on deadline. This work requires managing program workflows, exercising independent judgment in reviewing division submissions, and ensuring alignment and quality across all participating divisions (3) Briefing Materials and Legislative Preparation - Prepare weekly summaries of legislative activity; develop briefing materials, presentations, and supporting documents for leadership engagement with the General Assembly, including testimony at legislative hearings. (4)Program Stakeholder and Event Coordination - Coordinate program-related briefings, events, and engagement opportunities with internal and external stakeholders; support Government Affairs and Policy leadership in legislative planning and ongoing special projects. (5) Information Request Coordination - Track and coordinate requests for information from the Office of Government Affairs; collaborate with division leadership and subject matter experts to develop responses; ensure timely communication to internal and external partners. jobs.title: AI Resident
jobs.jd: Why RoboForce RoboForce is an AI robotics company developing Physical AI–powered Robo-Labor for dull, dirty, and dangerous work. The company’s robots are engineered for demanding industrial environments, with a focus on real-world deployment and scalability. The AI Residency Program The AI Residency Program is designed for exceptional early-career researchers and engineers who want to tackle some of the hardest problems in robotics and AI. Residents will work alongside a deeply technical team on core challenges in embodied physical intelligence, including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, World Models, World Action Models, and 3D foundation models, as well as the full stack of real-world learning—from efficient data collection systems and simulation to reinforcement learning and deployment on physical robots. This is a hands-on residency for people who want to do ambitious work with real consequences: building learning systems that connect perception, reasoning, and action in service of capable, deployable robots. What makes this program different is the direct connection between research and real-world deployment. Residents work with actual RoboForce robots, iterate quickly between simulation and physical execution, and contribute to systems designed for real use. The problems are hard, the standards are high, and the goal is to build systems that matter outside the lab. Research Focus Areas As an AI Resident, you may contribute across several core areas: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for general-purpose robotic behavior World Models for predictive modeling, planning, and long-horizon decision-making World Action Models for jointly modeling action and environment dynamics Simulation and sim-to-real transfer for scalable training, evaluation, and data generation Reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and policy optimization for embodied agents Multimodal learning across vision, language, proprioception, force, and action Learning systems for manipulation and real-world embodied interaction What You’ll Do Conduct research and build systems for embodied physical intelligence Develop and evaluate methods in VLA, World Models, World Action Models, simulation, and RL Design and run experiments on robotics tasks involving perception, planning, control, and long-horizon behavior Build training and evaluation pipelines for large-scale embodied learning systems Work closely with research and engineering teams to move ideas from prototype to real or simulated robot platforms Explore how multimodal foundation models can improve robot capability in real deployment settings Contribute to technical reports, internal research discussions, and, where appropriate, publications Basic Qualifications PhD student, recent graduate, or early-career researcher/engineer in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow Experience using AI-assisted coding tools and agentic development workflows to prototype, iterate, and build quickly Ability to implement, debug, and evaluate research ideas in a fast-moving environment Strong engineering judgment, including the ability to validate, refine, and productionize AI-assisted code Preferred Qualifications Rich hands-on experience in robotic manipulation, mobile manipulation, or industrial robotics Experience training, fine-tuning, or evaluating multimodal or embodied models Experience with World Models, action-conditioned prediction, model-based learning, planning, or control Strong hands-on experience with simulation platforms such as Isaac Gym, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, ManiSkill, Habitat, or similar systems Experience with reinforcement learning, imitation learning, or post-training for robotic policies Experience working with real robot hardware, data collection systems, evaluation workflows, or deployment pipelines Demonstrated technical initiative through research, open-source contributions, or high-impact engineering work Compensation and Resources Duration: 3–6 months, full-time Compensation: $10,000 monthly salary Benefits: Company-provided lunch and dinner, a fully stocked kitchen, and team events Premium fitness center membership covered by the company Resources: Access to large-scale GPU clusters and production-grade infrastructure, with dedicated support to enable fast, uninterrupted experimentation on ambitious robotics and AI workloads

We treat their capital like our own. We ship leverage, not features. And we measure ourselves by customer results, not our intentions. Move with Urgency & Purpose. We own outcomes, not just tasks. We hold a high Say:Do ratio and take responsibility from idea through impact. When something breaks, we fix it — we don't wait to be asked. Never Satisfied. What You'll Bring 2–4+ years of experience in revenue enablement, training, instructional design, or a related field — with demonstrated ability to own programs end-to-end and produce measurable outcomes. • Skilled facilitation and training delivery — you present to groups with clarity, engage diverse audiences, and adapt your approach based on the room and the objective. Strong writing skills — you create compelling, clear content across formats, from training decks and playbooks to quick reference guides and videos. An analytical and metrics-driven mindset — you identify trends, measure impact, and use data to continuously improve your enablement programs. A collaborative, solution-oriented approach — you work effectively with sales leaders, product teams, and cross-functional partners, building trust through the quality and relevance of your work. A solid and growing understanding of the B2B sales process, sales methodology, and the revenue metrics that matter to sales leadership. jobs.jd: About AppLovin AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. About the Role We are seeking a smart, hardworking Business Operations Analyst to provide technical and operational support to our Business Operations (BizOps) team and the systems supporting our mobile-advertising business. A central part of this role is helping other BizOps analysts deliver reliable projects. You will review their code, debug existing workflows, investigate product issues, and translate business problems into actionable requests for Engineering and Operations. You will also write and maintain your own workflow code and analyze product features and experiments. You will serve as a practical link between business and technical teams. We’re looking for someone who learns quickly, investigates problems independently, exercises good judgment, and follows issues through to resolution. AI-assisted development is a regular part of how our team works. You should be effective at using these tools and reviewing the code they produce, with the technical understanding to identify mistakes, challenge assumptions, and guide work toward reliable results. Responsibilities Support projects led by other BizOps analysts, helping clarify requirements, review technical approaches, and resolve implementation problems. Debug issues in existing workflow code, integrations, and data processes. Investigate root causes and implement or coordinate fixes. Review BizOps pull requests, including substantial AI-generated changes, for correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with business requirements. Provide actionable feedback and verify that concerns are addressed. Write and maintain Python code, SQL workflows, integrations, and automations supporting the team’s work. Investigate product bugs, distinguish expected behavior from defects, and gather evidence through code, logs, data, and reproducible examples. Write clear tickets for Engineering and Operations that explain the problem, business impact, supporting evidence, and expected outcome. Follow up on dependencies and verify resolutions. Manage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services supporting BizOps workflows, including service accounts, permissions, secrets, configuration, and deployments. Support Salesforce workflows and integrations, including programming against its application programming interfaces (APIs). Analyze product features, experiments, and operational and advertising data. Apply appropriate statistical methods, interpret results accurately, and explain limitations. Investigate discrepancies across internal systems and partner platforms. Prioritize competing requests and communicate findings, decisions, blockers, and next steps through concise Slack messages, tickets, and documentation. Qualifications At least two years of relevant professional experience in business operations, technical operations, analytics, software development, or a related field. Demonstrated technical ability through a bachelor’s degree in a field such as engineering, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or physics, or through substantial technical work, research, or projects. Strong problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar systems, connect information across sources, and work through ambiguous problems. A strong work ethic and sense of ownership: you take initiative, persist through difficult problems, and follow work through to completion. Good judgment about data quality, system changes, permissions, and operational risk. You recognize which problems you can resolve independently and when additional expertise or review is needed. Effective use of AI coding and workflow tools to develop, review, and maintain substantial volumes of code. You can evaluate generated work, identify mistakes, and steer it toward the intended outcome. Practical experience with Python, SQL, Git, pull-request workflows, and APIs, including investigating and debugging existing code. Hands-on experience managing GCP services and workflows, including permissions, credentials, configuration, and troubleshooting. Experience applying statistical analysis and data science techniques, including selecting appropriate methods, interpreting results accurately, and explaining limitations. Experience in advertising technology, with a working understanding of areas such as campaign delivery, attribution, measurement, mediation, monetization, or the iOS and Android ecosystems. Clear, concise written communication. You can explain technical issues in business terms, document reproducible problems, and write requirements and tickets that others can act on. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting internal tools, reviewing other people’s code, or coordinating technical work across business, Engineering, and Operations teams. Experience with Salesforce administration, reporting, permission models, or integrations. Experience maintaining production automations, data pipelines, or shared internal applications. assessing profitability and capital efficiency in a rapidly evolving industry Attention to detail and patience for getting to the source of truth on complex and interconnected underlying financial and computing infrastructure, including data centers, cloud service providers, etc Preferred qualifications 7+ years of experience in strategic finance, infrastructure investment, private equity, growth equity, consulting, or investment banking, preferably with telecom, datacenter, or network infrastructure experience 3+ years of experience specifically in network infrastructure financial management lease economics, contract structures, and pricing models Experience with capital project or long-lead equipment economics Proficiency with financial modeling tools and languages (SQL, Python, Excel) We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. jobs.jd: Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Maintain tools, equipment and personal protective equipment in an organized fashion. Maintain workspaces in a clean and sorted fashion. jobs.title: FP&A Analyst
jobs.jd: CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats. CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com . Role Overview: FP&A owns the long-range plan, the company-wide forecast, and the board and investor materials. As department count and spend grow with headcount, this role gives each partner area a dedicated finance partner. As an FP&A Analyst, you’ll serve as a business partner to functional leaders (e.g., Engineering, G&A and S&M leaders), tracking spend, forecasting, and explaining what’s driving the numbers. Coverage areas may change as the company scales. Ownership over: Rolling forecast inputs from partner areas to the company-wide forecast Monthly variance reporting for your partner areas Monthly headcount cost reconciliation with People Ops Partner reporting and dashboards, built on the Datarails platform Responsibilities: Partner with functional leaders on budget ownership, headcount and vendor spend decisions, and resource tradeoffs Translate current and past financial and operational data into clear recommendations for functional leaders Build and maintain recurring analyses for partner areas Identify and implement process improvements to streamline manual workflows and enhance reporting accuracy Areas of accountability: Own the monthly forecast and budget-to-actual inputs for your partner areas Develop your partner areas’ inputs to the company-wide forecast and annual plan Track actuals against plan, identify variances, and drive root-cause conversations with partners Prepare analysis and talking points for leadership, and support board and investor materials as needed Minimum Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or other related field, or equivalent work experience 2+ years in FP&A, corporate finance, or a related analytical role, supporting forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills Comfortable with AI tools and finding ways to automate manual work Familiarity with finance systems (ERP such as NetSuite; FP&A planning tool such as Datarails) Can operate independently and carry projects forward with minimal direction Comfortable in a fast-paced, changing environment and managing multiple priorities Exceptional business partnering and communication skills with ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders Preferred Requirements: Aerospace, defense, or hardware/manufacturing finance experience Familiarity with Foundry or other similar data platforms Exposure to international or multi-region financial reporting Why CHAOS? Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company Additional benefits : 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices Salary Range: $88,000 - $120,000 The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. jobs.title: Strategic Finance Associate (FP&A)
jobs.jd: About Mach Industries Founded in 2023, Mach Industries is a rapidly growing defense technology company focused on developing next-generation autonomous defense platforms. At the core of our mission is the commitment to delivering scalable, decentralized defense systems that enhance the strategic capabilities of the United States and its allies. With a workforce of approximately 350 employees, we operate with startup agility and ambition. Our vision is to redefine the future of warfare through cutting-edge manufacturing, innovation at speed, and unwavering focus on national security. We are dedicated to solving the next generation of warfare with lethal systems that deter kinetic conflict and protect global security. The Role The Strategic Finance Associate (FP&A) will support the development and scaling of Mach’s Strategic Finance capability. Working with finance leadership and cross-functional partners, this hands-on individual contributor will help develop planning, forecasting, modeling, and reporting processes, and use them to connect product and operational performance to financial outcomes and business decisions. Success in this role requires developing a deep, end-to-end understanding of Mach’s products: how they are designed, engineered, manufactured, and financed. The Associate will work closely with engineering, design, manufacturing, Accounting, and business leaders, bringing a product, engineering, manufacturing, design, and finance mindset to the work. Key Responsibilities Help develop the foundational planning cadence, including the annual budget, rolling forecasts, assumptions, and stakeholder inputs. Work with cross-functional teams to develop deep knowledge of Mach’s products, roadmap, and operating model, and translate product and operational plans into financial drivers. Help develop and maintain driver-based models covering revenue, costs, headcount, production capacity, capital needs, and product or program economics. Analyze actual results against plan and forecast, explain variances, and identify underlying business drivers. Help develop management reporting and KPIs, including consistent metric definitions and reliable data sources. Partner with Accounting on monthly results and contribute to documenting processes and improving model accuracy and data quality as the function scales. Support scenario analysis for business and investment decisions, and communicate concise, actionable financial insights. Support special projects and strategic initiatives as assigned. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field. 2–6 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, accounting, financial analysis, investment banking, consulting, or a related field. Strong Excel and financial modeling skills. Understanding of financial statements and accounting principles. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Ability to build processes in an ambiguous, evolving environment and manage competing priorities. Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work across finance and technical teams. Ability and interest in learning complex products in depth and translating engineering, design, and manufacturing details into financial drivers. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting the development or improvement of budgeting, forecasting, or reporting processes. Familiarity with ERP, financial planning, BI, or reporting systems such as Power BI or Tableau. Experience with manufacturing, product or program economics, production costs, or capital planning. Progress toward an MBA, CPA, CFA, or other relevant credential. Additional Requirements Available to work extended hours and weekends as needed ITAR Requirements To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here . Pay Range $140,000 — $170,000 USD At Mach, we believe that compensation is more than just a paycheck. It's a comprehensive package designed to reward the time, skills, and expertise you bring to our team. We are committed to offering competitive compensation that is equitable, transparent, and aligned with market trends. Key Elements of Our Compensation Philosophy: Competitive Salaries : We continuously research market rates to ensure our salaries are competitive with those in our industry and geographic location. Performance-Based Incentives : Our bonus structure is tied to both individual and company performance, creating a win-win scenario that motivates our team members to excel. Equity Participation : We offer stock options or equity to employees, ensuring that you share in the success and growth of the company. Benefit Packages : Our benefits include healthcare, dental and vision plans, retirement savings, and paid time off, because we understand that your well-being extends beyond the office. Professional Development : We allocate funds for continuing education, training, and career growth. Transparency : We are committed to openness about our compensation tiers and how decisions are made, ensuring trust and mutual respect. By joining Mach, you’re not just accepting a job—you’re becoming a key part of a team that values your contributions and invests in your growth. Together, we aim to create a rewarding environment that sets the stage for long-term success. Data Privacy To view Mach Industries candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://machindustries.com/privacy-policy . Disclosures This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Please note that any offer for employment may be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations without sponsorship for an export license. Mach participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offers may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and training, critical skills, and business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in most offers and are considered part of Mach’s total compensation package. Mach offers benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, and opportunities for professional development. Mach is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws. If you’d like to defend the American way of life, please reach out!

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst
jobs.jd: Who We Are At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more. About the Opportunity The Compliance Analyst conducts day-to-day monitoring, triage, and execution of electronic communications surveillance across email, chat, messaging platforms, and digital communication channels. Working within established procedures and SLAs, this role executes high-volume alert processing, identifies potential risk indicators, and escalates non-standard cases. This role reports to the Director of Anti-Bribery, Corruption & Conduct and supports the team by leveraging AI-assisted tools and ensuring high precision in daily surveillance operations. What You’ll Be Doing Operational Surveillance & Risk Detection Execute Primary Triage: Perform daily review and triage of e-communications alerts across email, chat, text, and messaging channels within target SLA timelines. Identify Risk Indicators: Apply foundational compliance and regulatory guidelines to detect potential policy breaches, misconduct, or operational risk indicators. Maintain Audit-Ready Records: Execute precise data entry and case logging to ensure complete, compliant documentation for audit trails. Case Processing & Escalation Gather Case Context: Conduct initial background gathering and evidence collection on flagged communications to support case evaluations. Draft Clear Case Notes: Prepare structured, fact-based summaries outlining key findings for non-standard alerts requiring upper-level review. Escalate Complex Issues: Promptly escalate ambiguous, high-risk, or complex matters to senior analysts and leadership. Operational Efficiency, AI & Continuous Improvement Meet Volume & Quality Targets: Consistently hit daily output targets (KPIs) while maintaining strong precision in case evaluations. AI Tooling & Automation: Utilize AI-assisted surveillance platforms, prompt engineering, and automated workflow enhancements to streamline alert review and triage quality. Support Lexicon & Model Tuning: Identify recurring false positives and operational bottlenecks, providing feedback to help refine alert parameters and ML /AI model accuracy Drive Process Enhancement: Bring strong intellectual curiosity and a proactive mindset to continuously challenge existing surveillance workflows, proposing innovative ways to improve operational efficiency. Expand Domain Knowledge: Actively participate in ongoing training to build technical expertise across crypto regulations, market conduct rules, and emerging compliance technologies. What We Look For In You Mandarin Language Proficiency: Fluent in Mandarin (written and spoken) to support regional, cross-border, and multi-lingual e-communications surveillance across global team channels. AI & Technical Aptitude: Hands-on experience working with AI-driven compliance tools, large language models (LLMs), or automated workflow tools to enhance daily analytical tasks. Mindset & Drive: Strong curiosity and an inherent drive to continuously refine processes, automate repetitive tasks, and elevate overall team performance. Analytical Skills: Strong attention to detail with the ability to synthesize unstructured text data, spot nuances, and present concise findings. Education / Experience: BA/BS in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Nice to Haves Prior exposure to specialized e-communications surveillance software (e.g., Smarsh, Behavox, Relativity) or lexicon/keyword monitoring tools. Understanding of market abuse indicators, insider trading, or conduct risk concepts within financial services or digital assets. Background in crypto, digital assets, Web3, or multi-lingual operational support. Perks & Benefits Competitive total compensation package L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development Various team building programs and company events Wellness and meal allowances Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants More that we love to tell you along the process! OKX Statement: OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. The salary range for this position is $53,000 - $79,000 The salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. In addition to the salary, a performance bonus and long-term incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, as well as a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. jobs.title: Research Participants - Customer Service (Fully Remote)
jobs.jd: Survey Participant - UK Resident (Task-Based, Remote, Flexible) Location: Remote (UK) Type of contract: Freelance Hourly Rate: £19 (pay based on actual study time) About Prolific Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills. The Role Do you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews.We’re inviting UK residents to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change.Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal. The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can. What you’ll be doing Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part What you’ll bring Residence in the UK Fluent English A device with a working microphone No specialist background or qualifications required, all backgrounds are welcomed. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population. Why join this project? This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution. Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities. Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home. We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity. Links to more information on Prolific Website Youtube Privacy Statement By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.

 • Provide ongoing production support for SAP Finance, including reviewing, troubleshooting, prioritizing, and resolving incidents, support tickets, and service requests. • Perform root cause analysis improvements. • Lead functional enhancements from requirements gathering and solution design through configuration, testing, defect resolution, and deployment. • Prepare clear documentation, teams and cross-functional SAP consultants to deliver reliable, end-to-end solutions. • Bachelor’s Degree • Travel up to 20% • 5+ years of SAP Finance experience in a manufacturing environment with a minimum of 2 full-cycle SAP implementations. • Strong understanding of finance and accounting business processes, with hands-on expertise in SAP FI configuration and functionality. • Experience providing production support, managing support tickets, performing root cause analysis, and resolving functional and technical issues. • Experience with SAP FI integration across other functional modules and the ability to troubleshoot cross-functional business processes. • Experience delivering functional enhancements across the SAP lifecycle, including requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and hypercare. • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with business and technical teams. • Knowledge of AI tools, Machine Learning and Big Data a plus • Knowledge of common interfaced tools, such as tax automation, vendor invoice management (VIM), and compliance SaaS products • SAP Costing experience • International project or SAP configuration experience in NAFTA, LATAM and/or EMEA, including relevant localization topics related to tax and financial legislature • Knowledge of financial reporting as it pertains to SOX compliance, public companies, etc. • S/4 Public and/or Private Cloud certification About Reply 
Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services. www.reply.com 
The base compensation range for this full-time position is between $110,000 - $150,000 plus benefits. jobs.title: Product Data Scientist - Youth, Families and Learning
jobs.jd:
About the role

We’re looking for a product data scientist to help OpenAI create more value and drive sustainable growth for young people, families, and learners. You’ll drive product data science across under-18 audiences, emerging opportunities for children under 13, family experiences, and learning and education more broadly.

You’ll help decide where we should invest, what we should build, and how we’ll know it is working. This means understanding distinct audience needs, identifying promising use cases, and turning evidence into a clear product strategy. Your work will connect discovery and early product development with adoption, retention, and sustained user value.

You’ll partner across Chat Product, Growth, Foundations, SafeSys, and other teams, working closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers. The role focuses and owns product value and growth while dedicated teams own policy and safety.

In this role, you will:

 - Shape strategy and prioritize opportunities. Size unmet needs and growth opportunities across audiences, use cases, and product experiences. Help teams choose where to invest and sequence work based on expected user value, reach, evidence, and effort.

 - Define what value and success mean. Develop an audience-specific measurement framework spanning activation, task success, learning progress, satisfaction, and durable retention. Connect these measures to product goals and assess whether repeat use reflects meaningful benefit.

 - Understand users and growth drivers. Analyze journeys, funnels, and cohorts to uncover where people find value, where they struggle, and what helps them return. Combine behavioral data with surveys and user research to explain differences across ages, family roles, and learning contexts.

 - Measure what changes actually cause. Design experiments and holdouts to evaluate product and model changes. Apply causal methods when randomization is impractical, make assumptions explicit, and account for seasonality, audience composition, and effects that differ across segments.

 - Turn findings into product decisions. Work with partners from initial hypotheses through launch and iteration. Recommend what to build, change, expand, or stop, explaining expected impact, uncertainty, and tradeoffs. Follow through to determine whether decisions delivered the intended results.

 - Build reliable measurement. Partner with engineering on instrumentation, dataset quality, and consistent audience definitions. Create reusable analyses and dashboards that make progress visible and let teams answer recurring questions independently.

 - Create alignment across teams. Bring a coherent view of audience value to work spanning multiple roadmaps. Help partners agree on priorities, success criteria, and the next questions to resolve, even when ownership is distributed and evidence is incomplete.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - A record of influencing product strategy and improving user outcomes through hands-on data science, including work from an ambiguous question to a decision and measurable impact.

 - Strong SQL and Python skills, sound statistical judgment, and practical experience with experiments, causal inference, cohort analysis, and measurement design.

 - The ability to develop useful definitions of product value, validate imperfect proxies, and distinguish short-term metric movement from lasting improvement.

 - Clear communication and strong product judgment. You can make a recommendation, explain its limits, and influence collaborators across functions without relying on formal authority.

 - Comfort setting priorities independently across a broad scope, staying close to users, and moving between strategic questions and detailed analytical work.

Helpful experience

Experience with consumer product growth, youth or family products, learning and education, or generative AI would be valuable. We also welcome experience measuring learning outcomes, combining quantitative and qualitative research, or evaluating products whose value emerges over time.

jobs.title: Vice President, UTA Advisory Business Operations
jobs.jd:
UTA Advisory seeks a Vice President, Business Operations who will build and lead the operating capability that connects commercial demand to workforce capacity, resource deployment, engagement execution and profitability. Serving as the central operating partner to Advisory leadership, this executive will establish the processes, systems and accountability needed to operate as an integrated business and deliver consistently as the portfolio grows.

 

The role translates booked work and qualified pipeline into actionable staffing and delivery plans, coordinates capabilities across teams, and identifies operational and economic risks before they affect execution. Success requires a commercially minded leader who can connect strategy to daily decisions, influence across functions and turn complex information into clear recommendations.

 

Performance will be evaluated against an agreed baseline and targets for forecast accuracy, utilization and chargeability, staffing responsiveness, engagement economics, scope and staffing variance, contractor spend, timely risk resolution, workforce approval revalidation and adoption of common operating practices.


 

This role owns operating integration, capacity visibility, deployment coordination and the evidence supporting staffing recommendations. Business leadership retains client relationships, commercial strategy and delivery quality; Finance retains budgets, financial forecasting, accounting and financial controls; People retains organization design, workforce strategy and talent decisions. Creative leadership retains creative strategy and quality. Final workforce investment approval follows existing company governance.

 


ABOUT UTA ADVISORY

 

UTA Advisory drives growth by turning culture, entertainment, sports and marketing into business advantage. The business brings together insight, strategy, creativity, activation and measurement to help consumer and enterprise clients build relevance, revenue and measurable impact through UTA’s talent, creator, partnership and platform ecosystem.

 


 


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 

Integrated Business Operations

·       Build and continuously improve the engagement lifecycle from qualified opportunity and scope development through staffing, kickoff, delivery, economic review and closeout; establish clear handoffs, stage gates and escalation paths.

·       Connect Advisory capabilities and relevant agency resources around client demand, enabling coordinated delivery and expansion across services in partnership with commercial and account leaders.

·       Lead weekly pipeline and resource reviews, delivery reviews, monthly operating reviews and quarterly capacity reviews; ensure decisions have accountable owners and follow through.

Workforce Capacity and Deployment

·       Maintain a rolling 90–180-day view of demand, headcount, utilization, chargeability, skills, availability and contractor requirements across Advisory.

·       Translate qualified opportunities into resource requirements by capability, level, skill, timing, duration, geography and shared-resource dependency; compare probability-weighted demand with available capacity.

·       Coordinate enterprise staffing and resolve resource conflicts using business priorities, delivery risk and economics. Assess redeployment, staffing mix, shared resources, work sequencing and flexible capacity before recommending permanent headcount.

·       Lead the operational evidence review for workforce investment requests; partner with Finance and People on affordability and organization design, track time-bound approvals and coordinate 90-day or earlier revalidation when assumptions change.

Commercial Planning and Engagement Economics

·       Partner with Enterprise Sales, business leaders and subject-matter experts to validate delivery feasibility, staffing assumptions, timing, shared-resource needs and resource costs before significant proposals or statements of work are finalized.

·       Partner with Finance to monitor engagement margin, revenue and margin per head, staffing mix, utilization, resource cost and scope variance; coordinate corrective action with the leaders accountable for the work.

·       Identify under-scoping, resource inefficiencies and avoidable external spending; provide staffing scenarios and operational recommendations that support sustainable growth and profitability.

Portfolio Delivery and Shared Capabilities

·       Maintain a consolidated portfolio view of active and upcoming engagements, staffing, milestones, dependencies and delivery risks; coordinate Closed-Won handoffs, kickoff readiness, scope-change escalation and closeout.

·       Establish intake, prioritization, workflow and deployment practices for Creative and other shared capabilities, balancing competing demand and internal versus external resource use.

·       Capture delivery lessons and actual-versus-plan results to improve future scoping, staffing, forecast accuracy and readiness for client expansion.

Systems Business Intelligence and Change Leadership

·       Lead the business requirements and adoption of connected Salesforce, Hive and Finance reporting workflows, in partnership with system owners; define resource taxonomy, data standards, project setup and reporting responsibilities.

·       Build reliable dashboards linking pipeline, capacity, utilization, engagement economics, headcount, contractor spend and delivery risk; present executive recommendations with clear implications and tradeoffs.

·       Validate available system functionality before designing automation, including skills-based resource matching; simplify processes and lead adoption across legacy teams.

·       Assess existing resources and capabilities before proposing the function’s team structure; develop and lead the approved team while coordinating dotted-line operating relationships.

Leadership Expectations

·       Apply critical thinking and strategic judgment to connect commercial, workforce and delivery signals; anticipate issues and recommend practical solutions.

·       Communicate with clarity and executive presence, adapting detail to the audience and making decisions, ownership and next steps explicit.

·       Build trust and accountability across teams; navigate competing priorities, invite constructive challenges and resolve disagreements with evidence and sound judgment.

·       Coach and motivate team members through clear expectations, timely feedback, meaningful learning and recognition of achievement; delegate responsibility and create opportunities for developing talent.

·       Maintain fluency in culture, the marketplace and the agency’s capabilities; help junior colleagues understand how their work connects to client outcomes and business performance.


 


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

 

·       Substantial progressive experience in business operations, resource management or professional services delivery, including senior leadership responsibility in an agency, consultancy or comparable client-service business.

·       Proven ability to build an integrated operating model across teams or business units and lead implementation through influence as well as direct authority.

·       Strong command of capacity forecasting, utilization, staffing models, engagement economics and contractor-versus-permanent workforce tradeoffs.

·       Experience connecting CRM, resource or project management systems and financial reporting; Salesforce and Hive experience is preferred, with comparable platforms also relevant.

·       Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with business leadership, Sales, Finance, People, Legal, Creative and technology teams.

·       Excellent analytical, communication, executive presentation and people-development skills; comfort operating through ambiguity and managing sensitive business information.

·       Experience in marketing, media, entertainment, sports, creators or culture-driven ad

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor
jobs.jd:
THE PROBLEM

As Flock expands across communities, our logistics footprint and hub operations are growing to support increased field activity and product distribution. You'll take ownership of our hub operations in Dallas, TX leading daily execution, inventory auditing, facility management, and site safety standards.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Valid forklift license with demonstrated skill in operating material handling equipment safely.

 - Practical experience with spreadsheet tools like Google Sheets or Excel, as well as software platforms like Salesforce, Slack, or Coupa.

COMPENSATION

#ZR

 🌟 The impossible takes every kind of mind. jobs.title: CRM Integration Consultant
jobs.jd:
ABOUT AVOCA

Avoca is transforming how home service companies engage with their customers. Our AI-powered conversational agents handle every high-value inbound call, from booking jobs, qualifying leads, and driving higher revenue, all at a speed and consistency unmatched by human call centers.

We're a Series B startup backed by Kleiner Perkins, Meritech Capital, General Catalyst, and other top-tier investors, with $125M raised and a $1B valuation. We grew 10x in 2025 and have scaled to 170+ employees in under two years across our NYC headquarters and Santa Barbara office.

In a $1T+ market where 85% of missed calls go to competitors, we're building the category-defining platform for AI-driven customer engagement, serving the largest brands in home services. With high-energy, in-office teams in both locations, every hire here has an immediate and visible impact.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a CRM Integration Consultant to join our Delivery organization and bring deeper expertise in the home-services CRM platforms our customers use. Our customers' use existing CRM configurations to support workflows like booking, scheduling, and dispatch.

In this role, you'll work closely with our Delivery and Technical Account Management teams to review customer CRM setups, troubleshoot booking and capacity challenges, and help customers optimize their existing workflows. You'll also work directly with customers to resolve more complex configuration and integration issues, share best practices, and support successful implementations.

We're looking for someone with deep, hands-on ServiceTitan experience who understands how home-services businesses operate and enjoys solving technical and operational challenges. This is a hands-on, fast-paced role where you'll work directly with customers to navigate complex CRM configurations, troubleshoot issues, and drive them to resolution quickly so implementations can keep moving.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Serve as Avoca's internal CRM expert, initially focused on ServiceTitan, supporting Implementation, CS, Support, and Product.

 - Review and optimize customer CRM configurations, including booking, scheduling, dispatch, and capacity workflows.

 - Work directly in customers' CRM environments, with their authorization, to troubleshoot issues, make configuration changes, and resolve implementation blockers.

 - Troubleshoot CRM integration issues, including booking failures, sync mismatches, and configuration-related challenges.

 - Train internal teams and customers on CRM best practices, common workflows, and troubleshooting.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering to identify recurring issues and improve integration functionality.

 - Develop repeatable configuration guides and processes to reduce implementation delays and improve efficiency.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 3+ years of hands-on experience configuring and administering ServiceTitan, ideally within a home-services business or consulting environment.

 - 2+ years of relevant experience preferred or Home Service industry knowledge and experience (preferred)

 - Strong understanding of CRM booking, scheduling, dispatch, capacity management, and related configuration workflows.

 - Experience troubleshooting complex CRM configurations, identifying issues, and making changes directly within customer systems.

 - Ability to work independently, manage multiple customer requests, and resolve technical issues quickly.

 - Strong communication skills and experience working directly with customers and cross-functional teams.

 - ServiceTitan certification preferred, but not required.

 - Experience with other home-services CRMs (Housecall Pro, PestPac, FieldEdge, etc.) or SaaS integrations is a plus.


WHO YOU ARE

 - Self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and comfortable operating in fast-moving, high-growth environments.

 - Thrives on owning processes end-to-end and balancing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

 - Autonomous, self-directed, and comfortable working with ambiguity.

 - A proactive and effective communicator.

 - Collaborative, organized, and efficient.

 - Comfortable with travel to customer sites and occasional visits to our NYC or Santa Barbara offices.


BENEFITS

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Company-sponsored 401(k) through Vestwell

 - Flexible PTO plus U.S. federal holidays

 - Company-wide off-sites

 - Daily in-office lunch through Parkday

 - Dinner covered when working late

 - Commuter benefits and late-night rideshare

 - Standing desks and workspace accommodations available on request

 - All core tools and software provided

Compensation: The expected base salary for this role is $120,000 - $150,000, with final compensation based on experience, skills, and qualifications determined during the interview process. Avoca's total compensation package includes base salary, bonus, equity, and a comprehensive suite of benefits and perks. Our Recruiting team will share the full details as you progress through our hiring process.







WHY AVOCA

At Avoca, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining company at the center of a massive market opportunity. We’re a fast-moving, collaborative team with a culture designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and impact.
